Abstract: Multimodal hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Standard textual Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) often fails to mitigate it due to a lack of explicit visual supervision. While existing works introduce visual preference DPO by contrasting original images against negative ones, they suffer from a theoretically inconsistent objective caused by partition function mismatches and rely on coarse-grained negatives that could enable shortcut learning. In this work, we propose In-Context Visual Contrastive Optimization (IC-VCO). By placing contrastive images within a shared multi-image context, IC-VCO ensures a mathematically rigorous objective. We further introduce Visual Contrast Distillation (VCDist), an auxiliary reliability-gated regularizer that encourages consistency between multi-image contrastive training and single-image inference. Finally, we propose a contrastive sample editing strategy that generates hard negatives via precise semantic perturbations. Experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate IC-VCO's best overall performance and the effectiveness of our sample editing strategy. Code and data are available at https://github.com/OPPO-Mente-Lab/IC-VCO.

</details>


### [77] [DecMem: Towards Minute-Long Consistent World Generation with Decoupled Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31336)
*Zhenhao Yang,Xiaoshi Wu,Zhengyao Lv,Xiaoyu Shi,Xintao Wang,Pengfei Wan,Kun Gai,Kwan-Yee K. Wong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DecMem，一种解耦的记忆架构，通过稀疏全局记忆和锚定局部记忆实现分钟级可控长视频生成，在细粒度时空一致性上显著超越当前方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型在长程推理下难以保持细粒度时空一致性，而显式3D记忆和粗粒度帧级隐式建模存在局限；朴素可学习记忆架构在长程外推中面临计算效率低下和注意力分散两大根本性问题。

Method: 提出DecMem解耦记忆架构：1) 稀疏全局记忆（Sparse Global Memory）实现高效细粒度的全局历史访问；2) 锚定局部记忆（Anchored Local Memory）实现稳定高质量的外推。

Result: DecMem在长视频生成任务上显著优于当前最先进方法，实现了分钟级可控长视频生成，具有高保真度和一致性。

Conclusion: 通过精确高效的长期记忆和优越的外推能力，DecMem成功解决了长程可控视频生成中的时空一致性问题。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generative models have promoted rapid progress in controllable world models. However, maintaining fine-grained spatio-temporal consistency under long-horizon reasoning remains a key challenge. In this work, we move beyond explicit 3D memory and coarse frame-level implicit modeling, and propose a fine-grained, learnable, and scalable memory for consistent world generation. We first identify two fundamental limitations of naïve learnable memory architectures in long-horizon extrapolation, namely computational inefficiency and attention dispersion. Through a systematic analysis of attention dispersion, we propose DecMem, a decoupled memory architecture that employs Sparse Global Memory for efficient fine-grained access to global history and Anchored Local Memory for stable and high-quality extrapolation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecMem significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art methods. By ensuring precise and efficient long-term memory and achieving superior extrapolation capabilities, DecMem enables minute-level controllable long video generation with high fidelity and consistency.

</details>


### [78] [FSM-Net: An Efficient Frequency-Spatial Network for Real-World Deblurring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31400)
*Vinh-Thuan Ly*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FSM-Net，一种频率-空间多分支网络，在NTIRE 2026高效真实去模糊挑战赛中获第二名，以4.94M参数和159.35 GMACs在RSBlur基准上达到33.144 dB PSNR，实现了效率与质量的最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实图像去模糊需要在高保真恢复与计算效率之间取得平衡，现有方法难以兼得。

Method: 提出FSM-Net，包含频率注意力模块（通过FFT显式恢复高频结构细节）、瓶颈处的交叉门控视觉E-Branchformer（以线性复杂度捕获全局依赖），以及渐进式课程训练策略与复合损失函数（多尺度Charbonnier、结构边缘和频率损失）。

Result: 在RSBlur基准上PSNR达33.144 dB，仅4.94M参数，1920×1200分辨率下159.35 GMACs。

Conclusion: FSM-Net有效推动了效率与质量的帕累托前沿，为资源受限的图像恢复任务建立了强基线。

Abstract: Real-world image deblurring demands both high-fidelity restoration and computational efficiency, a balance existing methods often struggle to achieve. In this paper, we propose FSM-Net (Frequency-Spatial Multi-branch Network), a highly efficient solution that secured 2nd place in the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Efficient Real-World Deblurring. FSM-Net pioneers a dual-domain approach: a novel Frequency Attention module explicitly recovers high-frequency structural details via FFT, while a Cross-Gated Vision E-Branchformer at the bottleneck captures global dependencies with linear complexity. To ensure robust convergence, we employ a progressive curriculum training strategy guided by a composite loss function (Multi-Scale Charbonnier, Structural Edge, and Frequency). Evaluated on the RSBlur benchmark, FSM-Net achieves an outstanding 33.144 dB PSNR with only 4.94M parameters and 159.35 GMACs (at 1920x1200 resolution). By effectively pushing the Pareto frontier of efficiency and quality, FSM-Net establishes a strong baseline for resource-constrained image restoration.

</details>


### [79] [YARD: Y-Architecture Register Decoding for Efficient Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31429)
*Ting Chen,Geng Li,Guohao Chen,Yu Hu,Guan Huang,Mai Chen,Langsheng Lei,Jun Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: YARD提出了一种基于Y型架构的寄存器解码框架，通过在中间层分支并替换视觉token为寄存器token来构建内部退化分支，无需完整前向传播即可实现高效的对比解码，在多个LVLM上取得了最先进的幻觉缓解效果并显著降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练自由的对比解码方法存在两个问题：一是完全丢弃视觉token过于极端，会引发语言幻觉；二是通过破坏输入图像来控制视觉证据的方式粗粒度且需要两次完整前向传播，推理延迟高。此外，现有方法缺乏对文本-视觉对齐在模型中何处发生的深入洞察。

Method: YARD框架包含三个关键设计：(1) 基于"可靠的文本到视觉定位主要出现在中间解码器层"的观察，在中间层进行分支，共享浅层计算；(2) 退化分支中用寄存器token替换patch级别的视觉token，保留全局图像语义但缺乏细粒度局部证据；(3) 采用Y型架构避免第二次完整前向传播，只需一次计算即可获得两个输出分布。

Result: 在生成式和判别式幻觉基准测试上，YARD在多个LVLM上一致取得了最先进的幻觉缓解效果，同时显著降低了推理延迟。

Conclusion: YARD通过Y型架构和寄存器token设计，在保持图像感知能力的同时提供可靠的对比信号，有效解决了现有对比解码方法中退化分支质量差和推理效率低的核心矛盾。

Abstract: Contrastive decoding (CD) seeks to mitigate hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by contrasting the output distributions of a standard model and a visually degraded model. However, existing training-free CD methods suffer from sub-optimal degraded branches: completely dropping visual tokens is too extreme and induces language hallucinations, while corrupting input images offers coarse control over visual evidence and suffers from high inference latency due to requiring two full forward passes. To address these dilemmas, we propose YARD, a training-free Y-Architecture Register Decoding framework. Motivated by the observation that reliable text-to-vision grounding predominantly emerges in the middle decoder layers, YARD constructs the degraded branch internally by sharing shallow-layer computations and branching exactly at this critical stage. For the degraded branch, YARD replaces patch-level visual tokens with register tokens, which preserve global image semantics but lack fine-grained local evidence. This image-aware yet locally under-grounded design provides a faithful contrastive signal without extreme modality mismatch, while the Y-architecture strictly avoids a costly second forward pass. Extensive experiments on generative and discriminative hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that YARD consistently achieves state-of-the-art hallucination mitigation across multiple LVLMs, alongside a significant reduction in inference latency.

</details>


### [80] [Astra: a generalizable report generation foundation model for 3D computed tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31437)
*Zhuhao Wang,Fang Chen,Chaohui Yu,Zihan Li,Yuchao Zheng,Jing Wang,Xuan Yang,Jia Guo,Zhenlu Yang,Xingju Zheng,Yihua Sun,Haojie Han,Xiaoxiao Qin,Zhan Feng,Wenbo Xiao,Chao Zhu,Yuehua Li,Shipeng Zhang,Hao Luo,Yunsong Peng,Fan Wang,Hongen Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Astra，一个基于90,678对胸腹CT-报告对（涵盖353,671个异常、8个器官系统）训练的可泛化CT报告生成基础模型。通过报告风格统一和强化学习优化诊断一致性，Astra在多个外部队列中实现SOTA性能（细粒度诊断指标平均提升44.1%），在真实临床工作流中加速胸部报告起草29.6%并提升腹部报告完整性11.3%，同时作为CT AI开发的基础设施可提升下游诊断性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT报告生成耗时且高度依赖专家经验，现有方法缺乏支持多区域报告且在外部真实世界队列中保持鲁棒性的通用基础模型；不同队列间的报告风格和诊断术语内在不一致性导致朴素联合训练易受噪声文本监督影响，限制了模型泛化能力。

Method: 收集90,678对胸腹CT-报告构建CTRgDB数据集（涵盖353,671个异常、8个器官系统）；通过报告风格统一（harmonization）解决跨队列风格不一致问题；利用强化学习进一步优化诊断一致性，实现风格一致且诊断准确的报告生成。

Result: 在CTRgDB和六个外部队列上达到SOTA性能，细粒度诊断指标平均提升44.1%（P<0.001）；临床工作流中加速胸部报告起草29.6%，提升腹部报告完整性11.3%（P<0.001）；通过高质量报告合成提升下游诊断性能和视觉-语言预训练效果。

Conclusion: Astra作为广泛可用的临床辅助工具和下一代AI医疗的关键基础设施，验证了大规模多区域CT报告生成基础模型的可行性与临床价值。

Abstract: CT interpretation requires radiologists to review hundreds of volumetric slices per examination, making reporting time-consuming and highly expertise-dependent. Automated CT report generation offers a promising route to improving clinical efficiency, yet the field still lacks a generalizable CT report generation foundation model that supports multi-region reporting and remains robust across external real-world cohorts. Intrinsic inconsistencies in reporting style and diagnostic terminology across cohorts make naive joint training prone to noisy textual supervision, thereby limiting model generalizability. Here we present Astra, a generalizable CT report generation foundation model trained on 90,678 thoracoabdominal CT-report pairs (CTRgDB) with 353,671 abnormalities spanning eight organ systems. By harmonizing report style and further refining diagnostic consistency via reinforcement learning, Astra achieves style-consistent and diagnostically accurate report generation across diverse anatomical regions and institutions. Evaluating on CTRgDB and six external cohorts, Astra achieves state-of-the-art performance with a 44.1% average improvement in fine-grained diagnostic metrics (P<0.001). In real-world clinical workflows, Astra assistance accelerates chest report drafting by 29.6% and improves abdominal report completeness by 11.3% (P<0.001). Furthermore, Astra also demonstrates broad utility as a foundation for CT AI development, improving downstream diagnostic performance and scaling vision-language pretrain through high-quality report synthesis. Overall, Astra serves as a broadly accessible clinical assistant and a pivotal infrastructure for the next generation of AI-powered healthcare.

</details>


### [81] [VisionPulse: Dynamic Visual Sparsity for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31457)
*Hengbo Xu,Shengjie Jin,Yanbiao Ma,Zhiwu Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VisionPulse提出了一种在推理过程中逐步剪枝视觉令牌的框架，仅保留5%的关键视觉令牌，将推理轨迹缩短11.2%，同时几乎不影响准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常在预填充阶段静态剪枝视觉令牌，忽视了视觉证据在推理过程中是逐渐依赖且动态变化的。冗余视觉上下文会引导模型关注无关区域，延长推理轨迹，造成推理时开销瓶颈。

Method: 提出VisionPulse框架，计算轻量级视觉注意力质量来估计每步的保留预算（利用其与有效视觉令牌使用率的强正相关性），在该预算下仅保留最关键的视觉令牌，强制推理时视觉稀疏性。

Result: 每步仅保留5%的视觉令牌，推理轨迹缩短11.2%，准确性几乎保持不变。

Conclusion: 视觉证据是逐步依赖且动态变化的，通过逐步剪枝冗余视觉令牌可自然缩短推理轨迹，实现高效的LMM推理。

Abstract: With the rapid advancement of large multimodal models (LMMs), inference-time overhead has become a key bottleneck for real-world deployment. Existing methods typically prune visual tokens at prefill, assuming the required visual evidence remains static during reasoning. However, we empirically show that visual evidence is strongly step-dependent: only a sparse subset of visual tokens is critical at each decoding step, and the critical set evolves across reasoning. Furthermore, we identify a coupled bottleneck where redundant visual context can steer the model toward query-irrelevant regions, lengthening the reasoning trace. Guided by these insights, we propose VisionPulse, a step-wise visual token pruning framework during reasoning. VisionPulse computes a lightweight visual attention mass to estimate the step-wise retention budget by exploiting its strong positive correlation with LMMs' effective visual token usage and retain only the most critical tokens under this budget. By enforcing visual sparsity during reasoning, VisionPulse filters redundant visual context while preserving relevant visual evidence, shortening reasoning traces naturally. Extensive experiments show that VisionPulse only retains 5% of visual tokens per step with reasoning traces shortened by 11.2%, while keeping accuracy almost unchanged.

</details>


### [82] [VolFill: Single-View Amodal 3D Scene Reconstruction with Volumetric Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31466)
*Tuan Duc Ngo,Chuang Gan,Evangelos Kalogerakis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VolFill是一种基于生成式框架的3D场景补全方法，利用混合3D VAE和潜在扩散Transformer，从单张RGB图像重建完整场景几何结构，在SCRREAM和NRGB-D数据集上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单张RGB图像重建完整场景几何结构仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在推断被遮挡区域的隐藏结构时，传统像素对齐回归方法难以处理视觉证据不完整的情况。

Method: 采用混合3D VAE将稀疏截断无符号距离函数网格压缩到紧凑潜在空间，结合潜在扩散Transformer去噪恢复完整场景；以几何基础模型为条件生成，利用丰富的空间先验进行稳健推理。

Result: 在SCRREAM和NRGB-D数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于当前基线方法。

Conclusion: VolFill提供了支持直接表面提取和大规模占用查询的结构化表示，为整体空间理解提供了稳健基础，克服了现有方法受限于逐射线约束或非结构化点云查询的局限。

Abstract: Reconstructing the complete geometry of a scene from a single RGB image remains challenging - especially when inferring hidden structures where visual evidence is incomplete. We introduce VolFill, a generative framework that predicts the 3D structure of the complete scene rather than relying on traditional pixel-aligned regression. Our method utilizes a hybrid 3D VAE to compress sparse truncated unsigned distance function grids into a compact latent space, paired with a latent Diffusion Transformer that denoises this representation to recover the complete scene. We condition the generation on geometry foundation models, leveraging rich spatial priors for robust reasoning. Unlike existing methods limited by per-ray constraints or unstructured point-cloud queries, VolFill provides a structured representation that supports direct surface extraction and occupancy queries at scale. Extensive experiments on the SCRREAM and NRGB-D datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms current baselines, providing a robust foundation for holistic spatial understanding.

</details>


### [83] [Enhancing Computer Vision Model Generalization in Warehouse Facilities: A Case Study on Anomaly Detection in Vertical Material Handling Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31487)
*Ruiliang Liu,Tina Dongxu Li,Joshua Migdal,Ken Meszaros,Trevor Dardik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种创新方法，通过在实验室环境中完成计算机视觉模型的标注和训练，通过优化相机 placement、触发策略、模型选择和集成，使模型能够直接泛化到不同仓库设施，从而省去了传统部署中在每个新环境重复进行数据采集、标注和再训练的繁琐过程，仅需安装相机、采集图像和部署模型即可。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统仓库视觉模型部署需要在每个新环境中重复进行相机安装、图像采集、标注、训练和部署等大量工作，资源消耗巨大且流程繁琐。本文旨在简化这一流程，减少部署时间和资源开销。

Method: 仅在实验室环境中执行标准流程（包括数据采集和标注），通过优化相机放置位置、图像触发策略、模型选择以及模型集成等关键因素，实现从实验室到多种仓库环境的有效泛化。

Result: 实验表明，结合最优相机 placement、策略性图像触发、精心模型选择和模型集成，能够实现从实验室条件到多样仓库设施环境的有效泛化，将部署简化为仅需相机安装、图像采集和模型部署三个步骤。

Conclusion: 该方法可大幅节省以往用于图像标注和模型再训练的资源与时间，有潜力变革仓库自动化实现方式。研究属于实验性质，尚未投入生产部署。

Abstract: Deploying computer vision models in Warehouse Facilities traditionally requires extensive resources for camera mounting, image collection, annotation, training, and deployment - a process often needing repetition in each new environment due to camera mounting constraints and environmental variability. This paper explores an innovative approach to streamline this process by conducting the standard procedure solely in a laboratory setting, focusing on vertical material handling systems and anomaly detection in forks of the systems. Through extensive experimentation, we have found that combining optimal camera placement, strategic image triggering, careful model selection and model ensemble enables effective generalization from laboratory conditions to diverse warehouse facilities environments, potentially transforming warehouse automation implementation by simplifying warehouse facilities deployment to just camera mounting, image collection, and model deployment, thereby saving significant resources and time typically spent on image annotation and model retraining. This is an experimental research study and not a production deployment.

</details>


### [84] [How can embedding models bind concepts?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31503)
*Arnas Uselis,Darina Koishigarina,Seong Joon Oh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）在概念绑定（确定哪个颜色属于哪个形状）上的局限性，发现CLIP的绑定函数复杂度高，导致无法泛化到未见过的概念组合；而通过充分数据训练的Transformer模型可以学习低复杂度的绑定函数（特征为概念间的乘法交互），实现系统性泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能轻松将颜色与形状正确绑定，但CLIP等视觉-语言模型虽然能识别单个概念，却无法表示哪些概念构成同一物体。作者希望探究这种绑定失败的根本原因，以及是否可以通过模型设计克服。

Method: 通过绑定函数的概念框架，分析CLIP场景嵌入的加性分解特性，发现其绑定函数具有高复杂度；然后通过从头训练的受控Transformer模型，在充分数据覆盖下验证绑定泛化是否可能。

Result: CLIP的场景嵌入可加性分解为物体表示，但绑定函数复杂度高，阻碍了跨概念组合的泛化；而Transformer在充足数据下可学习低复杂度的绑定函数，依赖概念间的乘法交互实现系统性泛化。

Conclusion: 概念绑定的泛化并非CLIP架构的固有限制，而是数据覆盖和绑定函数复杂度的问题；低复杂度的乘法交互绑定函数是关键。

Abstract: Humans easily determine which color belongs to which shape in multi-object scenes, an ability known as concept binding. Vision-language embedding models such as CLIP struggle with binding: they recognize individual concepts but fail to represent which concepts form which objects. Although CLIP behaves like a bag-of-concepts model in cross-modal retrieval, object information is recoverable from its image and text embeddings separately. We study this tension through the binding function, which maps concepts to scene embeddings. We find that scene embeddings decompose additively into object representations, explaining why uni-modal probes can recover object information. However, CLIP's binding function is high-complexity, which likely prevents the image and text encoders from learning a shared binding mechanism that generalizes to unseen concept combinations. We then ask whether this limitation is fundamental. We show that it is not. In controlled transformer models trained from scratch, binding generalization emerges with sufficient data coverage. These models learn low-complexity binding functions characterized by multiplicative interactions between concepts, enabling systematic generalization. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/oshapio/binding-concepts-complexity.

</details>


### [85] [Internalizing Temporal Consistency in Video Object-Centric Learning without Explicit Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31508)
*Rongzhen Zhao,Zhiyuan Li,Juho Kannala,Joni Pajarinen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出xSSC框架，通过时序通道分解（CCD）和跨时重建（CTR）两个近零开销机制，替代了视频目标中心学习中广泛使用的Slot-Slot对比损失（SSC），在提升训练效率的同时实现了视频目标发现与识别任务的新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频OCL方法依赖SSC损失来保持时序一致性，但SSC需要帧间一对一的物体对应关系且引入额外损失项，违背奥卡姆剃刀原则。作者认为时序一致性应作为隐式模型设计而非显式损失来强化。

Method: 提出xSSC框架，包含两个协同机制：(i) 时序通道分解（CCD）沿通道维度将slot表示结构化解耦为静态子空间（编码时不变语义）和动态子空间（编码时变运动学）；(ii) 跨时重建（CTR）将当前slot的静态通道与目标slot的动态通道融合，随机重建当前或前一时间步的目标特征，仅使用标准OCL解码器加少量训练适配。

Result: 将xSSC集成到主流基线方法中，不仅提升了训练效率，还在视频目标发现与识别任务上取得了新SOTA。PCA和梯度分析验证了对象时不变语义和时变运动学分别被编码到所提出的子空间中。

Conclusion: 时序一致性可以通过精巧的模型设计隐式实现，无需显式对比损失，这为视频OCL提供了一种更简洁、高效的范式。

Abstract: Video Object-Centric Learning (OCL) aims to represent objects as \textit{slot} vectors and maintain their consistency across frames. Slot-Slot Contrastive (SSC) loss has become the cornerstone for state-of-the-art (SOTA) video OCL methods. While highly effective, SSC relies on one-to-one object correspondence across frames and introduces an extra loss. Following Occam's Razor, we propose a paradigm shift: temporal consistency is better enforced as an implicit model design rather than an explicit loss. To elegantly exclude SSC (\textbf{xSSC}), we introduce two quasi-zero-overhead synergistic mechanisms: (\textit{i}) Chrono-Channel Decomposition (CCD) structurally disentangles slot representations along the channel dimension into \textit{static} and \textit{dynamic} sub-spaces, serving as an empirically unified information bottleneck; (\textit{ii}) Cross-Temporal Reconstruction (CTR) stochastically reconstructs target features of either the current or previous time step by fusing current slots' static channels and target slots' dynamic channels, using a single standard OCL decoder with minor training adaptation. Thereby, the slot sets inherently learn temporal consistency by minimizing the standard reconstruction error alone. Extensive experiments show that integrating xSSC into leading baselines not only improves training efficiency but also establishes new SOTAs on video object discovery and recognition tasks. Furthermore, our PCA and gradient analyses confirm that objects' time-invariant semantics and time-variant kinematics are encoded into the proposed sub-spaces. Our source code, model checkpoints and training logs are provided on https://github.com/Genera1Z/xSSC.

</details>


### [86] [Personalize Your Large Vision-language Models With In-context Prompt Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31513)
*Yanshu Li,Jiaqian Li,Kuai Yu,Xi Xiao,Dongfang Liu,Tianyang Wang,Ruixiang Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出上下文提示调优（ICPT）方法，通过轻量级投影模块和几何正则化，实现高效、准确的多图像多概念LVLM个性化，达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM个性化方法依赖推理时训练，效率低下；且在复杂多图像、多概念场景下难以保持准确性，限制了LVLM系统的广泛部署。

Method: 提出ICPT方法：1) 轻量级投影模块提取多参考图像中的细粒度视觉语义，将其与身份-标签映射转换为连续提示；2) 根据每个概念的视觉复杂度自适应确定提示长度；3) 引入两种几何正则化——解耦关键身份与瞬态环境、分离概念以避免语义混淆。

Result: 在多种任务和LVLM主干网络上，ICPT在个性化准确性上达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: ICPT通过上下文提示调优与几何正则化，有效解决了LVLM个性化中的效率与精度问题，为复杂场景下的个性化部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong general multimodal capability and are increasingly deployed in downstream systems. This trend has driven growing interest in LVLM personalization, which aims to enable models to quickly and effectively learn out-of-distribution multimodal concepts to meet user-specific needs. However, many existing methods rely on inference-time training, which reduces efficiency. They also struggle to maintain accuracy in complex multi-image, multi-concept settings. These limitations restrict the broader deployment of LVLM-based systems. Therefore, this paper proposes in-context prompt tuning (ICPT). Specifically, ICPT employs a lightweight projection module capable of operating in complex scenarios to extract fine-grained visual semantics from multiple reference images, seamlessly transforming these features alongside identity-label mappings into continuous prompts. To maximize computational efficiency, this module adaptively determines the prompt length based on the intrinsic visual complexity of each concept. Crucially, to overcome the environmental biases and cross-concept interference prevalent in real-world applications, we introduce two novel geometric regularizations. These constraints refine prompt representations by decoupling key identities from transient environmental states and separating concepts to avoid semantic confusion. Extensive experiments show that ICPT achieves state-of-the-art personalization accuracy across diverse tasks and LVLM backbones.

</details>


### [87] [SVI-Bench: A Dynamic Microworld for Strategic Video Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31529)
*Yulu Pan,Han Yi,Seongsu Ha,Md Mohaiminul Islam,Benjamin Zhang,Lorenzo Torresani,Gedas Bertasius*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SVI-Bench基准，通过团队体育视频评估从感知到因果推理、战略模拟到智能体决策的战略视频智能（SVI）能力。基准包含35K小时广播视频等大规模数据，定义9项任务和四层能力层级，发现现有模型在感知任务（约73%准确率）与高级认知任务（最低仅5%准确率）之间存在显著能力断崖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准存在两难困境：真实世界视频缺乏因果和战略问题的可验证标准答案，而合成环境又牺牲了真实多智能体系统的复杂性。需要建立一个既能保持真实世界复杂性又具有可验证性的基准来评估视频智能从感知到决策的完整能力栈。

Method: 利用团队体育作为动态微世界，通过数据引擎将原始比赛数据转换为密集交叉引用的语料库，构建包含35K小时广播视频、15M标注动作、15K小时专家解说、23K比赛报告和103K结构化统计记录的大规模基准。定义动态场景理解、因果推理、战略模拟和智能体合成四层能力层级共9项任务。

Result: 强多模态和智能体基线的评估显示：感知任务表现尚可（细粒度动作QA约73%准确率），但每上升一个认知层级性能急剧下降。智能体任务最难，最强模型在需要自主收集和整合180万片段语料证据时仅达到5%准确率。

Conclusion: 当前视频智能模型在感知层面已具备一定能力，但因果推理、战略模拟和自主决策等高级认知能力严重不足，存在显著的能力断崖，需要进一步发展面向结构化因果推理和自主证据整合的视频智能方法。

Abstract: True video intelligence demands more than recognizing what is visible: it requires reasoning about why events unfold, predicting what would change under different conditions, and deciding what to do next. We refer to this progression, from perception through causal reasoning and simulation to strategic planning, as Strategic Video Intelligence (SVI). No existing benchmark evaluates this capability stack: in-the-wild videos lack verifiable ground truth for causal and strategic questions, while synthetic environments sacrifice the complexity of real multi-agent systems. To bridge this gap, we introduce SVI-Bench, a large-scale benchmark that leverages team sports as a dynamic microworld, combining the complexity of real-world multi-agent interaction (10-22 agents making coordinated decisions under adversarial pressure) with the verifiability of explicit rules and definitive outcomes. SVI-Bench comprises approximately 35K hours of broadcast video, 15M annotated actions, 15K hours of expert commentary, 23K game reports, and 103K structured statistical records across basketball, soccer, and hockey, all constructed via a data engine that transforms raw game data into a dense, cross-referenced corpus. We organize evaluation into 9 tasks spanning a progressive four-pillar hierarchy: Dynamic Scene Understanding, Causal Reasoning, Strategic Simulation, and Agentic Synthesis. Evaluating strong multimodal and agentic baselines, we find a capability cliff: models perform competently on perceptual tasks, achieving approximately 73% on fine-grained action QA, but degrade sharply at each successive cognitive level. Agentic tasks prove hardest: the strongest model achieves only 5% accuracy when required to autonomously gather and integrate evidence across a corpus of 1.8M clips.

</details>


### [88] [Feature-Optimized Vision for Adaptive 3D Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31534)
*Eric Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种面向3D重建的自适应特征优化前端策略，通过对候选特征进行纹理、可重复性、区分性、三角测量角度和空间覆盖的多维度评分，并为每视图分配特征预算以最大化有效轨迹，相比随机、纯纹理和均匀网格基线，在保持广泛图像覆盖的同时获得了最佳质量感知完整性和最低重建RMSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的固定特征阈值和均匀特征预算容易部署，但会在重复纹理、低视差区域或不稳定点上浪费计算资源，因此需要一种能够自适应分配计算资源的特征选择方法。

Method: 对候选特征进行纹理、可重复性、区分性、预期三角测量角度和空间覆盖五个维度的评分，然后为每视图分配特征预算以最大化有用轨迹，在小型合成多视图原型上评估了四种选择策略。

Result: 自适应策略在走廊、立面、物体-桌面和杂乱场景中相比随机、纯纹理和均匀网格基线，获得了最佳质量感知完整性和最低聚合重建RMSE，同时保持广泛的图像覆盖。

Conclusion: 该方法并非替代现代 learned matching 或神经重建系统，而是一种模块化的前端策略，可使经典和 learned 3D 重建管道更加审慎地选择计算资源投入的视觉证据。

Abstract: Three-dimensional scene reconstruction depends on local image evidence that is both visually discriminative and geometrically useful. Fixed feature thresholds and uniform feature budgets are easy to deploy, but they can waste computation on repeated texture, low-parallax regions, or unstable points. This paper proposes an adaptive feature-optimized vision front end for 3D reconstruction. The method scores candidate features by texture, repeatability, distinctiveness, expected triangulation angle, and spatial coverage, then allocates a per-view feature budget to maximize useful tracks under a fixed reconstruction pipeline. A small synthetic multi-view prototype evaluates four selection policies across corridor, facade, object-table, and cluttered scenes. Compared with random, texture-only, and uniform-grid baselines, the adaptive policy obtains the best quality-aware completeness and the lowest aggregate reconstruction RMSE while preserving broad image coverage. The result is not a replacement for modern learned matching or neural reconstruction systems; it is a modular front-end policy that can make classical and learned 3D pipelines more deliberate about which visual evidence they spend compute on.

</details>


### [89] [RayDer: Scalable Self-Supervised Novel View Synthesis from Real-World Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31535)
*Ulrich Prestel,Stefan Andreas Baumann,Nick Stracke,Björn Ommer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RayDer 是一种统一的前馈 Transformer，将相机估计、场景重建和渲染整合到单一骨干网络中，将自监督新视角合成（NVS）转化为单模型扩展问题。通过最小动态状态吸收时变内容，利用动态视频数据作为可扩展监督，在多个模型规模和基准上展现出清晰的幂律缩放行为，零样本性能可与有监督方法竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督新视角合成（NVS）由于真实视频训练的脆弱性以及多网络系统设计的难预测缩放行为，难以大规模扩展，尽管视频数据十分丰富。

Method: 提出 RayDer，一种统一的、前馈的 Transformer 架构，将相机估计、场景重建和渲染合并到单个骨干网络中；引入最小动态状态作为干扰因素，吸收时变内容以实现稳定训练。

Result: 在不同模型规模和数量级的数据上展现出清晰的幂律缩放行为；在多个基准上取得与有监督方法相当的强零样本开放集性能。

Conclusion: RayDer 证明了将自监督 NVS 转化为单模型缩放问题的可行性，动态内容仅作为可扩展监督而非重建目标，实现了高效且可预测的规模化训练。

Abstract: Self-supervised novel view synthesis (NVS) remains challenging to scale, despite the abundance of video data, largely due to the brittleness of training on realistic videos and the hard-to-predict scaling behavior of multi-network system designs. We introduce RayDer, a unified, feed-forward transformer that consolidates camera estimation, scene reconstruction, and rendering into a single backbone, turning self-supervised NVS into a well-posed single-model scaling problem. A minimal dynamic state, treated as a nuisance factor, absorbs time-varying content and enables stable training on unconstrained real-world video. Importantly, RayDer keeps static-scene NVS as its target task: dynamic content is leveraged purely as scalable supervision, not reconstructed as in dynamic-scene (4D) NVS. Across multiple model sizes and orders of magnitude in data, RayDer exhibits clean power-law scaling with data and compute, and outperforms static-scene data mixtures. On a large number of benchmarks, RayDer achieves strong zero-shot open-set performance competitive with state-of-the-art supervised approaches. Project Page: https://compvis.github.io/rayder

</details>


### [90] [Automated Prediction of Postoperative Pancreatic Fistula Using Preoperative Computed Tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31539)
*Ashok Choudhary,Chris Varghese,Leo Y. Li-Han,Frank G. Lee,Ellen L. Larson,Elizabeth B. Habermann,Cornelius A. Thiels,Hojjat Salehinejad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种端到端的深度学习流程，从胰腺CT分割到分类，用于术前预测胰腺切除术后胰瘘（POPF）风险，在多个3D架构上展现了有前景的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术后胰瘘（POPF）是胰腺切除术后严重的并发症，增加发病率、住院时间和医疗成本。现有方法缺乏自动化的术前风险评估工具，因此需要开发一种基于术前CT的自动化风险分层方法。

Method: 构建了从胰腺自动分割到分类的端到端深度学习流程；数据集包含自动分割的胰腺体积和手术结果；评估了多个3D架构，包括自定义轻量级3D CNN基线（CNN3D）、R(2+1)D ResNet-18和ResNet-MC3-18模型。

Result: 在多个3D架构上的评估展示了有前景的预测性能。

Conclusion: 该方法为胰腺CT分类提供了临床有价值的工具和方法论基准，有助于改善胰腺手术的术前决策。

Abstract: Postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF) is a serious complication after pancreatic resection, increasing morbidity, hospital stay, and healthcare costs. We present an automatic, end-to-end deep learning pipeline-from pancreatic segmentation to classification-for preoperative POPF risk estimation and stratification using preoperative CT scans. A data set with auto-segmented pancreas volumes and surgical outcomes was used to evaluate multiple architectures, including a custom lightweight 3D CNN baseline (CNN3D), R(2+1)D ResNet-18, and ResNet-MC3-18 models. Evaluation across multiple 3D architectures demonstrated promising predictive performance. This approach offers a clinically valuable tool and a methodological benchmark for pancreas-specific CT classification, supporting improved preoperative decision-making in pancreatic surgery.

</details>


### [91] [SMART: SMPLest-X Mesh Adaptation and RAFT Tracking for Soccer Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31551)
*Parthsarthi Rawat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SMART方法在FIFA骨骼追踪挑战赛中，通过微调SMPLest-X模型，结合分层片段分割、多任务深度监督、广播增强、RAFT光流相机追踪、足部平面锚定和两遍时域平滑等技术，在验证集上取得0.647分（较基线提升38.6%），测试集达0.593分（全局MPJPE: 0.324m，局部MPJPE: 0.054m）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从广播视频中准确估计足球运动员的3D世界空间姿态，以超越现有基线方法（FIFA基线1.053）。

Method: 基于SMPLest-X (ViT-H, 687M参数)微调，采用分层片段分割、多任务深度监督、广播增强、RAFT稠密光流相机追踪、足部平面锚定、两遍时域平滑。

Result: 验证集0.647（较基线1.053提升38.6%），测试集0.593（全局MPJPE 0.324m，局部MPJPE 0.054m）。

Conclusion: SMART方法显著优于FIFA基线，证明了多策略融合在广播视频3D姿态估计中的有效性。

Abstract: We present our approach to the FIFA Skeletal Tracking Challenge 2026, which requires estimating 3D world-space poses of soccer players from broadcast video. Our method finetunes SMPLest-X (ViT-H, 687 M parameters) via a stratified clip split, multi-task depth supervision, and broadcast augmentation, paired with a RAFT dense optical flow camera tracker, foot-plane anchoring, and two-pass temporal smoothing. Against the FIFA baseline score of 1.053 on the validation set, SMART achieves 0.647, a 38.6% improvement; on the held-out test set, SMART scores 0.593 (Global MPJPE: 0.324 m, Local MPJPE: 0.054 m).

</details>


### [92] [EGOSTREAM: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Streaming Episodic Memory in Egocentric Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31557)
*Rosario Forte,Giuseppe Lando,Antonino Furnari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了Egostream，一个用于评估自我中心视觉中连续 episodic 记忆的诊断基准，包含2,250个问题（扩展至8,528个），涵盖七个认知维度，并引入答案有效性窗口（AVW）来区分真实遗忘与自然世界状态变化。实验表明现有记忆管理机制（滑动窗口、注意力汇聚、KV缓存剪枝、合并和卸载）均远低于实时处理能力，最高准确率仅约45%，揭示了当前架构的关键缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流式视频基准缺乏诊断模型记住了什么以及记忆持续时间的工具，无法有效评估自主智能体在动态真实环境中的连续 episodic 记忆能力。

Method: 构建Egostream基准，包含2,250个精心设计的问题（覆盖细节、空间、时间、事件、社交、因果和前瞻七个认知维度），并引入答案有效性窗口（AVW）来指定答案随场景变化而保持有效的时间范围，将问题扩展为8,528个基于回忆条件的评估。在统一的Qwen3-VL骨干上对多种记忆管理机制（滑动窗口、注意力汇聚、KV缓存剪枝、合并、卸载）进行标准化基准测试。

Result: 所有现有机制均远低于实时处理（>1秒/帧），最佳方法准确率仅约45%。不同机制展现出截然不同的记忆特征：token剪枝在保留细粒度细节和时间结构方面显著优于token合并，量化卸载改善超长期回忆。总体准确率相近但记忆分布差异显著。

Conclusion: Egostream为诊断和弥补连续 episodic 记忆中的关键缺陷提供了所需的标准测试床，揭示了当前多模态大语言模型架构在流式记忆方面的重大瓶颈。

Abstract: Continuous episodic memory is a core capability for autonomous agents operating in dynamic, real-world environments, yet current streaming video benchmarks provide limited tools for diagnosing what models remember and for how long. We introduce Egostream, a diagnostic benchmark for streaming episodic memory evaluation in egocentric vision. \egostream organizes 2,250 curated questions along seven cognitive dimensions: detail, spatial, temporal, event, social, causal, and prospective memory. We introduce the Answer Validity Window (AVW), which specifies the temporal span an answer remains valid as the observed scene evolves. This allows us to expand the questions into 8,528 recall-conditioned evaluations, enabling controlled testing from instant to ultra-long-term recall while separating genuine model forgetting from natural world-state changes. We rigorously establish baseline performance through a unified streaming MLLM framework that compares several state-of-the-art memory-management mechanisms, covering sliding windows, attention sinks, KV-cache pruning, merging, and offloading. Experiments within a unified Qwen3-VL backbone reveal that comparable aggregate accuracies mask starkly different memory profiles. For instance, token pruning preserves fine-grained details and temporal structure significantly better than token merging, while quantized offloading rescues ultra-long-term recall. Ultimately, all mechanisms operate well below real-time (>1s per frame), and top performing methods ceil at about 45% accuracy, exposing critical gaps in current architectures. Egostream provides the diagnostic testbed needed to close these gaps. Project website, news and updates at: https://saroo25.github.io/Egostream/

</details>


### [93] [nuReasoning: A Reasoning-Centric Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Tail Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31572)
*Zhiyu Huang,Johnson Liu,Rui Song,Zewei Zhou,Ruining Yang,Yun Zhang,Tianhui Cai,Hanyin Zhang,Mingxuan Gao,Valeria Xu,Jiali Chen,Yishan Shen,Yiluan Guo,Tony,Qi,Jiaqi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: nuReasoning是一个大规模真实世界数据集和基准，专注于自动驾驶中的长尾场景推理，包含20,000个20秒长的剪辑片段，涵盖空间推理、决策推理和反事实推理三种推理标注，支持推理评估和规划评估。实验表明，在该数据集上微调VLM可显著提升驾驶问答性能，且将推理监督融入VLA训练即使在推理时禁用文本推理输出也能提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶数据集和基准主要针对感知、预测或规划任务，对长尾驾驶场景中的推理能力（如常识知识、空间关系、智能体交互推理和安全决策）提供的监督有限，缺乏专门用于推理中心的自动驾驶数据集。

Method: 构建nuReasoning数据集，包含20,000个20秒长剪辑片段（多城市采集），同步多摄像头图像、LiDAR数据、高清地图、物体标注以及人工验证的推理标注（空间推理、决策推理、反事实推理），支持推理评估和规划评估。

Result: 微调VLM可显著提升驾驶问答性能；将推理监督融入VLA训练即使在推理时禁用文本推理输出也能提升规划性能。

Conclusion: nuReasoning可作为在真实长尾场景中评估和改进鲁棒、可解释、推理驱动的自动驾驶系统的基础数据集和基准。

Abstract: Reasoning is essential for autonomous driving (AD) in long-tail scenarios, where vehicles must apply commonsense knowledge, understand spatial relations, infer agent interactions, and make safe decisions. However, existing AD datasets and benchmarks mainly target perception, prediction, or planning, and provide limited supervision for reasoning over realistic long-tail driving scenes. We introduce nuReasoning, a large-scale real-world dataset and benchmark for reasoning-centric AD. Following the lineage of nuScenes and nuPlan, nuReasoning advances real-world AD datasets and benchmarks toward reasoning in long-tail driving scenarios. The dataset contains 20,000 clips, each 20 seconds long, collected across multiple cities, with synchronized multi-camera images, LiDAR data, HD maps, object annotations, and human-verified reasoning annotations spanning Spatial Reasoning, Decision Reasoning, and Counterfactual Reasoning. Unlike prior datasets that focus primarily on visual question answering, nuReasoning supports both reasoning evaluation and planning evaluation, enabling a direct study of how reasoning supervision affects driving performance. Experiments show that fine-tuning VLMs on nuReasoning substantially improves driving-specific question answering, while incorporating reasoning supervision into VLA training improves planning performance even when textual reasoning outputs are disabled at inference time. These results establish nuReasoning as a foundation for evaluating and improving robust, interpretable, reasoning-driven AD systems in realistic long-tail settings.

</details>


### [94] [Joint Multi-Camera LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration via Learned Pairwise Initialization and Geometric Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31576)
*Aziz Al-Najjar,Marzieh Amini,James R. Green,Felix Kwamena*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种两阶段联合多相机-激光雷达外参标定框架，先对每个相机独立进行CMRNext配准得到初始外参和稠密2D-3D对应，再通过多帧光束法平差联合优化，将独立预测转化为全局一致的多相机标定结果。在KITTI上平移误差0.89 cm、旋转误差0.038°；在Walkley数据集上平移误差从108.6 cm降至3.1 cm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的相机-激光雷达标定方法将每个相机-激光雷达对独立处理，忽略了多相机平台中相机之间的刚性几何耦合，导致各相机标定结果单独准确但系统层面不一致。

Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段对每个相机独立应用CMRNext，生成初始外参估计和稠密2D-3D对应点；第二阶段通过多帧光束法平差联合优化，包含重投影误差项、每相机先验项和相对位姿先验项，将逐对预测转化为全局一致的多相机标定结果。

Result: KITTI数据集上平移误差0.89 cm、旋转误差0.038°；Walkley数据集上平移误差从108.6 cm降至3.1 cm，显著提升了单相机预测不可靠时的标定精度。

Conclusion: 显式建模多相机耦合能够有效提升系统级标定的一致性，尤其在单相机预测不可靠时优势明显。

Abstract: Most learning-based camera-LiDAR calibration methods treat each camera-LiDAR pair independently, ignoring the rigid geometric coupling in multi-camera platforms. As a result, per-camera estimates may be individually accurate yet inconsistent at the system level. We present a two-stage framework for joint multi-camera LiDAR extrinsic calibration that combines learned pairwise matching with geometric refinement. First, CMRNext is applied independently to each camera to produce initial extrinsic estimates and dense 2D-3D correspondences. These predictions are then jointly refined through a multi-frame bundle adjustment with reprojection, per-camera prior, and relative-pose prior terms. This approach converts pairwise predictions into a globally consistent multi-camera calibration. Experiments on KITTI (in-domain for CMRNext) and Walkley (out-of-domain) datasets show improved per-camera accuracy and inter-camera consistency. On KITTI, the method achieves 0.89 cm translation error and 0.038 rotation error. On Walkley, it reduces translation error from 108.6 cm to 3.1 cm, highlighting the benefit of explicit multi-camera coupling when single-camera predictions are less reliable.

</details>


### [95] [SurGe: Improved Surface Geometry in Point Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31577)
*Karim Knaebel,Gonzalo Martin Garcia,Christian Schmidt,Ilya Fradlin,Lucas Nunes,Daan de Geus,Bastian Leibe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对前馈3D重建方法局部表面几何不准确的问题，本文提出点图法线度量来更显式地评估局部表面方向误差，并通过点梯度匹配损失和邻域注意力解码器（NAD）两种互补组件来减少这些误差。所提出的SurGe模型在八个零样本单目几何基准上取得了最优平均排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈3D重建方法虽能较好地预测全局3D几何，但其预测的局部表面几何不准确，而常见评估指标对此类误差反映较弱。为使这些误差在评估中更显式化，并实际减少此类误差。

Method: 1) 提出点图法线度量（point map normal metric），通过评估相邻3D预测点诱导的局部表面方向来量化局部几何误差。2) 提出点梯度匹配损失（point gradient matching loss），对深度归一化的3D有限差分进行监督。3) 提出邻域注意力解码器（Neighborhood Attention Decoder, NAD），通过逐步上采样特征并使用邻域注意力进行局部特征混合。

Result: 在八个零样本单目几何基准上，SurGe模型在全局点图AbsRel指标上取得最佳平均排名，并在局部点图及点图法线评估上实现一致改进。

Conclusion: 本文提出的评估度量与模型组件有效解决了前馈3D重建中局部表面几何不准确的问题，实现了更高质量的3D重建。

Abstract: Recent feedforward 3D reconstruction methods predict point maps and estimate global 3D geometry remarkably well. However, their predictions still exhibit inaccurate local surface geometry, which is clearly visible qualitatively but only weakly reflected in common metrics. To make these errors more explicit in evaluation, we introduce a point map normal metric that evaluates the local surface orientation induced by neighboring 3D predictions. To reduce these errors, we propose two complementary components: a point gradient matching loss that supervises depth-normalized 3D finite differences, and a Neighborhood Attention Decoder (NAD) that progressively upsamples features and uses Neighborhood Attention for local feature mixing. Across eight zero-shot monocular geometry benchmarks, our model, SurGe, achieves the best average rank for global point map AbsRel and consistently improves local point map and point map normal evaluations.

</details>


### [96] [Recognizing Co-Speech Gestures in-the-Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31589)
*Sindhu B Hegde,K R Prajwal,Andrew Zisserman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了GRW数据集，这是首个大规模、帧级标注的共语手势识别基准，包含156,688个视频片段和150类词汇，用于训练模型区分语义手势、识别对应词语并定位时间边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态模型难以捕获与特定词语语义关联的共语手势，主要瓶颈在于缺乏精确标注的训练数据。

Method: 构建GRW数据集：包含156,688个手动标注的视频片段，覆盖150类词汇（包括物理动作、空间描述符和抽象概念），并基于该数据集训练视频模型完成三项任务：语义/非语义手势分类、手势对应词语识别、手势时间定位。

Result: 建立了GRW数据集作为上述三项任务的基准。

Conclusion: GRW数据集能够有效推动共语手势识别研究，为多模态模型在语义手势理解方面提供关键训练资源。

Abstract: While humans naturally gesture during speech, only a sparse subset of these movements are visually depictive and semantically linked to specific spoken words. Current multimodal models struggle to capture these semantic co-speech gestures, heavily bottlenecked by a lack of precisely annotated training data. To address this, we introduce the Gesture Recognition in the Wild (GRW) dataset, the first large-scale benchmark designed to map unconstrained human gestures to specific words with frame-accurate temporal boundaries. Comprising 156,688 manually annotated video clips, GRW spans a highly diverse 150-word taxonomy of physical actions, spatial descriptors, and abstract concepts. We leverage GRW to train video models to (a) classify gestures as semantic or not, (b) recognize the word corresponding to a co-speech gesture, and (c) temporally localize the gesture. We also use GRW to establish benchmarks for these three tasks.

</details>


### [97] [TunerDiT: Training-free Progressive Steering of Diffusion Transformer for Multi-Event Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31590)
*Ruotong Liao,Guowen Huang,Qing Cheng,Guangyao Zhai,Lei Zhang,Xun Xiao,Thomas Seidl,Daniel Cremers,Volker Tresp*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现视频扩散Transformer（DiT）在去噪轨迹中存在内在转折点，条件文本从影响全局布局逐渐过渡到细粒度细节。基于此，提出无需额外训练的渐进式引导方法TunerDiT，通过事件分区掩码和跨事件提示融合实现多事件视频生成，在8个指标上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频中多事件生成的挑战：现有方法难以在保持视频一致性的同时清晰地分离不同事件，且通常需要额外训练。

Method: (1) 事件分区掩码（Event-Partitioned Masking）：强制事件边界，同时允许跨事件过渡带；(2) 跨事件提示融合（Cross-Event Prompt Fusion）：注入相邻事件语义用于后期细化阶段。

Result: 在8个指标上达到SOTA性能，文本对齐改进随事件数量增加而提升，表明随事件数增长具有扩展可能性。

Conclusion: TunerDiT是一种有效的无需训练的多事件视频生成方法，可在视频一致性与事件分离之间实现可调平衡，并展现出随事件数量增加的扩展潜力。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation faces challenging questions when generating videos with long horizons containing multiple events. Inspired by the intrinsics of the diffusion process, we probe video diffusion transformers (DiTs) and uncover intrinsic turning points in the DiT denoising trajectory where conditioning text affects generation from global layout to fine-grained details. Building on this finding, we present TunerDiT, a simple yet effective progressive steering method that requires no additional training for multi-event generation. TunerDiT comprises two steering handles: (1) Event-Partitioned Masking that enforces event boundaries while allowing cross-event transition bands; (2) Cross-Event Prompt Fusion that injects neighboring event semantics for late-stage refinement. We contribute a self-curated prompt suite for benchmarking multi-event generation, i.e., Meve. TunerDiT achieves state-of-the-art performance across 8 metrics and offers a tunable trade-off between video consistency and event separation, compared with other training-free methods. The improvement in text alignment increases with the event count, indicating a scaling possibility with increasing event count.

</details>


### [98] [CoFiDA-M: Concept-Aware Feature Modulation for Cross-Domain Adaptation with Image-Only Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31591)
*Nurjahan Sultana,Moi Hoon Yap,Xinqi Fan,Wenqi Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoFiDA-M提出了一种特权信息框架，在训练时利用MONET基础模型提供临床概念概率来指导特征编辑，训练学生网络在测试时仅凭图像即可复现经语义编辑的特征表示，有效解决了皮肤癌筛查中从皮肤镜图像到临床图像的性能下降问题，在跨数据集基准测试中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI皮肤癌筛查模型从皮肤镜图像迁移到临床图像时性能严重下降，而当前的域适应方法忽略了临床概念等关键语义不变信息。尽管MONET等基础模型可提供密集概率化的语义信息，但这些元数据在测试时不可用，导致实际部署中的矛盾困境。

Method: 提出CoFiDA-M框架：1) 训练教师网络，利用MONET概念概率指导FiLM调制器将视觉特征转换为语义"编辑"后的特征空间；2) 训练轻量级图像-only学生网络，使其复现教师网络的编辑后表征（而非仅最终预测），通过蒸馏将临床推理"烘焙"到学生网络权重中。

Result: 在具有挑战性的多数据集基准测试上，图像-only学生网络显著优于现有最先进方法，尤其在黑色素瘤召回率方面表现突出，展现出强大的跨数据集鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CoFiDA-M提供了一个实用且通用的框架，能够利用带噪声的概率化元数据作为特权信息，不仅在皮肤科领域有效，还具备超越该领域的实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Models for AI-based skin cancer screening suffer a severe performance drop when shifting from expert dermoscopic (source) images to consumer-grade clinical (target) images, hindering real-world deployment. Existing domain adaptation methods often ignore crucial semantic invariants, such as clinical concepts. While new foundation models like MONET can provide this semantic information as dense, probabilistic scores, this metadata is unavailable at test time, creating a deployment paradox for practical image-only screening tools. We address this gap by proposing CoFiDA-M, a privileged information framework that learns from concepts at training time but deploys as an image-only model. Our method trains a teacher network that uses MONET concept probabilities to guide a FiLM modulator, transforming visual features into a semantically ``edited" feature space. A lightweight, image-only student is then trained to reproduce this edited representation, not just the teacher's final predictions. This distillation ``bakes" the clinical reasoning into the student's weights. On a challenging multi-dataset benchmark, our image-only student significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, especially in melanoma recall. Our work provides a practical and generalizable framework for leveraging noisy, probabilistic metadata as privileged information, demonstrating strong cross-dataset robustness and potential for real-world deployment beyond dermatology. Implementation code is available at: https://github.com/mmu-dermatology-research/CoFiDA.git

</details>


### [99] [Learning Global Motion with Compact Gaussians for Feed-Forward 4D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31595)
*Mungyeom Kim,Minkyeong Jeon,Honggyu An,Jaewoo Jung,Hyuna Ko,Jisang Han,Hyeonseo Yu,Donghwan Shin,Sunghwan Hong,Takuya Narihira,Kazumi Fukuda,Yuki Mitsufuji,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: C4G是一个基于可学习高斯查询令牌的4D重建框架，通过全局时序上下文聚合和视频扩散模型增强渲染，实现了无需相机位姿的高效动态场景重建与新视角合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈方法逐帧像素级预测3D高斯，存在高斯重复和视角依赖偏差问题，难以有效学习场景运动。因此需要一种能够全局建模运动、避免逐场景优化的高效动态场景重建方法。

Method: 提出C4G框架，核心是一组可学习的时间戳条件高斯查询令牌，每个令牌聚合全时序上下文特征并解码出位置受目标时间戳调制的3D高斯；引入视频扩散模型用于渲染增强；同时将特征聚合能力扩展至特征提升，构建4D特征场以支持点跟踪和动态场景理解。

Result: C4G在无需相机位姿的条件下，使用显著更少的高斯数量实现了强的新视角合成性能，运动建模能力更强，对大的时间间隙具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: C4G通过紧凑的可学习查询令牌和全局时序聚合机制，有效解决了现有前馈方法的高斯冗余和视角偏差问题，并在新视角合成、运动建模和时间鲁棒性方面取得领先性能，同时拓展至4D特征场支持下游任务。

Abstract: Dynamic scene reconstruction from monocular video remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Existing feed-forward methods predict 3D Gaussians pixel-wise for each frame, suffering from duplicated Gaussians and view-dependent biases that hinder effective learning of scene motion. We present C4G, a feed-forward 4D reconstruction framework built upon a compact set of timestamp-conditioned learnable Gaussian query tokens. Each token aggregates corresponding features across the full temporal context and decodes a 3D Gaussian whose position is modulated by the target timestamp, enabling globally coherent motion modeling without per-scene optimization. To capture fine-grained details, we further introduce a video diffusion model-based rendering enhancement module. Since our framework effectively aggregates features into Gaussians, we extend this capability to feature lifting, producing a 4D feature field that supports point tracking and dynamic scene understanding. C4G achieves strong novel-view synthesis performance using significantly fewer Gaussians and without requiring camera poses, while exhibiting stronger motion modeling and robustness to large temporal gaps.

</details>


### [100] [KLIP: localized distribution shift detection via KL-divergence with diffusion priors in Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31596)
*Alireza Kheirandish,Jihoon Hong,Sara Fridovich-Keil*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于KL散度的OOD检测指标，无需校准数据或了解偏移分布，可检测全局图像异常并定位局部异常区域，在扩散模型、数据集和逆问题中具有泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的OOD检测方法通常需要偏移分布的先验知识，难以检测细微或局部的分布偏移，且仅适用于全图而非逆问题中的间接测量数据。

Method: 基于扩散先验与后验分布之间的KL散度构建OOD检测指标，无需校准数据或偏移分布知识，可同时检测整图OOD和定位图像内的OOD区域。

Result: 该指标能够检测微妙且语义有意义的分布偏移（如健康肝脏CT与肿瘤肝脏CT之间的偏移），并且在不同扩散模型、数据集和逆问题中具有良好泛化性。

Conclusion: 提出的KL散度指标是一种无需先验知识的、可检测全局与局部OOD的有效方法，在多种场景下均表现良好。

Abstract: Diffusion models have shown promising performance as data-driven priors for computational imaging, as well as some capacity to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) images. However, existing approaches to OOD detection often require some knowledge of the shifted distribution, fail to detect subtle or localized distribution shifts, and operate on full images, rather than the indirect measurements available in inverse problems. We propose an OOD detection metric based on the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the diffusion prior and the posterior distribution, that (i) does not require any calibration data or knowledge of the shifted distribution, and (ii) can detect whole images as OOD as well as localize OOD patches within an image. Experimentally, we show that this metric can detect subtle yet semantically meaningful distribution shifts, such as the shift from healthy liver CT scans to those with tumors, and generalizes across different types of diffusion models, datasets, and inverse problems. Our code can be found at https://github.com/voilalab/KLIP.

</details>


### [101] [SOCO: Benchmarking Semantic Object Correspondence in Vision Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31597)
*Olaf Dünkel,Basavaraj Sunagad,Haoran Wang,David T. Hoffmann,Christian Theobalt,Adam Kortylewski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SOCO基准测试通过语义对应任务系统评估视觉基础模型的部件级结构化理解能力，包含100个类别、100万+对应点对及关键点语言描述。实验发现：视觉主干模型编码强语义结构但跨类别对应迁移弱；大型视觉语言模型文本定位强于跨图像匹配；对应性能比ImageNet分类更能预测下游密集任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测量视觉基础模型的结构化对象理解能力面临评估协议不一致和部件级监督有限的挑战，现有方法难以系统性评估模型在语义对应方面的表现。

Method: 提出SOCO基准，引入对应类型分类体系，提供100个类别、100万+语义对应点对的功能性关键点标注，并包含关键点语言描述以支持大型视觉语言模型评估。

Result: (i)视觉主干编码强语义结构但跨类别迁移差、部件位置捕捉不完整；(ii)LVLM文本定位强于视觉参考跨图像匹配；(iii)对应性能比ImageNet分类更能预测分割、跟踪、3D姿态估计和3D检测等下游密集任务表现。

Conclusion: SOCO可作为评估视觉和多模态基础模型结构化部件级表示质量的基准，揭示语言定位与细粒度视觉对应之间存在鸿沟。

Abstract: Measuring structured object understanding in vision foundation models remains challenging due to inconsistent evaluation protocols and limited part-level supervision. Semantic correspondence (SC) evaluates this capability by testing whether object parts can be matched across instances and categories under large variations in appearance, viewpoint, and geometry. To enable a systematic SC evaluation, we introduce SOCO, a new benchmark for Semantic Object Correspondence that introduces a taxonomy of correspondence types and provides consistent, functionally meaningful keypoint annotations across 100 categories and over 1M correspondence pairs. In addition, SOCO includes keypoint language descriptions, enabling the evaluation of large vision-language models (LVLMs) and their fine-grained part-level understanding. Comprehensive experiments reveal that (i) vision foundation backbones encode strong semantic structure but transfer correspondences poorly across related categories and only partially capture object-part position, (ii) LVLMs are stronger at text-prompted part localization than at visual-reference cross-image matching, exposing a gap between language-grounded localization and fine-grained visual correspondence, and (iii) correspondence performance predicts performance on dense downstream tasks, including segmentation, tracking, 3D pose estimation, and 3D detection, more strongly than ImageNet classification. Together, these findings position SOCO as a benchmark for structured, part-level representation quality in vision and multimodal foundation models.

</details>


### [102] [Linear Scaling Video VLMs for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31598)
*Cristobal Eyzaguirre,Jiajun Wu,Juan Carlos Niebles*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StateKV是一种推理时方法，通过固定容量的基于重要性的循环状态携带跨帧上下文，将预训练的长视频VLM适配为线性时间视频预填充，在保持接近全自注意力精度的同时显著降低计算成本，无需微调或架构更改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频VLM在长视频和流式场景中，视频编码器依赖时空自注意力导致计算和延迟随帧数二次增长，而现有效率方法（如激进的帧/标记丢弃或粗略注意力近似）在提升可扩展性时往往损失精度。

Method: StateKV提出推理时方法：采用固定容量、基于重要性的循环状态携带跨帧上下文实现线性时间视频预填充，并配合第二个完整的逐帧缓存用于解码。

Result: 在三个长视频基准、七个模型（三个家族、多个尺度）上，StateKV性能接近全自注意力，一致优于主流的滑动窗口/基于近期的流式近似方法，并降低了视频预填充的FLOPs成本，在固定计算预算下可通过运行更大模型实现更高精度。

Conclusion: StateKV提供了向可扩展长视频理解迈进的实用步骤，无需微调或架构更改即可实现线性时间视频预填充，在效率和精度之间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Video vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in long-horizon and streaming settings, yet most video encoders still rely on spatiotemporal self-attention, causing compute and latency to grow quadratically with the number of frames. Existing efficiency methods improve scalability but often lose accuracy relative to full self-attention, for example through aggressive frame/token dropping or coarse attention approximations. We introduce StateKV, an inference-time method that adapts pretrained long-video VLMs to linear-time video prefill by carrying cross-frame context in a fixed-capacity, importance-based recurrent state, paired with a second full per-frame cache used for decoding. Across three long-video benchmarks and seven models spanning three families and multiple scales, StateKV remains close to full self-attention and consistently outperforms dominant sliding-window / recency-based streaming approximations, without fine-tuning or architectural changes. StateKV also reduces video-prefill cost measured FLOPs, enabling stronger accuracy at a fixed compute budget by running larger models. These results suggest a practical step toward scalable long-video understanding.

</details>


### [103] [Lumos-Nexus: Efficient Frequency Bridging with Homogeneous Latent Space for Video Unified Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31603)
*Jiazheng Xing,Hangjie Yuan,Lingling Cai,Xinyu Liu,Yujie Wei,Fei Du,Hai Ci,Tao Feng,Jiasheng Tang,Weihua Chen,Fan Wang,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Lumos-Nexus提出两阶段训练-推理框架，训练时仅用轻量生成器与理解模块对齐，推理时通过渐进频率桥接（UPFB）切换至大容量预训练生成器，实现高保真视频生成，同时推出VR-Bench评估推理驱动生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于连接器的视频统一模型在指令视频合成中表现出色，但将高保真生成器集成到统一训练循环中计算代价过高，限制了视觉质量。本文旨在在保持推理质量的前提下提升视频生成保真度。

Method: 两阶段设计：训练阶段仅将轻量生成器与理解模块对齐，学习推理驱动的语义控制；推理阶段引入统一渐进频率桥接（UPFB），在共享潜空间中将生成逐步切换至大容量预训练生成器，实现由粗到细的精化。同时提出VR-Bench基准评估推理驱动的视频生成能力。

Result: 在VBench上视觉真实感和时间连贯性显著提升，在VR-Bench上展现出强推理驱动的生成性能。

Conclusion: Lumos-Nexus通过训练高效的解耦设计，在推理质量不受损的情况下实现了高保真视频生成，为推理驱动的视频生成提供了有效框架。

Abstract: Connector-based video unified models have demonstrated strong capability in instruction-grounded video synthesis, but integrating a large high-fidelity generator into the unified training loop is computationally prohibitive, limiting achievable visual quality. We therefore propose Lumos-Nexus, a training-efficient unified video generation framework that facilitates the development of strong reasoning-driven generation capabilities while significantly enhancing visual fidelity. Lumos-Nexus adopts a two-stage design: 1) During training, only a lightweight generator is aligned with the understanding block to learn to take in reasoning-driven semantic control. 2) During inference, we introduce Unified Progressive Frequency Bridging (UPFB) to progressively hand off generation to a high-capacity pretrained generator in the shared latent space, enabling coarse-to-fine refinement and producing high-fidelity videos without compromising reasoning quality. To fill the gap in reasoning-driven video generation benchmarks, we introduce VR-Bench, which assesses a model's capability to translate inferred intent into coherent and semantically aligned video content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Lumos-Nexus achieves substantial gains in visual realism and temporal coherence on VBench, while exhibiting strong reasoning-based generative performance on VR-Bench. Code and models are available at https://jiazheng-xing.github.io/nexus-lumos-home/.

</details>


### [104] [Representation Forcing for Bottleneck-Free Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31604)
*Yuqing Wang,Zhijie Lin,Ceyuan Yang,Yang Zhao,Fei Xiao,Hao He,Qi Zhao,Zihan Ding,Fuyun Wang,Shuai Wang,Youliang Zhang,Haoqi Fan,Xihui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Representation Forcing (RF) 技术，使解码器在自回归预测像素之前先预测视觉表示作为中间token，从而消除统一多模态模型中VAE带来的结构瓶颈，在像素空间中同时实现理解与生成，性能达到或超越基于VAE的基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型依赖冻结且单独预训练的VAE进行图像生成，这引入了结构瓶颈；直接移除VAE会导致质量下降，因为模型需要同时从原始像素中学习高层结构和低层细节。

Method: 提出Representation Forcing (RF) 技术：在解码器中，自回归地预测视觉表示作为中间token，这些token保留在上下文中，在同一骨干网络内引导后续的像素扩散过程，从而将表示从感知输出转变为生成目标。

Result: 在图像生成任务上，基于像素空间的RF模型匹配了最先进的基于VAE的统一模型；在图像理解任务上，像素空间的RF模型普遍优于基于VAE的变体。

Conclusion: RF技术有效消除了对VAE等外部生成潜空间的依赖，为实现端到端、无瓶颈的统一多模态模型提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to handle perception and generation in a single model. Yet existing UMMs still rely on a frozen, separately pretrained VAE for image generation, imposing a structural bottleneck. Naively removing it introduces a quality gap, as the model must learn both high-level structure and low-level details from raw pixels. In this paper, we propose Representation Forcing (RF), a technique that closes this gap by making representation prediction a native capability of the model. Concretely, RF forces the decoder to autoregressively predict visual representations as intermediate tokens before pixels; these tokens then stay in context to guide pixel diffusion within the same backbone. By turning representations from perception outputs into generation targets, RF eliminates the need for any external generative latent space. We find that RF benefits both understanding and generation. On image generation, our pixel-space model with RF matches state-of-the-art VAE-based unified models. On image understanding, pixel-space RF generally outperforms its VAE-based variant. Together, these results offer an effective step toward end-to-end, bottleneck-free UMMs.

</details>


### [105] [SDF2Net: Shallow to Deep Feature Fusion Network for PolSAR Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17672)
*Mohammed Q. Alkhatib,M. Sami Zitouni,Mina Al-Saad,Nour Aburaed,Hussain Al-Ahmad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为SDF2Net的三分支复值CNN融合网络，用于极化SAR图像分类。在AIRSAR和ESAR数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比现有方法在总体精度上提升了0.5%-1.3%，且在仅1%采样率下即可达到96.01%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PolSAR图像分类面临不同于光学图像的挑战，传统方法难以有效提取有意义特征，需要借助深度学习方法来克服这些困难。

Method: 提出了一种三分支复值CNN融合网络SDF2Net（Shallow to Deep Feature Fusion Network），利用复值CNN的核能力捕捉PolSAR图像的局部信息和复值特性，实现从浅层到深层特征的融合。

Result: 在AIRSAR Flevoland和San Francisco数据集上总体精度分别提升1.3%和0.8%，在ESAR Oberpfaffenhofen数据集上提升0.5%。在Flevoland数据上仅用1%采样率即可达到96.01%的总体精度。

Conclusion: 提出的SDF2Net方法在PolSAR图像分类任务上优于多种现有方法，具有良好的性能表现和数据效率。

Abstract: Polarimetric synthetic aperture radar (PolSAR) images encompass valuable information that can facilitate extensive land cover interpretation and generate diverse output products. Extracting meaningful features from PolSAR data poses challenges distinct from those encountered in optical imagery. Deep learning (DL) methods offer effective solutions for overcoming these challenges in PolSAR feature extraction. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) play a crucial role in capturing PolSAR image characteristics by leveraging kernel capabilities to consider local information and the complex-valued nature of PolSAR data. In this study, a novel three-branch fusion of complex-valued CNN, named the Shallow to Deep Feature Fusion Network (SDF2Net), is proposed for PolSAR image classification. To validate the performance of the proposed method, classification results are compared against multiple state-of-the-art approaches using the airborne synthetic aperture radar (AIRSAR) datasets of Flevoland and San Francisco, as well as the ESAR Oberpfaffenhofen dataset. The results indicate that the proposed approach demonstrates improvements in overallaccuracy, with a 1.3% and 0.8% enhancement for the AIRSAR datasets and a 0.5% improvement for the ESAR dataset. Analyses conducted on the Flevoland data underscore the effectiveness of the SDF2Net model, revealing a promising overall accuracy of 96.01% even with only a 1% sampling ratio.

</details>


### [106] [Multimodal Fusion via Self-Consistent Task-Gradient Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.15475)
*Jiayu Xiong,Jing Wang,Jun Xue,Wanlong Wang,Jianlong Kwan,Xiaosen Lyu,Zhouqiang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出自洽场自编码器（SCFAE），利用自洽场原理平衡任务学习与特征组织，通过为每个模态配备小型自编码器实现信息完整保留，并借助互补特征子空间化解任务损失与重构损失的优化冲突，在多个多模态基准上展现出对缺失数据和不均等输入尺寸的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法要么激进地融合模态导致特征纠缠，使特征提取器对不完整输入脆弱；要么通过辅助损失分离特征却引入优化冲突，干扰主任务学习。因此需要一种能平衡任务学习与特征组织、避免优化冲突的融合方法。

Method: SCFAE遵循自洽场原理，为每个模态使用小型自编码器保持信息完整性；任务损失作为驱动力选择预测性特征，重构损失作为约束将特征分离到独立子空间，两者通过互补特征子空间运作以缓解优化干扰。

Result: 在音视频-文本、音视频和图像-视频基准上，SCFAE以简单结构在处理缺失数据和不均等输入尺寸方面表现更鲁棒；梯度分析证实SCFAE避免了冲突并维持了稳定的训练动态。

Conclusion: SCFAE通过自洽场原理和双目标互补子空间设计，有效解决了多模态学习中特征纠缠与优化冲突问题，为多模态融合提供了更优的梯度路径。

Abstract: Multimodal learning aims to preserve as much task-related information as possible from different inputs. However, current fusion designs often distort the feedback loop to feature extractors. Aggressively merging modalities entangles their representations, making the feature extractors fragile to incomplete inputs. Meanwhile, attempting to separate features via auxiliary losses frequently introduces optimization conflicts that distract from the primary task. We propose the Self-Consistent Field Autoencoder (SCFAE) to provide a better path for task gradients. Our method follows the self-consistent field principle to balance task learning with feature organization, thereby minimizing mutual information. We use small autoencoders for each modality to keep information intact. The task loss acts as a driving force to select predictive features. The reconstruction loss acts as a constraint to separate these features into independent subspaces. These dual objectives operate through complementary feature subspaces, thereby mitigating optimization interference. We evaluate SCFAE on audio-visual-text, audio-visual, and image-video benchmarks. Results show that SCFAE handles missing data and unequal input sizes more robustly via a simple structure. Gradient analysis confirms that SCFAE avoids conflicts and maintains stable training dynamics.

</details>


### [107] [Safeguarding Text-to-Image Generation via Inference-Time Prompt-Noise Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.03876)
*Jiangweizhi Peng,Zhiwei Tang,Gaowen Liu,Charles Fleming,Mingyi Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需训练的Prompt-Noise Optimization (PNO)方法，通过优化连续提示嵌入和注入噪声轨迹来抑制T2I扩散模型生成不安全图像，在保持生成质量的同时实现了最先进的安全性能和对对抗攻击的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前T2I扩散模型虽然能生成高质量图像，但仍会生成包含敏感或不适当内容的不安全图像，而现有防护方法容易被绕过且易受对抗攻击，亟需一种能有效对齐安全目标的方案。

Method: 提出PNO框架，在无需训练的情况下，同时优化两个关键要素：(1)连续提示嵌入 (2)采样过程中注入的噪声轨迹，从而引导模型生成安全的图像。

Result: 在抑制有毒图像生成方面达到最先进性能，对对抗攻击表现出鲁棒性，生成时间与现有方法相当，并在安全生成与提示-图像对齐这两个冲突目标之间实现了最佳权衡。

Conclusion: PNO是一种无需模型参数调整、高效且鲁棒的T2I模型安全对齐方法，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下有效解决了不安全图像生成问题。

Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models are widely recognized for their ability to generate high-quality and diverse images based on text prompts. However, despite recent advances, these models are still prone to generating unsafe images containing sensitive or inappropriate content, which can be harmful to users. Current efforts to prevent inappropriate image generation for diffusion models are easy to bypass and vulnerable to adversarial attacks. How to ensure that T2I models align with specific safety goals remains a significant challenge. In this work, we propose a novel, training-free approach, called Prompt-Noise Optimization (PNO), to mitigate unsafe image generation. Our method introduces a novel optimization framework that leverages both the continuous prompt embedding and the injected noise trajectory in the sampling process to generate safe images. Extensive numerical results demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in suppressing toxic image generations and demonstrates robustness to adversarial attacks, without needing to tune the model parameters. Furthermore, compared with existing methods, PNO uses comparable generation time while offering the best tradeoff between the conflicting goals of safe generation and prompt-image alignment.

</details>


### [108] [Cross-Modal Attention Calibration for LVLM Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.01926)
*Jiaming Li,Jiacheng Zhang,Zequn Jie,Lin Ma,Guanbin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需训练的跨模态注意力校准方法（CMAC），通过交错模态解码（IMD）和跨模态位置校准（CMPC）两个模块，分别解决幻觉中的单模态过度依赖和位置偏差问题，在多个幻觉基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM在复杂生成任务中仍存在幻觉问题，现有推理时干预方法（如对比解码）只缓解了语言先验的过度依赖，但忽略了位置偏差和虚假跨模态相关性导致的幻觉。

Method: 提出CMAC方法，包含两个模块：1) IMD（交错模态解码）：通过对比解码机制，遮蔽具有显著跨模态注意力权重的值向量作为失真，同时解决单模态过度依赖和误导性跨模态相关性；2) CMPC（跨模态位置校准）：缩小图像token的位置差距，缓解跨模态注意力中的位置偏差。

Result: 在多个幻觉基准测试上，CMAC方法在减少LVLM幻觉方面优于现有最先进技术。

Conclusion: CMAC是一种无需训练即可有效缓解LVLM幻觉的方法，通过解决位置偏差和虚假跨模态相关性来提升生成内容与视觉输入的一致性。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in visual-language understanding. Despite their success, LVLMs still suffer from generating hallucinations in complex generation tasks, leading to inconsistencies between visual inputs and generated content. To address this issue, some approaches have introduced inference-time interventions, such as contrastive decoding, to reduce overreliance on language priors. However, these approaches overlook hallucinations stemming from position bias and spurious inter-modality correlations. In this paper, we propose a Cross-Modal Attention Calibration (CMAC) method to mitigate hallucinations in LVLMs in a training-free manner. In this method, we design an Inter-Modality Decoding (IMD) module to alleviate hallucination by a novel contrastive decoding mechanism. IMD masks the value vectors associated with significant cross-modal attention weights as distortion, which addresses both uni-modality overreliance and misleading inter-modality correlations. Additionally, a Cross-Modal Position Calibration (CMPC) module shrinks the position gap of image tokens, alleviating the position bias in cross-modal attention. Experimental results on diverse hallucination benchmarks validate the superiority of our method over existing state-of-the-art techniques in reducing hallucinations for LVLM. Our code will be available at https://github.com/lijm48/IMCCD.

</details>


### [109] [On the Illusion of Gender Bias in Face Recognition: Explaining the Fairness Issue Through Non-demographic Attributes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12020)
*Paul Jonas Kurz,Haiyu Wu,Rouqaiah Al-Refai,Kevin W. Bowyer,Philipp Terhörst*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过40种去相关的非人口统计学面部特征组合，研究了人脸识别系统中的性别偏差，发现当男性和女性受试者共享特定面部属性时，性别差距消失，表明性能差异源于社会定义的外貌而非生物学因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究使用手动选择的、相关的、小规模的面部特征集来探究FRS中的性别偏差原因，缺乏对去相关、大规模面部属性组合的系统性分析。

Method: 1) 提出一种工具链，有效去相关并聚合40种非人口统计学面部属性；2) 设计两种专门度量来量化面部属性对绝对公平性和相对公平性的影响；3) 提出一种无监督联合调查框架，识别可导致偏差消失的属性组合，并将其用作平衡测试数据集的过滤谓词。

Result: 实验表明，当男性和女性受试者共享特定面部属性时，性别差距消失，证明偏差并非生物学问题，而是社会定义的外貌问题。

Conclusion: 该发现可能重塑对面部生物特征公平性的理解，并为解决FRS中的性别偏差问题提供见解。

Abstract: Face recognition systems (FRS) exhibit significant accuracy differences based on the user's gender. Since such a gender gap reduces the trustworthiness of FRS, more recent efforts have tried to find the causes. However, these studies make use of manually selected, correlated, and small-sized sets of facial features to support their claims. In this work, we analyze gender bias in face recognition by successfully extending the search domain to decorrelated combinations of 40 non-demographic facial characteristics. First, we introduce a toolchain to effectively decorrelate and aggregate facial attributes to enable a less-biased gender analysis on large-scale data. Second, we tailor two specialized metrics to quantify the effect of facial attributes on absolute and relative fairness. Based on these grounds, we thirdly present a novel unsupervised joint investigation framework capable of identifying attribute combinations leading to vanishing bias when used as filter predicates for balanced testing datasets. Experiments show the gender gap vanishing when images of male and female subjects share specific attributes, clearly indicating that the disparate performance is not a question of biology but of the social definition of appearance. These findings could reshape our understanding of fairness in face biometrics and provide insights into FRS, helping to address gender bias issues.

</details>


### [110] [PRISM: Self-Pruning Intrinsic Selection Method for Training-Free Multimodal Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.12119)
*Jinhe Bi,Aniri,Zengjie Jin,Yifan Wang,Danqi Yan,Wenke Huang,Xiaowen Ma,Sikuan Yan,Artur Hecker,Mang Ye,Xun Xiao,Hinrich Schuetze,Volker Tresp,Yunpu Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PRISM是一个无需训练的视觉指令数据选择框架，通过解决视觉特征分布的各向异性问题（全局语义漂移），将数据选择和模型微调的端到端时间减少到传统流程的30%，同时在多模态和语言理解基准上超越全数据集微调模型，相对基线提升101.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉指令数据选择方法（基于代理推理或训练指标）计算成本高昂，反而加剧了欲解决的效率瓶颈。作者发现视觉特征分布的各向异性导致全局语义漂移，是限制数据选择方法效率的关键因素。

Method: PRISM框架通过隐式重新中心化（implicit re-centering）建模内在视觉语义，手术式移除全局背景特征的干扰影响，实现无需训练的高效视觉指令选择。

Result: 端到端时间减少至传统流程的30%；在8个多模态和3个语言理解基准上超越全数据集微调模型；相对基线提升101.7%。

Conclusion: 首次揭示视觉特征各向异性导致的全局语义漂移现象是数据选择效率瓶颈的关键因素，并验证了无需训练的高效选择框架PRISM在降低计算成本的同时提升性能的有效性。

Abstract: Visual instruction tuning adapts pre-trained Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to follow human instructions for real-world applications. However, the rapid growth of these datasets introduces significant redundancy, leading to increased computational costs. Existing methods for selecting instruction data aim to prune this redundancy, but predominantly rely on computationally demanding techniques such as proxy-based inference or training-based metrics. Consequently, the substantial computational costs incurred by these selection processes often exacerbate the very efficiency bottlenecks they are intended to resolve, posing a significant challenge to the scalable and effective tuning of MLLMs. To address this challenge, we first identify a critical, yet previously overlooked, factor: the anisotropy inherent in visual feature distributions. We find that this anisotropy induces a \textit{Global Semantic Drift}, and overlooking this phenomenon is a key factor limiting the efficiency of current data selection methods. Motivated by this insight, we devise \textbf{PRISM}, the first training-free framework for efficient visual instruction selection. PRISM surgically removes the corrupting influence of global background features by modeling the intrinsic visual semantics via implicit re-centering. Empirically, PRISM reduces the end-to-end time for data selection and model tuning to just 30\% of conventional pipelines. More remarkably, it achieves this efficiency while simultaneously enhancing performance, surpassing models fine-tuned on the full dataset across eight multimodal and three language understanding benchmarks, culminating in a 101.7\% relative improvement over the baseline. The code is available for access via \href{https://github.com/bibisbar/PRISM}{this repository}.

</details>


### [111] [DISCO: Mitigating Bias in Deep Learning with Conditional Distance Correlation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.11653)
*Emre Kavak,Tom Nuno Wolf,Christian Wachinger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出标准反因果模型（SAM）统一因果框架来刻画偏差机制，并基于该理论提出DISCO$_m$和sDISCO两种高效的条件距离相关性估计器，用于在梯度模型中实现独立性正则化，从而减轻数据集偏差。在六个数据集上，该方法在减少超参数数量、支持多偏差场景的同时，达到或超越现有观测偏差缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集偏差导致深度学习模型依赖虚假相关性而非任务相关信号，现有方法缺乏统一理论框架，且存在超参数过多、难以扩展到多偏差场景等问题。

Method: 提出标准反因果模型（SAM）作为统一因果框架，推导出因果稳定性的条件独立性准则；基于该理论提出DISCO$_m$和sDISCO两种高效的条件距离相关性估计器，用于在梯度模型中施加独立性正则化。

Result: 在六个不同数据集上，该方法一致性地达到或超越了现有的观测偏差缓解方法，且所需超参数更少，能够无缝扩展到多偏差场景。

Conclusion: 该工作弥合了因果理论与深度学习实践之间的鸿沟，为鲁棒预测提供了既具有理论基础又具备实用工具的方法。

Abstract: Dataset bias often leads deep learning models to exploit spurious correlations instead of task-relevant signals. We introduce the Standard Anti-Causal Model (SAM), a unifying causal framework that characterizes bias mechanisms and yields a conditional independence criterion for causal stability. Building on this theory, we propose DISCO$_m$ and sDISCO, efficient and scalable estimators of conditional distance correlation that enable independence regularization in gradient-based models. Across six diverse datasets, our methods consistently outperform or are competitive in existing observed bias mitigation approaches, while requiring fewer hyperparameters and scaling seamlessly to multi-bias scenarios. This work bridges causal theory and practical deep learning, providing both a principled foundation and effective tools for robust prediction. Source Code: https://github.com/yakamoz5/DISCO.

</details>


### [112] [PictSure: Pretraining Embeddings Matters for In-Context Learning Image Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.14842)
*Lukas Schiesser,Cornelius Wolff,Sophie Haas,Simon Pukrop*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PictSure是一个纯视觉上下文学习模型家族，研究了编码器预训练与融合层训练数据对少样本图像分类的相对重要性，发现表示质量是视觉ICL的主要瓶颈，而非融合模块的训练多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在数据稀缺领域构建图像分类模型仍然繁琐，收集大规模标注数据集不切实际。先前工作未充分探索编码器预训练与融合层训练数据之间的相对重要性。

Method: 提出了PictSure，一个纯视觉ICL模型家族，采用易于使用的融合Transformer架构，并在域内和域外评估中系统比较了编码器预训练表示质量与融合层训练数据多样性对下游ICL性能的影响。

Result: 预训练诱导的表示质量与下游ICL性能强相关；融合Transformer的训练数据集从仅ImageNet扩展到多样化的多领域混合后，性能增益有限；表明融合层在嵌入充分结构化时能有效自适应。

Conclusion: 视觉ICL的瓶颈在于表示质量而非融合模块训练多样性。开源了所有模型权重并通过MCP服务器将PictSure暴露为LLM智能体系统的可调用工具。

Abstract: Building image classification models remains cumbersome in data-scarce domains, where collecting large labeled datasets is impractical. In-context learning (ICL) is a promising paradigm for few-shot image classification (FSIC), but prior work has underexplored the relative importance of encoder pretraining versus fusion-layer training data. We present PictSure, a vision-only ICL family of models that demonstrates the potential of easy-to-use fusion transformer architectures, as well as the need for better embedding representations across a wider range of image domains. In both in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations, we find that representation quality induced by pretraining strongly correlates with downstream ICL performance. Crucially, varying the training dataset for the fusion transformer, from ImageNet alone to diverse multi-domain mixtures, provides limited additional performance gains under the evaluated settings, demonstrating that the fusion layer appears capable of adapting effectively once embeddings are sufficiently structured. These results show that the bottleneck in visual ICL is representation quality, not fusion-module training diversity. To facilitate adoption and reproducibility, we release all model weights as open-source artifacts and provide an MCP server that exposes PictSure as a callable tool for LLM-based agentic systems, enabling few-shot image classification to be invoked directly within AI pipelines without integration overhead. Code can be found at https://github.com/PictSure and models at https://huggingface.co/pictsure.

</details>


### [113] [Sinkhorn Normalization of Diffusion Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.06161)
*Nathan Kessler,Robin Magnet,Jean Feydy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于对称Sinkhorn算法的通用平滑算子归一化方法，使得从任意相似度或邻接矩阵导出的平滑算子能够继承拉普拉斯算子的热扩散特性，适用于点云、稀疏体素网格等不规则数据上的平滑、形状分析和匹配任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的拉普拉斯算子依赖于定义良好的域结构（如流形），但在许多实际场景中缺乏这种结构；而基于简单卷积核或消息传递的方法对域边界存在偏差。本文旨在弥合这一差距，使任意相似度/邻接矩阵都能获得类似拉普拉斯的热扩散特性。

Method: 引入一类基于相似度或邻接矩阵的广义平滑算子，通过对称Sinkhorn算法对其进行重缩放归一化，使其行为与热扩散一致。该方法无需预定义的域结构，适用于点云、稀疏体素网格、高斯混合等不规则数据。

Result: 得到的算子不仅能够近似热扩散，还能保留拉普拉斯算子的谱信息，在形状分析和匹配等任务中展示了有效性。

Conclusion: 对称Sinkhorn归一化能够将通用平滑算子转化为类似拉普拉斯的扩散算子，为不规则数据上的平滑和处理提供了原则性方法，扩展了谱方法的适用范围。

Abstract: Smoothing a signal based on local neighborhoods is a core operation in machine learning and geometry processing. On well-structured domains such as vector spaces and manifolds, the Laplace operator derived from differential geometry offers a principled approach to smoothing via heat diffusion, with strong theoretical guarantees. However, constructing such Laplacians requires a carefully defined domain structure, which is not always available. Most practitioners thus rely on simple convolution kernels and message-passing layers, which are biased against the boundaries of the domain. We bridge this gap by introducing a broad class of smoothing operators, derived from general similarity or adjacency matrices, and demonstrate that they can be normalized into diffusion-like operators that inherit desirable properties from Laplacians. Our approach relies on a symmetric variant of the Sinkhorn algorithm, which rescales positive smoothing operators to match the structural behavior of heat diffusion. This construction enables Laplacian-like smoothing and processing of irregular data such as point clouds, sparse voxel grids or mixture of Gaussians. We show that the resulting operators not only approximate heat diffusion but also retain spectral information from the Laplacian itself, with applications to shape analysis and matching.

</details>


### [114] [Joint angle based learning to refine kinematic human pose estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.11075)
*Chang Peng,Yifei Zhou,Haoqiang Ren,Shiqing Huang,Chuangye Chen,Jianming Yang,Bao Yang,Huifeng Xi,Zhenyu Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于关节角度的无标记人体姿态估计精炼方法（JAR），通过傅里叶级数构建高质量训练数据集，结合双向循环网络后处理模块，有效纠正关键点识别错误并平滑时空轨迹，在花样滑冰等挑战性场景中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人体姿态估计存在关键点识别偶发错误和轨迹随机波动问题，且深度学习精炼模型受限于手动标注的不准确训练数据集。

Method: (i) 基于关节角度的人体运动姿态鲁棒描述；(ii) 利用高阶傅里叶级数拟合关节角度时间变化以生成可靠的"真实值"；(iii) 设计双向循环网络作为后处理模块，对单图像HPE模型输出进行精炼。

Result: JAR方法在花样滑冰、breaking等挑战性案例中优于最新HPE精炼网络，并展现出纠正现有数据集的潜力。

Conclusion: 基于关节角度的精炼方法能够有效克服标注数据不准确问题，提升HPE在复杂场景下的鲁棒性，并可用于现有数据集修正。

Abstract: Marker-free human pose estimation (HPE) has found increasing applications in various fields. Current HPE suffers from occasional errors in keypoint recognition and random fluctuation in keypoint trajectories when analyzing kinematic human poses. The performance of existing deep learning-based models for HPE refinement is considerably limited by inaccurate training datasets in which the keypoints are manually annotated.
