### [152] [What is Missing? Explaining Neurons Activated by Absent Concepts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09787)
*Robin Hesse,Simone Schaub-Meyer,Janina Hesse,Bernt Schiele,Stefan Roth*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了深度神经网络中存在一种被主流XAI方法忽视的因果关系——编码缺失（encoded absences），即概念的缺失反而会增强神经激活，并提出了两种扩展方法用于检测和解释这种编码缺失现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流可解释人工智能（XAI）方法主要关注概念存在与神经激活之间的正向关联（如归因方法识别贡献最大的输入像素，特征可视化寻找激活神经元的输入），但忽视了概念缺失也可能导致神经激活增强这一反向因果关系，导致对模型行为的理解不完整。

Method: 提出两种简单扩展方法，分别应用于归因方法和特征可视化技术，以揭示编码缺失的因果关系。通过实验验证这些方法在ImageNet模型上的有效性，并展示编码缺失对去偏任务的改进作用。

Result: 实验表明：（1）编码缺失现象在深度神经网络中普遍存在；（2）主流XAI方法在标准形式下难以揭示这种因果关系；（3）提出的扩展方法能够有效检测和解释编码缺失；（4）ImageNet模型广泛利用编码缺失；（5）考虑编码缺失可以改进模型的去偏效果。

Conclusion: 编码缺失是深度神经网络中一种常见但被忽视的因果机制，现有XAI方法存在系统性盲区。提出的扩展方法能够揭示这一现象，有助于更全面地理解模型行为，并可在去偏等实际应用中带来改进。

Abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) aims to provide human-interpretable insights into the behavior of deep neural networks (DNNs), typically by estimating a simplified causal structure of the model. In existing work, this causal structure often includes relationships where the presence of a concept is associated with a strong activation of a neuron. For example, attribution methods primarily identify input pixels that contribute most to a prediction, and feature visualization methods reveal inputs that cause high activation of a target neuron - the former implicitly assuming that the relevant information resides in the input, and the latter that neurons encode the presence of concepts. However, a largely overlooked type of causal relationship is that of encoded absences, where the absence of a concept increases neural activation. In this work, we show that such missing but relevant concepts are common and that mainstream XAI methods struggle to reveal them when applied in their standard form. To address this, we propose two simple extensions to attribution and feature visualization techniques that uncover encoded absences. Across experiments, we show how mainstream XAI methods can be used to reveal and explain encoded absences, how ImageNet models exploit them, and that debiasing can be improved when considering them.

</details>


### [153] [World2Act: Latent Action Post-Training from World Model Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10422)
*An Dinh Vuong,Tuan Van Vo,Abdullah Sohail,Haoran Ding,Liang Ma,Xiaodan Liang,Anqing Duan,Ivan Laptev,Ian Reid*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: World2Act提出了一种基于潜在空间的世界模型后训练框架，通过对比对齐视频-动作潜在空间，在不依赖像素级监督的情况下将世界模型动力学迁移到VLA策略中，在模拟和真实机器人任务上均取得了显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的后训练方法依赖像素级监督，使策略对世界模型 rollout 产生的视觉伪影敏感，影响泛化性能。作者希望设计一种无需像素级监督即可将世界模型动力学迁移到VLA策略的方法。

Method: World2Act包含两个阶段：1) 通过对比学习将世界模型的动力学潜在表示与动作嵌入对齐，构建共享的视频-动作潜在空间；2) 在后训练过程中引导策略的动作表示朝向世界模型想象的潜在动力学特征（而非解码后的像素），实现无需像素级监督的动力学迁移。

Result: 基于GR00T-N1.6，在模拟基准（RoboCasa、LIBERO、Bridge-SIMPLER）上绝对成功率提升最高达+2.5%，在真实机器人上提升+6.7%；相比像素级世界模型监督方法，最高提升+6.0%。

Conclusion: 潜在空间的世界模型动力学迁移比像素级迁移更稳定，在像素监督会降低基线的LIBERO任务上仍有效，为基于世界模型的后训练提供了更可靠的替代方案。

Abstract: World Models (WMs) offer a promising mechanism for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies by providing dynamics priors that improve generalization under task and scene variation. However, most WM-based post-training methods rely on pixel-space supervision, making policies sensitive to visual artifacts introduced by imperfect WM rollouts. We present World2Act, a latent-space post-training framework that transfers WM dynamics to the VLA policy without pixel-space supervision. World2Act operates in two stages: 1) it induces a shared video-action latent space by contrastively aligning WM-dynamics latents with action embeddings, and 2) it post-trains the VLA by guiding policy action representations toward WM-imagined dynamics rather than decoded pixels. Built on GR00T-N1.6, World2Act delivers absolute success-rate gains of up to +2.5% on simulation benchmarks (RoboCasa, LIBERO, Bridge-SIMPLER) and +6.7% on a real robot over finetuned VLA baselines. Notably, it outperforms pixel-space WM supervision by up to +6.0%, including on LIBERO where pixel supervision degrades the baseline, suggesting that latent WM dynamics offer a more stable WM-based post-training alternative to pixel-space transfer.

</details>


### [154] [IsoCLIP: Decomposing CLIP Projectors for Efficient Intra-modal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19862)
*Simone Magistri,Dipam Goswami,Marco Mistretta,Bartłomiej Twardowski,Joost van de Weijer,Andrew D. Bagdanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了CLIP模型中投影层导致的模态内错位问题，通过谱分析发现了一个各向同性的对齐子空间，并提出了一种无需训练的方法（IsoCLIP），通过去除各向异性方向来改善模态内对齐，在检索和分类任务上优于现有方法且降低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP在跨模态任务中表现优异，但其编码器在应对图像-图像检索等模态内任务时存在模态内错位问题，影响性能。

Method: 通过分析CLIP中余弦相似度的形式及其与对比损失的交互，识别出负责模态间对齐的交互相和仅负责归一化的模态内算子；对模态间算子进行谱分析，发现各向同性对齐子空间和各向异性方向；直接从投影权重获取该对齐子空间，去除各向异性方向以改善模态内对齐。

Result: 提出的无训练方法在模态内检索和分类基准上减少了模态内错位，大幅降低延迟，并在多个预训练CLIP类模型上优于现有方法。

Conclusion: CLIP投影层存在结构性的模态内错位问题，通过谱分析可识别对齐子空间并无需训练即可校正，该方法高效且跨模型通用。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models like CLIP are extensively used for inter-modal tasks which involve both visual and text modalities. However, when the individual modality encoders are applied to inherently intra-modal tasks like image-to-image retrieval, their performance suffers from the intra-modal misalignment. In this paper we study intra-modal misalignment in CLIP with a focus on the role of the projectors that map pre-projection image and text embeddings into the shared embedding space. By analyzing the form of the cosine similarity applied to projected features, and its interaction with the contrastive CLIP loss, we show that there is an inter-modal operator responsible for aligning the two modalities during training, and a second, intra-modal operator that only enforces intra-modal normalization but does nothing to promote intra-modal alignment. Via spectral analysis of the inter-modal operator, we identify an approximately isotropic subspace in which the two modalities are well-aligned, as well as anisotropic directions specific to each modality. We demonstrate that this aligned subspace can be directly obtained from the projector weights and that removing the anisotropic directions improves intra-modal alignment. Our experiments on intra-modal retrieval and classification benchmarks show that our training-free method reduces intra-modal misalignment, greatly lowers latency, and outperforms existing approaches across multiple pre-trained CLIP-like models. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/simomagi/IsoCLIP.

</details>


### [155] [TTE-CAM: Self-Explainable Class Activation Maps for Pretrained Black-Box CNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26885)
*Kerol Djoumessi,Philipp Berens*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TTE-CAM是一种测试时框架，通过卷积替换分类头将预训练黑盒CNN转换为自解释模型，在保持原预测性能的同时提供忠实的内在解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CNN在医学图像分析中性能优异但缺乏可解释性；事后解释方法不忠实，而内在可解释架构通常牺牲预测性能，存在根本性权衡。

Method: 在测试阶段，用基于卷积的结构替换预训练黑盒CNN的分类头，并从原始权重初始化，将模型转换为自解释模型。

Result: 转换后的模型保持了与黑盒模型相当的预测性能，同时提供了与事后方法相比具有竞争力的忠实解释（定性和定量评估）。

Conclusion: TTE-CAM成功弥合了可解释性与预测性能之间的鸿沟，为高风险的临床环境提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) achieve state-of-the-art performance in medical image analysis yet remain opaque, limiting adoption in high-stakes clinical settings. Existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: post-hoc methods provide unfaithful approximate explanations, while inherently interpretable architectures are faithful but often sacrifice predictive performance. We introduce TTE-CAM, a test-time framework that bridges this gap by converting pretrained black-box CNNs into self-explainable models via a convolution-based replacement of their classification head, initialized from the original weights. The resulting model preserves black-box predictive performance while delivering built-in faithful explanations competitive with post-hoc methods, both qualitatively and quantitatively. The code is available at https://github.com/kdjoumessi/Test-Time-Explainability

</details>


### [156] [Rays as Pixels: Learning A Joint Distribution of Videos and Camera Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09429)
*Wonbong Jang,Shikun Liu,Soubhik Sanyal,Juan Camilo Perez,Kam Woh Ng,Sanskar Agrawal,Juan-Manuel Perez-Rua,Yiannis Douratsos,Tao Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Rays as Pixels (RaP)视频扩散模型，通过将相机参数编码为"射线像素"(raxels)与视频帧在共享潜空间联合去噪，首次实现单一框架内同时进行相机位姿预测和相机控制视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法将相机参数恢复和新视角渲染视为分离任务，在图像覆盖稀疏或位姿模糊时两者相互依赖、互相制约，亟需统一框架解决此耦合问题。

Method: 将相机表示为稠密射线像素(raxels)作为像素对齐编码，与视频帧共享同一潜空间；通过解耦自交叉注意力机制(Decoupled Self-Cross Attention)对视频和相机轨迹进行联合去噪。

Result: 在姿态估计和相机控制视频生成任务上取得有效结果；提出闭环自一致性测试验证预测位姿与基于该位姿的渲染结果一致；消融实验证明共享潜空间表示优于Plücker嵌入。

Conclusion: 单一模型可处理三种任务：从视频预测相机轨迹、从输入图像沿预定义轨迹生成视频、从输入图像联合合成视频和轨迹，证明了统一框架的有效性。

Abstract: Recovering camera parameters from images and rendering scenes from novel viewpoints have been treated as separate tasks in computer vision and graphics. This separation breaks down when image coverage is sparse or poses are ambiguous, since each task depends on what the other produces. We propose Rays as Pixels, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM) that learns a joint distribution over videos and camera trajectories. To our knowledge, this is the first model to predict camera poses and do camera-controlled video generation within a single framework. We represent each camera as dense ray pixels (raxels), a pixel-aligned encoding that lives in the same latent space as video frames, and denoise the two jointly through a Decoupled Self-Cross Attention mechanism. A single trained model handles three tasks: predicting camera trajectories from video, generating video from input images along a pre-defined trajectory, and jointly synthesizing video and trajectory from input images. We evaluate on pose estimation and camera-controlled video generation, and introduce a closed-loop self-consistency test showing that the model's predicted poses and its renderings conditioned on those poses agree. Ablations against Plücker embeddings confirm that representing cameras in a shared latent space with video is subtantially more effective.

</details>


### [157] [Dual-Exposure Imaging with Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10273)
*Mingyuan Lin,Hongyi Liu,Chu He,Wen Yang,Gui-Song Xia,Lei Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于事件相机的高质量双曝光成像算法（E-DEI），利用事件相机的高时间分辨率解决传统双曝光成像中的运动伪影和特征差异问题，通过双路径并行特征传播架构和事件辅助的特征对齐融合模块，在多个数据集上取得了优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统双曝光成像（DEI）虽能结合短曝光和长曝光图像的互补优势提升低光场景图像质量，但存在场景运动导致的空间位移和不同曝光时间引起的图像特征差异，从而产生伪影问题。

Method: 将任务分解为基于事件的运动去模糊和低光图像增强两个子任务，设计双路径并行特征传播架构的E-DEI网络，提出双路径特征对齐与融合（DFAF）模块，利用事件相机辅助双曝光图像特征的精确对齐与融合，并构建了包含配对的低/正常光照图像和事件数据的真实世界数据集PIED。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明所提方法优于现有方法。

Conclusion: E-DEI算法有效利用事件相机的高时间分辨率信息，解决了双曝光成像中的运动伪影和特征差异问题，提升了低光场景下的图像重建质量。

Abstract: By combining complementary benefits of short- and long-exposure images, Dual-Exposure Imaging (DEI) enhances image quality in low-light scenarios. However, existing DEI approaches inevitably suffer from producing artifacts due to spatial displacement from scene motion and image feature discrepancies from different exposure times. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel Event-based DEI (E-DEI) algorithm, which reconstructs high-quality images from dual-exposure image pairs and events, leveraging high temporal resolution of event cameras to provide accurate inter-/intra-frame dynamic information. Specifically, we decompose this complex task into an integration of two sub-tasks, i.e., event-based motion deblurring and low-light image enhancement tasks, which guides us to design E-DEI network as a dual-path parallel feature propagation architecture. We propose a Dual-path Feature Alignment and Fusion (DFAF) module to effectively align and fuse features extracted from dual-exposure images with assistance of events. Furthermore, we build a real-world Dataset containing Paired low-/normal-light Images and Events (PIED). Experiments on multiple datasets show the superiority of our method. The code and dataset are available at github.

</details>


### [158] [Analytical Modeling and Correction of Distance Error in Homography-Based Ground-Plane Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10805)
*Mateusz Szulc,Marcin Iwanowski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文推导了单目相机中单应性矩阵扰动与距离误差之间的二次关系，并评估了两种校正策略：回归估计和梯度下降优化。基于1900万以上样本的仿真表明，回归精度更高但依赖模型拟合质量，梯度下降对不良初始校准更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目相机距离估计中，平面单应性初始化的小误差会导致系统性距离畸变，目前缺乏对这种误差传播关系的显式建模和有效校正策略的研究。

Method: 首先推导单应性扰动与距离误差之间的显式关系，证明误差随真实距离呈近似二次增长。然后提出两种校正策略：基于回归的二次误差函数估计，以及基于坐标梯度下降的直接单应性优化。通过大规模仿真（1900万样本）验证方法有效性。

Result: 回归方法在模型可靠拟合时达到更高峰值精度，梯度下降方法对不良初始校准具有更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 在许多实际系统中，改善几何校准比增加模型复杂度能带来更大的性能提升。

Abstract: Accurate distance estimation from monocular cameras is essential for intelligent monitoring systems. In many deployments, image coordinates are mapped to ground positions using planar homographies initialized by manual selection of corresponding regions. Small inaccuracies in this initialization propagate into systematic distance distortions. This paper derives an explicit relationship between homography perturbations and the resulting distance error, showing that the error grows approximately quadratically with the true distance from the camera. Based on this model, two simple correction strategies are evaluated: regression-based estimation of the quadratic error function and direct optimization of the homography via coordinate-based gradient descent. A large-scale simulation study with more than 19 million test samples demonstrates that regression achieves higher peak accuracy when the model is reliably fitted, whereas gradient descent provides greater robustness against poor initial calibration. This suggests that improving geometric calibration may yield greater performance gains than increasing model complexity in many practical systems.

</details>


### [159] [SpaCeFormer: Fast Proposal-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20395)
*Chris Choy,Junha Lee,Chunghyun Park,Minsu Cho,Jan Kautz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpaCeFormer是一种无需候选框的空间曲线Transformer，实现0.12-0.30秒/场景的开放词汇3D实例分割，结合SpaCeFormer-3M数据集（300万标注、7.4K场景），在ScanNet200上zero-shot mAP达11.1，比之前最好的无候选框方法提升2.8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇3D实例分割方法存在瓶颈：多阶段2D+3D方案速度慢（数百秒/场景），而伪标签端到端方法依赖碎片化掩码和外部区域提议，效率与质量难以兼顾。

Method: 提出SpaCeFormer：基于空间窗口注意力与Morton曲线序列化获取空间连贯特征，通过RoPE增强解码器直接预测实例掩码，无需外部候选框。同时构建SpaCeFormer-3M数据集，采用多视图掩码聚类和多视图VLM描述生成300万标注。

Result: ScanNet200 zero-shot mAP 11.1（2.8×提升），ScanNet++ 22.9 mAP，Replica 24.1 mAP，超越所有先前方法；推理速度0.12-0.30秒/场景，比多阶段2D+3D方案快2-3个数量级；数据集掩码召回率54.3%，比单视图方案高21倍。

Conclusion: SpaCeFormer证明了无候选框、端到端的空间曲线Transformer在开放词汇3D实例分割中兼具速度与精度优势，大规模多视图标注数据集进一步释放了模型潜力。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation is a core capability for robotics and AR/VR, but prior methods trade one bottleneck for another: multi-stage 2D+3D pipelines aggregate foundation-model outputs at hundreds of seconds per scene, while pseudo-labeled end-to-end approaches rely on fragmented masks and external region proposals. We present SpaCeFormer, a proposal-free space-curve transformer that runs in 0.12--0.30 seconds per scene across standard benchmarks, 2--3 orders of magnitude faster than multi-stage 2D+3D pipelines. We pair it with SpaCeFormer-3M, the largest open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation dataset (3.0M multi-view-consistent captions over 604K instances from 7.4K scenes) built through multi-view mask clustering and multi-view VLM captioning; it reaches 21$\times$ higher mask recall than prior single-view pipelines (54.3% vs 2.5% at IoU$>$0.5). SpaCeFormer combines spatial window attention with Morton-curve serialization for spatially coherent features, and uses a RoPE-enhanced decoder to predict instance masks directly from learned queries without external proposals. On ScanNet200 we achieve 11.1 zero-shot mAP, a 2.8$\times$ improvement over the prior best proposal-free method; on ScanNet++ and Replica, we reach 22.9 and 24.1 mAP, surpassing all prior methods including those using multi-view 2D inputs.

</details>


### [160] [MAPRPose: Mask-Aware Proposal and Amodal Refinement for Multi-Object 6D Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20650)
*Yang Luo,Yan Gong,Yongsheng Gao,Xiaoying Sun,Jie Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAPRPose是一种两阶段6D物体姿态估计框架，通过掩码感知对应关系生成姿态提议，并利用非模态驱动ROI预测进行鲁棒精化，在BOP基准上以76.5% AR超越FoundationPose 3.1%，同时实现43倍多目标推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有6D物体姿态估计方法在严重遮挡和传感器噪声场景下性能不佳，亟需更鲁棒的姿态精化机制来应对遮挡导致的定位误差和空间错位问题。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) MAPP阶段，将2D对应提升至3D空间建立关键点匹配，基于对应评分生成几何一致的姿态假设并选出Top-K候选；(2) AMPR精化阶段，通过非模态掩码预测和ROI重对齐恢复完整几何并动态调整ROI，结合GPU加速的RGB-XYZ重投影实现所有N×B姿态假设的单次前向并行精化。

Result: 在BOP基准上达到76.5% AR，超越FoundationPose 3.1% AR，多目标推理速度提升43倍。

Conclusion: MAPRPose通过掩码感知对应与非模态驱动的ROI精化，在严重遮挡下实现了优越的精度与效率，验证了两阶段框架在复杂场景姿态估计中的有效性。

Abstract: 6D object pose estimation in cluttered scenes remains challenging due to severe occlusion and sensor noise. We propose MAPRPose, a two-stage framework that leverages mask-aware correspondences for pose proposal and amodal-driven Region-of-Interest (ROI) prediction for robust refinement. In the Mask-Aware Pose Proposal (MAPP) stage, we lift 2D correspondences into 3D space to establish reliable keypoint matches and generate geometrically consistent pose hypotheses based on correspondence-level scoring, from which the top-$K$ candidates are selected. In the refinement stage, we introduce a tensorized render-and-compare pipeline integrated with an Amodal Mask Prediction and ROI Re-Alignment (AMPR) module. By reconstructing complete object geometry and dynamically adjusting the ROI, AMPR mitigates localization errors and spatial misalignment under heavy occlusion. Furthermore, our GPU-accelerated RGB-XYZ reprojection enables simultaneous refinement of all $N \times B$ pose hypotheses in a single forward pass. Evaluated on the BOP benchmark, MAPRPose achieves a state-of-the-art Average Recall (AR) of 76.5%, outperforming FoundationPose by 3.1% AR while delivering a 43x speedup in multi-object inference.

</details>


### [161] [SpaMEM: Benchmarking Dynamic Spatial Reasoning via Perception-Memory Integration in Embodied Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22409)
*Chih-Ting Liao,Xi Xiao,Chunlei Meng,Zhangquan Chen,Yitong Qiao,Weilin Zhou,Tianyang Wang,Xu Zheng,Xin Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpaMEM，一个大规模诊断基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在具身环境中维持空间信念演化的能力。基准包含1000个程序化生成房屋中的25,000+交互序列，覆盖1060万张四模态图像，设计了三级15项诊断任务。实验揭示主流VLM存在坐标一致性瓶颈和符号脚手架依赖：模型在文本记录下表现良好，但在原始视觉流中难以维持稳健的空间记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在静态视觉-空间推理中表现不俗，但在具身环境中，模型需要从第一人称观测持续更新空间信念（belief revision），且面临环境动态变化和长程交互的挑战。目前缺乏能够隔离诊断空间信念演化核心机制的基准，因此作者构建SpaMEM以填补这一空白。

Method: SpaMEM基于物理引擎在1000个随机生成房屋中收集10,601,392张高保真图像（RGB、深度、实例分割、语义分割四种模态），涵盖25,000+交互序列。形式化具身空间推理为三级层次结构：Level 1（单视角原子空间感知）、Level 2（基于oracle文本状态历史的时间推理）、Level 3（从原始视觉流端到端信念维护）。任务维度涵盖短期（逐步）更新和长期（情节级）重建。

Result: 主流开源VLM家族在SpaMEM上呈现一致的堆叠瓶颈：坐标一致的定位能力是硬上限（hard ceiling）；从Level 2到Level 3的显著性能崩塌暴露了符号脚手架依赖——模型在文本书写的状态追踪下表现优异，但在依赖视觉记忆维持信念时大幅衰退。

Conclusion: SpaMEM提供了细粒度的诊断标准，揭示了当前MLLM在具身空间推理中的根本性缺陷，并激励未来研究开发显式的状态表示、信念修正机制以及长程情节整合方法。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced static visual--spatial reasoning, yet they often fail to preserve long-horizon spatial coherence in embodied settings where beliefs must be continuously revised from egocentric observations under environmental change. We introduce SpaMEM (Spatial Memory from Action Sequences), a large-scale diagnostic benchmark that isolates the mechanics of spatial belief evolution via action-conditioned scene transformations (spawn, place, remove) over long interaction horizons. SpaMEM is built on a physically grounded dataset with 10,601,392 high-fidelity images across four modalities (RGB, depth, instance, semantic segmentation), collected from 25,000+ interaction sequences in 1,000 procedurally generated houses. We formalize embodied spatial reasoning as a three-level hierarchy with 15 diagnostic tasks: Level 1 measures atomic spatial perception from single observations; Level 2 probes temporal reasoning with oracle textual state histories to factor out perceptual noise; and Level 3 requires end-to-end belief maintenance from raw visual streams under the same task dimensions. We further evaluate both short-term (step-wise) updates and long-term (episodic) reconstruction. Benchmarking representative open-source VLM families reveals a consistent stacked bottleneck: coordinate-consistent grounding remains a hard ceiling, and the sharp collapse from Level 2 to Level 3 exposes a pronounced symbolic scaffolding dependency, where models succeed with text-based bookkeeping but struggle to sustain robust visual memory. SpaMEM provides a granular diagnostic standard and motivates explicit mechanisms for state representation, belief revision, and long-horizon episodic integration. A subset of SpaMEM is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mill-ct-liao/SpaMEM.

</details>


### [162] [Semantic Foam: Unifying Spatial and Semantic Scene Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26262)
*Amr Sharafeldin,Shrisudhan Govindarajan,Thomas Walker,Aryan Mikaeili,Daniel Rebain,Kwang Moo Yi,Andrea Tagliasacchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Semantic Foam通过将Radiant Foam的Voronoi网格与细胞级显式语义特征场结合，实现了高质量且一致的语义分解，在物体级分割上达到或超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D场景重建方法（如3D Gaussian Splatting）在交互式图形应用中的采用受限，主要瓶颈在于难以与这些表示进行交互。尽管已有研究尝试对模型进行语义分解，但在分割质量和一致性方面仍存在重大挑战。

Method: 将Radiant Foam的Voronoi网格自然空间体积分解与细胞级参数化的显式语义特征场相结合，利用显式结构实现直接的空间正则化，防止因遮挡或跨视图监督不一致导致的伪影。

Result: 在物体级分割性能上达到或超越了Gaussian Grouping和SAGA等最先进方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的显式语义特征场与Voronoi网格结合的方法能有效提高分割质量与一致性，为交互式图形应用中的3D场景语义理解提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Modern scene reconstruction methods, such as 3D Gaussian Splatting, deliver photo-realistic novel view synthesis at real-time speeds, yet their adoption in interactive graphics applications has been limited. A major bottleneck is the difficulty of interacting with these representations compared to traditional, human-authored 3D assets. While previous research has attempted to impose semantic decomposition on these models, significant challenges remain regarding segmentation quality and consistency. To address this, we introduce Semantic Foam, extending the recently proposed Radiant Foam representations to semantic decomposition tasks. Our approach integrates the natural spatial volumetric decomposition of Radiant Foam's Voronoi mesh with an explicit semantic feature field parameterized at the cell level. This explicit structure enables direct spatial regularization, which prevents artifacts caused by occlusion or inconsistent supervision across views - common pitfalls for other point-based representations. Experimental results show that our method achieves comparable or superior object-level segmentation performance compared to state-of-the-art methods like Gaussian Grouping and SAGA.

</details>


### [163] [Robust Lightweight Crack Classification for Real-Time UAV Bridge Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27617)
*Wei Li,Haisheng Li,Weijie Li,Jiandong Wang,Kaichen Ma,Luming Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AttXNet，一种用于无人机桥梁裂缝检测的轻量级统一CNN框架，通过结合轻量骨干网络、CBAM注意力机制、基于先验的定向增强策略和Focal Loss，在SDNET2018数据集上以11.21M参数和825 FPS的推理速度实现了F1分数提升2.51%、召回率提升3.95%的性能，平衡了精度、速度和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机在桥梁结构健康监测中广泛应用，但实际检测面临裂缝特征弱、成像条件退化、类别严重不平衡以及计算资源有限等四大挑战，现有方法难以同时满足这些约束。

Method: 提出统一轻量级CNN框架AttXNet，包含四个协同组件：轻量骨干网络（降低计算量）、CBAM（通道和空间注意力增强）、基于检测场景先验的定向鲁棒增强策略（应对退化成像）、以及Focal Loss（处理类别不平衡）。

Result: 在SDNET2018桥面数据集上，模型仅11.21M参数、1.82G FLOPs，推理速度达825 FPS；相比基线，F1分数提升2.51%，召回率提升3.95%。Grad-CAM可视化显示注意力模块使模型关注从分散区域转向沿裂缝轨迹的精准追踪。

Conclusion: 该方法在精度、速度和鲁棒性之间实现了良好平衡，为无人机桥梁检测中地面站辅助的实时部署提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: With the widespread application of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in bridge structural health monitoring, deep learning-based automatic crack detection has become a major research focus. However, practical UAV inspections still face four key challenges: weak crack features, degraded imaging conditions, severe class imbalance, and limited computational resources for practical UAV inspection workflows. To address these issues, this paper proposes a unified lightweight convolutional neural network framework composed of four synergistic components: a lightweight backbone network, a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for channel and spatial enhancement, a directed robust augmentation strategy based on inspection-scene priors, and Focal Loss for hard-sample learning under class imbalance. Experiments on the SDNET2018 bridge deck dataset show that the proposed method achieves an inference speed of 825 FPS with only 11.21M parameters and 1.82G FLOPs. Compared with the baseline model, the complete framework improves the F1-score by 2.51% and recall by 3.95%. In addition, Grad-CAM visualizations indicate that the introduced attention module shifts the model's focus from scattered regions to precise tracking along crack trajectories. Overall, this study achieves a strong balance among accuracy, speed, and robustness, providing a practical solution for ground-station assisted real-time deployment in UAV bridge inspections. The source code is available at: https://github.com/skylynf/AttXNet .

</details>


### [164] [FreeTimeGS++: Secrets of Dynamic Gaussian Splatting and Their Principles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03337)
*Lucas Yunkyu Lee,Soonho Kim,Youngwook Kim,Sangmin Kim,Jaesik Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了4D高斯喷溅（4DGS）框架中的隐藏因素，建立可控基线FreeTimeGS_ours，揭示了高斯持续时间驱动的时序分区、光度保真度与时空一致性之间的差异等关键秘密，并提出了改进方法FreeTimeGS++，采用门控边缘化和神经速度场实现更稳定的动态重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4DGS虽在动态场景重建中表现优异，但其性能提升的具体驱动因素尚不明确，缺乏对底层原理的系统性理解。

Method: 建立可控基线FreeTimeGS_ours复现FreeTimeGS；沿基本轴线剖析4DGS，揭示高斯持续时间导致的时序分区等现象；提出FreeTimeGS++，采用门控边缘化和神经速度场。

Result: FreeTimeGS++在稳定性上更优，动态表示更鲁棒，可复现结果且运行间方差降低。

Conclusion: 通过系统分析揭示了4DGS的关键隐藏因素，提出的FreeTimeGS++为动态场景重建提供了更可靠的基础，将开源实现以促进未来研究。

Abstract: The recent surge in 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has achieved impressive dynamic scene reconstruction. While these methods demonstrate remarkable performance, the specific drivers behind such gains remain less explored, making a systematic understanding of the underlying principles challenging. In this paper, we perform a comprehensive analysis of these hidden factors to provide a clearer perspective on the 4DGS framework. We first establish a controlled baseline, FreeTimeGS_ours, by formalizing and reproducing the heuristics of the state-of-the-art FreeTimeGS. Using this framework, we dissect 4DGS along its fundamental axes and uncover key secrets, including the emergent temporal partitioning driven by Gaussian durations and the discrepancy between photometric fidelity and spatiotemporal consistency. Based on these insights, we propose FreeTimeGS++, a principled method that employs gated marginalization and neural velocity fields to achieve superior stability and robust dynamic representations. Our approach yields reproducible results with reduced run-to-run variance. We will release our implementation to provide a reliable foundation for future 4DGS research.

</details>


### [165] [Autoregressive Visual Generation Needs a Prologue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06137)
*Bowen Zheng,Weijian Luo,Guang Yang,Colin Zhang,Tianyang Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Prologue通过为自回归图像生成引入独立的"序言令牌"（prologue tokens），解决了重建与生成之间的差距问题——这些令牌专用于生成任务，而视觉令牌保持不变，从而在不影响重建质量的前提下显著提升生成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归图像生成中存在重建与生成之间的差距：视觉令牌需要同时兼顾重建质量和生成能力，导致两者相互掣肘。现有方法通过修改视觉令牌来平衡两者，但难以同时优化。

Method: 提出Prologue方法，在视觉令牌序列前添加一组小的序言令牌。序言令牌仅用自回归交叉熵损失训练以优化生成，视觉令牌则专用于重建。这种解耦设计使得生成优化可以在AR模型的真实分布上进行，而不影响重建质量，并从ELBO角度进行了形式化分析。

Result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，Prologue-Base在无分类器引导下将gFID从21.01降至10.75，重建几乎不变；Prologue-Large达到rFID 0.99和gFID 1.46的竞争力结果，无需辅助语义监督。16个序言令牌的线性探测Top-1达35.88%，远高于标准分词器前16个令牌的23.71%。

Conclusion: 生成质量可以通过引入独立的可学习生成表示来提升，同时保持原始表示不变。序言令牌在仅受AR梯度驱动下展现出突现的语义结构，表明了一种新的研究方向。

Abstract: In this work, we propose Prologue, an approach to bridging the reconstruction-generation gap in autoregressive (AR) image generation. Instead of modifying visual tokens to satisfy both reconstruction and generation, Prologue generates a small set of prologue tokens prepended to the visual token sequence. These prologue tokens are trained exclusively with the AR cross-entropy (CE) loss, while visual tokens remain dedicated to reconstruction. This decoupled design lets us optimize generation through the AR model's true distribution without affecting reconstruction quality, which we further formalize from an ELBO perspective. On ImageNet 256x256, Prologue-Base reduces gFID from 21.01 to 10.75 without classifier-free guidance while keeping reconstruction almost unchanged; Prologue-Large reaches a competitive rFID of 0.99 and gFID of 1.46 using a standard AR model without auxiliary semantic supervision. Interestingly, driven only by AR gradients, prologue tokens exhibit emergent semantic structure: linear probing on 16 prologue tokens reaches 35.88% Top-1, far above the 23.71% of the first 16 tokens from a standard tokenizer; resampling with fixed prologue tokens preserves a similar high-level semantic layout. Our results suggest a new direction: generation quality can be improved by introducing a separate learned generative representation while leaving the original representation intact.

</details>


### [166] [Eulerian Motion Guidance: Robust Image Animation via Bidirectional Geometric Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06280)
*Thong Nguyen,Khoi M. Le,Cong-Duy Nguyen,Luu Anh Tuan,See-Kiong Ng,Chunyan Miao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于欧拉运动场（相邻帧光流）的扩散模型图像动画方法，通过双向几何一致性机制解决遮挡导致的漂移伪影，实现并行化训练和有界误差监督，在加速训练、保持时间连贯性和减少动态伪影方面优于参考基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的图像动画可控框架依赖拉格朗日运动引导（相对于初始帧的光流估计），这种方法存在训练无法并行化、误差累积无界等问题。本文旨在通过重新设计光流监督方式来解决上述局限。

Method: 1) 使用相邻帧欧拉运动场替代初始帧参考的拉格朗日光流，实现并行化训练和有界误差监督；2) 引入双向几何一致性机制，通过前向-后向循环检查数学识别并掩蔽遮挡区域，防止模型学习错误的扭曲目标。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在训练速度、时间连贯性保持和动态伪影减少方面均优于基于参考的基线方法。

Conclusion: 欧拉运动场结合双向几何一致性机制能有效解决相邻帧生成中的漂移问题，为图像动画提供更高效的训练范式。

Abstract: Recent advancements in image animation have utilized diffusion models to breathe life into static images. However, existing controllable frameworks typically rely on Lagrangian motion guidance, where optical flow is estimated relative to the initial frame. This paper revisits the same optical-flow primitive through a more local supervision design: we use adjacent-frame Eulerian motion fields to guide generation, where the motion signal always describes a short temporal hop. This shift enables parallelized training and provides bounded-error supervision throughout the generation process. To mitigate the drift artifacts common in adjacent frame generation, we introduce a Bidirectional Geometric Consistency mechanism, which computes a forward-backward cycle check to mathematically identify and mask occluded regions, preventing the model from learning incorrect warping objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach accelerates training, preserves temporal coherence, and reduces dynamic artifacts compared to reference-based baselines.

</details>


### [167] [Self-Captioning Multimodal Interaction Tuning: Amplifying Exploitable Redundancies for Robust Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08145)
*Yuriel Ryan,Hei Man Ip,Adriel Kuek,Paul Pu Liang,Roy Ka-Wei Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出通过放大多模态间的冗余交互（共享信息）来解决视觉语言模型的幻觉和鲁棒性问题，设计了多模态交互门（Multimodal Interaction Gate）机制将独特交互转化为冗余交互，实验表明该方法可减少38.3%的视觉诱导错误并提升16.8%的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在面对模糊或受损模态时存在幻觉和鲁棒性问题，作者假设通过利用模态间共享信息来补偿受损模态可以解决这些问题。

Method: 提出自标注工作流（self-captioning workflow），核心是Multimodal Interaction Gate机制，该门控机制将模态间的独特交互（exclusive）转换为冗余交互（redundant），从而增加可被利用的共享信息。

Result: 增加冗余交互可减少38.3%的视觉诱导错误，并提升16.8%的一致性。

Conclusion: 放大冗余交互是提升多模态模型可靠性的有效途径，弥补了现代指令数据集因优先视觉定位而消除冗余的问题。

Abstract: Current vision language models face hallucination and robustness issues against ambiguous or corrupted modalities. We hypothesize that these issues can be addressed by exploiting the shared information between modalities to compensate for the impaired one. To this end, we analyze multimodal interactions -- redundant (shared), unique (exclusive), and synergistic (emergent) task-relevant information provided by the modalities -- to determine their impacts on model reliability. Specifically, amplifying redundant interactions would increase this exploitable shared information to resolve these issues; yet, modern instruction datasets often eliminate redundancies to prioritize visual grounding. We bridge this gap through a self-captioning workflow featuring a \textsc{Multimodal Interaction Gate}: a mechanism to convert unique interactions into redundant interactions. Our findings suggest that increasing redundancy can reduce visual induced errors by 38.3\% and improve consistency by 16.8\%.

</details>


### [168] [3D-Belief: Embodied Belief Inference via Generative 3D World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11367)
*Yifan Yin,Zehao Wen,Suyu Ye,Jieneng Chen,Zehan Zheng,Nanru Dai,Haojun Shi,Aydan Huang,Zheyuan Zhang,Alan Yuille,Jianwen Xie,Ayush Tewari,Tianmin Shu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出3D-Belief，一种将世界建模视为具身智能体在3D空间中进行信念推断的生成式模型。不同于传统的新视角合成或未来帧预测方法，3D-Belief从部分观测中推断显式、可操作的3D信念，并在线更新，直接表示3D空间中的不确定性，支持智能体想象场景补全并推理部分观测环境。实验表明，该方法在2D/3D想象质量和下游导航任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉生成世界模型大多聚焦于视觉真实感（新视角合成或未来帧预测），忽略了具身智能体在部分可观测环境下所需的结构化不确定性建模能力。作者认为世界模型应维护并更新智能体对未观测3D世界的信念，而非仅渲染可能看到的内容。

Method: 提出3D-Belief，一种生成式3D世界模型，具备四个关键能力：空间一致性的场景记忆、多假设信念采样、序列信念更新、以及对未观测区域的语义信息预测。模型从部分观测输入推断显式的3D信念表示，并在时间序列上在线更新，直接以3D形式表示不确定性。

Result: 在2D视觉质量（场景记忆与未观测场景想象）、3D想象（基于提出的3D-CORE基准评估对象级和场景级想象）以及物体导航任务（仿真和真实世界）上进行评估。3D-Belief在2D/3D想象质量和下游具身任务性能上均优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 将世界建模重新定义为具身信念推断在3D空间中的过程，并验证了显式3D不确定性表示对下游具身任务的有效性，为构建更符合具身智能需求的世界模型提供了新方向。

Abstract: Recent advances in visual generative models have highlighted the promise of learning generative world models. However, most existing approaches frame world modeling as novel-view synthesis or future-frame prediction, emphasizing visual realism rather than the structured uncertainty required by embodied agents acting under partial observability. In this work, we propose a different perspective: world modeling as embodied belief inference in 3D space. From this view, a world model should not merely render what may be seen, but maintain and update an agent's belief about the unobserved 3D world as new observations are acquired. We identify several key capabilities for such models, including spatially consistent scene memory, multi-hypothesis belief sampling, sequential belief updating, and semantically informed prediction of unseen regions. We instantiate these ideas in 3D-Belief, a generative 3D world model that infers explicit, actionable 3D beliefs from partial observations and updates them online over time. Unlike prior visual prediction models, 3D-Belief represents uncertainty directly in 3D, enabling embodied agents to imagine plausible scene completions and reason over partially observed environments. We evaluate 3D-Belief on 2D visual quality for scene memory and unobserved-scene imagination, object- and scene-level 3D imagination using our proposed 3D-CORE benchmark, and challenging object navigation tasks in both simulation and the real world. Experiments show that 3D-Belief improves 2D and 3D imagination quality and downstream embodied task performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [169] [Causal Forcing++: Scalable Few-Step Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15141)
*Min Zhao,Hongzhou Zhu,Kaiwen Zheng,Zihan Zhou,Bokai Yan,Xinyuan Li,Xiao Yang,Chongxuan Li,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Causal Forcing++，一种基于因果一致性蒸馏的帧级自回归视频生成流水线，仅需1-2步采样即可实现实时交互式视频生成，在帧级2步设置下超越SOTA的4步块级因果强迫方法，同时降低首帧延迟50%和训练成本约4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归扩散蒸馏方法在块级4步生成上取得不错效果，但存在响应粒度粗、采样延迟高的问题。为实现实时交互式视频生成，需要更激进的帧级自回归（仅需1-2步采样），而现有初始化策略要么目标不对齐、要么无法支持少步生成、要么成本过高，急需一种高效的帧级少步自回归初始化方案。

Method: 提出Causal Forcing++流水线，核心是因果一致性蒸馏：通过相邻时间步之间的单步在线教师ODE步提供监督，学习与因果ODE蒸馏相同的AR条件流映射，无需预计算和存储完整的PF-ODE轨迹，从而实现高效且易于优化的少步AR初始化。

Result: 帧级2步设置下，在VBench Total上提升0.1，VBench Quality上提升0.3，VisionReward上提升0.335；首帧延迟降低50%；Stage 2训练成本降低约4倍。

Conclusion: Causal Forcing++为实时交互式视频生成提供了一种高效、可扩展的帧级少步自回归方案，并可扩展至以行动为条件的世界模型生成（类似Genie3）。

Abstract: Real-time interactive video generation requires low-latency, streaming, and controllable rollout. Existing autoregressive (AR) diffusion distillation methods have achieved strong results in the chunk-wise 4-step regime by distilling bidirectional base models into few-step AR students, but they remain limited by coarse response granularity and non-negligible sampling latency. In this paper, we study a more aggressive setting: frame-wise autoregression with only 1--2 sampling steps. In this regime, we identify the initialization of a few-step AR student as the key bottleneck: existing strategies are either target-misaligned, incapable of few-step generation, or too costly to scale. We propose \textbf{Causal Forcing++}, a principled and scalable pipeline that uses \emph{causal consistency distillation} (causal CD) for few-step AR initialization. The core idea is that causal CD learns the same AR-conditional flow map as causal ODE distillation, but obtains supervision from a single online teacher ODE step between adjacent timesteps, avoiding the need to precompute and store full PF-ODE trajectories. This makes the initialization both more efficient and easier to optimize. The resulting pipeline, \ours, surpasses the SOTA 4-step chunk-wise Causal Forcing under the \textit{\textbf{frame-wise 2-step setting}} by 0.1 in VBench Total, 0.3 in VBench Quality, and 0.335 in VisionReward, while reducing first-frame latency by 50\% and Stage 2 training cost by $\sim$$4\times$. We further extend the pipeline to action-conditioned world model generation in the spirit of Genie3. Project Page: https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing and https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM .

</details>


### [170] [MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16716)
*Shuowei Li,Yuming Zhao,Parth Bhalerao,Oana Ignat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MAVEN框架，通过多智能体提示细化提升文生视频（T2V）的文化保真度，涵盖单文化和跨文化场景。基于243个文化提示和972个视频的基准评估表明，并行专业化策略能显著改善文化相关性，同时保持视觉质量和时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2V生成在视觉保真度上进步显著，但对多文化忠实表征的能力尚缺乏系统探索，尤其是单提示中需同时体现多种文化元素的场景。

Method: 提出MAVEN（Multi-Agent prompt refiNement）框架，将提示分解为人物（person）、动作（action）、地点（location）三个维度，由专门智能体以并行或串行方式处理。同时构建包含3种文化（中、美、罗马尼亚）、3种动作类别、单文化与跨文化场景的243个文化提示及972个视频的基准数据集。

Result: 综合CLIP指标、VLM评判和视频质量评估显示，多智能体细化（尤其是并行专业化）能显著提升文化相关性，同时保持视觉质量和时间一致性。

Conclusion: 多智能体并行分解策略是提升T2V跨文化生成保真度的有效方法，为文化感知视频生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has rapidly progressed in visual fidelity, yet its ability to faithfully represent multiple cultures within a single prompt remains underexplored. We introduce MAVEN, a multi-agent prompt refinement framework designed to improve cultural fidelity in both mono-cultural and cross-cultural T2V generation. MAVEN decomposes prompts into person, action, and location dimensions, handled by specialized agents operating in parallel or sequentially. To support systematic evaluation, we contribute a new benchmark of 243 culturally grounded prompts and 972 corresponding videos, spanning three cultures (Chinese, American, Romanian), three action categories, and both mono-cultural and cross-cultural scenarios. Evaluations combining CLIP-based metrics, VLM-as-judge assessments, and videoquality measures show that multi-agent refinement, particularly parallel specialization, significantly improves cultural relevance while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MAVEN

</details>


### [171] [DSAA: Dual-Stage Attribute Activation for Fine-grained Open Vocabulary Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18023)
*Donghong Jiang,Endian Lin,Hanqing Liu,Mingjie Liu,Luoping Cui,Zhao Yang,Chuang Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DSAA框架，通过在文本嵌入和BERT编码两个阶段增强属性语义，解决开放词汇目标检测在细粒度属性检测中的性能瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OVD模型在涉及颜色、材质、纹理等属性的细粒度检测任务中表现不佳，原因是类别信号主导导致属性信息被边缘化，造成属性与目标对象的错误绑定。

Method: 提出双阶段属性激活框架：1) 文本嵌入阶段使用Attribute Prefix Adapter注入显式属性先验；2) BERT编码阶段通过Key/Value Modulator模块选择性增强属性token的K/V向量；3) 引入属性感知对比损失提升同类不同属性实例的区分度。

Result: 在FG-OVD基准上验证了该方法在多种主流开放词汇模型上的有效性。

Conclusion: DSAA框架通过双阶段属性激活策略有效缓解了OVD模型中类别信号对属性信息的抑制，显著提升了细粒度检测性能。

Abstract: Open-Vocabulary Object Detection (OVD) models break the limitations of closed-set detection, enabling the identification of unseen categories through natural language prompts. However, they exhibit notable limitations in fine-grained detection tasks involving attributes like color, material, and texture. We attribute this performance bottleneck in OVD models to a core issue: when category signals dominate, OVD models tend to marginalize attribute information during inference. This leads to incorrect binding between attributes and target objects. To address this, we propose the Dual-Stage Attribute Activation (DSAA) framework, which enhances fine-grained detection capabilities by strengthening attribute semantics at two critical stages. In the text embedding stage, we employ Attribute Prefix Adapter (APA) module to generate attribute prefixes that inject explicit attribute priors. To further amplify the influence of these attributes, our Key/Value (K/V) Modulator module then intervenes during the BERT encoding phase, selectively enhancing the Key and Value vectors of the corresponding attribute tokens. In addition, we introduce an attribute-aware contrastive loss to improve discrimination among same-category instances with different attributes during training. Experimental results on the FG-OVD benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of our method across various mainstream open-vocabulary models.

</details>


### [172] [CHOIR: Contact-aware 4D Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20992)
*Hao Xu,Yilin Liu,Yinqiao Wang,Chi-Wing Fu,Niloy J. Mitra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CHOIR是一个从日常单目视频中重建手-物交互（HOI）的4D框架，通过显式利用接触信号作为手与物体之间的耦合线索，实现了关节手运动、物体形状与6D位姿、接触时空信息的联合重建，在挑战性视频上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常假设已知物体或精心布置的场景，且独立估计手和物体在杂乱、遮挡和未知几何下容易产生对齐错误，缺乏从开放世界单目视频中规模化挖掘真实交互的能力。

Method: 首先从开放世界视觉先验初始化粗略的、无接触的4D HOI序列；然后引入生成式HOI空间校正模块，预测射线深度校正并修正手-物相对位置，再在校正几何上推导初始逐帧接触对应关系；最后通过动态更新接触约束的联合优化，强制几何、时序和接触一致性。

Result: 在受控和挑战性视频上，CHOIR在物体重建质量、物理合理性和时序一致性方面均优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: 以接触作为显式耦合信号能够有效解决单目视频中手-物交互重建的对齐问题，为可扩展的真实交互挖掘和场景感知合成与规划提供了可行方案。

Abstract: We ask whether everyday open-world monocular videos can be turned into reusable 4D interaction primitives: articulated hand motion, object shape with 6D pose over time, and the when/where of contact. Such a capability would enable scalable mining of real interactions and, beyond reconstruction, support scene-aware synthesis and planning. However, reconstructing hand-object interaction (HOI) from challenging monocular videos remains difficult: methods often assume known objects or curated scenes, and separately estimated hands and objects easily become misaligned under clutter, occlusion, and unseen object geometries. Targeting this setting, we present CHOIR, a Contact-aware HOI Reconstruction framework for a monocular camera, using contact as an explicit coupling signal between hands and objects. CHOIR first initializes a coarse, contact-agnostic 4D HOI sequence from open-world visual priors. It then introduces a generative HOI spatial rectification module to predict ray-depth corrections and rectify hand-object relative placement, then derive initial per-frame contact correspondences on the rectified geometry. Last, a contact-aware joint optimization with dynamically updated contact constraints enforces geometric, temporal, and contact consistency. Experiments on controlled and challenging videos show that CHOIR improves object reconstruction, physical plausibility, and temporal consistency over state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [173] [LiteViLNet: Lightweight Vision-LiDAR Fusion Network for Efficient Road Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21007)
*Daojie Peng,Bingtao Wang,Fulong Ma,Liang Zhang,Jun Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LiteViLNet，一种轻量级多模态道路分割网络，通过双流轻量编码器、深度可分离卷积、多尺度特征融合模块和大核桥接模块，在KITTI数据集上以14.04M参数达到96.36% MaxF，RTX 4060 Ti上163.79 FPS，Jetson Orin NX上22.18 FPS，实现精度与效率的平衡，适合嵌入式实时部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的多模态道路分割方法虽性能优异，但计算开销巨大，无法在资源受限的边缘设备上实时部署。亟需一种轻量级、高效率且保持高精度的多模态道路分割方案。

Method: 1) 双流轻量编码器 + 深度可分离卷积提取RGB和LiDAR层级特征；2) 多尺度特征融合模块(MSFM)促进跨模态交互；3) 大核桥接模块以线性复杂度捕获长距离依赖。

Result: 14.04M参数，KITTI Road数据集上96.36% MaxF（所有CNN方法最优，可比肩大型Transformer模型）；RTX 4060 Ti上163.79 FPS（模型推理），Jetson Orin NX上22.18 FPS。

Conclusion: LiteViLNet在精度与效率间取得了优异平衡，证明了其在自动驾驶和智能机器人实时嵌入式部署中的潜力。

Abstract: Road segmentation is a fundamental perception task for autonomous driving and intelligent robotic systems, requiring both high accuracy and real-time inference, especially for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Existing multi-modal road segmentation methods often rely on heavy transformer-based encoders to achieve state-of-the-art performance, but their enormous computational cost prohibits real-time deployment on embedded platforms. To address this dilemma, we propose LiteViLNet, a lightweight multi-modal network that fuses RGB texture information and LiDAR geometric information for efficient road segmentation. Specifically, we design a dual-stream lightweight encoder and depth-wise separable convolutions to extract hierarchical features from both modalities with minimal parameters. We further propose a Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Module (MSFM) to facilitate cross-modal interaction at different levels, and a large-kernel-bridge module to capture long-range dependencies with linear complexity. Extensive experiments on the KITTI Road dataset and real-world applications demonstrate that LiteViLNet achieves a promising balance between accuracy and efficiency. Notably, with only 14.04M parameters, our model attains a 96.36% MaxF score, ranking the best among all CNN-based methods and being comparable to larger transformer-based models, and runs at 163.79 FPS in model-only inference on RTX 4060 Ti (22.18 FPS on Jetson Orin NX). It outperforms numerous heavy-weight methods in inference speed while maintaining highly competitive accuracy, fully validating the potential of LiteViLNet for real-time embedded deployment in autonomous driving and intelligent robotics.

</details>


### [174] [Stream3D: Sequential Multi-View 3D Generation via Evidential Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21472)
*Kaichen Zhou,Zeyang Bai,Xinhai Chang,Mengyu Wang,Paul Liang,Fangneng Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Stream3D 提出了一种无需训练的视频流式3D生成方法，通过维护一个紧凑的"证据记忆"缓存最富信息的历史帧，将冻结的视图条件3D生成器转化为流式生成器，在长单目视频流中保持时间一致性，无需重训练或修改架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视图条件3D生成器（如SAM 3D、TRELLIS、Hunyuan3D）能从单视图生成高质量3D重建，但实际视觉观察往往是长单目视频流。直接对各帧独立应用这些生成器会导严重的时间不一致性（帧间抖动、几何突变）。

Method: 提出Stream3D，一种无需训练（training-free）的流式机制。核心是维护一个紧凑的"证据记忆"（evidential memory），基于提出的证据分数（evidence score）机制选择性缓存最富信息的历史帧。记忆随流式过程动态更新，保持固定数量的信息帧，防止内存随序列长度线性增长，底层生成器完全冻结不变。

Result: 在真实和合成流式基准测试上，Stream3D在光度指标和几何指标上均优于潜在传输基线方法（包括KV-cache复用和基于流的特征编辑）。

Conclusion: Stream3D是首个无需训练的流式3D生成机制，通过紧凑的证据记忆实现长序列时间一致性，同时保持底层生成器完全不变，具备实际部署的轻量级优势。

Abstract: View-conditioned 3D generators such as SAM 3D, TRELLIS, and Hunyuan3D produce high-quality object reconstructions from a single view, but real-world visual observation often arrives as long monocular streams. Naively applying these generators to each streaming frame independently leads to severe temporal inconsistency in the generated results. To address this problem, we propose Stream3D, the first training-free streaming mechanism that turns a frozen view-conditioned 3D generator into a streaming generator with constant cross-chunk memory. Stream3D achieves this by maintaining a compact evidential memory, which selectively caches the most informative historical frames based on a proposed evidence score mechanism. As the stream progresses, the memory dynamically updates to retain a fixed number of informative frames, preventing the memory footprint from growing linearly with sequence length. This also prevents degradation over long sequences and keeps the underlying generator completely unchanged without retraining, architectural modifications, or auxiliary losses. Evaluated on both realistic and synthetic streaming benchmarks, Stream3D outperforms latent-transport baselines, including KV-cache reuse and flow-based feature editing, across both photometric and geometric metrics. More details can be found at: https://stream-3d.github.io/stream3d.github.io/.

</details>


### [175] [Broken Memories: Detecting and Mitigating Memorization in Diffusion Models with Degraded Generations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22050)
*Yuanmin Huang,Mi Zhang,Chen Chen,Feifei Li,Geng Hong,Xiaoyu You,Min Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 扩散模型在生成高质量图像时存在记忆训练数据的隐私/版权风险。本文首次发现记忆化会导致内部数值不稳定并表现为“破碎”伪影，借鉴数值方法中的稳定性分析，引入基于潜更新范数的经验稳定区域来量化生成过程中的稳定行为，并提出一个原则性的实时框架进行逐步骤检测和自适应缓解，在不改变提示或引导的情况下抑制记忆化，保留语义保真度和图像质量。在Stable Diffusion 1.4上的实验表明，该方法检测AUC>0.999，缓解后记忆率为0.0%，每张图像开销仅约0.01秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在生成图像时倾向于记忆训练数据，带来隐私和版权风险。现有方法缺乏对记忆化内在机制的深入理解，且往往需要修改提示或引导，可能损害语义保真度。

Method: 首次识别记忆化会引起内部数值不稳定并表现为视觉“破碎”伪影；借鉴数值稳定性分析，定义基于潜更新范数的经验稳定区域；提出逐步骤检测和自适应缓解的实时框架，在不改变提示/引导的前提下抑制记忆化。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion 1.4上，检测AUC超过0.999，缓解后记忆化率降至0.0%，每张图像额外开销仅约0.01秒。

Conclusion: 记忆化与数值不稳定性之间存在强关联，通过实时检测和自适应缓解可以高效、无损地抑制记忆化，保留图像质量和语义保真度。

Abstract: While diffusion models excel at generating high-quality images, their tendency to memorize training data poses significant privacy and copyright risks. In this work, we for the first time identify that memorization induces internal numerical instability, often manifesting as visually ``broken'' artifacts. Inspired by stability analysis in numerical methods, we introduce empirical stability regions based on latent update norms to quantitatively characterize stable behavior during generation. Leveraging this, we propose a principled, on-the-fly framework for step-wise detection and adaptive mitigation. Our approach suppresses memorization without altering prompts or guidance, thereby preserving semantic fidelity and image quality. Extensive experiments on Stable Diffusion 1.4 demonstrate that our method achieves an AUC $>0.999$ detection performance and a $0.0\%$ memorization rate after mitigation with negligible overhead ($\approx0.01$s per image).

</details>


### [176] [DeliCIR: Deliberative Test-Time Evolutionary Hierarchical Multi-Agents for Composed Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22478)
*Xingtian Pei,Yukun Song,Changwei Wang,Shunpeng Chen,Rongtao Xu,Shengpeng Xu,Shibiao Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种层次化感知-推理框架(PDF)，通过引入经验自进化和测试时缩放定律(TTS)来解决组合图像检索中的感知短视和逻辑漂移问题，在三个基准数据集上取得了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CIR方法存在单空间感知短视(Perception Myopia)和迭代协作中的逻辑漂移(Logic Drift)问题，根源在于底层检索器的感知上限限制了模型性能。

Method: 提出PDF框架，采用层次化多智能体架构：1) 意图路由管理器(Intent Routing Manager)根据修改意图动态调度多视角工人感知信号，构建高召回候选池；2) 决策管理器(Decision Manager)结合免训练推理策略蒸馏(Training-free Reasoning Policy Distillation)和锦标赛式TTS策略(T-TTS)，实现自进化的细粒度推理。

Result: 在CIRR、CIRCO和FashionIQ三个基准数据集上取得SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 经验驱动的自进化和测试时缩放定律是实现零样本细粒度多媒体检索的高潜力、可扩展路径。

Abstract: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) requires both preserving the visual continuity of the reference image and faithfully executing the semantic variables specified in the modification text, which constitute the core challenge of the task. Existing methods often suffer from Perception Myopia in a single space, or fall into Logic Drift in iterative collaboration due to the perception ceiling of the underlying retriever. To address this issue, we propose a one-stop hierarchical Perception-to-Deliberation Framework (PDF), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to introduce experience self-evolution and Test-Time Scaling Laws (TTS) into CIR. Relying on a hierarchical multi-agent architecture, PDF first utilizes an Intent Routing Manager to dynamically dispatch multi-view Worker perception signals based on modification intents to construct a high-recall candidate pool. Subsequently, the Decision Manager combines a Training-free Reasoning Policy Distillation mechanism with a Tournament-style TTS (T-TTS) strategy to achieve self-evolving fine-grained reasoning, yielding the final retrieval results. Experimental results demonstrate that PDF achieves SOTA performance on three benchmark datasets: CIRR, CIRCO, and FashionIQ. This study indicates that experience-driven self-evolution and TTS represent a highly promising and scalable path for achieving zero-shot fine-grained multimedia retrieval. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [177] [GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22882)
*Kaichen Zhou,Yuzhen Chen,Fangneng Zhan,Hang Hua,Grace Chen,Xinhai Chang,Ao Qu,Yilun Du,Zhuang Liu,Paul Pu Liang,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GEM-4D是一种几何约束的视频世界模型，通过注入稠密4D对应关系监督，在保持单流架构的同时提升了视频预测的几何一致性，并将对应一致的视频滚动转换为可执行的机器人轨迹，使真实世界操作成功率从61%提升至81%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型生成视频看似合理但缺乏物理基础，无法在时间上一致地跟踪相同物理点，导致难以可靠执行机器人操作等动作任务。

Method: 在视频生成骨干网络的训练过程中，注入从预训练几何基础模型蒸馏得到的稠密4D对应关系监督，使模型联合捕获外观和几何结构，保持单流架构且无额外推理成本；同时引入逆动力学模块，将对应一致的视频滚动转换为可执行的机器人轨迹。

Result: 在视频预测和几何一致性方面达到最先进水平，真实世界机器人操作成功率从61%提升至81%。

Conclusion: 将几何对应监督注入视频生成模型能有效桥接视觉生成与物理现实，为机器人操作等动作任务提供可靠基础。

Abstract: Video world models can generate realistic futures from a single instruction, but they often fail to track the same physical points consistently across time. As a result, the generated videos appear plausible, yet lack the physical grounding required for reliable action execution, such as robot manipulation. We present GEM-4D, a geometry-grounded video world model that resolves this limitation by injecting dense 4D correspondence supervision distilled from a pretrained geometry foundation model into the video generative backbone during training. This supervision enables the model to jointly capture appearance and geometric structure while retaining a single-stream architecture with no additional inference cost. We further introduce an inverse dynamics module that converts correspondence-consistent video rollouts into executable robot trajectories, enabling direct deployment in both real-world and simulated manipulation. GEM-4D achieves state-of-the-art performance on both video prediction and geometric consistency across both simulation and realistic scenarios and improves real-world manipulation success from 61% to 81%. Additional results are available at https://gem-4d.github.io/.

</details>


### [178] [SRUG: Shadow-Guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24700)
*Yonghao Zhao,Zexin Yin,Jian Yang,Beibei Wang,Jin Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SRUG框架，利用阴影引导3D补全模型恢复不可见区域几何，结合迭代材质分解和物理光照模型，实现城市场景的可重照明，在视角合成和重照明任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市场景重照明任务中，不可见区域（如超出视野的部分）会向可见区域投射阴影，但现有方法难以合理建模这些阴影；同时稀疏输入视图和复杂光照条件导致材质分解存在严重歧义。

Method: 1) 阴影引导的3D补全模型，恢复不可见区域几何以合成物理合理的阴影；2) 迭代材质分解方案，利用大材质模型(LMM)提供材质监督并逐步分解场景材质属性；3) 基于物理的光照模型，捕捉城市场景的复杂光照。

Result: 在新视角合成和重照明任务上，定量评估和视觉比较均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: SRUG通过阴影引导补全不可见区域几何、迭代材质分解及物理光照模型，有效解决了城市场景重照明的病态问题。

Abstract: Creating relightable urban scenes from images or videos is widely useful but highly ill-posed. Urban environments are typically unbounded and extend beyond the visible regions. As a result, many portions of the scene remain unobserved, yet these invisible regions can cast shadows onto visible areas. Reasonably modeling shadows cast by such invisible regions is challenging and poses a significant obstacle to creating relightable urban scenes. At the same time, sparse input views and complex illumination conditions further complicate relighting, as they introduce severe ambiguities in material decomposition. In this paper, we propose Shadow-guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation model (SRUG), a novel framework designed to address relighting challenges in urban scenes. SRUG leverages shadows to guide a 3D completion model for recovering the geometry of invisible regions, promoting the synthesis of physically reasonable shadows. In addition, SRUG employs an iterative material decomposition scheme that applies the large material model (LMM) to provide material supervision and iteratively decompose the scene's material properties, enabling robust material decomposition. Building upon these components, we introduce a physically-based lighting model that captures the complex illumination of urban scenes and supports reliable relighting. Extensive quantitative evaluations and visual comparisons demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both novel view synthesis and relighting tasks.

</details>


### [179] [SpongeBob: Sync-Aware Harmonious Audio-Visual Generative Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25193)
*Sen Liang,Cong Wang,Fengbin Guan,Zhentao Yu,Yiting Lu,Yuanzhi Wang,Yuan Zhou,Xin Li,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpongeBob是首个端到端音视频联合编辑框架，通过双向跨模态交互机制解决现有方法中视听不同步和上下文冲突的问题，在同步性和一致性指标上分别提升30%和12.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频编辑方法采用解耦流水线，缺乏双向模态交互，导致视听不同步和生成音频与保留内容之间的上下文冲突。

Method: 提出SpongeBob框架，包含Sync-Aware Mechanism（双向注意力、时间对齐、空间约束实现同步）和Context-Aware Module（声学和视觉上下文注意力防止语义冲突），以及Sync-Preserving Training and Guidance (SPTG)增强对齐；同时构建了可扩展数据流水线和大规模主体级数据集SpongeBob-Bench。

Result: SpongeBob显著优于现有基线，Sync-C提升30%，Ctx-F1提升12.5%。

Conclusion: 端到端双向跨模态交互是解决音视频联合编辑中同步和上下文一致性问题的有效途径。

Abstract: Visual and acoustic events in the physical world are inherently coupled, yet existing video editing methods typically adopt decoupled pipelines, lacking bidirectional modality interaction. This results in two key limitations: (i) audio-visual desynchronization and (ii) contextual conflicts between generated audio and preserved content. To address these, we propose SpongeBob, the first end-to-end audio-visual joint editing framework featuring bidirectional cross-modal interaction. For synchronization, a Sync-Aware Mechanism aligns visual edits with sound events via bidirectional attention, temporal alignment, and spatial constraints. For contextual consistency, a Context-Aware Module leverages acoustic and visual context attention to prevent semantic clashes. Additionally, we introduce Sync-Preserving Training and Guidance (SPTG) to enhance alignment without degrading quality. Due to the scarcity of paired data, we construct a scalable data pipeline and a large-scale subject-level dataset. We also propose SpongeBob-Bench for systematic evaluation. Experiments show SpongeBob significantly outperforms existing baselines, improving Sync-C by 30% and Ctx-F1 by 12.5%. Our project page is available at: https://hy-spongebob.github.io/.

</details>


### [180] [$R^3$: 3D Reconstruction via Relative Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26519)
*Congrong Xu,Huachen Gao,Xingyu Chen,Yuliang Xiu,Jun Gao,Anpei Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出R³，一种采用相对回归机制的几何基础模型，通过轻量级MLP预测置信度加权的相对约束，支持离线全上下文重建和因果有限内存流式重建，解决了全局坐标假设在长上下文和流式重建中的瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的前馈几何基础模型依赖全局坐标框架假设，这导致在长上下文和流式重建场景中网络需要维护一个任意的时序原点，且平移幅度随时间增长无界，成为显著瓶颈。

Method: 提出R³，采用相对回归范式，使用轻量级MLP预测置信度加权的相对约束。这些置信度作为统一锚点：训练时用于加权损失，推理时用于引导位姿聚合。

Result: 在离线全上下文和流式场景下的评估验证了所提相对机制的有效性。

Conclusion: R³通过相对回归机制有效克服了全局坐标假设的局限性，同时支持离线全上下文重建和有界内存的因果流式重建，为长场景几何重建提供了新思路。

Abstract: Recent feed-forward geometry foundation models have demonstrated impressive generalization by recovering depth and poses in a single forward pass. However, these models are typically constrained by a global coordinate frame assumption. This dependency becomes a significant bottleneck for long-context and streaming reconstruction, as it forces the network to maintain an arbitrary temporal origin and handle translation magnitudes that grow unbounded over time. Our solution, which we call $R^3$, employs relative regression. We employ a lightweight MLP to predict confidence-weighted relative constraints. These confidences serve as a unified anchor: weighting losses during training and guiding pose aggregation during inference. $R^3$ supports both full-context offline reconstruction and causal, bounded-memory streaming. Our evaluation in both offline and streaming settings validates the effectiveness of our relative mechanism. Project page: https://kevinxu02.github.io/r3-site

</details>


### [181] [SpatialBench: Is Your Spatial Foundation Model an All-Round Player?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27367)
*Haosong Peng,Hao Li,Jiaqi Chen,Yuhao Pan,Runmao Yao,Yalun Dai,Fushuo Huo,Fangzhou Hong,Zhaoxi Chen,Haozhao Wang,Dingwen Zhang,Ziwei Liu,Wenchao Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpatialBench是一个跨范式、多领域的空间基础模型基准测试，包含19个数据集、546个场景、41个模型和6种范式，在5个任务套件和4种输入密度下全面评估。结果显示当前模型尚不是全能选手，全上下文注意力最大化准确率，有界记忆策略实现长序列可扩展性，严格领域对齐和数据质量比简单扩大数据集更关键。同时引入大规模数据集DA-Next-5M和强基线模型DA-Next。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间基础模型主要在特定领域上评估，受限于狭窄的范式覆盖、有限的场景域和任意帧采样，难以评估真实的泛化能力。因此需要构建一个全面、跨范式、多领域的基准来系统评估模型的真正泛化能力。

Method: 构建SpatialBench基准，覆盖19个数据集、546个场景、5个空间域，评估41个模型（6种范式）在5个任务套件和4种输入密度下的表现。采用确定性采样设计，引入DA-Next-5M数据集（50万场景，500万帧）和DA-Next基线模型。

Result: 当前空间基础模型尚未达到全能水平；全上下文注意力机制能最大化准确率，有界记忆策略可提升长序列可扩展性；在具身和自我中心任务中，严格领域对齐和高数据质量比简单扩大数据集更关键；识别出最大数据缺口并引入大规模数据集和强基线模型。

Conclusion: SpatialBench全面揭示了现有模型的不足，为未来研究提供了关键洞察：注意力机制选择、数据质量与规模平衡、以及跨域泛化策略是提升空间基础模型能力的重要方向。

Abstract: While spatial foundation models have demonstrated impressive performance on standard datasets, a critical question remains: are they truly all-round players capable of generalizing robustly across diverse downstream tasks, arbitrary viewpoints, shifting scene domains, varying input densities, and specific hardware constraints? Answering this overarching question requires a holistic assessment, yet current models are mainly evaluated on specific domains for which they were specifically designed or trained. Such evaluations are intrinsically limited by narrow paradigm coverage, limited scene domains, and arbitrary frame sampling, making it fundamentally difficult to assess their true generalization capabilities. To address this gap, we present SpatialBench, a cross-paradigm, domain-diverse benchmark for spatial foundation models with deterministic sampling. SpatialBench features unprecedented scale and rigorous deterministic design, comprising 19 datasets and 546 scenes across 5 diverse spatial domains. It comprehensively evaluates 41 models across 6 paradigms on 5 task suites under 4 different input density settings. Our extensive evaluation reveals that current models are not yet all-round players, and uncovers crucial insights for future advancement. Specifically, we demonstrate that full-context attention maximizes accuracy while bounded-memory strategies unlock long-sequence scalability. Moreover, our empirical evaluations in challenging embodied and egocentric tasks demonstrate that strict domain alignment and high data quality are far more critical to performance than simple dataset scaling. Furthermore, to address the largest data gap identified in our analysis, we go beyond evaluation by introducing a large-scale dataset, DA-Next-5M, and a strong baseline model, DA-Next, pushing the boundaries of spatial representation learning.

</details>


### [182] [Guidance Contrastive Token Credit Assignment for Discrete Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29198)
*Shufan Li,Konstantinos Kallidromitis,Akash Gokul,Yuta Kyuragi,Aditya Grover*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GCPO算法，通过对比正负提示下的模型预测实现逐token信用分配，克服了GRPO/DAPO等样本级奖励均匀分配的问题，在文本到图像生成和思维链推理任务上均优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于组优势的强化学习方法（如GRPO、DAPO）使用样本级奖励，对所有token进行均匀信用分配，无法捕捉细粒度的token级贡献，导致学习信号不够精确。

Method: 提出Guidance Contrastive Policy Optimization (GCPO)，通过对比正负提示下的模型预测来计算token级优势，替代传统的样本级均匀优势分配，实现更精细的逐token信用分配。

Result: GCPO在文本到图像生成和思维链推理基准上一致优于GRPO和DAPO基线；能关注与文本提示对齐的视觉区域（文本到图像生成）以及推理轨迹中的关键关键词（思维链任务）。

Conclusion: GCPO是一种通用且可扩展的离散策略学习优化策略，通过对比性token级信用分配有效提升强化学习性能。

Abstract: Group-advantage-based reinforcement learning methods, such as GRPO and DAPO, have demonstrated strong performance across diverse domains, including mathematical reasoning and text-to-image generation. However, their reliance on sample-level rewards introduces a key limitation as uniform credit assignment across all tokens fails to capture fine-grained, token-level contributions. To address this issue, we propose Guidance Contrastive Policy Optimization (GCPO), a novel algorithm that enables per-token credit assignment by contrasting model predictions under positive and negative prompts. Rather than uniformly broadcasting sample-level advantages, GCPO assigns token-level advantages proportional to the difference between these contrastive predictions, allowing more precise and informative learning signals. Empirically, we find that GCPO emphasizes semantically relevant regions such as visual areas aligned with textual prompts in text-to-image generation, and critical keywords within reasoning traces for chain-of-thought tasks. Through extensive experiments, GCPO consistently outperforms GRPO and DAPO baselines on both text-to-image generation and chain-of-thought reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness as a general and scalable optimization strategy for discrete policy learning.

</details>


### [183] [Pocket-Dentist: On-Device Dental Image Understanding via Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29299)
*Kai Bian,Xucheng Guo,Bin Chen,Lingyan Ruan,Yiran Shen,Ting Dang,Hong Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Pocket-Dentist，一个面向牙科多模态问答的效率感知基准，涵盖3个数据集、约1159名患者、5种任务类型和7项指标。在14个VLM上的评估发现，紧凑型VLM（如2B参数）在牙科图像理解中准确率更高且计算成本更低。微调后的Pocket-Dentist-2B在iPhone 17 Pro上本地部署，每个样本仅需4.31秒，相比7B基线延迟降低4.9倍，内存减少2.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有牙科视觉-语言模型评估存在数据集、任务定义和指标碎片化，且忽视计算成本，限制了其在非专科中心的实际部署（涉及推理时效、有限硬件和本地隐私保护需求）。

Method: 构建Pocket-Dentist效率感知基准，整合多数据集与多任务指标；在14个VLM上系统评估；对紧凑型VLM进行微调并在iPhone 17 Pro上本地部署测试。

Result: 紧凑型VLM（2B参数）在准确率上超越大型VLM，计算成本显著降低；Pocket-Dentist-2B在iPhone上实现4.31秒/样本，延迟降低4.9倍，内存减少2.3倍。

Conclusion: 紧凑型VLM在牙科图像理解任务中能够兼顾高准确率与低计算开销，适合本地化、隐私保护的临床预筛查部署。

Abstract: Evaluations of dental vision-language models remain fragmented across datasets, task definitions and metrics, and often ignore their computational cost. This limits their widespread deployment for dental screening outside specialist centres, where timely inference, limited hardware, and local handling of patient images are vital for practical, privacy-preserving clinical prescreening. Here we present Pocket-Dentist, an efficiency-aware benchmark for dental multimodal question answering that brings together three datasets spanning approximately 1,159 patients, five task types and seven metrics. Across typical 14 VLMs, our results reveals an interesting observation: compact VLMs (e.g., 2B-parameter models) outperform larger VLMs in accuracy while requiring substantially lower computational costs in dental image understanding. Deployed locally on an iPhone 17 Pro, our finetuned compact VLM Pocket-Dentist-2B processed each sample in 4.31 s, reducing latency by 4.9-fold and memory use by 2.3-fold compared with a 7B baseline.

</details>


### [184] [ParCo-SDF: Learning Prior-Free Partial-to-Complete Signed Distance Fields of Deformable Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29417)
*Deokmin Hwang,Minseok Song,Daehyung Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ParCo-SDF两阶段框架，通过时序几何编码和FiLM条件SDF预测，实现无先验的可变形物体从部分观测到完整几何的高保真重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可变形物体重建方法依赖隐式神经表示，但通常需要物体特定的形状先验来保证训练稳定性，限制了泛化能力。本文旨在实现无先验、稳定的部分到完整几何重建。

Method: 提出ParCo-SDF两阶段框架：第一阶段用时序编码器捕获可变形物体序列中的结构相似性，实现无先验的稳定训练；第二阶段用FiLM条件化SDF预测网络，在降低网络复杂度的同时保持重建表达能力。

Result: 在橡皮筋操作数据集上，与现有最先进的可变形物体表面重建基线相比，在严重遮挡条件下实现了鲁棒且高保真的重建。

Conclusion: ParCo-SDF通过时序结构相似性捕获和FiLM条件化，有效去除了对物体特定先验的依赖，实现了稳定训练和高表达力的部分到完整可变形物体重建。

Abstract: This study addresses the partial-to-complete geometry reconstruction of deformable objects (DOs) from point-cloud observations toward precise DO manipulation. Recent DO reconstruction approaches often adopt implicit neural representations (INRs) to model continuous surfaces as well as capture structural variability. However, these methods typically rely on object-specific shape priors that improve training stability and limit generalization. To figure it out, we introduce ParCo-SDF, a two-stage partial-to-complete signed distance field (SDF) reconstruction framework consisting of temporal geometry encoding followed by FiLM-conditioned SDF prediction. The temporal encoder captures structural similarity across DO sequence, enabling prior-free stable training. FiLM-based conditioning preserves reconstruction expressivity while reducing network complexity. We evaluate the proposed method against a state-of-the-art DO surface reconstruction baseline on a rubber band manipulation dataset, demonstrating robust and high-fidelity reconstruction under severe occlusions.

</details>


### [185] [SuperVoxelGPT: Adaptive and Ordered 3D Tokenization for Autoregressive Shape Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29655)
*Yuan Li,Congyi Zhang,Xifeng Gao,Xiaohu Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SuperVoxelGPT通过自适应且确定性排序的超体素标记化方法，解决了自回归多模态大语言模型在3D生成中因标记化不足导致的高分辨率形状生成困难问题，在Trellis-500K数据集上将序列长度减少至均匀体素标记化的12.8%，同时实现最先进的生成质量和平均10倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归MLLM在3D生成中面临结构权衡：基于集合的表示丢弃空间顺序导致序列预测模糊，而均匀/八叉树体素网格虽保留顺序但存在严重的冗余和过长序列问题，限制了稳定高效的3D生成。

Method: 首先根据提示预测粗粒度几何显著性分布，通过显著性引导的质心Voronoi剖分构建形状自适应的超体素划分（复杂区域细粒度单元，平滑区域大单元）；然后提出SuperVoxelVAE，并微调预训练MLLM以自回归生成超体素标记。

Result: 在Trellis-500K数据集上，序列长度减少至均匀体素标记化的12.8%，生成质量达到最优，平均推理速度相比先前方法提升10倍。

Conclusion: 通过自适应的超体素标记化有效解决了自回归3D生成中空间顺序保持与序列长度之间的根本矛盾，为高效高质量3D生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: Autoregressive multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable 3D generation but struggle to scale to high-resolution shapes due to inadequate 3D tokenizations. Compact set-based representations discard deterministic spatial ordering, leading to ambiguous sequence prediction, while uniform or octree-based voxel grids preserve ordering at the cost of severe redundancy and excessively long sequences. This structural trade-off limits stable and efficient autoregressive 3D generation. We present SuperVoxelGPT, a representation-first framework that resolves this tension through adaptive and deterministically ordered supervoxel tokenization. Given a prompt, we first predict a coarse geometric saliency distribution and construct a shape-adaptive supervoxel partition using saliency-guided centroidal Voronoi tessellation, allocating fine-grained cells to complex regions and larger cells to smooth regions. Conditioned on the text and ordered supervoxel layout, we introduce a SuperVoxelVAE and fine-tune a pretrained MLLM to autoregressively generate supervoxel tokens. Experiments on Trellis-500K show that SuperVoxelGPT reduces token sequence length to 12.8% of uniform voxel tokenization while achieving state-of-the-art generation quality and an average 10$\times$ speedup over prior methods.

</details>


### [186] [Parameter-Efficient Subspace Decoupling ViT for Mitigating Multi-Task Negative Transfer in Histological Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29852)
*Youhan Huang,Jiajun Li,Yilin Fang,Shuai Wang,Chuheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种子空间解耦的多任务Vision Transformer，通过轻量级任务特定Adapter和正交性约束，在NAS多任务学习中构建独立的特征子空间，有效减少任务干扰，并在小鼠NAFLD组织学数据集上实现了更好的多任务稳定性和泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAFLD组织学评分自动化面临两个关键挑战：高注释成本，以及NAS各指标间强相关性导致的多任务学习中的负迁移问题。

Method: 提出子空间解耦的多任务Vision Transformer (ViT)，集成轻量级任务特定Adapter并结合正交性约束，为脂肪变性、气球样变和炎症构建独立特征子空间，在保留共享表征的同时减少任务干扰。

Result: 在构建的多任务小鼠NAFLD组织学数据集上，该方法相比训练独立的单任务模型，在显著降低计算成本的同时提升了多任务稳定性和泛化性能。

Conclusion: 子空间解耦策略可有效缓解NAS多任务学习中的负迁移问题，为NAFLD自动化评分提供了一种高效且可复现的解决方案。

Abstract: Histological scoring is essential for diagnosing Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD), yet its automation remains challenging due to the high annotation cost and negative transfer among the strongly correlated NAFLD Activity Score (NAS) indicators in multi-task learning. To address this issue, we propose a subspace-decoupled multi-task Vision Transformer (ViT) that integrates lightweight task-specific Adapters with orthogonality-based constraints. This design constructs independent feature subspaces for steatosis, ballooning, and inflammation, effectively reducing task interference while retaining shared representations. We further construct a curated multi-task mouse NAFLD histology dataset with expert annotations for all NAS components. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves multi-task stability and generalization with substantially reduced computational cost compared to training separate single-task models. The code and the curated dataset have been prepared and will be made publicly available upon acceptance to support reproducibility.

</details>


### [187] [DGSG-Mind: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Scene Graphs for Long-Term Scene Understanding and Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29879)
*Luzhou Ge,Xiangyu Zhu,Jinyan Liu,Xuesong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DGSG-Mind提出了一种混合实例感知的3D高斯动态场景图系统，结合概率体素网格与显式3D高斯实现鲁棒的跨模态实例融合和增量语义建图，并在此基础上构建层次化场景图和3D高斯思维进行多模态推理，在零样本3D视觉定位、语义分割和场景重建上取得了优异成绩，并在真实机器人上验证了其目标导向推理和动态更新能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动态3D场景表示方法存在跨视角实例关联脆弱、难以处理物体级拓扑变化、缺乏显式空间推理能力且依赖离线真值3D几何等问题，无法满足长期具身场景理解的需求。

Method: 1) 耦合概率体素网格与显式3D高斯实现跨模态实例融合和增量语义建图；2) 通过基于高斯的视觉重定位和几何-语义一致性引导的局部掩码精化处理动态变化；3) 在实例高斯地图上构建层次化场景图；4) 提出3D高斯思维，融合结构关系、空间语义信息和带视觉标注的RoI高斯渲染进行多模态推理。

Result: 在零样本3D视觉定位任务中达到自建地图方法中的最佳性能，在3D开放词汇语义分割和场景重建中也表现强劲，并在真实机器人上验证了目标导向推理和动态更新能力。

Conclusion: DGSG-Mind有效地解决了动态场景中的实例关联和拓扑变化问题，为长期具身场景理解提供了一种兼具鲁棒性和推理能力的解决方案。

Abstract: Integrating open-vocabulary semantic information into dynamic 3D scene representations is essential for long-term embodied scene understanding. However, existing methods often suffer from fragile instance association due to incomplete cross-view cues, while their limited ability to handle object-level topological changes restricts long-term robotic task execution. Moreover, current 3D scene understanding methods either rely on simple feature matching without explicit spatial reasoning or assume offline ground-truth 3D geometry. To address these challenges, we present DGSG-Mind, a hybrid instance-aware 3D Gaussian dynamic scene graph system with an embodied reasoning agent. Our system couples a probabilistic voxel grid with explicit 3D Gaussians to enable robust cross-modal instance fusion and incremental semantic mapping. It handles dynamic changes through Gaussian-based visual relocalization and localized masked refinement guided by geometric-semantic consistency. Built on the instance Gaussian map, DGSG-Mind further constructs a hierarchical scene graph and develops the 3D Gaussian Mind, which integrates structural relations, spatial-semantic information, and visually annotated RoI Gaussian renderings for multimodal reasoning. Extensive experiments show that DGSG-Mind achieves the best zero-shot 3DVG performance among methods operating on self-reconstructed maps, while also delivering strong performance in 3D open-vocabulary semantic segmentation and scene reconstruction. We further deploy DGSG-Mind on real-world robots to demonstrate its target-oriented reasoning and dynamic update capabilities. The project page of DGSG-Mind is available at https://icr-lab.github.io/DGSG-Mind

</details>


### [188] [Towards Consistent Video Geometry Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30060)
*Zhu Yu,Jingnan Gao,Runmin Zhang,Lingteng Qiu,Zhengyi Zhao,Rui Peng,Yichao Yan,Kejie Qiu,Siyu Zhu,Zilong Dong,Si-Yuan Cao,Hui-Liang Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViGeo是一个基于纯Transformer架构的前馈基础模型，通过动态分块注意力机制和支持流式、全序列及长视频推理的统一框架，实现视频序列的时空一致几何恢复，在深度估计、表面法线估计和点图估计任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频几何恢复方法通常针对特定任务设计专用架构，缺乏统一的、可扩展的基础模型，且难以同时兼顾在线流式推理和离线全序列处理，此外训练数据中稀疏、噪声的标注限制了监督质量。

Method: 1) 采用纯Transformer架构，无任务特定修改；2) 提出动态分块注意力（Dynamic Chunking Attention），训练时暴露于双向和因果时序上下文，测试时可自适应调整注意力模式；3) 提出基于补全的数据精炼框架，训练视频深度补全教师模型，利用稀疏噪声标注和视频/多视角上下文生成密集、时序一致且几何可靠的训练目标。

Result: 仅在公开数据集上训练，ViGeo在在线、离线及长视频深度估计、表面法线估计和视频点图估计任务上均达到当前最优性能。

Conclusion: ViGeo证明了纯Transformer架构结合动态注意力机制与数据精炼策略，能够有效统一多种视频几何恢复任务，且具备良好的时域一致性和泛化能力。

Abstract: This work presents ViGeo, a feed-forward foundation model for recovering spatially dense and temporally consistent geometry from video sequences. Built upon a plain transformer architecture without task-specific architectural modifications, ViGeo supports streaming, full-sequence, and long-video inference within a unified model. The key design is dynamic chunking attention, which exposes the model to both bidirectional and causal temporal contexts during training and allows it to adapt its attention pattern at test time without retraining. To improve supervision quality, we further introduce a completion-based data refinement framework. This framework trains a video depth completion teacher that conditions on sparse and noisy annotations and exploits video/multi-view context to produce dense, temporally coherent, and geometrically reliable training targets. Beyond depth and point maps, ViGeo also predicts surface normals within the same framework. Trained solely on public datasets, ViGeo achieves state-of-the-art performance across online, offline, and long-video depth estimation, surface normal estimation, and video point map estimation.

</details>


### [189] [Déjà View: Looping Transformers for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30215)
*Alessandro Burzio,Tobias Fischer,Sven Elflein,Qunjie Zhou,Riccardo de Lutio,Jiawei Ren,Jiahui Huang,Shengyu Huang,Marc Pollefeys,Laura Leal-Taixé,Zan Gojcic,Haithem Turki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DéjàView提出一种循环transformer架构，通过单一循环块对多视图特征进行K步迭代精化，在显著减少参数量的同时匹配或超越更大规模前馈基准模型。实验表明显式迭代比同等算力的独立参数层具有更强的归纳偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前前馈3D重建transformer规模已超十亿参数，但证据表明连续transformer层常表现为重复操作。作者认为模型深度部分可被解释为迭代，直接用独立参数支付该迭代代价是低效的，因此提出将迭代显式化到架构中。

Method: DéjàView采用单一循环transformer块，对每个视图的特征进行K步循环精化。训练完成后，K可作为推理时的计算旋钮进行调节。模型使用共享参数而非每步独立参数。

Result: 在室内、室外、物体中心和驾驶场景五个重建基准上，DéjàView使用远少于前馈基线的参数和相当或更低的计算量，匹配或超越其性能。共享参数的循环块优于同等算力下独立每步参数的变体。

Conclusion: 显式迭代不仅是计算高效的容量替代方案，更是多视图3D重建中更强的归纳偏置。循环架构在参数效率和性能之间取得了更好的权衡。

Abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D reconstruction transformers have scaled to over a billion parameters, following the broader trend of increasing model capacity in computer vision. Yet emerging evidence suggests that contiguous transformer layers often behave like repeated applications of similar operations, and multi-view reconstruction transformers refine their predictions progressively across decoder depth. We posit that model depth partially buys iteration, paid for inefficiently in unique parameters, and instead make that iteration explicit in architecture. Our model, DéjàView, applies a single looped transformer block recurrently to per-view features for K refinement steps.
