Trained once, it exposes K as an inference-time compute knob, matching or outperforming substantially larger feed-forward baselines across five reconstruction benchmarks spanning indoor, outdoor, object-centric, and driving scenes, while using a fraction of their parameters and comparable or lower compute. Importantly, the same looped block formulation outperforms an otherwise identical variant with independent per-step parameters under matched training data and compute, suggesting that explicit iteration is not merely a compute-efficient substitute for capacity but a stronger inductive bias for multi-view 3D reconstruction.

</details>


### [190] [GenClaw: Code-Driven Agentic Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30248)
*Junyan Ye,Jun He,Zilong Huang,Dongzhi Jiang,Xuan Yang,Rui Chen,Weijia Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenClaw提出了一种代码驱动的智能体图像生成范式，将图像生成过程分解为概念构思、代码草图绘制和最终着色三个阶段，利用代码作为可控中间媒介桥接语言推理和像素合成，实现了更可控和可解释的视觉生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像生成智能体仍然受限于底层黑盒图像模型，工作流程局限于重复的提示词重写以进行生成优化，缺乏直接操作画布的机制，LLMs作为精确视觉构建的"画笔"的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。

Method: GenClaw采用三阶段流程：1) 通过搜索和推理构建概念知识上下文；2) 利用代码（如SVG、HTML、ThreeJS）渲染可执行的视觉草图；3) 使用图像生成模型补充纹理、材质和逼真度。代码作为可控中间画布，桥接语言推理与像素合成。

Result: 将图像生成从黑盒范式转变为类似于人类创作的分阶段过程，实现了高度可控和可解释的视觉生成系统。

Conclusion: GenClaw通过代码驱动的智能体范式，将图像生成分解为概念化、草图和着色三个阶段，为构建高度可控和可解释的视觉生成系统迈出了重要一步。

Abstract: Image generation models have evolved from text-conditioned pixel synthesis toward multimodal agents endowed with visual comprehension and tool invocation capabilities. Yet, existing agents remain at the mercy of underlying black-box image models. Their workflow is trapped in a repetitive cycle of prompt rewriting for generation refinement, leaving them with no mechanism to directly manipulate the canvas. In essence, the potential of LLMs to serve as a genuine "brush" for precise visual construction remains largely untapped. In this paper, we propose GenClaw, a code-driven agentic image generation paradigm that empowers the agent to create like a human artist: first conceptualizing, then sketching, and finally coloring. Specifically, the agent first constructs the conceptual knowledge and context through search and reasoning. It then utilizes code (e.g., SVG, HTML, ThreeJS) to render executable visual sketches. Finally, it employs an image generation model to supplement textures, materials, and photorealism. In this workflow, code serves as a controllable intermediate canvas bridging linguistic reasoning and pixel synthesis, seamlessly integrating programmatic logic with the visual expressiveness of generative models. By transforming image generation from a black-box paradigm into a staged process akin to authentic human creation, GenClaw offers a step toward for highly controllable and interpretable visual generation systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

### [191] [Structured interactions improve distributed coordination beyond model scaling in a real-world multi-robot system](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30383)
*Junping Wang,Zhizhong Zhang,Yongqiang Tang,Geng Zheng,Jiaming Zhang,Shiji Song,Yanmei Li,Yushan Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在固定硬件预算下，将机器人通信拓扑从全连接改为模块化层次结构，性能提升47分，而将神经网络隐藏层尺寸翻倍最多仅提升9分，表明交互结构比模型规模对多机器人系统性能的影响更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究多机器人协同中系统级设计问题：在固定硬件预算下，重构通信拓扑与扩大机载模型规模相比，哪种方式能带来更大的性能提升。

Method: 使用10台物理机器人执行运输与建图任务（每种条件5次运行，共60次），比较全连接拓扑与模块化层次交互拓扑，以及神经网络隐藏层尺寸翻倍的效果。采用嵌套混合效应模型比较模型拟合度，并在SMAC中进行独立复制验证。

Result: 通信拓扑重构使标准化性能提升47分（0-100），而扩大隐藏层尺寸最多仅提升9分；嵌套混合效应模型显示拓扑调整的模型拟合改善显著大于规模扩展；超过1024隐藏单元出现性能饱和。

Conclusion: 在测试的系统与任务设置中，交互结构对性能的主导作用大于模型规模，但更广泛的量化泛化仍有待建立。

Abstract: Scaling individual robot capabilities is common but costly. Here we investigate a system-level design question in real-world multi-robot coordination: given matched hardware budgets, does restructuring communication among robots yield larger gains than increasing onboard model size? Using a representative transport-and-mapping task with 10 physical robots (5 runs per condition, 60 runs total), we find that switching from fully connected to modular hierarchical interactions improves normalised performance by 47 points (0--100), whereas doubling neural network hidden size yields at most 9 points. Nested mixed-effects model comparisons show a substantially larger improvement in model fit for topology than for scale. The pattern is confirmed in independent SMAC replications; heterogeneous benchmark reanalyses provide secondary supporting consistency checks rather than primary evidence. Performance saturation beyond 1024 hidden units is observed in simulation-calibrated extrapolation, not directly on hardware. These results indicate that interaction structure can play a dominant role within the tested system and task setting, while broader quantitative generalisation remains to be established.

</details>


### [192] [Physics-informed Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning under Hybrid Contact Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30503)
*Vittorio Giammarino,Anastasios Manganaris,Ahmed H. Qureshi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文揭示了物理信息驱动的目标条件强化学习（Pi-GCRL）在接触丰富操作任务中因接触导致的混合动力学、模式依赖可控性和非光滑价值面而性能退化的问题，并提出接触感知与分层公式以选择性应用物理启发归纳偏置，从而将Pi-GCRL扩展至接触丰富操作领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Pi-GCRL方法在导航和无物体目标到达领域有效，但在接触丰富任务中，接触交互导致混合动力学、模式依赖可控性和非光滑价值面，使现有方法性能退化。因此需要探索如何将Pi-GCRL可靠地扩展到接触丰富操作领域。

Method: 首先分析接触丰富操作的结构特性（混合动力学、模式依赖可控性、非光滑价值面）如何导致现有Pi-GCRL方法失效。基于此分析，提出接触感知（contact-aware）和分层（hierarchical）公式，选择性地在操作问题的不同部分应用物理启发归纳偏置。

Result: 证明了现有Pi-GCRL方法在接触丰富操作中直接应用时性能退化，而提出的接触感知与分层公式能够有效将Pi-GCRL扩展至该领域。

Conclusion: 该工作为将Pi-GCRL推广到接触丰富操作问题迈出了原理性的一步，为处理具有接触动力学的复杂机器人操作任务提供了新的方法论基础。

Abstract: Learning to reach arbitrary goals from sparse feedback requires agents to infer a rich notion of reachability across state--goal pairs. Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) tackles this challenge by learning policies that generalize across goals, but this generalization becomes increasingly difficult as the underlying dynamics become high-dimensional, hybrid, or contact-dependent. To address this issue, physics-informed GCRL (Pi-GCRL) introduces optimal-control-inspired inductive biases into goal-conditioned value learning. While Pi-GCRL methods have proven effective in navigation and object-free goal-reaching domains, their reliability in contact-rich tasks remains unclear, where contact interactions induce hybrid dynamics, mode-dependent controllability, and nonsmooth value landscapes. In this work, we show that these structural properties can cause existing Pi-GCRL methods to degrade when applied naively to contact-rich manipulation. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce contact-aware and hierarchical formulations that apply physics-informed inductive biases selectively across the manipulation problem. Our results provide a principled step toward extending Pi-GCRL to contact-rich manipulation.

</details>


### [193] [VLM-GLoc: Vision-Language Model Enhanced Monte Carlo Localization for Robust Semantic Global Localization in Cluttered Quasi-Static Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30506)
*Shivendra Agrawal,Bradley Hayes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VLM-GLoc是一种利用视觉-语言模型(VLM)作为统一语义观测前端的分层语义蒙特卡洛定位方法，在几何混淆的准静态环境(如杂货店、办公室)中实现全局定位，在3500平方英尺杂货店和3700平方英尺实验室分别达到70%和74%的全局定位成功率，显著优于传统几何方法和专用视觉基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 杂货店、办公室等室内环境中存在几何混淆（如平行货架、重复家具）和长尾语义分布问题，传统方法依赖独特的几何特征或特定领域视觉管线，难以应对语义歧义和瞬态视觉杂波。

Method: 提出分层语义蒙特卡洛定位(VLM-GLoc)，利用开放词汇视觉-语言模型(VLM)作为统一语义观测前端，包含：(1)提取高判别性文本特征，(2)对模糊或动态物体进行隐式质量过滤，(3)通过永久性推理进行针对性数据增强。引入逆语义提议机制，通过文本到地图检索生成粒子初始分布。

Result: 在3500平方英尺杂货店（手机平台）和3700平方英尺实验室（四足机器人平台）两个真实环境中，全局定位成功率分别达到70%和74%，显著优于传统纯几何方法和特定领域基线。

Conclusion: VLM作为统一语义观测前端能够有效解决几何混淆环境中的全局定位问题，开放词汇特性使其具备跨场景泛化能力，逆语义提议机制和隐式质量过滤是提升定位性能的关键组件。

Abstract: Global localization in geometrically aliased, quasi-static environments such as grocery stores, offices, schools, and hospitals poses a significant challenge for mobile robots. Grocery stores with parallel aisles and a long tailed distribution of products, as well as offices and labs with repetitive furniture such as chairs, desks, monitors, and doors, exemplify common indoor environments that present geometric and even semantic ambiguity. Traditional approaches rely either on distinct geometric features or on domain-specific vision pipelines that struggle with long-tail semantic distributions and transient visual clutter. We present VLM-GLoc, a method for hierarchical semantic Monte Carlo Localization (MCL) that leverages open-vocabulary Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as a unified semantic observation front-end. We hypothesize a three-fold benefit from VLMs: (1) extracting highly discriminative rich text features, (2) implicit quality filtering of blurry or dynamic objects, and (3) permanence reasoning for targeted data augmentation. We introduce an inverse semantic proposal mechanism that seeds particles via text-to-map retrieval. Evaluated across two real-world environments with different characteristics and two different platforms: a 3,500 sq. ft. grocery store with a cellphone and a 3,700 sq. ft. lab space with a quadruped, VLM-GLoc achieves 70% and 74% global localization success respectively, substantially outperforming traditional geometry-only and domain-specific baselines.

</details>


### [194] [ARISTO Hand: Sensing-Driven Distal Hyperextension for Fine-Grained Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30508)
*Aaron Kim,Dong Ho Kang,Mark Helwig,Mingyo Seo,Kazuto Yokoyama,Tetsuya Narita,Luis Sentis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了ARISTO Hand，一种肌腱驱动的机器人手，集成了主动远端过伸机制和混合指尖传感架构（刚性指甲安装力-扭矩传感器+软性电容触觉阵列）。主动过伸使指尖可控地超出标准屈曲运动学极限，在1-20mm薄物体上拔出力提升2.76倍，同时保留正常抓取能力。刚性指甲传感器在边缘接触时提供可靠力测量，弥补了接触几何接近运动学奇异点时本体力传感退化的缺陷。通过定量力表征和多阶段SD卡插拔任务验证了该架构的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有拟人机器人手在处理薄物体时缺乏精确的接触几何和可靠的力感知能力，尤其是标准屈曲构型在薄物体操控中机械成功率低，且本体力传感在边缘接触时因运动学奇异点而退化。

Method: 设计了一种肌腱驱动机器人手，采用主动远端过伸机构扩展指尖运动范围，并结合刚性指甲力-扭矩传感器与软性电容触觉阵列的混合传感架构。

Result: 主动过伸使拔出力提升2.76倍（物体厚度1-20mm），刚性指甲传感器在边缘接触时提供可靠的力测量，补偿了本体传感的退化。

Conclusion: 所提出的混合传感与主动过伸架构能有效增强机器人手对薄物体的操控能力，在精密操作任务（如SD卡插拔）中展现出应用潜力。

Abstract: Manipulating thin objects requires precise contact geometry and reliable force perception, yet many anthropomorphic robotic hands lack the mechanical and sensing capabilities needed for such interactions. We present the ARISTO Hand, a tendon-driven robotic hand that integrates active distal hyperextension with a hybrid fingertip-sensing architecture that combines a rigid, nail-mounted force-torque sensor and a soft capacitive tactile array. Active hyperextension enables controlled fingertip engagement beyond the kinematic limits of standard flexion, increasing pull-out force by 2.76x for object thicknesses of 1-20 mm while preserving the nominal grasp capability. The rigid nail-mounted sensor provides reliable force measurements during edge contacts, where the sensitivity of proprioceptive force estimation degrades as the contact geometry approaches kinematic singularities. We validate the proposed architecture through quantitative force characterization and a multi-stage SD card extraction and insertion task. Video and supplementary materials are available at: https://aristohand.github.io

</details>


### [195] [Any-ttach: Quick End-effector Swapping Enables Manipulation Dexterity with Simplicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30569)
*Weizhe Ni,Jinzhou Li,Haoyu Li,Cody Andres Alessio-Bunnell,Wenjing Pan,Xianyi Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Any-ttach提出了一种以工具为中心的机器人操作框架，通过快速末端执行器更换机制替代传统复杂多指手的设计，结合低成本自动更换接口、手持示教设备和任务规划框架，实现了多种工具（日常工具、剪刀、Fin Ray手指、拟人手）的灵活切换，在制作三明治和准备黄瓜等长时域任务中验证了六个子技能的执行能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器人灵巧操作追求高自由度多指手，但人类手的复杂性很大程度上是为了使用和制造工具。受此启发，作者认为无需复制人手形态，而是通过快速更换末端执行器（工具）来实现操作灵巧性，从而降低机械复杂度。

Method: Any-ttach包含三个核心组件：(1) 低成本自动更换机构，适配开合式机器人接口；(2) 手持式示教设备，用于采集人类演示数据；(3) 任务规划框架，组合学习型、参数化和规划型工具使用技能。系统通过统一接口支持多种工具模块。

Result: 实验表明Any-ttach在工具更换可靠性、示教效率、工具位姿变异性方面均有改善；在两个长时域任务（制作三明治、准备黄瓜）中通过末端执行器切换和执行监控成功执行了六种工具使用子技能。

Conclusion: 机器人操作能力的提升不仅可以通过更复杂的末端执行器实现，也可通过快速可更换的工具和末端执行器模块来实现，为灵巧操作提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation dexterity is often pursued by building increasingly complex high-DoF multifingered hands. While many robotic hands are designed to replicate human morphology, the functional role of human hands suggests a different perspective: much of their complexity may exist to enable tool use and tool making. This observation motivates Any-ttach, a tool-centric manipulation framework that treats quick end-effector swapping as a mechanism for dexterity with simplicity. Any-ttach combines a low-cost automatic swapping mechanism for an open-close robot interface, a handheld device for collecting human demonstrations, and a task planning framework that composes learned, parameterized, and planned tool-use skills. The system supports diverse tools and end-effector modules, including daily tools, articulated tools such as scissors, Fin Ray fingers, and a low-cost anthropomorphic hand, through the same shared interface. Our experiments show that Any-ttach improves tool-swapping reliability, increases demonstration efficiency, reduces tool-pose variability, and supports diverse tool-use skills. In two long-horizon tasks, making a sandwich and preparing a cucumber, Any-ttach executes six tool-use subskills through end-effector switching and execution monitoring. These results suggest that robots can expand manipulation capability not only through more complex end-effectors, but also through rapidly exchangeable tools and end-effector modules. More details and videos are available at https://any-ttach.github.io/.

</details>


### [196] [Caspar: CUDA Accelerator for Symbolic Programming with Adaptive Reordering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30583)
*Emil Martens,Aaron Miller,Matias Varnum,Annette Stahl*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Caspar是一个利用符号编程自动生成优化CUDA内核的库，在机器人领域实现比最先进方案快5-20倍的非线性GPU求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低机器人和优化问题中GPU编程的复杂性，弥合Python符号编程与C++高性能GPU运行时之间的鸿沟，使开发者无需手动编写CUDA代码即可利用GPU加速。

Method: 基于SymForce库，用户定义符号残差函数，Caspar通过符号微分自动生成优化的CUDA内核，支持李群运算，提供非线性优化求解接口。

Result: 在BAL数据集上进行束调整基准测试，Caspar比最优替代方案快5-20倍，内存占用更少，精度相当。

Conclusion: 符号GPU编程方法在机器人领域的大规模非线性优化中具有显著性能优势，Caspar作为开源库可广泛应用于各类优化问题。

Abstract: We present Caspar, a library that makes the power of modern GPUs more accessible in robotics and provides a state-of-the-art nonlinear GPU solver that can be applied to a wide range of different optimization problems. Caspar bridges the gap between expressive symbolic programming in Python and high-performance GPU runtimes in C++ by automatically generating optimized CUDA kernels from symbolic expressions. Building on the SymForce library, users can easily define and combine symbolic expressions, including Lie group operations, to generate custom CUDA kernels. To use Caspar as a solver, users need only define the symbolic residual functions; Caspar then uses symbolic differentiation to generate the necessary GPU kernels and interfaces to perform nonlinear optimization.
  In this paper, we present the core components of Caspar and showcase its performance by performing bundle adjustment on the Bundle Adjustment in the Large (BAL) dataset. We benchmark Caspar against other state-of-the-art bundle adjusters and show that it is 5 to 20 times faster than the best alternative, requires less memory, and achieves similar accuracy. This illustrates the benefit of our symbolic GPU programming approach. Caspar is released as part of SymForce and is freely available at https://github.com/symforce-org/symforce

</details>


### [197] [ZAPS-DA: Zero-Phase Action Policy Smoothing with Decoupled Actor for Continuous Control in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30612)
*Faiq Shamass*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ZAPS-DA是一种框架，通过解耦的actor对零相位滤波目标进行监督模仿学习，在不修改主actor、不引入后处理过滤和相位滞后的情况下，显著降低连续控制策略的动作抖动（14-45x），同时保持任务完成率和奖励水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习训练的连续控制策略常产生高频动作抖动，直接部署在物理执行器上不可行。后处理滤波会引入相位滞后，而将平滑惩罚嵌入actor损失会干扰强化学习梯度并混淆奖励回归与过激平滑的目标。

Method: ZAPS-DA将一个未经修改的主actor（由基础RL损失训练）与一个独立的解耦actor配对，后者通过监督学习从回放缓冲区中零相位滤波的目标进行模仿。部署时使用解耦actor，它是一个从当前观测量到平滑动作的前馈映射，无需推理时滤波或动作历史输入——即非因果滤波器的因果蒸馏。使用幅度匹配的MSE损失，实现跨优化器类的零超参数可移植性。

Result: 在MetaDrive上：转向抖动减少14-21倍，油门抖动减少3-5倍（所有p<10^-4，Bonferroni校正），任务完成率匹配（成功p=0.28，碰撞p=0.31），奖励成本6.3%。在Webots自适应巡航控制上：奖励持平（p=0.121），转向抖动减少8-45倍，总任务失败率从2.0%降至0.7%。

Conclusion: ZAPS-DA通过因果蒸馏非因果滤波器的方式，在几乎不损失奖励的情况下实现大幅动作平滑，且无需后处理滤波或动作历史输入，适用于多种优化器和环境。

Abstract: Continuous control policies trained with off-policy reinforcement learning frequently exhibit high-frequency action jitter, rendering direct deployment on physical actuators impractical. Post-hoc filtering attenuates jitter but introduces phase lag; embedding smoothness penalties in the actor's loss couples them with the RL gradient and conflates reward regression with over-aggressive smoothing. We present ZAPS-DA, a framework that reduces action jitter at deployment with negligible phase lag and no post-processing. ZAPS-DA pairs an unmodified main actor (trained by the base RL loss) with a separate decoupled actor trained via supervised imitation of zero-phase filtered targets stored in the replay buffer. The deployed policy is the decoupled actor: a feed-forward map from the current observation to a smooth action, with no inference-time filter and no action-history input -- a mechanism we term causal distillation of a non-causal filter. A magnitude-matched MSE loss provides zero-hyperparameter portability across optimizer classes. Validated with Soft Actor-Critic and a Savitzky--Golay filter in two driving simulators using paired n=150 evaluation protocols: on MetaDrive, ZAPS-DA reduces steering jitter by 14--21x and throttle jitter by 3--5x (all $p < 10^{-4}$, Bonferroni-corrected) while matching task-completion (p=0.28 success, p=0.31 crash) at a 6.3% reward cost; on a custom Webots adaptive cruise control environment, the same SG configuration produces a Pareto improvement -- reward parity (p=0.121), 8--45x steering jitter reduction, and total task-failure rate reduced from 2.0% to 0.7%.

</details>


### [198] [Exploiting Chordal Sparsity for Globally Optimal Estimation with Factor Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30617)
*Avinash Subramanian,Connor Holmes,Timothy D. Barfoot,Frank Dellaert,Frederike Dümbgen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文在GTSAM框架中实现了因子图凸松弛SDP的自动构建，并利用贝叶斯树分解加速求解，实现了对经典局部求解器易陷入局部最小值问题的全局优化与认证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准因子图求解器（如GTSAM、g2o中的求解器）是局部的，可能收敛到较差的局部极小值，带来安全隐患。凸松弛技术虽能全局求解或认证状态估计问题，但需要耗费大量精力来构建，且求解大尺度半定规划（SDP）的计算成本远高于局部求解器。

Method: 1) 在GTSAM框架中创建自动构建凸SDP松弛的流程，支持常见因子和变量类型；2) 利用GTSAM原生的贝叶斯树结构分解SDP问题，利用弦稀疏性加速求解。

Result: 在3D位姿图SLAM（环状因子图）和2D定位（链状因子图）两个案例中，展示了这种利用结构的全局估计器相比标准局部求解器具有良好的可扩展性。

Conclusion: 该方法在GTSAM中自动构建凸松弛并利用结构稀疏性加速，为解决因子图状态估计的全局优化问题提供了一条实用且高效的途径。

Abstract: Robust and efficient state estimation is crucial for perception, navigation, and control in robotics. State estimation problems are conveniently modeled using the factor-graph framework as enabled by modern software packages such as GTSAM or g2o. However, the standard solvers included in such frameworks are local and may converge to poor local minima, posing significant safety concerns. Conversely, techniques based on convex relaxations have been shown to provide a means of globally solving or certifying many state estimation problems. However, these relaxations 1) often require substantial effort to formulate, and 2) may incur significantly higher cost compared to efficient local solvers, as they require solving a large semidefinite program (SDP). In this work, we address both shortcomings by 1) creating a new procedure within the GTSAM framework for automatically constructing convex SDP relaxations for any factor graphs with common factor and variable types, and by 2) exploiting the Bayes tree constructions native to GTSAM to decompose the SDP problem, leading to significant speedup in solver time for chordally sparse problems. We demonstrate the favorable scaling of this structure-exploiting global estimator compared to standard local solvers for two case studies: A 3D pose-graph SLAM problem with a ring factor graph and a 2D localization problem with a chain factor graph. The software framework is available at https://github.com/borglab/gtsam.

</details>


### [199] [Primitive Subspaces Mediate Few-Shot Transfer in VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30695)
*Anya Singh,Cabrel Happi,Jai Relan,Varun Nair,Vidyut Baradwaj*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出基于基元感知训练（primitive-aware training）的方法，使VLA策略可零样本组合子技能，仅需3条示范即可达到微调上限性能的78%，比平面训练策略实现3倍样本效率提升，并在多种架构和数据集上验证了基元表征的因果关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业环境中的VLA策略需要低成本教授新任务的能力，但当前VLA策略每学习一个新任务都需要微调，成本过高。本文旨在探索是否可以通过基元感知训练产生可迁移的构件：一个学到的子技能库，能够在推理时仅基于少量示范进行组合，完成未经训练的任务。

Method: 在REASSEMBLE接触丰富装配数据集上，使用匹配的LoRA微调配方和锁定超参数，训练两种具有不同归纳偏置的VLA架构（OpenVLA和π₀.₅）。训练方式对比：平面轨迹训练 vs. 基元分割的episode训练（含基元特定语言提示）。在6个物体-任务组合上评估少样本迁移（0/1/3/5/10条示范，无权重更新），并在LIBERO-Long数据集上验证。通过消融基元可解码隐空间子空间建立因果关系。

Result: 基元训练模型仅需3条示范即可达到微调上限性能的78%，而平面训练模型需要10条示范才能达到相同水平——3倍样本效率差异，在多个种子、架构和数据集上一致复现。消融基元可解码隐空间子空间导致少样本迁移性能下降32个百分点，而消融等维度的随机子空间无影响。此外，发现并纠正了评估分块策略时的家族式膨胀问题。

Conclusion: 基元感知训练能够产生可迁移的基元表征（子技能库），这些表征是少样本迁移因果必要的，而非偶然相关。该方法在不需要参数更新的情况下，仅需极少示范即可实现对新任务的泛化，显著降低工业部署中教授新任务的成本。

Abstract: Deploying vision-language-action (VLA) policies in industrial environments requires the ability to teach new tasks at low cost, a property current VLAs lack, since each new task requires fine-tuning. We investigate whether primitive-aware training produces a transferable artifact: a learned library of sub-skills that can be composed at inference time, conditioned on a small number of demonstrations, to perform tasks the policy was never trained on. We train two VLA architectures with different inductive biases, OpenVLA and $π_{0.5}$, on the REASSEMBLE contact-rich assembly dataset under matched LoRA fine-tuning recipes and locked hyperparameters, varying training between flat trajectories and primitive-segmented episodes with primitive-specific language prompts. We hold out 6 object-task combinations from training and evaluate few-shot transfer: models receive $m \in \{0, 1, 3, 5, 10\}$ demonstrations of a held-out task and attempt execution without weight updates. We replicate across three training seeds and validate on a second dataset (LIBERO-Long). Primitive-trained models reach 78% of fine-tuned upper-bound performance with only m=3 demonstrations, while flat-trained models require m=10 demonstrations to reach the same level -- a $3\times$ sample efficiency gap that replicates across seeds, architectures, and datasets. To establish causation, we ablate the primitive-decodable subspace of hidden states and show few-shot transfer degrades by 32 percentage points while ablating a random subspace of equal dimensionality has no effect, indicating primitive representations are causally necessary rather than incidentally correlated with transfer. We identify and correct a methodological pitfall in evaluating chunked policies: family-wise inflation of single-step action-range gates produces order-of-magnitude higher false-failure rates against ground-truth human demonstrations.

</details>


### [200] [Geometry-Aware Control Barrier Functions for Collision Avoidance via Bernstein Polynomial Approximations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30696)
*Siwon Jo,Yanze Zhang,Yupeng Yang,Wenhao Luo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于伯恩斯坦多项式符号距离场（BP-SDF）的几何感知控制障碍函数（CBF），统一表示机器人和障碍物的形状，利用伯恩斯坦多项式的可微性在闭环中施加控制约束，并在单机器人导航和异构多机器人避碰中验证了其安全性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CBF方法使用球体或超椭球等形状替代物在非结构化场景中过于保守，或需要大量局部基元导致约束数量膨胀、降低实时性能，亟需一种统一且高效的几何感知安全约束方法。

Method: 提出基于伯恩斯坦多项式符号距离场（BP-SDF）的几何感知CBF，用BP-SDF统一表示障碍物和机器人形状，通过伯恩斯坦多项式的可微性实现闭环控制约束的施加。

Result: 在单机器人导航和异构多机器人避碰仿真中验证了方法的效率和性能，能在不同环境下保证安全性。

Conclusion: BP-SDF CBF为不规则几何形状的机器人安全导航提供了一种统一、高效且不过于保守的解决方案，具有良好的实时性能。

Abstract: Safe navigation often relies on well-defined conditions based on the shape of robots and obstacles, and can be challenging when they have irregular geometries. While Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) offer an efficient mechanism to enforce safe set forward invariance, common shape surrogates (e.g., spheres or super-ellipsoids) either are overly conservative in unstructured scenes or require many local primitives, which inflates constraint counts and degrades real-time performance. In this paper, we introduce a novel geometry-aware Control Barrier Function (CBF) based on Bernstein-Polynomial Signed Distance Fields (BP-SDFs). It provides a unified way to represent the obstacles and robots, so as to represent the barrier function with a unified minimum distance. Benefiting from the differentiability of the Bernstein polynomials, one can easily enforce the control constraints in a closed loop. We validate the method's efficiency and performance to guarantee safety in single-robot navigation and heterogeneous multi-robot collision avoidance via simulations under different environments.

</details>


### [201] [GSAM: A Generalizable and Safe Robotic Framework for Articulated Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30740)
*Beichen Shao,Mengying Xie,Heng Su,Wanyi Zhang,Mingyan Li,Yan Ding,Fausto Giunchiglia,Chao Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GSAM是一个通用且安全的机器人操作框架，通过视觉感知生成运动学参数、VLM链式推理修正感知、LLM生成交互约束函数实现轨迹规划，在50个铰接物体任务中相比最优基线将操作成功率提升36.0%，标准差降低3.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（端到端策略学习、视觉运动规划、大模型）忽视了铰接物体的多样性及末端执行器与把手交互的复杂性，导致泛化能力有限且容易发生破坏性碰撞。

Method: 1) 视觉感知器生成运动学参数；2) 微调VLM采用链式推理进行常识性修正感知；3) 交互约束函数生成器融合铰接物体、交互姿态和避障知识，LLM将其函数化用于轨迹规划；4) 运动学感知操作规划器验证轨迹可达性。

Result: 在5类物体50个铰接任务和50个随机初始配置上，GSAM相比最优基线将操作成功率提升36.0%，标准差降低3.1%。

Conclusion: GSAM在物体泛化能力和交互安全性上优于现有方法，有效减少了破坏性碰撞。

Abstract: Articulated object manipulation is a unique challenge for service robots. Existing methods employ end-to-end policy learning, visionmotion planning, and large-language/visual-language model (LLM/VLM), but often overlook the diversity of articulated objects and the complexity of interactions between end-effector and handle, leading to limited generalization and destructive collisions. To address this, we propose GSAM, a generalizable and safe robotic framework for articulated object manipulation. Specifically, a vision-based perceiver generates the kinematic parameters. Considering that pre-trained markers in perceiver yield raw estimations that may deviate from commonsense, we present a f ine-tuned VLM-based refiner, using chain-of-thought (COT) commonsense reasoning to refine perception. To prevent destructive collisions, we design an interaction constraint function generator, integrating articulated object, interaction pose, and obstacle avoidance knowledge into a base. LLM then functionalize these constraints and apply them to trajectory and posture planning. A kinematic-aware manipulation planner verifies reachability for trajectory and posture. Experiments on 50 hinge tasks across 5 object categories and 50 randomly initialized end-effectorhandle configurations show that GSAM reduces standard deviation by 3.1% and improves manipulation success rate by 36.0% compared to the best baseline, respectively demonstrating the superior object generalization and interaction safety of GSAM in practical scenarios.

</details>


### [202] [SSR: Scaling Surefooted and Symmetric Humanoid Traversal to the Open World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30770)
*Ruiqi Yu,Yiwen Wang,Yuan Hao,Jun WU,Qiuguo Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SSR框架，通过设想脚触点引导、等变潜空间对称增强和地形特定多判别器运动先验，实现基于第一人称视觉的人形机器人高效端到端穿越，在多种真实地形上达成安全、稳定、高质量的 locomotion。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将人形机器人的穿越能力拓展到开放世界是实际部署的关键，但现有方法在异质地形上的安全落脚、动态运动协调和类人行为生成方面仍面临挑战，亟需一个能联合学习视觉引导、稳定控制和自然运动的端到端框架。

Method: 1) 设想脚触点引导（Imagined Foothold Guidance）：学习建模即将到来的摆腿脚触点，评估其支撑性以引导触地前摆动朝向稳定区域，减少边缘滑移；2) 等变潜空间对称增强（Equivariant Latent-space Symmetry Augmentation）：在高维视觉观测下高效诱导双侧协调；3) 地形特定多判别器运动先验（Terrain-specific Multi-discriminator Motion Priors）：鼓励跨场景的类人行为。

Result: 在多种真实世界地形上实现安全、稳定、高质量的 locomotion，包括不同结构的楼梯、宽间隙、高平台等极端挑战，并在开放户外环境中实现可靠的长时域穿越。

Conclusion: SSR通过端到端学习视觉引导的落脚规划、双侧协调和类人运动先验，有效提升了人形机器人在复杂开放环境中的穿越能力与稳定性。

Abstract: Extending humanoid traversal to the open world is key to practical deployment in human environments, but remains challenging. The robot must use vision to ensure safe and reliable foot placement on heterogeneous terrain under highly dynamic motion, while producing coordinated, natural whole-body behaviors. We propose SSR, an efficient end-to-end framework for egocentric vision-based humanoid traversal that jointly learns these capabilities. SSR introduces imagined foothold guidance, which learns to model forthcoming swing-foot contacts and evaluates their support to guide pre-touchdown swings toward stable regions, reducing edge slips. It further employs equivariant latent-space symmetry augmentation to efficiently induce bilateral coordination under high-dimensional visual observations, and uses terrain-specific multi-discriminator motion priors to encourage human-like behavior across scenes. Extensive experiments show that SSR achieves safe, stable, and high-quality locomotion on diverse real-world terrains, including stairs with varied structures and extreme challenges such as wide gaps and high platforms, while enabling reliable long-horizon traversal in open outdoor environments.

</details>


### [203] [Two Degree-of-Freedom Vibratory Transport in a Grasp](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30780)
*C. L. Yako,Shenli Yuan,Kenneth Salisbury*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文利用非对称振动实现平行夹爪抓取中零件的两自由度（平移+旋转）灵巧操作，通过闭环位置控制产生周期性粘滑波形，理论分析了粘滞加速度和滑动加速度两个波形参数对平均速度的影响，并通过实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统平行夹爪在抓取后缺乏对零件进行灵巧操作的能力，通常需要重新抓取或借助其他机械结构。本文旨在利用非对称振动在夹持状态下直接实现零件的平移和旋转，提升操作灵活性。

Method: 采用闭环位置控制驱动移动表面产生周期性粘滑波形（非对称振动），建立理论模型分析粘滞加速度和滑动加速度对零件平均速度的影响。构建2-DoF振动平台（平移+绕面法线旋转），以平行夹爪构型配置两个平台，实现零件的双向平移和旋转操作。

Result: 理论趋势与实验吻合；2-DoF振动表面在平行夹爪中成功实现了多种零件的双向平移和旋转；平移中的波形趋势同样适用于面内旋转。

Conclusion: 非对称振动是一种有效的平行夹爪内零件操作方式，通过调节波形参数可控制零件运动速度，且该方法可推广至旋转自由度。

Abstract: In this paper, we use asymmetric vibrations to demonstrate two degree-of-freedom (DoF) in-hand manipulation of grasped parts. The asymmetric vibrations are achieved through closed-loop position control of a moving surface, which applies a periodic stick-slip waveform to the part to be manipulated. We show analytically how two vibratory waveform parameters, the sticking acceleration and the slipping acceleration, affect average part velocity when moving against gravity. The theoretical trends are then validated using an experimental setup where the squeeze force is controlled and part motion is recorded by a high-resolution encoder. We also develop a 2-DoF vibratory surface capable of translation in one direction and rotation about the surface normal. Using two of these 2-DoF surfaces in a parallel jaw gripper configuration, we bidirectionally translate and rotate a variety of grasped parts, as well as demonstrate that the same waveform trends for translation also persist for in-plane rotation.

</details>


### [204] [Feat2Go: Visual Feature-Grounded Value Estimation for Embodied Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30795)
*Junyang Shu,Zhiwei Lin,Bingqing Wei,Yongtao Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Feat2Go提出一种细粒度价值估计框架，通过预训练视觉世界模型提取补丁级语义进度作为密集奖励信号，从而在无需人工设计奖励的情况下显著提升VLA模型在长程操作任务中的强化学习效果，在ManiSkill3和RoboTwin 2.0上分别将OpenVLA-OFT的成功率从17.5%提升至82.9%，并达到88.8%的平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习在提升VLA模型能力方面潜力巨大，但面临稀疏监督和长程操作任务中奖励信号设计困难的问题，亟需一种无需人工奖励工程的密集奖励方法。

Method: 首先从预训练视觉世界模型中通过补丁级相似性度量推导连续进度目标，并利用趋势聚类将轨迹划分为语义阶段；然后训练一个具身价值模型从当前观测和指令预测该结构进度，并用预测值重塑终端奖励以优化策略。

Result: 在ManiSkill3上，Feat2Go将OpenVLA-OFT的平均分布外成功率从17.5%提升至82.9%，同时保留96.9%的分布内性能；在RoboTwin 2.0上达到88.8%平均成功率，优于先前强化学习方法。

Conclusion: Feat2Go兼容现有VLA策略强化学习管线（PPO/GRPO），无需人工奖励工程，在单臂和双臂操作场景下均能稳定提升VLA模型性能，为长程操纵任务提供了一种有效的密集奖励解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning is a promising approach for improving the capabilities of vision-language-action (VLA) models while avoiding the heavy data requirements of imitation learning. However, its effectiveness for VLA models is often constrained by sparse supervision and the difficulty of designing informative reward signals for long-horizon manipulation. In this work, we present Feat2Go, a fine-grained value estimation framework for embodied reinforcement learning. Specifically, Feat2Go first derives a continuous progress target from a pretrained visual world model by measuring patch-level similarity to subgoal states and partitioning episodes into semantic stages with trend-based clustering. We then train an embodied value model to predict this structural progress from the current observation and task instruction, and use the predicted value to reshape terminal rewards during policy optimization. The proposed framework is compatible with existing VLA policy reinforcement learning pipelines, including PPO and GRPO, and does not rely on manual reward engineering. Extensive experiments on ManiSkill3 and RoboTwin 2.0 demonstrate that Feat2Go consistently improves the performance of existing VLA models under both single-arm and bimanual manipulation settings. More specifically, on ManiSkill3, Feat2Go improves OpenVLAOFT from 17.5% to 82.9% average out-of-distribution success while retaining 96.9% in-distribution performance. On RoboTwin 2.0, Feat2Go achieves an average success rate of 88.8% in domain-randomized task settings, outperforming prior reinforcement learning methods.

</details>


### [205] [Hide-and-Seek in Trajectories: Discovering Failure Signals for VLA Runtime Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30834)
*Seongheon Park,Wendi Li,Changdae Oh,Samuel Yeh,Zsolt Kira,Michael Hagenow,Sharon Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Hide-and-Seek框架，通过轨迹间和轨迹内对比学习，从粗粒度轨迹级标签中定位失败指示动作，实现VLA模型执行失败检测，无需步骤级标注，在多个基准和真实机器人平台上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在执行中容易发生故障，现有检测方法要么依赖昂贵的动作重采样或外部模型，要么将轨迹级标签均匀传播到每个时间步，模糊了局部失败信号，缺乏高效且精准的失败检测方法。

Method: 将VLA失败检测建模为粗监督学习问题，结合轨迹间对比学习（区分成功/失败轨迹）和轨迹内对比学习（区分同一轨迹中失败前后状态），从轨迹级标签中诱导出具有时间结构的失败信号，无需步骤级标注。

Result: 在LIBERO、VLABench和真实机器人平台上，针对OpenVLA、π₀和π₀.₅三种VLA策略，在多任务失败检测中取得SOTA性能；在保形预测框架下实现准确的精度-时效权衡；对已知和未知任务均有良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: Hide-and-Seek通过粗监督对比学习有效解决了VLA失败检测中的局部信号模糊问题，为机器人系统的可靠部署提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to follow natural language instructions and generalize across diverse tasks, but they remain vulnerable to execution failures that compromise reliability in real-world deployment. Detecting such failures during execution is therefore critical for the robust deployment of embodied systems. Existing failure detection methods either rely on expensive action resampling or external models, while alternatives propagate trajectory-level labels uniformly across every timestep, obscuring localized failure signals. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Hide-and-Seek}, a framework that formulates VLA failure detection as a coarsely supervised learning problem. By combining inter-trajectory and intra-trajectory contrastive objectives, Hide-and-Seek localizes failure-indicative actions and induces temporally structured failure signals from trajectory-level supervision alone, without any step-level annotation. We evaluate Hide-and-Seek on LIBERO, VLABench, and a real-world robotic platform across three representative VLA policies: OpenVLA, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$.Our method achieves state-of-the-art multi-task failure detection performance with a practical accuracy--timeliness trade-off under conformal prediction, and generalizes well to both seen and unseen tasks.

</details>


### [206] [High-Load-Density Electro-Permanent Magnetic Foot with Controllable Adhesion for Quadruped Wall-Climbing Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30849)
*An Li,Bo Tao,I-Ming Chen,Han Ding*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于四足机器人铁磁表面攀爬的高负载密度可控电永磁足端，基于环形Halbach电永磁（CHN-EPM）吸附单元和力反馈控制系统，实现了超过1000N吸附力和200:1负载自重比，并在实际四足机器人上验证了天花板、垂直墙面及复杂表面的稳定运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现四足机器人在铁磁表面（如天花板、垂直墙面）上的可靠攀爬运动，需要高负载密度、可控吸附且对气隙变化鲁棒的吸附机构。

Method: 提出环形Halbach电永磁（CHN-EPM）吸附单元，采用三维磁路结构与通量汇聚效应，形成分布式并联磁通路径以提升磁通利用率并降低气隙敏感性；设计磁化驱动器与两级脉冲电流控制策略实现精准磁化；集成柔性压力传感器实现接触力反馈与吸附状态监测。

Result: 最大吸附力超过1000N，负载自重比超过200:1；在Unitree GO2四足机器人上实现了天花板和垂直墙面上的高负载吸附，以及在喷漆、穿孔和曲面铁磁表面上的稳定运动。

Conclusion: CHN-EPM吸附单元结合力反馈控制策略，能够有效应对部分接触等不确定条件，实现高可靠性吸附切换，为四足机器人在铁磁表面上的攀爬运动提供了可行方案。

Abstract: To enable reliable climbing locomotion of quadruped robots on ferromagnetic surfaces, this paper presents a high-load-density electro-permanent magnetic foot with controllable adhesion, featuring force-feedback circular Halbach-net electro-permanent magnet (CHN-EPM) adhesion units and a magnetization control system. Due to its three-dimensional magnetic circuit structure and flux-concentration effect, the CHN-EPM enables a distributed parallel magnetic flux path with enhanced flux utilization, resulting in reduced sensitivity to air-gap variations and allowing effective adhesion to be maintained even under partial contact conditions. The proposed CHN-EPM generates a maximum adhesion force exceeding 1000 N with a load-to-weight ratio over 200:1. A magnetization driver and a two-stage pulse current control strategy are developed to regulate the excitation current amplitude and duration, enabling accurate and reliable magnetization. By incorporating a flexible pressure sensor for contact force feedback, the system can effectively monitor attachment and detachment states, ensuring robust adhesion switching under uncertain contact conditions. The proposed system is integrated into a commercial quadruped robot (Unitree GO2), demonstrating high-load adhesion on ceiling and vertical-wall surfaces and stable locomotion on painted, perforated, and curved ferromagnetic surfaces.

</details>


### [207] [Wall-OSS-0.5 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30877)
*Ryan Yu,Pushi Zhang,Starrick Liu,Brae Liu,Miracle Kang,Shalfun Li,Lights Shi,Ellie Ma,Ping Yang,Chris Pan,Jerry Chen,Dongxiu Liu,Rain Sun,Miles Guo,Byron Zhang,Hugo Zhou,Zach Xu,Vincent Chen,Harrison Huang,James Wang,Dance Kuzi,Andy Zhai,Hang Su,Roy Gan,Lucy Liang,Hao Wang,Qian Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Wall-OSS-0.5 是一个开源 4B VLA 模型，通过在 20+ 具身形态、百万级轨迹上采用梯度桥接联合训练（离散动作预测、多模态预测、连续流匹配），证明了 VLA 预训练本身就能产生可执行的零样本机器人行为，而不仅仅是更好的下游初始化。微调后达到 60.5% 平均任务进度，超越 π_0.5 达 17.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回答一个根本性问题：VLA 预训练本身是否就能产生可执行的机器人行为，还是仅仅为下游策略学习提供更好的初始化？现有研究几乎总是在任务特定微调后才报告预训练 VLA 的效果。

Method: 构建 Wall-OSS-0.5（基于 3B VLM 骨干+动作生成组件），在 20+ 具身形态、百万级机器人轨迹上预训练，采用梯度桥接联合训练策略，包含三个互补目标：离散动作预测（引导 VLM 梯度）、多模态预测（保持视觉-语言理解）、连续流匹配（部署时的动作接口）。

Result: 零样本下在 17 个任务套件上实现非平凡的真实机器人行为（包括未见过的可变形操作任务）；微调后 15 个真实机器人任务平均任务进度 60.5%，超越 π_0.5 达 17.5%；多模态评估表明动作训练未侵蚀视觉-语言能力。

Conclusion: VLA 预训练应被重新定位为可直接测试、已有用的机器人能力来源，而不仅仅是一种初始化策略。

Abstract: Large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) pretraining is increasingly adopted as the foundation for robot policies, yet the evidence for pretrained VLAs is almost invariably reported after task-specific fine-tuning.This leaves a foundational question unanswered: does VLA pretraining itself yield executable robot behavior, or does it merely furnish a better initialization for downstream policy learning? We present Wall-OSS-0.5, an open-source 4B VLA built upon a 3B VLM backbone augmented with action-generation components, designed so that pretrained robotic capability is directly measurable on physical hardware.The model is pretrained across more than 20 embodiments, processing over one million robot trajectories per epoch alongside a grounded multimodal corpus. We adopt a gradient-bridged co-training recipe in which three objectives play distinct and complementary roles: discrete action prediction routes strong VLM-native gradients into the backbone, multimodal prediction preserves grounded vision-language understanding, and continuous flow matching serves as the deployment-time action interface. Before task-specific fine-tuning, the pretrained checkpoint achieves non-trivial zero-shot real-robot behavior, completing several tasks, including a held-out deformable manipulation task, at high task progress on a 17-task suite. After fine-tuning, the same checkpoint serves as a stronger adaptation prior, reaching 60.5% average task progress on 15 real-robot tasks and outperforming π_0.5 by 17.5%. Multimodal evaluations further confirm that action training does not erode grounded vision-language competence: the model preserves broad vision-language ability while strengthening embodied grounding. Together, these results reposition VLA pretraining from an initialization strategy to a directly testable, already useful source of robot capability.

</details>


### [208] [Trajectory Planning for Non-Communicating Mobile Robots using Inverse Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30906)
*Nina Majer,Yannick Epple,Xin Ye,Stefan Schwab,Sören Hohmann*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种结合逆最优控制与自预测的联合轨迹规划与预测算法，用于非通信移动机器人的碰撞避免。通过估计其他机器人的目标状态并实现联合预测，显著提升了多机器人场景下的规划效率与求解鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在非通信移动机器人碰撞避免场景中，现有的基于恒定加速度假设的目标状态估计方法效率较低，且可能导致规划或预测问题无解。因此需要一种更高效的联合轨迹规划与预测方法。

Method: 使用逆最优控制根据观测到的历史轨迹估计所有机器人的未知目标状态；每个机器人从其他机器人的视角进行自预测，并基于估计的目标状态求解联合预测问题；将预测结果用于轨迹规划。

Result: 在2-8个机器人的仿真场景中，所有机器人到达目标的中位时间相比基于恒定加速度估计目标状态的方法快了9.8%；且该方法从未导致规划或预测问题求解失败。

Conclusion: 提出的联合轨迹规划与预测方法在非通信多机器人碰撞避免场景中，能够更高效地规划路径且保证求解的可靠性。

Abstract: To enable an efficient interaction of non-communicating mobile robots in collision avoidance scenarios, we present a novel combined trajectory planning and prediction algorithm. Inverse optimal control is used to estimate unknown goal states of all robots based on observed past trajectories. Each robot also takes the perspective of other robots in considering self-prediction and solves a joint prediction problem using the estimated goal states. The resulting predictions are then considered for planning. Simulation results of scenarios with 2-8 robots show that the median of the durations until all vehicles reach their goals is 9.8 % faster compared to planning with constant acceleration based estimated goal states. Moreover, the proposed approach never leads to the solver being unable to find a solution to the planning or prediction problem.

</details>


### [209] [Enhancing Human-Likeness in Reinforcement Learning Agents via Hierarchical Macro Action Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30928)
*Usman Nizamani,M. Shaheer Luqman,Fawad Javed Fateh,Ali Shah Ali,Murad Popattia,M. Zeeshan Zia,Quoc-Huy Tran*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于层次化宏动作量化（HiMAQ）的类人强化学习框架，通过两级向量量化将人类演示编码为宏动作，在保持高奖励的同时生成更接近人类行为序列的动作，在D4RL基准上超越非层次化基线MAQ，且与IQL、SAC、RLPD等多种RL算法兼容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习代理虽性能强大但多为奖励驱动，行为与人类差异大，缺乏可解释性和可靠性，因此需要一种既能最大化奖励又能生成类人行为的RL框架。

Method: 提出层次化宏动作量化（HiMAQ）框架，包含两级向量量化：低层将输入动作映射为细粒度子动作簇，高层将这些子动作簇聚合为动作簇，从而将人类演示编码为宏动作，指导RL代理生成类人行为序列。

Result: 在D4RL基准上，HiMAQ在类人得分上优于非层次化基线MAQ，同时保持与先前RL代理相当或更优的成功率，且该改进可泛化至IQL、SAC、RLPD等多种RL算法。

Conclusion: 层次化宏动作量化是一种有效的类人RL方法，能够在奖励最大化与行为类人性之间取得良好平衡，且具有跨算法的泛化能力。

Abstract: Human-like agents are a long-standing goal of artificial intelligence. Despite strong performance, most reinforcement learning (RL) agents remain reward-driven and often exhibit behaviors that differ from humans, limiting interpretability and reliability. In this work, we introduce a novel human-like RL framework that predicts action sequences closely aligned with human behaviors while maximizing rewards. Specifically, we encode human demonstrations into macro actions using a hierarchical macro action quantization approach (termed HiMAQ) consisting of two successive levels of vector quantization. The lower quantization level maps input actions to fine-grained subaction clusters, while the higher quantization level aggregates these subaction clusters into action clusters. Extensive evaluations on the D4RL benchmarks show that our hierarchical approach outperforms the non-hierarchical baseline (MAQ), achieving better human-likeness scores while maintaining comparable or better success rates than previous RL agents. The improvements generalize across integrations with various RL algorithms, namely IQL, SAC, and RLPD.

</details>


### [210] [RDGen: Demonstration Generation for High-Quality Robot Learning via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30957)
*Zijian Zhu,Menglin Zou,Zhuang Li,Yaojie Tu,Xinhai Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RDGen框架，利用强化学习从仿真到真实环境生成高质量机器人演示轨迹，替代昂贵的人工遥操作，用于训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，实验表明其轨迹更平滑且下游性能优于人工采集数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLA模型性能受限于高质量机器人轨迹数据的可用性，而人工遥操作数据采集成本高、劳动密集且难以规模化，亟需一种可扩展的高质量数据生成方法。

Method: 提出RDGen框架：1) VLM-based任务解析器识别任务相关物体；2) Grounding DINO目标定位器；3) 从仿真迁移到真实机器人的RL策略。将训练好的RL策略作为结构化轨迹生成器，收集成功的rollout作为高质量演示，仿真阶段提供可扩展的额外轨迹。

Result: 在抓取放置任务上，迁移的RL策略实现了高任务成功率；与人工遥操作相比，RDGen生成更平滑的轨迹，且下游VLA性能更优。

Conclusion: RL生成的演示可作为比人工遥操作更可靠、更一致的监督信号用于机器人策略学习，为突破VLA模型的数据瓶颈提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot control. However, their performance remains fundamentally constrained by the availability of high-quality robot trajectory data. In current robot learning practice, such data are primarily collected through human teleoperation, which is labor-intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. In this paper, we propose RDGen, a sim-to-real reinforcement learning framework for generating high-quality robot demonstrations. Rather than employing reinforcement learning solely as the final control policy, RDGen leverages trained RL policies as a structured trajectory generator. The system consists of a VLM-based task parser that identifies task-relevant objects, a Grounding DINO-based object localizer, and an RL policy transferred from simulation to the real robot. Successful rollouts are then harvested as clean, high-quality demonstrations for downstream VLA training, while the simulation stage further provides a scalable source of additional trajectories at little marginal cost. Experiments on a pick-and-place task demonstrate that the transferred RL policy achieves a high task success rate. Compared with human teleoperation, RDGen produces significantly smoother trajectories and yields superior downstream VLA performance. These results indicate that RL-generated demonstrations can serve as more reliable and consistent supervisory signals for robot policy learning.

</details>


### [211] [A study on a Real-Time VR-Based Teleoperation Framework for Manipulator in Dynamic Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30989)
*InGyu Choi,GeonYeong Go,SunWoo Ahn,HyoJae Kang,Min-Sung Kang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种集成GPU加速逆运动学和轨迹优化的VR遥操作框架，能够在静态和动态障碍物环境中实现实时、碰撞感知的机器人操控，实验证明该方法可在7自由度机械臂上生成符合操作者指令且安全避障的运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VR遥操作研究多作为机器人模仿学习的数据采集工具，未明确处理动态障碍物、工作空间变化或碰撞风险；为实现安全部署，遥操作需能低延迟响应动态场景并对新手操作员的失误具有鲁棒性。

Method: 提出VR遥操作框架，将GPU加速的逆运动学和轨迹优化集成到VR界面中，在每个控制周期内生成满足机器人约束的可行关节指令，同时处理静态和移动障碍物的碰撞。

Result: 在7自由度机械臂上进行了三个场景（无障碍、静态障碍物、移动障碍物）的实验，结果表明该方法能生成与操作者命令一致的运动，并在障碍物干扰命令路径时产生安全的绕行轨迹。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了稳定在线的碰撞感知运动生成，能够在危险环境中安全地执行遥操作任务。

Abstract: Robot teleoperation enables safe, non-contact task execution in hazardous environments where direct human access is difficult, and its application has expanded with recent VR technologies. Many VR teleoperation studies, however, have primarily served as data-collection tools for robot imitation learning, so they often do not explicitly address dynamic obstacles, workspace changes, or collision risks during operation. For real deployment aimed at operator safety, teleoperation must react to dynamic situations with low latency and remain robust to mistakes made by inexperienced operators. This paper presents a VR teleoperation framework that supports real-time manipulation while handling collisions with both static and moving obstacles. The framework integrates GPU-accelerated inverse kinematics and trajectory optimization within a VR interface to generate feasible joint commands at each control cycle under robot constraints. Experiments with a 7-DoF manipulator demonstrate stable online behavior and collision-aware motion generation across three scenarios: obstacle-free, static-obstacle, and moving-obstacle environments. The results indicate that the proposed approach generates motion consistent with the operator's command while producing safe detours when obstacles interfere with the commanded path.

</details>


### [212] [Building Generalization Into Behavior Generation Via Adaptive Compositions of Regularities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31110)
*Aravind Battaje,Malte Bernhard,Vito Mengers,Oliver Brock*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究机器人泛化问题，提出泛化源于对规律的自适应组合，并通过AICON框架验证了这一命题。实验表明，该机制能在绝大多数新颖条件下生成情境适当的行为，且网络能自动根据信息量调节规律的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人泛化需要关于世界结构的先验知识，但结构会随情境变化。现有方法难以在动态变化的环境中实现有效泛化，因此需要研究如何通过自适应组合规律来生成情境适当的行为。

Method: 采用AICON（Active InterCONnect）框架，将规律表示为可微网络中的交互过程，通过感觉反馈实现规律组合，利用梯度下降生成行为。在模拟环境中隔离所有相关规律，将模型暴露于设计时未考虑的新颖条件下进行测试。

Result: 模型在除一种情况外的所有新颖条件下均能生成情境适当的行为，其中失败案例是由于编码规律不足。消融实验表明网络能自动根据规律的信息量调节其对行为的影响。

Conclusion: 规律的自适应组合为行为生成中的泛化提供了强大的归纳偏置，是构建机器人泛化能力的有效途径。

Abstract: Generalization in robotics requires prior knowledge about how the world is structured, yet this structure changes from one situation to the next. This paper investigates the proposition that generalization arises from adaptively composing regularities -- predictable relationships within the robot-environment system -- into situation-appropriate structures for behavior generation. We examine this proposition by analyzing the mechanism in AICON (Active InterCONnect), a framework representing regularities as interacting processes in a differentiable network, where sensory feedback realizes composition and gradient descent generates behavior. To isolate adaptive composition as the key mechanism, we study a simple simulated problem in which all relevant regularities can be identified. We expose the resulting model to a wide range of novel conditions not considered during design, and we find that it generates context-appropriate behavior in all but one case, where encoded regularities are provably insufficient. Ablations reveal that the network automatically modulates which regularities influence behavior based on their informativeness. These results suggest that adaptive composition of regularities constitutes a powerful inductive bias for building generalization into behavior generation.

</details>


### [213] [TARIC: Memory-Augmented Traversability-Aware Outdoor VLN under Interrupted Semantic Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31121)
*Tianle Zeng,Hanjing Ye,Jianwei Peng,Jingwen Yu,Hanxuan Chen,Hong Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种统一户外视觉语言导航框架，通过可通行性一致的执行引导和3D线索记忆，在语义线索中断的长距离环境中保持目标导向导航，在四足和轮式平台上实现了显著优于基线的成功率（仿真+10%，真实世界40% vs 17.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 户外视觉语言导航中，长距离开放世界环境常因语义线索中断（目标线索稀疏、遮挡或离开视野）导致导航退化（回溯、振荡、盲目探索）。现有记忆方法在受可通行性驱动的绕行下，记忆线索方向不可行，使线索过时、历史模糊，可通行性成为维持目标导向引导的稳定性条件而非局部安全问题。

Method: 1) 从可见性门控的目标或探索线索中提取语义方位，利用实时近场可通行性剖面将其转化为可执行朝向，提供超越拒绝式安全过滤的目标一致可行引导。2) 将间歇的2D证据提升为世界对齐的3D线索记忆，结合不确定性感知的读取机制，确保绕行期间引导持续可达且稳定。

Result: 在600-1000米路线的四足和轮式平台上，仿真成功率比最强基线提升10个百分点以上；真实世界成功率达40%（最强基线17.5%），在长时间线索中断区间具有更高的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 将可通行性从局部安全约束提升为全局引导稳定性条件是户外VLN长程语义中断问题的有效解决方案，3D线索记忆与可通行性感知引导的结合显著提升了实际部署性能。

Abstract: Outdoor vision-language navigation (VLN) in long-range, open-world environments is frequently disrupted by semantic-cue interruptions, where informative goal cues become sparse, occluded, or leave the field of view. Once such cues disappear, agents enter a cue-free phase and often degrade into backtracking, oscillatory headings, or aimless exploration. While memory-based methods attempt to bridge these gaps, they often fail under traversability-driven detours: the remembered cue direction may be infeasible, forcing detours that prolong cue-free phases and gradually render robot-centric cues stale and implicit histories blurred. This makes traversability a stability condition for maintaining goal-directed guidance, rather than merely a local safety concern.
  We propose a unified outdoor VLN framework that survives semantic-cue interruptions by maintaining traversability-consistent executable guidance throughout prolonged cue-free phases. Specifically, our method extracts semantic bearings from visibility-gated goal or exploration cues and grounds them into executable headings using a real-time near-field traversability profile, providing goal-consistent feasible guidance beyond reject-only safety filtering. To prevent guidance degradation during detours, we lift intermittent 2D evidence into a world-aligned 3D cue memory with an uncertainty-aware readout mechanism, ensuring guidance remains continuously reachable and stable as the robot moves.
  We evaluate the framework on quadrupedal and wheeled platforms over 600--1000 m routes. Our method improves simulation success rate by over 10 percentage points over the strongest baseline and achieves a real-world success rate of 40%, compared to 17.5% for the strongest baseline, with substantially higher robustness during prolonged cue-free intervals.

</details>


### [214] [Simulation of collision avoidance behavior in crowd movement by data-driven approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31210)
*Xuanwen Liang,Eric Wai Ming Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为CPGAN的数据驱动人群仿真模型，通过在损失函数中引入基于侧向加速度的碰撞惩罚项和Voronoi运动特征提取，显著降低了双向流场景中的行人碰撞率，并能复现车道形成等典型自组织现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的人群仿真模型在欧氏度量下轨迹预测精度高，但在双向和多向流场景中碰撞率过高，亟需将行人碰撞机制融入模型以提升安全性和真实性。

Method: 基于生成对抗网络（GAN）架构，提出CPGAN模型。核心创新包括：(1) 基于侧向加速度的碰撞损失函数，用于惩罚高碰撞风险的轨迹；(2) 基于Voronoi图的运动特征提取方法，以更好地捕捉行人局部空间交互信息。

Result: 在双向流场景中，CPGAN将相反方向行人的碰撞率显著降低至与受控实验相当的水平，并成功复现了车道形成和N-t曲线等典型双向流特征。

Conclusion: 将行人动力学机制（如碰撞规避）融入数据驱动模型的损失函数是提升仿真真实性和安全性的有效途径，为后续研究提供了新思路。

Abstract: Crowd movement simulation is essential for pedestrian safety management and facility layout optimization. Data-driven models enhance trajectory prediction accuracy under Euclidean metrics, yet they suffer from excessively high collision rates, especially in bidirectional and multidirectional flows. In this paper, we establish a novel data-driven crowd simulation model that incorporates the pedestrian collision mechanism into the loss function to reduce collisions. A new lateral-acceleration-based collision loss function and a Voronoi-based motion feature extraction approach are proposed. The model is based on a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) architecture and is termed CPGAN (Collision-Penalized GAN). We evaluate CPGAN in bidirectional flow scenarios, which involve frequent collision avoidance behaviors. Results show that the proposed lateral-acceleration-based collision loss significantly reduces opposite-direction pedestrian collision rates to levels comparable with controlled experiments. CPGAN effectively simulates bidirectional flow, reproducing lane formation and N-t curves. The research outcomes can provide inspiration for integrating pedestrian dynamics mechanisms into loss functions in data-driven crowd simulation.

</details>


### [215] [HARP-VLA: Human-Robot Aligned Representation Learning for Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31234)
*Xiang Zhu,Puzhen Yuan,Yichen Liu,Jianyu Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了HARP框架，通过配对的人-机器人演示作为跨本体桥梁，结合非配对数据训练视觉编码器和潜在动作模型，实现人-机器人对齐的视觉-语言-动作预训练，在CALVIN ABC→D任务上达到4.481平均长度，真实世界成功率提升7.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型从人类视频学习时，人机视觉表征和动作执行的跨本体差异导致策略输入不一致和领域依赖的潜在动作，阻碍了人类视频的有效协同训练。

Method: HARP框架包含：(1) 有限配对人-机器人演示作为跨本体桥梁；(2) 非配对人/机器人视频作为可扩展动态监督源；(3) 基于操作中心辅助线索和源相对对判别对齐损失的机器人适配视觉编码器和潜在动作模型训练；(4) 统一视觉和动作表示用于VLA策略学习，轻量级机器人动作头将潜在动作转化为可执行指令。

Result: 在特征可视化、仿真和真实世界操作实验中，HARP在CALVIN ABC→D上达到4.881平均长度，真实世界成功率比最强基线提升7.1%。

Conclusion: HARP通过人-机器人对齐表征学习有效弥合了跨本体差异，提升了VLA模型从人类视频中预训练的效果。

Abstract: Learning generalizable vision-language-action (VLA) models from large-scale human videos is promising but challenging due to cross-embodiment discrepancies in both visual observations and executable actions. While latent action models reduce the action execution gap by learning action abstractions, they still rely on visual features. Thus, misaligned human and robot visual representations can lead to inconsistencies in policy inputs and induce domain-dependent latent actions, hindering effective co-training with human videos. To address this, we propose HARP, a human-robot aligned representation learning framework for more effective VLA pretraining from human videos. Specifically, HARP uses limited paired human-robot demonstrations as cross-embodiment bridges and abundant unpaired human and robot videos as a scalable dynamics supervision data source. It trains a robot-adapted visual encoder and a latent action model with manipulation-centric auxiliary cues and a source-relative pair-discriminative alignment loss, which adapts robot representations toward human semantics while preserving pair-level discrimination. The learned aligned vision encoder and latent action model provide a unified vision and action representation for VLA-style policy learning, where human and robot videos provide vision-language-to-latent-action supervision and a lightweight robot action head grounds latent actions into executable commands. Experiments on feature visualization, simulation, and realworld manipulation show improved human-robot alignment and downstream policy performance, achieving 4.481 average length on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D and a 7.1\% realworld success rate gain over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [216] [DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31286)
*Taiyi Su,Jian Zhu,Tianjian Wang,Youzhang He,Zitai Huang,Jianjun Zhang,Chong Ma,Hanyang Wang,Tianjiao Zhang,Munan Yin,Weihao Ding,Yi Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出DeMaVLA，一个面向可变形物体（如衣物）折叠的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型。该方法通过VLM骨干网络+流匹配动作专家、层间剪枝策略降低计算成本，结合约5000小时真实世界演示预训练与人类在环数据聚合（DAgger）后训练，实现了跨类别、跨场景的通用折叠操作，实验在RoboTwin和家庭折叠基准上取得竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA系统通常为不同物体类别训练独立策略，而简单的多任务混合训练存在任务干扰和性能下降问题。需要一种能够在跨类别、跨场景下实现通用可变形物体折叠操作的VLA基础模型。

Method: 采用VLM骨干网络+动作专家架构，使用流匹配（flow matching）生成连续动作；通过每隔一层剪枝Transformer层并保持层间对齐来构建高效动作专家；先在大规模真实世界双人演示数据（约5000小时）上预训练获取通用操作先验，再在混合折叠数据上通过人类在环DAgger流程后训练，聚合自采演示和真实机器人故障纠正轨迹。

Result: 在RoboTwin上取得竞争性表现，在家庭折叠基准上取得强实际机器人实验结果。

Conclusion: 可扩展的真实世界数据、高效的动作生成和纠正学习对于可变形物体操作中的通用VLA策略具有重要价值。

Abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixed multi-task training often suffers from task interference and degraded performance. To move beyond category-specific folding policies, we introduce DeMaVLA, a VLA foundation model for generalizable Deformable Manipulation. DeMaVLA adopts a VLM backbone with an action expert and formulates continuous action generation using flow matching. To improve efficiency, the action expert is constructed by pruning every other transformer layer while preserving layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone, reducing training and inference cost. DeMaVLA is first pre-trained on approximately 5,000 hours of selected real-world dual-arm demonstrations to acquire general manipulation priors. It is then post-trained on mixed folding data that aggregates self-collected demonstrations and corrective trajectories from real-robot failures across multiple folding tasks through a human-in-the-loop Data Aggregation~(DAgger) pipeline. Experiments show that DeMaVLA achieves competitive performance on RoboTwin and strong real-world results on our household folding benchmark. These results highlight the value of scalable real-world data, efficient action generation, and corrective learning for general-purpose VLA policies in deformable-object manipulation.

</details>


### [217] [Shaft-integrated Force Sensing with Transformer-based Dynamics Compensation for Telesurgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31434)
*Shuyuan Yang,Grant Boone,Timo Markert,Sebastian Matich,Andreas Theissler,Martin Atzmueller,Zonghe Chua*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将六轴力传感器集成到缆驱动手术器械远端的方法，结合变压器神经网络补偿内部缆力，实现末端力测量，归一化误差低于6%，适用于RAMIS中的触觉反馈、技能评估和自主性研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAMIS中力信息对于性能评估、触觉定位和手术自主性具有重要价值，但目前缺乏可及且可复现的力传感集成方法。

Method: 将商用六轴力传感器集成到缆驱动手术器械远端，利用变压器神经网络融合力传感器测量与机器人状态信息，补偿执行器内部缆力，估算末端施加力。

Result: 归一化误差低于6%，泛化到未见条件优于纯近端数据驱动方法；高内部缆力导致传感器饱和并降低轴向力可观测性，在高负载下性能下降。

Conclusion: 该方法在系统可集成性与性能之间取得平衡，可支持RAMIS中触觉反馈、技能评估和力信息自主性等应用与研究。

Abstract: Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery (RAMIS) enhances surgeon dexterity, with newer platforms leveraging haptic feedback to further improve performance. Such force information has broader potential to inform performance assessment, tactile localization, and surgical autonomy. This motivates the need for accessible approaches to integrating force sensing into RAMIS tools. This work presents a method for integrating a six-axis commercial force sensor into the distal end of a standard cable-driven surgical instrument, enabling end-effector force measurement while preserving the original mechanical functionality of the device. The proposed design emphasizes reproducibility and accessibility for research applications, requiring no specialized manufacturing tools. A transformer neural network integrates force sensor measurements with robot state information to aid estimation of applied forces at the end-effector, compensating for internal cable forces arising from actuation. Our proposed approach achieved normalized errors below 6%, and generalized to unseen conditions better than purely proximal data-driven sensing approaches. High internal cable forces caused sensor saturation and reduced axial force observability, which can degrade performance along the tool's major axis and under higher load conditions. Given current levels of performance, the balance of system integrability and performance enables applications and research into timely topics of haptic feedback, skill assessment, and force-informed autonomy in RAMIS. Videos and code are available at https://enhanced-telerobotics.github.io/shaft force sensing.

</details>


### [218] [Actuator-Aware Inverse Kinematics with Joint-Limit Admissibility for Torque-Controlled Redundant Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31436)
*Mohammad Dastranj,Mahdi Hejrati,Jouni Mattila*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向力矩控制型冗余机器人的、考虑执行器特性的逆运动学方法。该方法将逆运动学输出视为关节速度指令（而非纯运动学解），通过构建凸二次规划问题，结合控制障碍函数约束、任务松弛变量和控制器兼容性目标，在关节极限约束下生成可执行的速度指令。实验表明，该方法能降低极限逼近指令、保证速度在允许范围内，并提升实际任务跟踪性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统逆运动学仅输出纯运动学层面的关节速度，忽略了后续力矩控制器的动态特性，导致即使运动学残差很小，实际执行效果却可能很差。为此，本文提出一种“执行器感知”的逆运动学方法，使输出的关节速度指令与底层力矩控制器更兼容，从而提升实际任务执行质量。

Method: 将逆运动学问题建模为凸二次规划问题：（1）决策变量为关节所需速度；（2）引入控制障碍函数（CBF）风格的约束，保证关节极限可接受性；（3）采用带惩罚的松弛变量处理任务方程；（4）通过控制器兼容性目标解决冗余问题，该目标同时考虑前一指令的一致性和执行器力矩容量加权。该方法不依赖特定的力矩控制器，可作为末端轨迹与冗余机器人控制器之间的中间逆运动学层。

Result: 在七自由度上肢外骨骼（采用虚拟分解控制）上进行实验，与标准逆运动学基线方法和带约束任务保持的二次规划基线方法对比。结果表明，所提方法能发出更低的极限逼近指令、生成有界且可接受的关节速度，并在不修改下游控制器的情况下改善了实际任务跟踪行为。

Conclusion: 本文证明，在力矩控制架构中，逆运动学输出应考虑执行器特性，通过凸二次规划框架将关节极限约束、任务保持和控制器兼容性统一建模，可有效提升冗余机器人实际任务执行效果，且该方法具有控制器无关性，便于集成。

Abstract: This paper proposes actuator-aware inverse kinematics for torque-controlled redundant robots under joint-limit constraints. In the considered architecture, the inverse-kinematic output is not merely a purely kinematic joint-velocity command; it is the required joint velocity supplied to a downstream torque-level controller. Therefore, a small commanded task residual may not necessarily improve realized motion. The proposed method formulates a convex quadratic programming problem whose decision variable is the joint-level required velocity. Control barrier function style bounds impose reference-level joint-limit admissibility, while the task equation is handled through a penalized slack variable. Redundancy is resolved using a controller-compatibility objective that accounts for previous-command consistency and actuator torque-capacity weighting. The method is independent of the particular torque-level controller and can serve as an intermediate IK layer between an endpoint trajectory and a redundant robot controller. Experiments on a virtual-decomposition-controlled seven-degree-of-freedom upper-limb exoskeleton compare the method with standard inverse-kinematic baselines and a constrained task-preserving quadratic programming baseline. The results indicate lower limit-pushing commands, bounded admissible required velocities, and improved realized task behavior in the tested trajectory, without modifying the downstream controller.

</details>


### [219] [On-Device Robotic Planning: Eliminating Inference Redundancy for Efficient Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31460)
*Joonhee Lee,Hyunseung Shin,Hyunmi Kim,Pei Zhang,Jeonggil Ko*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: REIS提出了一种基于人类认知启发的机器人决策框架，通过轻量级场景门控、KV引导的 affordance 路由和深思熟虑推理，显著减少冗余推理开销，在ALFRED和真实机器人任务上实现了低延迟的语义规划能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型和视觉-语言模型的机器人推理策略虽然具备强大的语义规划能力，但推理延迟过高，难以满足实际实时部署需求。

Method: REIS框架包含三个核心组件：轻量级场景门控（lightweight scene gating）、KV-steered affordance路由（KV-steered affordance routing）和深思熟虑推理（deliberative reasoning），利用机器人推理工作负载中的时间冗余性（连续观测常产生相同动作和子目标）来减少不必要的推理。

Result: 在ALFRED基准和真实机器人任务上，REIS显著抑制了推理开销，同时保持了具有竞争力的任务性能。

Conclusion: REIS通过模仿人类认知机制，在保持语义适应性的前提下最小化冗余推理，为机器人实时控制提供了一种高效的加速方案。

Abstract: Reasoning-based robotic policies using large language and vision-language models achieve strong semantic planning capabilities but mostly suffer from a high inference latency that limits practical real-time deployment. In this work, we observe that robotic reasoning workloads contain substantial temporal redundancy, where consecutive observations frequently produce identical actions and subgoals. Based on this insight, we present REIS, a human cognition inspired robotic decision-making framework that minimizes unnecessary reasoning while preserving semantic adaptability. REIS combines lightweight scene gating, KV-steered affordance routing, and deliberative reasoning to accelerate robotic control under embodied constraints. Experiments on ALFRED, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that REIS significantly suppresses reasoning overhead while maintaining competitive task performance.

</details>


### [220] [IDOL: Inverse-Dynamics-Guided Future Prediction for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31476)
*Chenghao Zhang,Timin Li,Dongmei Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出IDOL框架，通过逆动力学将世界模型的未来预测与端到端规划紧密耦合，在BEV潜空间中实现从被动场景预测到主动轨迹优化的转变，在NAVSIM基准上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的端到端自动驾驶方法中，未来预测与可执行的轨迹生成之间存在弱耦合问题——预测场景演变时未显式解码状态转换中隐含的运动信息，导致未来推理对实际规划贡献有限。

Method: 1) 使用BEV世界模型预测多个未来潜空间场景状态；2) 对相邻潜状态应用逆动力学模型，解码转换感知的轨迹特征并恢复规划相关的运动增量；3) 利用逆动力学信号优化规划轨迹；4) 通过轻量级闭环精炼模块利用优化后的轨迹进行新一轮未来感知推理，提升长时程一致性。

Result: 在NAVSIM v1和v2基准上，IDOL达到可比方法中的最优性能。

Conclusion: 逆动力学能够有效桥接未来预测与轨迹优化，将世界模型从被动场景预测转化为主动规划指导，实现更紧致的建模-规划耦合。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has emerged as a compelling paradigm for learning planning directly from sensor observations, while recent world-model-based approaches further enrich this paradigm by enabling explicit reasoning about how the scene may evolve in the future. Yet future prediction alone does not guarantee better planning unless the predicted evolution can be converted into planning-relevant trajectory updates. Many current methods still forecast future scene states without explicitly decoding the motion implications hidden in state transitions. As a result, future reasoning often remains descriptively useful but only weakly coupled to executable motion generation. To address this limitation, we propose \mathbf{IDOL}, an inverse-dynamics-guided future prediction framework for world-model-based end-to-end planning in latent BEV space, where inverse dynamics serves as the key bridge between future prediction and trajectory optimization. IDOL first predicts multiple future latent scene states with a BEV world model, then applies an inverse dynamics model to adjacent latent futures to decode transition-aware trajectory features and recover planning-relevant motion deltas that explain how the latent world evolves over time. These inverse-dynamics-derived signals are used to optimize the planned trajectory, turning future forecasting from passive scene anticipation into actionable planning guidance. A lightweight closed-loop refinement module further improves long-horizon consistency by reusing the optimized trajectory for another round of future-aware reasoning. By introducing inverse dynamics into latent future reasoning, IDOL tightens the coupling between world modeling and planning. Extensive experiments on the NAVSIM v1 and NAVSIM v2 benchmarks show that IDOL achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable methods.

</details>


### [221] [Batched Differentiable Rigid Body Dynamics in PyTorch for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31481)
*Yue Wang,Yanran Xu,Wenbo Wu,Chuanhang Qiu,Zhaoxing Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BARD是一个基于PyTorch的刚体动力学库，通过批处理GPU计算和自动微分优化Featherstone算法，在Forward Kinematics和Jacobians计算上相比Pinocchio实现高达64倍和63倍的吞吐量提升，并在Isaac Lab训练管线中实现8.5倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器人控制转向大规模强化学习（含循环动力学计算），社区对Pinocchio等CPU绑定库的依赖在GPU训练管线中造成了吞吐瓶颈。

Method: 三个核心设计：1) 分层惰性求值缓存，避免冗余树遍历；2) 通过预计算Rodrigues常数的无矩阵乘法关节变换；3) 层级并行传播，将顺序操作减少为树深度批次步骤。

Result: 在5个机器人模型（7-23自由度）上数值精度匹配Pinocchio；batch size 4096时Forward Kinematics吞吐量提升64倍，Jacobians提升63倍；梯度化的系统辨识中连杆质量恢复误差1.24%（5%扭矩噪声下）；Isaac Lab AMP训练管线中比Pinocchio快8.5倍，比ADAM快2.0倍。

Conclusion: BARD证明了在GPU上高效批处理刚体动力学计算的可行性，为大规模强化学习中的动力学计算提供了高性能替代方案，并已在GitHub开源。

Abstract: As robot control shifts toward large-scale reinforcement learning with in-loop dynamics computation, the community's reliance on CPU-bound libraries such as Pinocchio creates a throughput bottleneck in GPU-based training pipelines. We present BARD (Batched Articulated Rigid-body Dynamics), a self-contained PyTorch implementation of Featherstone's rigid-body dynamics algorithms, optimized for batched GPU evaluation and automatic differentiation. Three design choices make this efficient: a tiered lazy-evaluation cache that avoids redundant tree traversals, matmul-free joint transforms via pre-computed Rodrigues constants, and level-parallel propagation that reduces sequential operations to tree-depth batched steps. On five robot models (7-23 DOFs), BARD matches Pinocchio numerically while reaching up to 64x higher throughput for Forward Kinematics and 63x for Jacobians at batch size 4096 on an NVIDIA H200. We validate differentiability through gradient-based system identification on a 7-DOF manipulator, recovering link masses to 1.24% mean error under 5% torque noise, and integrate BARD into an Isaac Lab AMP training pipeline for an 11-DOF spined quadruped with 4096 parallel environments, where it is 8.5x faster than Pinocchio and 2.0x faster than ADAM for in-loop dynamics. BARD is open-sourced at: https://github.com/YueWang996/bard-pytorch-dynamics.

</details>


### [222] [Learning Controlled Separation of Small Objects Between Two Fingers with a Tactile Skin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31486)
*Ulf Kasolowsky,Berthold Bäuml*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出并解决了一种新颖的多功能机械手两指精确分离小物体的任务：在抓取一把小物体后，仅通过触觉反馈控制手指间保留指定数量的物体。通过强化学习在仿真中训练分离策略，并成功实现从仿真到真实DLR-Hand II机械手的迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机械手在抓取小物体时缺乏精确控制保留数量的能力，尤其是当物体尺寸远小于手指宽度且无视觉辅助时。本文旨在证明仅依靠空间分辨触觉反馈即可完成这一精细操作任务。

Method: 使用安装在指尖的空间分辨触觉皮肤，通过强化学习在仿真中训练分离策略，采用稀疏奖励函数（仅检查保留物体数量是否达到目标）。对比不同分辨率触觉传感器的效果，并训练估计器预测接触位置的真实值以分析触觉反馈的优势。

Result: 高分辨率触觉传感器近乎完美地完成任务；4x4分辨率（较低）传感器相比仅使用关节传感器仍有最高20%的性能提升。成功实现了从仿真到真实DLR-Hand II机械手的迁移。

Conclusion: 空间分辨触觉反馈对于机械手精确分离小物体任务至关重要，即使较低分辨率也能显著提升性能。该工作展示了纯触觉策略在精细操作中的可行性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: We introduce and solve the novel task of controlled separation of small objects with two fingers of a multi-purpose robotic hand: after grasping into a box of small objects, the task is to drop as many of them until a desired number remains between the fingers. The objects are small compared to the width of the fingers but also in absolute terms. In our case little pellets with a diameter of only 6mm are handled. We show that the task can be performed purely tactile (no vision) using a spatially-resolved tactile skin on a fingertip. The separation policy is trained in simulation via reinforcement learning using a straightforward sparse reward, which basically checks if the desired number of objects is reached. In simulation experiments, we provide an exhaustive analysis of the benefits of using spatially-resolved tactile feedback: while an ideal (high-resolution) tactile sensor allows solving the task almost perfectly, a sensor with lower spatial resolution (here 4x4 taxels) still leads to an improvement of up to 20% compared to using only the fingers' joint sensors. For this analysis, we further train an estimator alongside the policy that predicts the ground truth contact positions. Finally, we demonstrate the successful sim-to-real transfer for the DLR-Hand II equipped with a tactile skin.

</details>


### [223] [TAGA: A Tangent-Based Reactive Approach for Socially Compliant Robot Navigation Around Human Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.21168)
*Utsha Kumar Roy,Sejuti Rahman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出TAGA（切线动作群体规避）方法，通过在现有导航策略上叠加分层安全控制器来检测并规避群体边界，无需修改底层策略。同时提出群体穿越率（GCR）作为连续度量指标，并在包含五种实证场景的仿真基准上验证了该方法在经典反应式基线中的显著提升效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人导航方法将行人视为独立个体，忽视了社交群体的隐式边界，导致即使无碰撞也会产生社交干扰行为。需要一种能感知群体结构同时不改变底层导航策略的方法。

Method: 提出TAGA框架：通过切线路径机动检测群体边界，采用分层安全控制器协调群体级规避与个体碰撞预防；提出群体穿越率（GCR）作为连续度量指标；构建包含五个实证阶段的仿真基准（个体速度异质性、群体速度耦合、F-formation静态群体、领导者-跟随者动力学、凸包边界）。

Result: 在ORCA、Social Force、DS-RNN和Intention-RL四种方法上评估，TAGA对经典反应式基线提升最大（成功率最高提升8个百分点，GCR减半），对学习型策略几乎零成本。

Conclusion: 发现了反应式与学习型方法的非对称性：模块化群体感知对反应式基线价值显著，而端到端群体感知训练更适合学习型策略。为何时采用模块化群体感知提供了可操作指导。

Abstract: Robots navigating human-populated environments must avoid collisions while respecting the social structure of crowds, particularly the implicit boundaries of social groups. Most navigation approaches model humans as independent individuals,causing socially disruptive behavior even when collision-free. This paper presents TAGA (Tangent Action for Group Avoidance), detected group boundaries via tangent-path maneuvers without modifying the underlying navigation policy. A hierarchical safety controller coordinates group-level avoidance with individual collision prevention. We propose the Group Crossing Rate (GCR), a continuous metric measuring the fraction of timesteps the robot spends inside any group convex hull, providing finer-grained social compliance assessment than terminal metrics alone. We introduce a realistic crowd simulation benchmark with five empirically grounded phases: individual speed heterogeneity, group speed coupling, F-formation static groups, leader-follower dynamics, and convex-hull boundaries, evaluated under both ORCA and Social Force pedestrian dynamics. Experiments across ORCA, Social Force, DS-RNN, and Intention-RL reveal a reactive-learning asymmetry: TAGA provides the largest gains for classical reactive baselines (up to +8pp success rate, GCR halved) with near-zero cost for learned policies. These findings offer actionable guidance for when modular group-awareness adds value versus when end-to-end group-aware training is preferable.

</details>


### [224] [Learning Generalizable Robot Policy with Human Demonstration Video as a Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20795)
*Xiang Zhu,Yichen Liu,Hezhong Li,Jianyu Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段框架，利用人类示范视频直接作为提示来学习可泛化的机器人策略，无需新的遥操作数据和模型微调。第一阶段通过交叉预测训练捕捉人机视频联合表征的视频生成模型，第二阶段使用原型对比损失融合人机共享动作空间。在真实世界的灵巧操作任务上验证了有效性和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人学习方法依赖遥操作收集大量数据集进行模仿学习，面对新任务时需要重新采集数据和微调策略，数据采集过程繁琐昂贵。而人类能通过观察他人高效学习新任务，因此希望利用人类示范视频直接引导机器人执行新任务，消除对遥操作数据和模型微调的需求。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 训练视频生成模型，通过交叉预测学习人机演示视频数据的联合表征；2) 使用新颖的原型对比损失，融合所学表征并构建人机共享动作空间。

Result: 在真实世界灵巧操作任务上的实验表明，该方法能够有效泛化到新任务，无需任何新的遥操作数据和模型微调。

Conclusion: 该方法成功实现了以人类示范视频作为提示直接驱动机器人执行新任务，大幅降低了对遥操作数据的依赖，展示了良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Recent robot learning methods commonly rely on imitation learning from massive robotic dataset collected with teleoperation. When facing a new task, such methods generally require collecting a set of new teleoperation data and finetuning the policy. Furthermore, the teleoperation data collection pipeline is also tedious and expensive. Instead, human is able to efficiently learn new tasks by just watching others do. In this paper, we introduce a novel two-stage framework that utilizes human demonstrations to learn a generalizable robot policy. Such policy can directly take human demonstration video as a prompt and perform new tasks without any new teleoperation data and model finetuning at all. In the first stage, we train video generation model that captures a joint representation for both the human and robot demonstration video data using cross-prediction. In the second stage, we fuse the learned representation with a shared action space between human and robot using a novel prototypical contrastive loss. Empirical evaluations on real-world dexterous manipulation tasks show the effectiveness and generalization capabilities of our proposed method.

</details>


### [225] [Motion Tracking with Muscles: Predictive Control of a Parametric Musculoskeletal Canine Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23768)
*Vittorio La Barbera,Steven Bohez,Leonard Hasenclever,Yuval Tassa,John R. Hutchinson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种通过程序化生成、基于精确3D肌肉网格的犬类肌肉骨骼模型，并配套基于动捕的 locomotion 任务、改进的肌肉动力学模型，通过与真实EMG数据对比验证，旨在弥合生物力学、机器人学和计算神经科学之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前生物力学、机器人学与计算神经科学领域之间存在隔阂，缺乏一个既能反映真实肌肉解剖结构、又兼容多种控制算法且支持可微框架的通用平台，以研究肌肉驱动与神经肌肉控制。

Method: 程序化生成基于精确3D肌肉网格的犬类骨骼肌肉模型；配套基于动作捕捉的 locomotion任务；提出改进的肌肉动力学模型以增强可微控制框架下的收敛性；通过与实验获得的EMG数据对比进行验证。

Result: 模拟的肌肉激活模式与之前犬类运动研究中实验获得的肌电图（EMG）数据具有可比性，验证了模型的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个鲁棒的研究平台，能够弥合生物力学、机器人学和计算神经科学之间的差距；计划开源完整模型及重定向的动捕数据以促进后续研究。

Abstract: We introduce a novel musculoskeletal model of a dog, procedurally generated from accurate 3D muscle meshes. Accompanying this model is a motion capture-based locomotion task compatible with a variety of control algorithms, as well as an improved muscle dynamics model designed to enhance convergence in differentiable control frameworks. We validate our approach by comparing simulated muscle activation patterns with experimentally obtained electromyography (EMG) data from previous canine locomotion studies. This work aims to bridge gaps between biomechanics, robotics, and computational neuroscience, offering a robust platform for researchers investigating muscle actuation and neuromuscular control.We plan to release the full model along with the retargeted motion capture clips to facilitate further research and development.

</details>


### [226] [HUNT: High-Speed UAV Navigation and Tracking in Unstructured Environments via Instantaneous Relative Frames](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19452)
*Alessandro Saviolo,Jeffrey Mao,Giuseppe Loianno*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HUNT是一个统一的实时框架，通过相对导航公式实现了无人机在未知非结构化环境中的高速搜索与目标追踪，无需全局定位。


<details>
