  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的相对导航方法在目标可见时表现良好，但无法处理目标不在视野中的情况；而全局定位方法在退化感知条件下容易失效。需要一种能同时支持高速搜索和目标追踪的统一框架。

Method: HUNT利用机载即时可观测量（姿态、高度、速度）定义导航目标，实现反应式高速飞行；检测到目标后，同一感知-控制管线无缝切换至追踪模式，全部基于相对公式化表述。

Result: 在茂密森林、集装箱堆场以及使用车辆和人体模型的搜救行动中进行了室外实验，在全局定位方法失效的场景下展示了鲁棒的自主能力。

Conclusion: HUNT通过统一相对导航框架解决了高速搜索与目标追踪的冲突需求，在无全局定位和感知退化的条件下实现了鲁棒的自主飞行。

Abstract: Search and rescue operations require unmanned aerial vehicles to both traverse unknown unstructured environments at high speed and track targets once detected. Achieving both capabilities under degraded sensing and without global localization remains an open challenge. Recent works on relative navigation have shown robust tracking by anchoring planning and control to a visible detected object, but cannot address navigation when no target is in the field of view. We present HUNT (High-speed UAV Navigation and Tracking), a real-time framework that unifies traversal, acquisition, and tracking within a single relative formulation. HUNT defines navigation objectives directly from onboard instantaneous observables such as attitude, altitude, and velocity, enabling reactive high-speed flight during search. Once a target is detected, the same perception-control pipeline transitions seamlessly to tracking. Outdoor experiments in dense forests, container compounds, and search-and-rescue operations with vehicles and mannequins demonstrate robust autonomy where global methods fail.

</details>


### [227] [Mixture of Horizons in Action Chunking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.19433)
*Dong Jing,Gang Wang,Jiaqi Liu,Weiliang Tang,Zelong Sun,Yunchao Yao,Zhenyu Wei,Yunhui Liu,Zhiwu Lu,Mingyu Ding*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出混合动作视界（MoH）策略，通过并行处理不同长度的动作片段并融合输出，解决了VLA模型中动作块长度选择的固有权衡，同时提升了长期预见性和短期精度，在多个策略模型和任务上取得显著提升，LIBERO上达到99%平均成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型对训练时使用的动作块长度（即视界）非常敏感，长视界提供更强的全局预见性但降低细粒度精度，短视界提升局部控制但在长期任务上表现不佳，固定的单视界选择存在次优性。

Method: 将动作块重新排列为具有不同视界的多个片段，通过共享动作变换器并行处理，并使用轻量线性门控融合输出。MoH支持自适应视界的动态推理，通过跨视界共识选择稳定动作。

Result: 在π₀、π₀.₅和π_reg三种策略上均取得一致且显著的提升。π₀.₅+MoH在LIBERO混合任务上仅30k训练迭代即达到99%平均成功率，达新SOTA。动态推理模式下吞吐量比基线高2.5倍。

Conclusion: MoH是一种即插即用的策略，能够在不增加显著训练或推理开销的前提下，同时利用长期预见性和短期精度，提升模型性能和泛化能力，并支持高效动态推理。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown remarkable capabilities in robotic manipulation, but their performance is sensitive to the $\textbf{action chunk length}$ used during training, termed $\textbf{horizon}$. Our empirical study reveals an inherent trade-off: longer horizons provide stronger global foresight but degrade fine-grained accuracy, while shorter ones sharpen local control yet struggle on long-term tasks, implying fixed choice of single horizons being suboptimal. To mitigate the trade-off, we propose a $\textbf{mixture of horizons (MoH)}$ strategy. MoH rearranges the action chunk into several segments with different horizons, processes them in parallel with a shared action transformer, and fuses outputs with a light linear gate. It has three appealing benefits. 1) MoH exploits long-term foresight and short-term precision jointly within a single model, improving both performance and generalizability to complex tasks. 2) MoH is plug-and-play for full-attention action modules with minimal training or inference overhead. 3) MoH enables dynamic inference with adaptive horizons, which selects stable actions through cross-horizon consensus, achieving 2.5$\times$ higher throughput than baselines while preserving superior performance. Extensive experiments over flow-based policies $π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, and one-step regression policy $π_{\text{reg}}$ demonstrate that MoH yields consistent and significant gains on both simulations and real-world tasks. Notably, under mixed-task setting, $π_{0.5}$ with MoH reaches a new state-of-the-art with 99$\%$ average success rate on LIBERO after only $30k$ training iterations. Project page: https://timsty1.github.io/moh/

</details>


### [228] [Cross-Entropy Optimization of Physically Grounded Task and Motion Plans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.11571)
*Andreu Matoses Gimenez,Nils Wilde,Chris Pek,Javier Alonso-Mora*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出利用GPU并行物理模拟器和交叉熵优化方法，在考虑动力学和接触的情况下，为机器人任务规划生成可执行的、考虑底层控制器影响的运动实现方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TAMP算法注重计算性能、完备性或最优性，但通过简化和抽象导致规划可能忽略动力学或复杂接触，且忽视底层控制器影响可能导致方案在现实系统中不可行或非最优。

Method: 使用GPU并行物理模拟器计算带有运动控制器的规划实现，通过交叉熵优化对控制器参数（动作参数）进行采样，以获取低成本解决方案，且使用与现实系统相同的控制器。

Result: 在一组机器人利用环境几何移动物体的任务中验证了该方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法能够显式考虑动力学和环境接触，生成的规划可直接在真实机器人上执行，弥补了传统TAMP方法中抽象简化带来的现实可行性差距。

Abstract: Autonomously performing tasks often requires robots to plan high-level discrete actions and continuous low-level motions to realize them. Previous TAMP algorithms have focused mainly on computational performance, completeness, or optimality by making the problem tractable through simplifications and abstractions. However, this comes at the cost of the resulting plans potentially failing to account for the dynamics or complex contacts necessary to reliably perform the task when object manipulation is required. Additionally, approaches that ignore effects of the low-level controllers may not obtain optimal or feasible plan realizations for the real system. We investigate the use of a GPU-parallelized physics simulator to compute realizations of plans with motion controllers, explicitly accounting for dynamics, and considering contacts with the environment. Using cross-entropy optimization, we sample the parameters of the controllers, or actions, to obtain low-cost solutions. Since our approach uses the same controllers as the real system, the robot can directly execute the computed plans. We demonstrate our approach for a set of tasks where the robot is able to exploit the environment's geometry to move an object. Website and code: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/parallel-realization

</details>


### [229] [SKETCH: Semantic Key-Point Conditioning for Long-Horizon Vessel Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18537)
*Linyong Gan,Zimo Li,Wenxin Xu,Xingjian Li,Jianhua Z. Huang,Enmei Tu,Shuhang Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于语义关键点（Next Key Point）条件化的船舶轨迹预测框架，将长时域预测分解为全局语义决策与局部运动建模，通过预训练-微调策略估计NKP先验，在真实AIS数据上显著优于现有方法，尤其在长时域、方向准确性和细粒度预测方面表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时域船舶轨迹预测方法在长时间外推时难以保持全局方向一致性，容易产生漂移或不符合实际的轨迹，亟需一种能有效约束轨迹可行域、保持语义一致性的建模方法。

Method: 提出语义关键点条件化轨迹建模框架，将未来轨迹预测建模为以高层Next Key Point（NKP）为条件的生成过程，将长时域预测分解为全局语义决策与局部运动建模两个子任务，并采用预训练-微调策略从历史观测中高效估计NKP先验分布。

Result: 在真实AIS数据上的大量实验表明，所提方法在长时域预测、方向准确性和细粒度轨迹预测等指标上一致优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过NKP条件化分解长时域预测能够有效约束轨迹的语义可行性，提升全局方向一致性和预测精度，预训练-微调策略有利于高效估计语义先验。

Abstract: Accurate long-horizon vessel trajectory prediction remains challenging due to compounded uncertainty from complex navigation behaviors and environmental factors. Existing methods often struggle to maintain global directional consistency, leading to drifting or implausible trajectories when extrapolated over long time horizons. To address this issue, we propose a semantic-key-point-conditioned trajectory modeling framework, in which future trajectories are predicted by conditioning on a high-level Next Key Point (NKP) that captures navigational intent. This formulation decomposes long-horizon prediction into global semantic decision-making and local motion modeling, effectively restricting the support of future trajectories to semantically feasible subsets. To efficiently estimate the NKP prior from historical observations, we adopt a pretrain-finetune strategy. Extensive experiments on real-world AIS data demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, particularly for long travel durations, directional accuracy, and fine-grained trajectory prediction.

</details>


### [230] [TIC-VLA: A Think-in-Control Vision-Language-Action Model for Robot Navigation in Dynamic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02459)
*Zhiyu Huang,Yun Zhang,Johnson Liu,Rui Song,Chen Tang,Jiaqi Ma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TIC-VLA提出了一种延迟感知的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过显式建模语义推理延迟并将其融入动作生成，实现了在动态环境中遵循语言指令的实时鲁棒控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型假设时间对齐的推理与控制，但语义推理相对于实时动作存在固有延迟，导致动态环境中控制性能下降。

Method: 1) 定义延迟语义-控制接口，将延迟的视觉-语言语义状态和显式延迟元数据与当前观测共同作为动作生成条件；2) 提出延迟一致性训练流程，在模仿学习和在线强化学习中注入推理延迟，使训练与异步部署对齐；3) 构建DynaNav物理仿真平台用于动态环境语言导航评估。

Result: 在仿真和真实机器人实验中，TIC-VLA在多秒推理延迟下持续优于现有VLA模型，并保持鲁棒的实时控制。

Conclusion: 显式建模语义推理延迟是提升VLA模型在动态人机交互环境中实时控制性能的有效策略。

Abstract: Robots in dynamic, human-centric environments must follow language instructions while maintaining real-time reactive control. Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a promising framework, but they assume temporally aligned reasoning and control, despite semantic inference being inherently delayed relative to real-time action. We introduce Think-in-Control (TIC)-VLA, a latency-aware framework that explicitly models delayed semantic reasoning during action generation. TIC-VLA defines a delayed semantic-control interface that conditions action generation on delayed vision-language semantic states and explicit latency metadata, in addition to current observations, enabling policies to compensate for asynchronous reasoning. We further propose a latency-consistent training pipeline that injects reasoning inference delays during imitation learning and online reinforcement learning, aligning training with asynchronous deployment. To support realistic evaluation, we present DynaNav, a physics-accurate, photo-realistic simulation suite for language-guided navigation in dynamic environments. Extensive experiments in simulation and on a real robot show that TIC-VLA consistently outperforms prior VLA models while maintaining robust real-time control under multi-second reasoning latency. Project website: https://ucla-mobility.github.io/TIC-VLA/

</details>


### [231] [Variance-Reduced Model Predictive Path Integral via Quadratic Model Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03639)
*Fabian Schramm,Franki Nguimatsia Tiofack,Nicolas Perrin-Gilbert,Marc Toussaint,Justin Carpentier*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出混合方差缩减MPPI框架，通过将目标函数分解为近似模型与残差项，利用二次近似构建闭式模型引导先验，有效降低采样方差并提升样本效率，在非线性控制与接触丰富操作任务中验证了优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于采样的控制器（如MPPI）存在方差大、样本效率低的问题，限制了其在采样成本高昂或受限场景下的实用性。

Method: 将目标函数分解为已知近似模型与残差项；采用二次近似推导闭式模型引导先验，使样本集中在信息丰富区域；框架与几何信息源无关，支持精确导数、结构化近似或免梯度随机平滑。

Result: 在标准优化基准、欠驱动倒立摆控制以及接触丰富操作任务中，相较于标准MPPI，实现了更快的收敛速度和低样本区间的更优性能。

Conclusion: 该方法能使基于采样的控制策略在样本获取昂贵或受限的场景中更具实用性。

Abstract: Sampling-based controllers, such as Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) methods, offer substantial flexibility but often suffer from high variance and low sample efficiency. To address these challenges, we introduce a hybrid variance-reduced MPPI framework that integrates a prior model into the sampling process. Our key insight is to decompose the objective function into a known approximate model and a residual term. Since the residual captures only the discrepancy between the model and the objective, it typically exhibits a smaller magnitude and lower variance than the original objective. Although this principle applies to general modeling choices, we demonstrate that adopting a quadratic approximation enables the derivation of a closed-form, model-guided prior that effectively concentrates samples in informative regions. Crucially, the framework is agnostic to the source of geometric information, allowing the quadratic model to be constructed from exact derivatives, structural approximations (e.g., Gauss- or Quasi-Newton), or gradient-free randomized smoothing. We validate the approach on standard optimization benchmarks, a nonlinear, underactuated cart-pole control task, and a contact-rich manipulation problem with non-smooth dynamics. Across these domains, we achieve faster convergence and superior performance in low-sample regimes compared to standard MPPI. These results suggest that the method can make sample-based control strategies more practical in scenarios where obtaining samples is expensive or limited.

</details>


### [232] [SignScene: Visual Sign Grounding for Mapless Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12686)
*Nicky Zimmerman,Joel Loo,Benjamin Koh,Zishuo Wang,David Hsu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SignScene，一种以标志为中心的时空语义表征方法，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）将现实世界中的导航标志指令（如“出口→”）与局部3D场景元素进行语义关联（即标志接地），从而实现机器人在无地图条件下的开放世界导航。在9种环境类型的114条查询上达到88%的接地准确率，并在Spot机器人上验证了实世界无地图导航的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类可以利用导航标志在不熟悉的环境中无需地图进行导航，但机器人如何类似地利用真实世界中的标志进行无地图导航仍是一个挑战。主要难题在于标志解读：现实标志多样且复杂，其抽象语义内容需与局部3D场景对应。现有VLM具备语义常识和推理能力，但对空间信息的表示方式敏感。

Method: 提出SignScene，一种以标志为中心的空间-语义表征方法：（1）捕获与导航相关的场景元素和标志信息；（2）将这些信息以有利于有效推理的形式呈现给VLM。将标志接地问题形式化为将标志上的语义指令映射到对应场景元素和导航动作。

Result: 在涵盖9种不同环境类型的114条查询数据集上，接地准确率达到88%，显著优于基线方法。在Spot机器人上实现了仅使用标志的实世界无地图导航。

Conclusion: SignScene通过精心设计的空间-语义表征，有效解决了VLM对空间信息表示敏感的问题，实现了高精度的标志接地，并证明了其在真实机器人平台上的无地图导航可行性。

Abstract: Navigational signs enable humans to navigate unfamiliar environments without maps. This work studies how robots can similarly exploit signs for mapless navigation in the open world. A central challenge lies in interpreting signs: real-world signs are diverse and complex, and their abstract semantic contents need to be grounded in the local 3D scene. We formalize this as sign grounding, the problem of mapping semantic instructions on signs to corresponding scene elements and navigational actions. Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer the semantic common-sense and reasoning capabilities required for this task, but are sensitive to how spatial information is represented. We propose SignScene, a sign-centric spatial-semantic representation that captures navigation-relevant scene elements and sign information, and presents them to VLMs in a form conducive to effective reasoning. We evaluate our grounding approach on a dataset of 114 queries collected across nine diverse environment types, achieving 88% grounding accuracy and significantly outperforming baselines. Finally, we demonstrate that it enables real-world mapless navigation on a Spot robot using only signs.

</details>


### [233] [Neurosim: A Fast Simulator for Neuromorphic Robot Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15018)
*Richeek Das,Pratik Chaudhari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Neurosim是一个高速实时传感器仿真库（帧率可达~2700 FPS），可模拟动态视觉传感器、RGB相机、深度传感器和惯性传感器，并支持多旋翼飞行器在复杂动态环境中的敏捷动力学仿真。其配套通信库Cortex基于ZeroMQ，提供高吞吐量低延迟的消息传递系统，原生支持NumPy和PyTorch，便于与机器学习/机器人工作流集成。论文展示了该工具链在神经形态感知与控制算法的自监督训练及实时闭环测试中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仿真工具难以同时满足高帧率传感器仿真、多旋翼敏捷动力学模拟以及与机器学习/机器人工作流的无缝集成需求，缺乏一个支持神经形态感知与控制算法从训练到实时闭环测试的统一平台。

Method: 开发了Neurosim传感器与动力学仿真库（GPU加速，达~2700 FPS），配合基于ZeroMQ的Cortex通信中间件（支持Python/C++、NumPy、PyTorch），两者协同实现多模态时间同步数据生成与低延迟消息传递。

Result: 在桌面GPU上实现了约2700 FPS的帧率；成功支持了(i)基于自监督学习的神经形态感知与控制算法训练（利用时间同步的多模态数据），(ii)这些算法的实时闭环测试。

Conclusion: Neurosim与Cortex构成了一个高效、灵活的开源工具链，能够桥接神经形态算法的仿真训练与实物部署之间的鸿沟，为神经形态机器人学的研究提供了基础设施支持。

Abstract: Neurosim is a fast, real-time, high-performance library for simulating sensors such as dynamic vision sensors, RGB cameras, depth sensors, and inertial sensors. It can also simulate agile dynamics of multi-rotor vehicles in complex and dynamic environments. Neurosim can achieve frame rates as high as ~2700 FPS on a desktop GPU. Neurosim integrates with a ZeroMQ-based communication library called Cortex to facilitate seamless integration with machine learning and robotics workflows. Cortex provides a high-throughput, low-latency message-passing system for Python and C++ applications, with native support for NumPy arrays and PyTorch tensors. This paper discusses the design philosophy behind Neurosim and Cortex. It demonstrates how they can be used to (i) train neuromorphic perception and control algorithms, e.g., using self-supervised learning on time-synchronized multi-modal data, and (ii) test real-time implementations of these algorithms in closed-loop. Neurosim and Cortex are available at https://github.com/grasp-lyrl/neurosim .

</details>


### [234] [Notes-to-Self: Scratchpad Augmented VLAs for Memory Dependent Manipulation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.21013)
*Sanjay Haresh,Daniel Dijkman,Apratim Bhattacharyya,Roland Memisevic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在非马尔可夫、依赖记忆的长时域灵巧操作任务中的"无状态"缺陷，提出通过引入语言暂存器（language scratchpad）为VLA赋予空间和时间记忆能力，显著提升了模型在记忆依赖任务上的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLA模型虽成功将互联网级语义理解引入机器人领域，但本质上是"无状态"的，无法处理具有非马尔可夫性质、依赖记忆的长时域灵巧操作任务，对此问题缺乏足够关注。

Method: 在VLA中引入语言暂存器（language scratchpad），使模型能够记忆任务特定信息（如物体位置），并跟踪计划及其子目标进度。该方法适用于非递归和递归模型。

Result: 在ClevrSkills环境中的记忆依赖任务子集、MemoryBench以及具有挑战性的真实世界抓取放置任务上，语言暂存器的引入显著提升了模型的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 语言暂存器是一种有效为VLA赋予空间和时间记忆能力的方法，能显著改善模型在记忆依赖的长时域操作任务上的表现。

Abstract: Many dexterous manipulation tasks are non-markovian in nature, yet little attention has been paid to this fact in the recent upsurge of the vision-language-action (VLA) paradigm. Although they are successful in bringing internet-scale semantic understanding to robotics, existing VLAs are primarily "stateless" and struggle with memory-dependent long horizon tasks. In this work, we explore a way to impart both spatial and temporal memory to a VLA by incorporating a language scratchpad. The scratchpad makes it possible to memorize task-specific information, such as object positions, and it allows the model to keep track of a plan and progress towards subgoals within that plan. We evaluate this approach on a split of memory-dependent tasks from the ClevrSkills environment, on MemoryBench, as well as on a challenging real-world pick-and-place task. We show that incorporating a language scratchpad significantly improves generalization on these tasks for both non-recurrent and recurrent models.

</details>


### [235] [Meta-Adaptive Beam Search Planning for Transformer-Based Reinforcement Learning Control of UAVs with Overhead Manipulators under Flight Disturbances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26612)
*Hazim Alzorgan,Sayed Pedram Haeri Boroujeni,Abolfazl Razi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于强化学习的元自适应波束搜索规划器，结合Transformer DDQN框架，通过软件在环的模拟展开来预测末端执行器运动，显著降低了空中机械臂的跟踪误差（从6%降至3%），并提升了29.6%的奖励-误差综合指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机搭载的机械臂因机体姿态变化（如风扰、控制误差）导致末端执行器偏离预定轨迹，且传统的固定基座学习控制方法无法直接适用于这种强耦合系统。

Method: 提出基于强化学习的Transformer DDQN框架，核心是自适应波束搜索规划器：利用学习到的评论家网络作为前向估计器，在短时域内对候选控制序列进行波束搜索，通过软件在环（SITL）模拟展开来预测末端运动，避免直接在实际模型上执行动作。

Result: 在3-DOF空中机械臂上，相比DDQN基线：奖励提升10.2%，平均跟踪误差从约6%降至3%，奖励-误差综合指标提升29.6%；在外部扰动下能稳定保持5cm跟踪误差。

Conclusion: 该方法通过前瞻性模拟展开有效解耦了无人机姿态变化对末端执行器的影响，在跟踪精度和稳定性上均优于固定波束搜索和纯Transformer变体。

Abstract: Drones equipped with overhead manipulators offer unique capabilities for inspection, maintenance, and contact-based interaction. However, the motion of the drone and its manipulator is tightly linked, and even small attitude changes caused by wind or control imperfections shift the end-effector away from its intended path. This coupling makes reliable tracking difficult and also limits the direct use of learning-based arm controllers that were originally designed for fixed-base robots. These effects appear consistently in our tests whenever the UAV body experiences drift or rapid attitude corrections. To address this behavior, we develop a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework with a transformer-based double deep Q learning (DDQN), with the core idea of using an adaptive beam-search planner that applies a short-horizon beam search over candidate control sequences using the learned critic as the forward estimator. This allows the controller to anticipate the end-effector's motion through simulated rollouts rather than executing those actions directly on the actual model, realizing a software-in-the-loop (SITL) approach. The lookahead relies on value estimates from a Transformer critic that processes short sequences of states, while a DDQN backbone provides the one-step targets needed to keep the learning process stable. Evaluated on a 3-DoF aerial manipulator under identical training conditions, the proposed meta-adaptive planner shows the strongest overall performance with a 10.2% reward increase, a substantial reduction in mean tracking error (from about 6% to 3%), and a 29.6% improvement in the combined reward-error metric relative to the DDQN baseline. Our method exhibits elevated stability in tracking target tip trajectory (by maintaining 5 cm tracking error) when the drone base exhibits drifts due to external disturbances, as opposed to the fixed-beam and Transformer-only variants.

</details>


### [236] [Hyper-DP3: Frequency-Aware Right-Sizing of 3D Diffusion Policies for Visuomotor Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01581)
*Jinhao Zhang,Zhexuan Zhou,Huizhe Li,Yichen Lai,Wenlong Xia,Haoming Song,Youmin Gong,Jie Mei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文从频域角度分析了扩散策略在机器人操作中的效率问题，发现动作轨迹低频主导的特性使得去噪在少量步骤后饱和，据此提出超轻量级3D扩散策略Hyper-DP3（HDP3），采用仅需两步DDIM推理的轻量Diffusion Mixer解码器，在保持SOTA性能的同时参数量不足先前3D扩散策略的1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于扩散的视觉运动策略继承了图像生成领域的解码器和多步采样范式，计算开销大。作者从频域角度重新审视这一设计，希望通过利用机器人动作轨迹的低频特性来大幅简化扩散模型。

Method: 提出Hyper-DP3（HDP3），核心是轻量级的Diffusion Mixer解码器，支持两步DDIM（去噪扩散隐式模型）推理。理论贡献是证明了最优去噪器的误差受低频子空间维度和残余高频能量约束，因此去噪误差在极少量反向步骤后即饱和。

Result: 在RoboTwin2.0、Adroit、MetaWorld和真实世界任务中，HDP3以不足先前3D扩散策略1%的参数实现了SOTA性能，并显著降低了推理延迟。合成实验验证了理论预测，证明两步去噪的充分性。

Conclusion: 机器人动作轨迹的平滑性（低频主导）使得扩散去噪可以大幅简化，仅需两步反向采样即可达到充足的去噪效果，为设计高效轻量的机器人操作策略提供了新方向。

Abstract: Diffusion-based visuomotor policies perform well in robotic manipulation, yet current methods still inherit image-generation-style decoders and multi-step sampling. We revisit this design from a frequency-domain perspective. Robot action trajectories are highly smooth, with most energy concentrated in a few low-frequency discrete cosine transform modes. Under this structure, we show that the error of the optimal denoiser is bounded by the low-frequency subspace dimension and residual high-frequency energy, implying that denoising error saturates after very few reverse steps. This also suggests that action denoising requires a much simpler denoising model than image generation. Motivated by this insight, we propose Hyper-DP3 (HDP3), a pocket-scale 3D diffusion policy with a lightweight Diffusion Mixer decoder that supports two-step DDIM inference. Our synthetic experiments validate the theory and support the sufficiency of two-step denoising. Futhermore, across RoboTwin2.0, Adroit, MetaWorld, and real-world tasks, HDP3 achieves state-of-the-art performance with fewer than 1% of the parameters of prior 3D diffusion-based policies and substantially lower inference latency.

</details>


### [237] [Multi-Robot Box Transport over Different Surfaces with Decentralized Role-based Proportional Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26430)
*Aditya Bhatt,Himavarshini Yarragangu,Urvish Shah,Venkata Sai Yaswanth Mohan Thota,Souma Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为R2P2的异步分散式任务与运动规划方法，用于多机器人协作推运物体。该方法通过角色分配（推、支撑、阻止）和规则/比例控制实现不同倾斜度和摩擦系数的地面上的箱子运输，在六机器人仿真和四机器人实物实验中均表现出优于传统虚拟领航-跟随方法的成功率和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人协作推运物体在建筑、仓储、灾后清理等场景有广泛应用，但不同倾斜度和摩擦系数的地面给协作运输带来了独特挑战，需要一种能应对这些挑战的分散式方法。

Method: 提出R2P2（Roles with Rules and Proportional-control Primitive）方法：首先基于对操作模式（箱子旋转vs平移）的感知，通过规则为机器人分配角色（推、支撑、阻止）；然后根据角色采用基于规则的控制或比例速度控制。每个机器人仅需观测自身和箱子的位置与朝向，实现异步分散式决策。

Result: 在六机器人NVIDIA IsaacSim仿真环境中验证了R2P2在不同地面摩擦/倾斜度和箱子质量场景下的泛化能力，成功率优于标准虚拟领航-跟随方法；并在四台TurtleBot搬运1.2kg箱子的实物实验中成功验证。

Conclusion: R2P2通过异步分散式的角色分配与控制策略，有效解决了多机器人在复杂地形上的协作推运问题，降低了通信、同步和共识需求，消除了单点故障风险，具有较好的可扩展性和实用性。

Abstract: Collaborative transport of objects via pushing by multiple robots has many applications, ranging from construction and warehouse environments to post disaster debris clean-up. Achieving collaborative transport over surfaces with different inclination and friction properties however poses unique challenges. To address these challenges, this paper presents an asynchronous decentralized task and motion planning approach for transporting rectangular boxes of varying mass over flat, uphill and downhill terrain. Such a decentralized approach alleviates communication, synchronization and consensus needs and mitigates single point of failure issues. Our approach, called R2P2 or Roles with Rules and Proportional-control Primitive, assigns roles (e.g., push, support and prevent) to robots based on rules cognizant of the mode of manipulation needed (box rotation vs translation); this is followed by either rule-based control or proportional control of robot velocity based on the roles. Each robot is assumed to observe the location and heading of self and the box in executing the role and controls. R2P2 is evaluated with a six-robot team deployed in a simulator built using NVIDIA IsaacSim -- demonstrating generalizability across different surface friction/inclination and box mass scenarios, and better success rate compared to a standard virtual-leader-follower method. R2P2 is also successfully validated with a physical experiment, where it is executed onboard four turtlebots tasked with moving a 1.2 kg box.

</details>


### [238] [VR-DAgger: Immersive VR for Dexterous Data Collection and Uncertainty-Guided On-Policy Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27114)
*René Zurbrügg,Tifanny Portela,Arjun Bhardwaj,Aravind Elanjimattathil Vijayan,Maximum Wilder-Smith,Marco Hutter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VR-DAgger是一个基于VR的人机交互框架，通过蒙特卡洛dropout不确定性估计选择高信息量的失败片段进行选择性纠正，在灵巧操作任务上相比行为克隆提升最多23个百分点，并将数据收集时间减少约40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从示教学习在机器人操作中效果显著，但收集足够任务特定数据仍是主要瓶颈。在分布偏移下，小误差会累积导致性能下降，专家时间常浪费在冗余低价值的纠正上，而非关键的失败案例。

Method: 提出VR-DAgger框架：1) 利用VR应用进行灵巧遥操作、示教收集和选择性策略纠正；2) 在Isaac Lab中使用蒙特卡洛(MC)dropout对扩散策略的 rollout 进行不确定性评分，选择信息量大的失败片段；3) 在VR中回放这些片段，操作员选择性标记和纠正策略行为，将监督集中在不确定性最高的区域。

Result: 在三个灵巧操作任务（Pan取放、抽屉打开、阀门转动）上使用10-DoF XHand进行评估，主动标注在所有任务上均优于行为克隆，最高提升23个百分点。相比无引导的人机循环检查，VR-DAgger通过聚焦于选定片段而非完整rollout，将每样本收集时间减少约40%。

Conclusion: VR-DAgger通过不确定性引导的主动学习策略，在不需完整rollout监控或单独干预分类器的情况下，有效提升了策略性能并显著降低了数据收集成本。

Abstract: Learning from demonstrations is effective for robotic manipulation, but collecting sufficient task-specific data remains a major bottleneck. Under distribution shift, small errors compound, performance degrades, and expert time is often spent on redundant, low-value corrections instead of the few critical failure cases. We present VR-DAgger, a human-in-the-loop framework centered on an immersive VR application for dexterous teleoperation, demonstration collection, and selective policy correction. The VR client provides intuitive hand control with synchronized scene visualization, while a backend workstation runs simulation and learning, enabling autonomous rollouts without continuous operator oversight. We use Monte Carlo (MC) dropout to score uncertainty during Isaac Lab rollouts of a diffusion policy and select informative failure segments for correction. These segments are replayed in VR as clips, where the operator selectively labels and corrects the policy's behavior, concentrating supervision where uncertainty is highest without full-rollout monitoring or a separate intervention classifier. We evaluate on three dexterous manipulation tasks (Pan pick-and-place, Drawer opening, Valve turning) with a 10-DoF XHand under standard and challenging initial configurations. Active labeling consistently improves over behavioral cloning across all tasks, with gains of up to 23 percentage points. Compared to unguided human-in-the-loop inspection, VR-DAgger reduces per-sample collection time by approximately 40% by focusing review on selected segments rather than full rollouts.

</details>


### [239] [UniLab: A Heterogeneous Architecture for Robot RL Beyond GPU-Dominant Paradigms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30313)
*Yufei Jia,Zhanxiang Cao,Mingrui Yu,Heng Zhang,Shenyu Chen,Dixuan Jiang,Meng Li,Xiaofan Li,Yiyang Liu,Junzhe Wu,Zheng Li,XiLin Fang,Tingyu Cui,Shengcheng Fu,Haoyang Li,Anqi Wang,Zifan Wang,Dongjie Zhu,Chenyu Cao,Zhenbiao Huang,Ziang Zheng,Jie Lu,Xin Ma,Zhengyang Wei,Xiang Zhao,Tianyue Zhan,Ye He,Yuxiang Chen,Yizhou Jiang,Yue Li,Haizhou Ge,Yuhang Dong,Fan Jia,Ziheng Zhang,Meng Zhang,Xiwa Deng,Zhixing Chen,Hanyang Shao,Chenxin Dong,Yixuan Li,Yizhi Chen,Bokui Chen,Kaifeng Zhang,Hanqing Cui,Yusen Qin,Ruqi Huang,Lei Han,Tiancai Wang,Xiang Li,Yue Gao,Guyue Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: UniLab是一种异构CPU仿真/GPU学习架构，通过统一运行时解耦CPU并行仿真与GPU策略更新，在相同硬件配置下实现3-10倍的端到端训练效率提升，并支持跨平台执行，证明了GPU仿真并非高效训练的必要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于仿真的机器人强化学习默认假设高效训练需要将物理引擎置于GPU上，但这种GPU中心化范式限制了系统选择并增加了对NVIDIA CUDA软件栈的依赖。作者希望重新审视这一假设，探索CPU仿真在高效机器人RL训练中的可行性。

Method: UniLab采用异构CPU仿真/GPU学习架构，通过统一运行时实现数据移动、缓冲和同步的解耦。系统使用MuJoCoUni和MotrixSim作为CPU批量物理后端，支持PPO、FastSAC、FlashSAC和APPO等多种强化学习算法。

Result: 在代表性仿真机器人控制任务上，UniLab在相同硬件配置下实现3-10倍端到端训练效率提升，降低了对NVIDIA CUDA软件栈的依赖，并支持Apple macOS平台以及AMD ROCm和Intel XPU加速后端上的跨平台执行。

Conclusion: GPU仿真是实现高效训练的有效途径，但并非必要途径。UniLab拓宽了机器人强化学习训练的实际系统选择范围。

Abstract: Simulation-based RL for contemporary robot control is increasingly organized around GPU-resident simulation: physics, rollout collection, and learning are placed on a single GPU-centric execution path. This paradigm has greatly improved training speed, but it has also encouraged a default assumption that efficient training requires physics to reside on the GPU. We revisit this assumption. Our view is that, in simulation-dominated robot control, the essential question is not which processor runs physics, but whether simulation throughput, policy learning, and runtime synchronization form an efficient end-to-end loop. We present UniLab, a heterogeneous CPU-simulation / GPU-learning architecture that decouples CPU-parallel simulation from GPU policy updates through a unified runtime for data movement, buffering, and synchronization. UniLab is implemented as a complete and extensible training system using MuJoCoUni and MotrixSim CPU-batched physics backends, supporting PPO, FastSAC, FlashSAC, and APPO. On representative simulation-based robot control tasks, UniLab improves end-to-end training efficiency by 3--10$\times$ under the same hardware configuration, while reducing dependence on the NVIDIA CUDA-based software stack and supporting cross-platform execution on the Apple macOS platform and the AMD ROCm and Intel XPU accelerator backends. These results show that GPU simulation is an effective path to efficient training, but not a necessary one, broadening the practical system choices available for robot RL training. Project page: https://unilabsim.github.io.

</details>


### [240] [LiftNav: Path Planning via Semantic Lifting in TSDF-Guided Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31376)
*Hannah Schieber,Dominik Frischmann,Victor Schaack,Angela P. Schoellig,Daniel Roth*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LiftNav 提出了一种混合导航框架，结合 GSFusion 的 TSDF+GS 双地图、YOLO 实时检测、TSDF 3D 提升和 B 样条轨迹优化，在 Replica 数据集仿真中实现了 100% 可行率和更短轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法中，TSDF 等经典表示支持安全规划但缺乏语义，而 Gaussian Splatting 等逼真方法外观丰富但几何不精确，难以实现精准避障。需要一种兼顾几何精度与语义理解的导航框架。

Method: 基于 GSFusion 的 TSDF+GS 双地图表示，结合 YOLO 实时目标检测、TSDF 3D 提升和 B 样条轨迹优化，并引入基于铰链损失的碰撞惩罚函数以提升轨迹平滑性与安全性。

Result: 在 Replica 数据集仿真中，与最先进的辐射场基线相比，LiftNav 实现了 100% 的可行率，且轨迹更短。

Conclusion: LiftNav 有效融合了几何与语义信息，在无需密集 3D 嵌入的情况下实现了灵活、安全且高效的语义导航。

Abstract: Autonomous robots in unknown indoor environments require both reliable collision avoidance and object-level understanding. Classical representations such as TSDF support safe planning but lack semantics, while photorealistic methods like Gaussian Splatting (GS) provide rich appearance yet suffer from soft geometry, limiting precise obstacle avoidance. We present LiftNav, a hybrid navigation framework built on GSFusion's TSDF+GS dual map, augmented with a real-time pipeline of YOLO-based detection, TSDF-based 3D lifting, and B-spline trajectory optimization. This design enables flexible semantic navigation without dense 3D embeddings. We further introduce a hinge-loss-based collision penalty that improves trajectory smoothness and safety. We evaluate our approach in a simulation using the Replica dataset. Compared against a state-of-the-art radiance field baseline we show a 100% feasibility rate and shorter trajectories.

</details>


### [241] [Don't Fool Me Twice: Adapting to Adversity in the Wild with Experience-Driven Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31119)
*Navin Sriram Ravie,Andrew Jong,Krrish Jain,John Liu,Omar Alama,Bijo Sebastian,Sebastian Scherer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"Don't Fool Me Twice"框架，使移动机器人在未知非结构化环境中通过持续学习在线从干扰中学习，利用语义属性将异常行为归因于原因，实现更好的预测和规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在未知非结构化环境中，机器人难以预测所有特定于自身形态的危险，现有VLM方法虽能预测常识性危险，但无法捕捉交互依赖和形态依赖的对抗情况。

Method: 1) 观察干扰并描述其对机器人的影响；2) 结合视觉上下文查询VLM预测可能原因；3) 使用核回归对局部干扰进行高效少样本建模；4) 利用语义体素中心建模估计认知不确定性，将交互驱动的干扰视为可学习的空间行为。

Result: 在仿真和硬件上跨多种机器形态和对抗模式验证了四个假设的有效性。

Conclusion: 该持续学习框架使机器人能够在线学习形态依赖的干扰，通过语义归因和不确定性建模提升对未来世界的预测与规划能力。

Abstract: In robotics, dangers and adversity modes are often embodiment-specific and relative to each agent. A frontier of autonomous mobile robotics is to enable agents to operate effectively in the wild in unseen unstructured environments. A significant challenge in unseen unstructured environments is that it may not be possible to predict all the dangers to the specific robot. Although recent work has used large foundation vision-language models (VLMs) to preemptively predict an exhaustive list of common-sense dangers, it remains difficult to capture possible interaction and embodiment-dependent adversities. We propose a continual learning framework for a mobile embodied agent to learn online from disturbances and attribute anomalous behaviours to causes through semantics, enabling better prediction and planning of the world in the future. Our framework, "Don't Fool Me Twice", first observes disturbances and describes their effects on the robot; this description is augmented with visual context to query a VLM to predict possible causes; the local disturbance is characterized using kernel regression, which allows for efficient, few-shot modeling of transient anomalies. We leverage semantic voxel-centric modeling to estimate epistemic uncertainty, enabling richer downstream recovery by treating interaction-driven disturbances as learnable spatial behaviors. We present four hypotheses and validate them in simulation and on hardware across embodiments and adversity modes.

</details>


### [242] [Self-Supervised Online Robot-Agnostic Traversability Estimation for Open-World Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28442)
*Julia Hindel,Simon Bultmann,Houman Masnavi,Daniele Cattaneo,Abhinav Valada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: COTRATE是一个面向多模态无标签机器人经验的在线持续可穿越性估计学习框架，通过机器人无关的在线地形评估模块生成鲁棒的可穿越性分数，并利用新颖的对齐损失监督视觉可穿越性网络，结合多样性感知特征选择策略实现轻量级持续学习，在11种户外地形数据集上验证了其跨平台迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖手工设计的本体感受可穿越性分数（限制机器人无关性），要么对先验数据进行聚类（阻碍在线学习），且许多持续学习方法计算和存储成本过高，难以部署在机载平台。

Method: 提出COTRATE框架：1）基于学习的机器人无关在线地形评估模块（利用本体感受和惯性信号）推断鲁棒可穿越性分数；2）通过新颖的对齐损失将视觉嵌入与在线地形评估相关联；3）多样性感知特征选择策略，使用紧凑回放记忆缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在两个机器人平台、11种户外地形上收集约50,000张图像的数据集上进行评估，并在三个代表性户外环境中对导航任务进行基准测试，展示了跨不同运动学机器人的知识迁移能力。

Conclusion: COTRATE实现了机器人无关的在线持续可穿越性学习，支持跨平台知识迁移，且内存和计算开销低，适合机载部署。

Abstract: Self-supervised online traversability estimation enables robots to continuously learn from unlabeled open-world experiences and adapt their navigation behavior toward safe and efficient trajectories. Existing approaches either rely on handcrafted proprioceptive traversability scores, limiting robot-agnosticism, or cluster prior data, preventing online learning. Moreover, many continual learning methods incur substantial memory and computational costs, hindering onboard deployment. We introduce COTRATE, an online learning framework for continuous traversability estimation from multimodal, unlabeled robot experience. Our method first infers robust traversability scores using a robot-agnostic, learning-based online terrain assessment module operating on proprioceptiveand inertial signals. These scores then supervise a visual traversability network through a novel alignment loss that associates visual embeddings with online terrain assessments. To mitigate forgetting during continual learning with minimal overhead, we propose a diversity-aware feature selection strategythat preserves performance using a compact replay memory. We further show that the learned traversability representation supports knowledge transfer across different robot platforms with different locomotion kinematics. We evaluate COTRATE on a dataset of $\approx$ 50,000 images collected with two robotic platforms across 11 outdoor terrains, and benchmark it on navigation tasks in three representative outdoor environments. We make the dataset, code, and trained models publicly available.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [243] [QASM-Eval: A Dataset to Train and Evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3 Beyond Quantum Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30358)
*Zhenxiao Fu,Lei Jiang,Fan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QASM-Eval是首个专门为OpenQASM-3设计的硬件面向编程数据集，包含100个专家验证的测试任务和4000个训练任务，覆盖经典逻辑、时序调度、脉冲控制和复杂工作流。评估显示现有LLM在OpenQASM-3编码任务上表现困难，针对QASM-Eval的微调能显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型在代码生成方面进展迅速，但缺乏专门针对OpenQASM-3程序（特别是涉及硬件面向特性的程序）进行训练和评估的数据集，这限制了LLM在NISQ时代量子编程中的应用。

Method: 构建了一个包含专家验证的100个测试任务和4000个训练任务的综合数据集，系统覆盖经典逻辑、时序调度、脉冲控制和真实工作流。使用扩展验证器自动检查语法、量子态和程序时间线。

Result: 现有最先进的LLM在OpenQASM-3编码任务上表现严重不足，但通过在QASM-Eval上进行针对性微调，可以获得显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: QASM-Eval为加速开发可靠的LLM助手（用于NISQ时代硬件面向的量子编程）提供了关键的基准测试和训练基础。

Abstract: Quantum computing remains in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, where the performance is highly constrained to noise. Addressing the limitation often requires hardware-facing capabilities beyond gate-sequence circuit specification, including mid-circuit measurement and classical feedback for quantum error correction (QEC), precise timing control for dynamical decoupling (DD), and pulse-level waveform access for calibration. OpenQASM-3 was introduced to expose exactly these capabilities, providing a hardware-level programming interface. However, despite the rapid progress of large language models in code generation, there is still no dataset specifically designed to train and evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3 programs that involve its advanced hardware-oriented features. To address this gap, we introduce QASM-Eval, the first comprehensive dataset designed to train and evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3. Rather than focusing on quantum algorithm design or reasoning, QASM-Eval explicitly targets the language's hardware-facing features. QASM-Eval comprises an expert-verified test set of 100 tasks and a training set of 4,000 tasks, systematically covering classical logic, timing scheduling, pulse control, and complex real-world workflows. To automatically validate generated programs, we check syntax, quantum states and program timeline using an extended verifier. Our evaluation reveals that while state-of-the-art LLMs struggle heavily in OpenQASM-3 coding tasks, targeted fine-tuning on QASM-Eval yields significant gains. QASM-Eval provides a crucial benchmark and training foundation to accelerate the development of reliable LLM assistants for hardware-facing quantum programming in NISQ era. Data and code: https://github.com/fuzhenxiao/QASM-Eval

</details>


### [244] [Gait2Hip-60: A Unified Deep Learning Benchmark for Predicting Hip Muscle Forces and Joint Moments from Multi-Cadence Gait Kinematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30374)
*Jiaqi Zhang,Ji Hou,Qing Sun,Xianzhi Gao,Bo Huo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一个深度学习框架，直接从下肢步态运动学预测髋关节肌肉力和关节力矩，比较了LSTM、Transformer和Mamba三种序列模型。在60名健康成人数据上，Transformer在髋部肌力预测（R²=0.819）和力矩预测（R²=0.862）上表现最佳；在9名股骨头坏死患者的零样本外部验证中，Transformer保留了中等预测能力（肌力R²=0.537，力矩R²=0.569）。结果表明从步态运动学估计髋关节动力学是可行的，Transformer可作为强基线模型，但临床应用前需要更广泛的病理验证和改进泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肌肉骨骼仿真虽能估计髋部肌力和关节力矩，但耗时长、难以在临床场景中应用，亟需一种高效便捷的替代方法来直接从步态运动学数据预测髋关节动力学参数。

Method: 收集60名健康成年人在三种节拍器引导步频下的步态数据，以10个双侧下肢关节角度为输入，OpenSim导出的髋部肌力和关节力矩为标签，在统一预处理和评估协议下训练LSTM、Transformer和Mamba三种深度学习模型，并在9名股骨头坏死（ONFH）患者上进行零样本外部验证。

Result: 健康受试者中Transformer最优：肌力预测RMSE=1.33 N/kg, MAE=0.57 N/kg, R²=0.819；力矩预测RMSE=0.11 Nm/kg, MAE=0.07 Nm/kg, R²=0.862。外部零样本验证中Transformer仍具中等预测能力：肌力R²=0.537，力矩R²=0.569。

Conclusion: 从步态运动学直接估计髋关节动力学是可行的，Transformer可作为该任务的强基线模型；但模型在病理人群中的泛化能力有限，需在更广泛的病理数据上验证和改进后才能应用于临床。

Abstract: Estimating hip muscle forces and joint moments during gait typically relies on musculoskeletal simulation, which is informative but time-consuming and difficult to apply in clinical settings. This study developed a deep learning framework to predict these hip dynamics parameters directly from lower-limb gait kinematics and compared three representative sequence models under a unified protocol. Gait data were collected from 60 healthy adults under three metronome-guided cadence conditions. Ten bilateral lower-limb joint angles were used as inputs, and OpenSim-derived hip muscle forces and hip joint moments were used as reference outputs. Three deep learning models of LSTM, Transformer, and Mamba were trained and evaluated using the same subject-level split, preprocessing pipeline, and metrics. The best model was then directly tested on an external cohort of 9 patients with osteonecrosis of the femoral head (ONFH) without retraining. In the healthy-subject benchmark, Transformer achieved the best subject-level mean performance for both hip muscle force prediction (RMSE = 1.33 N/kg, MAE = 0.57 N/kg, R2 = 0.819) and hip joint moment prediction (RMSE = 0.11 Nm/kg, MAE = 0.07 Nm/kg, R2 = 0.862), with similar advantages across walking cadences. In zero-shot external validation, Transformer retained moderate predictive ability in ONFH for hip muscle force prediction (RMSE = 1.51 N/kg, MAE = 0.70 N/kg, R2 = 0.537) and hip joint moment prediction (RMSE = 0.17 Nm/kg, MAE = 0.12 Nm/kg, R2 = 0.569). These findings support the feasibility of estimating hip dynamics from gait kinematics, identify Transformer as a strong baseline, and highlight the need for broader pathological validation and improved generalization before clinical application.

</details>


### [245] [Supervised Training Rapidly Degrades Early Visual Cortex Alignment Across Biologically Plausible Learning Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30556)
*Nils Leutenegger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 未训练的随机神经网络在表征相似性上始终与早期视觉皮层匹配甚至超越训练过的网络。本文追溯四种学习规则（BP、FA、PC、STDP）训练过程中的RSA对齐变化，发现：1）单轮训练使V1对齐下降25-90%；2）BP下降最严重（Δr=-0.080），PC和STDP保留更多（Δr≈-0.04）；3）LOC区域出现相反趋势。结果表明未训练架构通过归纳偏置捕获低级视觉统计，全局误差信号（BP）比局部学习规则（PC、STDP）更激进地重塑早期表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究为何随机未训练神经网络在表征相似性上能与训练网络相当甚至更好，挑战了"学习提升大脑对齐"的传统假设。

Method: 使用720张THINGS数据库图像和三名人脑fMRI数据，在六个视觉ROI上，对比BP、FA、PC、STDP四种学习规则在8个训练检查点（epoch 0-40）的模型-大脑表征相异矩阵的Spearman相关性。

Result: 1）单轮训练使V1对齐下降25-90%；2）BP导致V1对齐下降最严重（Δr=-0.080），PC和STDP保留更多（Δr≈-0.04）；3）LOC区域BP对齐上升最大但绝对值小。

Conclusion: 未训练架构通过归纳偏置捕获低层视觉统计特征；全局误差信号（BP）比局部学习规则（PC、STDP）更激进地重塑早期表征，降低与大脑的相似性。

Abstract: Random, untrained neural networks consistently match or exceed trained networks in representational similarity to early visual cortex. This puzzling finding challenges the assumption that learning improves brain alignment. We investigate it by tracking representational similarity analysis (RSA) alignment to human fMRI data across training for four learning rules: backpropagation (BP), feedback alignment (FA), predictive coding (PC), and spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP). Using 720 object images from the THINGS database and fMRI data from three subjects across six visual ROIs, we measure Spearman correlations between model and brain representational dissimilarity matrices at eight training checkpoints (epochs 0-40). We find that (1) a single epoch of training reduces V1 alignment by 25-90%, depending on the learning rule; (2) backpropagation reduces V1 alignment most severely (delta r = -0.080), while predictive coding and STDP preserve substantially more (delta r ~ -0.04); and (3) a weaker, opposite tendency appears in object-selective cortex (LOC), where BP shows the largest increase in alignment during training, although the absolute change is small. These results suggest that untrained architectures capture low-level visual statistics through inductive biases alone, and that global error signals (BP) reshape early representations more aggressively than local learning rules (PC, STDP), which better preserve brain-like structure.

</details>


### [246] [When LLMs Learn to Be Consistently Wrong: A Multi-Model Study of Linear Representations of Synthetic Deception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30381)
*Vahideh Zolfaghari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过LoRA微调五种Transformer模型（Pythia-1.4B, Gemma-2-2B/9B, Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B），发现线性探针可在早期层（1-3层）以近完美AUC（≥0.99）检测合成欺骗，支持线性表征假说；机制分析揭示两种表征模式：Pythia/Llama/Qwen的表征坍塌与Gemma-2的高维保持，且欺骗方向在深层逐渐巩固。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欺骗性对齐（模型保持准确内部表征但故意输出错误结果）是AI安全的核心挑战。由于策略性欺骗难以直接研究，本文通过直接优化错误答案诱导的合成欺骗作为可控实验平台，探究学习型欺骗的表征基础。

Method: 采用多模型范式，对五种Transformer模型使用LoRA进行诚实/欺骗变体的微调；训练线性探针和MLP探针检测均池化隐藏状态；进行机制分析（Fisher判别比、有效秩、质心几何、方向稳定性、跨域对齐、ECE校正）。

Result: 线性探针在四种架构的1-3层达到AUC≥0.99（Pythia-1.4B峰值为0.705）；TruthfulQA探针泛化至MMLU近乎零损失（ΔAUC≈0）；深层表征对高斯噪声鲁棒，Gemma-2稳定性极佳；揭示两种表征机制：Pythia/Llama/Qwen的表征坍塌与Gemma-2的高维保持。

Conclusion: 稳健且域不变的欺骗表征可通过适度的监督微调快速固化，对基于激活的监控方法具有重要启示；最佳ECE校准（除Pythia外<0.01）可在1-4层实现，为早期检测提供可能。

Abstract: Deceptive alignment, in which models maintain accurate internal representations while deliberately producing false outputs, remains a central challenge in AI safety. While strategic deception is the primary long-term concern, synthetic dishonesty - induced via direct optimization on incorrect answers - provides a controlled testbed for studying the representational basis of learned deception. We introduce a multi-model paradigm in which honest and deceptive variants of five transformer models (Pythia-1.4B, Gemma-2-2B/9B, Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B) are fine-tuned using LoRA on the same question distribution. Linear probes trained on mean-pooled hidden states detect synthetic dishonesty with near-perfect AUC (greater than or equal to 0.99) as early as layers 1-3 in four architectures, while Pythia-1.4B reaches a peak of 0.705. Logistic regression probes consistently match or outperform MLP probes, supporting the Linear Representation Hypothesis. Probes trained on TruthfulQA generalize with near-zero loss (Delta AUC approx. 0) to held-out MMLU subjects. Late-layer representations show strong robustness to Gaussian noise, with Gemma-2 models exhibiting exceptional stability. Mechanistic analysis of Fisher Discriminant Ratio, effective rank, centroid geometry, directional stability, cross-domain alignment, and calibration (ECE) reveals two regimes: representational collapse in Pythia/Llama/Qwen versus high-dimensional preservation in Gemma-2. Across all models, the dishonesty direction consolidates progressively in deeper layers, with optimal calibration (ECE less than 0.01 except Pythia) achievable in layers 1-4. These results demonstrate that robust, domain-invariant dishonesty representations can be rapidly entrenched via modest supervised fine-tuning, with implications for activation-based monitoring.

</details>


### [247] [LLMs Without Deep Neural Networks: New Architecture, Benefits and Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30385)
*Vincent Granville*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种替代传统深度神经网络（DNN）的新模型，该模型基于RBF网络机制，但无需迭代训练即可通过闭式解找到损失函数的全局最优解，从而消除繁琐的训练步骤。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为作者独立发现的深度神经网络替代方案提供验证，该方案在LLM背景下具有更高的可解释性和准确性，同时解决传统DNN训练耗时长的问题。

Method: 提出一种基于RBF网络机制的新型模型，该模型能够通过闭式解在一次迭代中找到损失函数的全局最优解，无需像标准DNN那样进行繁琐的迭代训练。

Result: 新模型在不需要深度神经网络结构的情况下，通过闭式解实现全局最优，消除了训练步骤，并提供了案例研究和与类似方法的比较。

Conclusion: 该模型作为传统DNN的有效替代方案，兼具高可解释性和准确性，且训练效率显著提升，在LLM领域具有潜在应用价值。

Abstract: The purpose of this article is to provide validation to my deep neural network alternative in the context of LLMs. Very recently, there has been a significant interest by Chinese researchers in a model called RBF network, as a substitute to standard DNNs, with increased explainability and higher accuracy. It turns out that my new model, discovered independently, is based on the exact same machinery. But with a major twist: it does not need DNN as it finds the global optimum of the loss function in closed form, in one iteration, thus eliminating the tedious training step. Here I provide a high-level overview of my technology, with case study and comparison to similar methods.

</details>


### [248] [Functional MRI Time Series Generation via Wavelet-Based Image Transform and Spectral Flow Matching for Brain Disorder Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30387)
*Hwa Hui Tew,Junn Yong Loo,Fang Yu Leong,Julia K. Lau,Ding Fan,Hernando Ombao,Raphaël C. -W. Phan,Chee Pin Tan,Chee-Ming Ting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DSFM（双频谱流匹配）框架，通过离散小波变换（DWT）和离散余弦变换（DCT）对fMRI BOLD信号进行双频域表示，再利用频谱流匹配生成类条件余弦频率表示，最后通过逆变换重建生理上可信的时域BOLD信号，在下游脑网络分类任务中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fMRI数据获取成本高、样本有限，现有生成模型难以捕捉BOLD信号固有的非平稳性、复杂的时空动态及生理变异性。

Method: 1) 利用DWT将BOLD信号转化为小波分解图，捕获全局瞬态和多尺度变化；2) 将信号投影到DCT空间，利用低频主导BOLD系数的局部能量压缩特性；3) 训练频谱流匹配模型生成类条件余弦频率表示；4) 通过逆DCT和逆DWT重建时域BOLD信号。

Result: 通过改进的下游fMRI脑网络分类任务证明了生成数据的有效性。

Conclusion: 双变换方法能够施加结构化频率先验，保留关键的生理脑动态，生成生理上可信的BOLD信号。

Abstract: Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) provides non-invasive access to dynamic brain activity by measuring blood oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) signals over time. However, the resource-intensive nature of fMRI acquisition limits the availability of high-fidelity samples required for data-driven brain analysis models. While modern generative models can synthesize fMRI data, they often remain challenging in replicating their inherent non-stationarity, intricate spatiotemporal dynamics, and physiological variations of raw BOLD signals. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Spectral Flow Matching (DSFM), a novel fMRI generative framework that cascades dual frequency representation of BOLD signals with spectral flow matching. Specifically, our framework first converts BOLD signals into a wavelet decomposition map via a discrete wavelet transform (DWT) to capture globalized transient and multi-scale variations, and projects into the discrete cosine transform (DCT) space across brain regions and time to exploit localized energy compaction of low-frequency dominant BOLD coefficients. Subsequently, a spectral flow matching model is trained to generate class-conditioned cosine-frequency representation. The generated samples are reconstructed through inverse DCT and inverse DWT operations to recover physiologically plausible time-domain BOLD signals. This dual-transform approach imposes structured frequency priors and preserves key physiological brain dynamics. Ultimately, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach through improved downstream fMRI-based brain network classification. The code is available at https://github.com/htew0001/DSFM.git .

</details>


### [249] [A Novel Evaluation Metric for Unsupervised Learning in AIS-Based Maritime Anomaly Detection: MADQI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30388)
*Ismet Gocer,Zakirul Bhuiyan,Raza Hasan,Shakeel Ahmad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于MADQI质量指标的无监督评估框架，用于检测海事AIS数据中的异常（速度、位置跳跃、时间间隔、转向角等），无需标注数据。该框架通过ARC、PPS、SDS和ECE四个子指标结合多块评估和自适应缩放技术实现自动化评估，在AIS数据集上取得了80.37%的MADQI得分，其中ECE和ARC分别达到0.907和1.000。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督学习算法（如Isolation Forest）虽广泛用于船舶异常行为检测，但缺乏系统且有意义的评估指标，导致无法有效衡量无监督异常检测的性能。

Method: 提出MADQI复合质量指标，集成四个子指标（ARC、PPS、SDS、ECE），通过多块评估和自适应缩放技术实现自动归一化，结合Haversine距离计算分析AIS数据的空间和行为特征。

Result: MADQI总分为80.37%，ECE得分0.907，ARC得分1.000，表明该方法在检测极端异常和维持异常率一致性方面表现优异。

Conclusion: 该框架为无监督海事AIS异常检测提供了可靠且有意义的评估方法，无需标注数据即可有效评价检测性能。

Abstract: This paper introduces a new systematic framework for detecting anomalies in maritime Automatic Identification System (AIS) datasets. These anomalies include abnormal vessel behaviours related to speed, position jumps, time gaps, and turn angles. Although unsupervised learning algorithms such as Isolation Forest are widely used for detecting anomalous vessel movements, they often lack systematic and meaningful evaluation measures. To address this limitation, we propose a novel quality metric called Maritime Anomaly Detection Quality Index (MADQI). The prosed MADQI is a composite index designed to evaluate the anomaly detection performance of machine learning models without requiring labelled data. The proposed framework uses Haversine distance calculations to analyse AIS datasets and identify anomalies based on their spatial and behavioural characteristics. The proposed MADQI evaluation framework integrates four interconnected metrics: Anomaly Rate Consistency (ARC), Physical Plausibility Score (PPS), Score Distribution Separation (SDS), and Extreme Case Evidence (ECE). These metrics are combined through automatic normalisation using multi-chunk evaluation and adaptive scaling techniques. Experimental results on the AIS dataset show that the proposed framework achieved a MADQI score of 80.37%, demonstrating its effectiveness for unsupervised anomaly detection. In particular, the algorithm performed strongly in identifying abnormal vessel behaviour. Among the individual MADQI components, ECE and ARC achieved scores of 0.907 and 1.000, respectively, indicating excellent capability in detecting extreme anomalies and maintaining anomaly rate consistency. Overall, these results are encouraging and demonstrate that the proposed framework provides a reliable and meaningful approach for evaluating unsupervised anomaly detection in maritime AIS data.

</details>


### [250] [NumLeak: Public Numeric Benchmarks as Latent Labels in Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30393)
*Anany Kotawala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NumLeak框架，发现顶级前沿LLM在公共数字基准测试中存在记忆召回（memorized recall）而非真实样本外技能的问题。通过API边界探针和白盒验证，模型对Fama-French市场超额收益等金融经济指标的回忆准确率极高（r=0.97-0.99），但在最新保留集上解析率暴跌至21-57%，表明存在"拒绝-召回"不对称性。白盒实验复现了剂量反应，logprob排名能检测到开放式生成无法发现的记忆化。一种单行系统提示防御可阻断99.8%的非自适应单轮后缀攻击，且对概念性和历史叙事查询的效用成本近乎为零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于日期的评估可能因公共数字基准出现在预训练数据中而测量的是记忆召回而非真实样本外技能，需要新的框架来量化这一记忆化通道的规模。

Method: 提出NumLeak测量框架，结合API边界探针（在闭源生产模型上）和白盒控制验证（在开源因果语言模型上），通过数值回忆准确率、解析率、logprob排名等多维度指标检测记忆化。

Result: 顶级模型对Fama-French市场超额收益回忆r=0.97-0.99，对五个兄弟因子误差在25bps内；对失业率、CPI通胀、NOAA温度也有类似精度。最新保留集上解析率降至21-57%，但回答的月份r≈0.99。白盒实验复现剂量反应，logprob排名检测到开放式生成遗漏的记忆化。Sonnet的"日期到市场情绪"回归与真实Mkt-RF的r=0.74降至r=0.02（残差化后）。单行系统提示防御阻断99.8%攻击。

Conclusion: 闭源API黑盒探针低估了记忆化通道的规模；记忆化可以通过logprob排名等方法更有效地检测；简单的系统提示防御可以有效阻断数值记忆提取攻击，且不损害模型在概念性和历史叙事任务上的表现。

Abstract: Public numeric benchmarks appear in pretraining, so an evaluation that conditions on a date may be measuring memorized recall rather than out-of-sample skill. We introduce NumLeak, a measurement framework that combines API-boundary probes on production models with a white-box controlled validation on an open causal LM. Top-tier frontier LLMs recall the Fama-French market excess return at 3-seed pooled Pearson r=0.97-0.99 while staying within 0.15 within-25bps on the five sibling factors; comparable fidelity appears on U.S. unemployment, CPI inflation, and NOAA temperature. On a recent-release holdout, parse rate collapses to 21-57% but r stays at approximately 0.99 on months answered, the refuse-or-recall asymmetry a memorized channel predicts. The white-box experiment reproduces the dose-response, and logprob ranking detects memorization that open-ended generation misses, implying closed-API black-box probes understate the channel. A Sonnet "date to market-sentiment" regression that correlates with true Mkt-RF at r=0.74 collapses to r=0.02 once the model's own recall is residualized out. A one-line system-prompt defense blocks 99.8% of a non-adaptive single-turn suffix attack set at near-zero utility cost on conceptual and historical-narrative queries

</details>


### [251] [LongDS-Bench: On the Failure of Long-Horizon Agentic Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30434)
*Kewei Xu,Xiaoben Lu,Shuofei Qiao,Zihan Ding,Haoming Xu,Lei Liang,Ningyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LongDS是一个评估智能体在长周期、多轮数据分析中追踪和维护演化分析状态能力的基准测试，包含68个基于Kaggle笔记本构建的任务（2225轮对话），最佳模型仅达48.45%准确率，长周期错误占失败案例的52%-69%，表明状态维护是核心瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准大多评估孤立或短交互任务，未能测试智能体在长周期数据分析中追踪演进分析上下文的能力，缺乏对长期、多轮数据分析状态的评估基准。

Method: 从真实Kaggle笔记本构建68个任务（2225轮对话），覆盖地理科学、商业、教育等6个领域，设计状态演化模式（反事实扰动、回滚、多状态组合），平均依赖跨度11.3轮。

Result: 最佳模型（SOTA）平均准确率仅48.45%，从早期到后期轮次性能下降近47个百分点，长周期错误占失败的52%-69%。增加智能体步骤数并不必然提升性能。

Conclusion: 长周期数据分析的核心瓶颈在于维护正确的分析状态而非增加交互预算，LongDS为研究可靠的长周期智能体数据分析提供了评估平台。

Abstract: Real-world data analysis is inherently iterative, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate isolated or short interactive tasks, leaving agents' ability to track evolving analytical context over long horizons untested. We introduce LongDS, a benchmark for long-horizon, multi-turn data analysis where agents must maintain, update, restore, and compose evolving analytical states. LongDS comprises 68 tasks constructed from real-world Kaggle notebooks, spanning 2,225 turns across six domains including Geoscience, Business, and Education. Tasks are designed around state-evolution patterns (e.g., counterfactual perturbation, rollback, multi-state composition), with an average dependency span of 11.3 turns. Evaluating five state-of-the-art models, we find that the best model reaches only 48.45% average accuracy, performance drops nearly 47 points from early to late turns, and long-horizon errors account for 52%--69% of failures. Further analysis shows that additional agent steps do not necessarily improve performance, suggesting that the key bottleneck is maintaining a correct analytical state rather than increasing interaction budget. We release LongDS to support research on reliable long-horizon agentic data analysis. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/zjunlp/DataMind.

</details>


### [252] [Calibrated Preference Learning: The Case of Label Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30447)
*Santo M. A. R. Thies,Viktor Bengs,Timo Kaufmann,Sebastian J. Vollmer,Eyke Hüllermeier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次正式定义了概率标签排序中的校准问题，提出了涵盖全排序、子排序和Top-K排序的校准层次体系，并通过理论证明和实证分析揭示了不同校准概念之间的关系及其在实际模型（包括RLHF奖励模型）中的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 校准对于可靠决策至关重要，但此前研究仅针对分类和回归任务，概率标签排序（预测标签集排序上的分布）中的校准问题尚未被正式定义和研究。

Method: 形式化定义了标签排序的校准概念，建立了包含全排序校准、子排序校准和Top-K校准的层次化框架，并通过理论证明梳理了各概念间的蕴含与不可比关系。在多个流行标签排序模型和RLHF奖励模型上进行了实证评估。

Result: （1）全排序校准蕴含子排序校准和Top-K校准，但反之不成立；（2）子排序校准与Top-K校准不可相互比较；（3）流行的标签排序模型普遍校准不佳，子排序与Top-K指标存在显著差异；（4）在RLHF奖励模型中，校准与基准准确率强相关但不完全一致，表明校准捕捉了Top-1准确率之外的质量维度。

Conclusion: 标签排序模型存在显著的校准问题，校准度量能够反映模型质量的一个独立维度，未来需要研究误校准的下游影响并开发相应的校准方法。

Abstract: Calibration, the alignment of predicted probabilities with true outcome frequencies, is essential for reliable decision-making. While extensively studied for classification and regression, calibration has not been formally addressed for probabilistic label ranking, where the goal is to predict a distribution over orderings of a label set. Naively treating rankings as classes ignores their structure and fails to capture important modalities such as pairwise and top-k predictions. We formalize calibration for label ranking and develop a hierarchy of notions covering full rankings, sub-rankings, and top-k rankings. We prove that full-rank calibration implies the others but not conversely, and sub-ranking and top-k calibration are incomparable. Empirically, we find popular label ranking models are often poorly calibrated, with substantial differences between sub-ranking and top-k metrics. Applying our framework to RLHF reward models, we find that calibration correlates strongly but not perfectly with benchmark accuracy, suggesting it captures a meaningful quality dimension beyond top-1 accuracy. These findings motivate future work on understanding the downstream effects of miscalibration and developing methods to correct it.

</details>


### [253] [VeriGate: Verifier-Gated Step-Level Supervision for GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30451)
*Aakriti Agrawal,Minghui Liu,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VeriGate是一种基于验证器门控的GRPO扩展方法，通过在验证器奖励退化时引入过程监督、将PRM步骤分数转化为未来累积奖励、并转换为token级组归一化优势，解决了GRPO中奖励稀疏、梯度消失和信用分配不足的问题，在MATH数据集上训练1.5B和7B模型后在六个推理基准上平均准确率提升约20%和12%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准GRPO存在两个关键缺陷：1）当所有采样轨迹获得相同验证器奖励时，组相对优势归零，学习停滞（稀疏监督问题）；2）仅使用结果奖励无法提供步骤级别的信用分配，限制了探索并难以学习稳健的推理能力。

Method: VeriGate包含三个设计：1）验证器门控机制：当验证器奖励能产生有意义的偏好时由验证器主导，仅在验证器奖励退化时启用过程监督；2）将PRM步骤分数转换为未来累积奖励（future-cumulated rewards），实现续感知的信用分配；3）将这些奖励转化为组归一化的token级优势，恢复信息梯度并提供细粒度信用分配，同时比直接优化聚合PRM分数的方法更不易受到奖励黑客攻击。

Result: 在MATH数据集上使用1.5B和7B Qwen2.5-Instruct模型训练，在六个推理基准上评估，平均准确率分别提升约20%和12%；显著减少了零梯度失败；降低了奖励黑客行为；相比纯结果GRPO和PRM-as-outcome基线，推理质量得到改善。

Conclusion: VeriGate通过验证器门控的过程监督策略，在保持对奖励黑客攻击鲁棒性的同时，有效解决了GRPO的稀疏奖励和信用分配问题，是提升推理模型训练效果的有效方案。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is an effective recipe for training reasoning models with verifier-based outcome rewards, but its supervision is sparse: when all sampled trajectories for a prompt receive the same verifier reward, the group-relative advantage collapses to zero and learning stalls. Outcome-only rewards also provide no step-level credit assignment, limiting exploration and making it harder to learn robust reasoning. We present VeriGate (Verifier-Gated Step-Level GRPO), a verifier-gated extension of GRPO that addresses these limitations with three design choices. First, VeriGate keeps the verifier in charge whenever verifier rewards induce a meaningful preference among sampled trajectories, and uses process supervision only when verifier rewards are degenerate. Second, instead of collapsing Process Reward Model (PRM) step scores into a single trajectory reward, VeriGate converts them into future-cumulated rewards to assign continuation-aware credit. Third, VeriGate transforms these rewards into group-normalized token-level advantages, restoring informative gradients and fine-grained credit assignment while remaining less susceptible to reward hacking than methods that optimize aggregated PRM scores. Empirically, training on MATH with 1.5B and 7B Qwen2.5-Instruct models and evaluating on six reasoning benchmarks, VeriGate improves average accuracy by about 20% and 12% for 1.5B and 7B models respectively, substantially reduces zero-gradient failures, decreases reward-hacking behavior, and improves reasoning quality relative to outcome-only GRPO and PRM-as-outcome baselines.

</details>


### [254] [A Unified Framework for Gradient Aggregation in Multi-Objective Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30452)
*Zeou Hu,Kelvin Ho,Yaoliang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为梯度聚合多目标优化建立了统一框架，推导出收敛至Pareto驻点的最优速率，提出充分对齐条件与非冲突方向定理，并从原始优化视角统一现有算法，引入基于CVaR的capped MGDA方法，在对抗联邦学习中验证了鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多目标优化梯度聚合方法动机各异、缺乏统一的理论分析框架，不同方法之间的理论关系不清晰，且收敛保证不统一。

Method: 提出充分对齐条件，证明凸包内的非冲突方向是收敛的充分条件；通过对偶锥投影确保可行性；从原始优化视角统一现有梯度聚合算法；基于CVaR提出capped MGDA方法。

Result: 建立了梯度聚合的统一框架，推导出收敛至Pareto驻点的最优速率，capped MGDA在对抗联邦学习中展现鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 非冲突方向是梯度聚合收敛的充分条件，对偶锥投影可扩展收敛保证，统一框架有助于设计和理解多目标优化算法。

Abstract: Many machine learning problems involve multiple inherent trade-offs that are best addressed by gradient-based multi-objective optimization (MOO) algorithms. Existing methods are often proposed with various motivations, analyzed case by case, and differ algorithmically in how the component gradients are aggregated at each step. In this work, we develop a unifying framework for gradient aggregation in MOO, establishing (optimal) rates of convergence to Pareto stationarity, the standard measure of performance in MOO. Central to our analysis is a sufficient alignment condition, from which we derive a theorem showing that non-conflicting directions, when chosen within the convex hull of gradients, form a fundamental sufficient condition for convergence. We further show that feasibility can be ensured through projection onto the dual cone, broadening the scope of methods that admit convergence guarantees. In parallel, we present a primal optimization perspective of gradient aggregation that encompasses established algorithms, clarifies their theoretical relationships, and enables the design of new variants. As an illustration, we introduce capped MGDA, derived from a CVaR-based formulation, and demonstrate its robustness in adversarial federated learning. Finally, we validate our theory through experiments on synthetic problems and practical benchmarks.

</details>


### [255] [DisjunctiveNet: Neural Symbolic Learning via Differentiable Convexified Optimization Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30456)
*Shraman Pal,Can Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个统一的端到端框架，在神经网络中强制执行硬性的、输入依赖的混合整数线性约束，通过分层凸松弛将规则表示为析取约束，实现精确的规则满足和强预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学与工程中的许多学习任务面临稀疏数据集问题，纯数据驱动方法效果有限，而这类问题常伴随丰富的领域知识（物理定律、操作需求、专家启发），这些知识通常表达为包含逻辑命题和线性不等式的规则。现有神经符号方法要么通过软惩罚近似执行规则，要么假设输入无关规则设计专用架构，要么依赖推理时的非可微后处理来硬性满足约束，缺少端到端可微的硬约束强制执行方案。

Method: 将规则表示为析取约束，应用分层凸松弛获得凸包络公式，得到可处理的线性约束，将其嵌入为可微优化层，同时实现精确规则满足。

Result: 在真实数据集上实现了完美的规则满足率和强的预测性能。

Conclusion: 提出的端到端框架能有效在神经网络中强制执行硬性的混合整数线性约束，解决了现有方法在可微性和硬约束满足之间的权衡问题。

Abstract: Many learning tasks in science and engineering are characterized by sparse datasets, which limits the effectiveness of purely data-driven approaches. At the same time, these problems are often accompanied by rich domain knowledge derived from physical laws, operational requirements, and expert heuristics. Such knowledge is frequently expressed as rules involving logical propositions and linear inequalities. Existing neuro-symbolic methods typically enforce these rules approximately through soft penalties, assume input-independent rules when designing specialized architectures, or rely on non-differentiable post-processing at inference time to achieve hard constraint satisfaction. While recent advances in differentiable optimization layers enable end-to-end feasibility enforcement within neural networks, extending these approaches to logical or mixed-integer rules remains challenging due to inherent nonconvexity. In this work, we propose a unified end-to-end framework for enforcing hard, input-dependent mixed integer linear constraints within neural networks. Our approach represents rules as disjunctive constraints and applies hierarchical convex relaxations to obtain convex hull formulations. These relaxations yield tractable linear constraints that can be embedded as differentiable optimization layers while enabling exact rule satisfaction. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on real-world datasets, achieving perfect rule satisfaction and strong predictive performance.

</details>


### [256] [Scalable Constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via State Augmentation and Consensus for Separable Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30461)
*Santiago Amaya-Corredor,Miguel Calvo-Fullana,Anders Jonsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种分布式约束多智能体强化学习方法，通过邻居间对偶变量共识实现全局约束协调，在保持线性可扩展性的同时满足资源约束，实验证明该方法在智能电网场景中可扩展到数千智能体，而集中式训练分散式执行方法仅能处理数十个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在智能体具有可分离动力学但需满足全局资源约束的MARL场景中，独立学习无法产生可行解，因为智能体无法确定各自对约束满足的适当贡献。

Method: 将状态增强策略学习与对偶变量分布式共识相结合：每个智能体离线学习一个增广策略（以局部状态和对偶变量为条件），执行时通过局部邻居通信达成对偶变量共识。

Result: 在温和连通性假设下，智能体间乘子的共识误差有界，约束违规随图连通性和共识轮次增加而减小。方法训练和执行复杂度均为线性，而CTDE方法随智能体数量至少二次增长。智能电网实验中，无共识时智能体通过无限期推迟需求来满足约束（退化非解），有共识时收敛到共享对偶变量并同时满足电网约束和需求满足，可扩展至数千智能体。

Conclusion: 邻居间对偶变量轻量共识足以实现全局协调约束执行，同时保持独立训练的可扩展性，在约束MARL中共识协调对可行性至关重要。

Abstract: We present a distributed approach for constrained Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) that combines state-augmented policy learning with distributed consensus over dual variables. Our method targets systems where agents have separable dynamics but must coordinate to satisfy global resource constraints, a setting in which, as we demonstrate empirically, independent learning fails to produce feasible solutions because agents cannot determine appropriate individual contributions toward collective constraint satisfaction. The key technical contribution is showing that lightweight neighbor-to-neighbor consensus over Lagrange multipliers suffices for globally coordinated constraint enforcement while preserving the scalability of independent training. Each agent learns a single augmented policy offline, conditioned on both its local state and a dual variable encoding constraint feedback. During execution, agents reach agreement on this dual variable through local communication alone. We prove that under mild connectivity assumptions, the consensus error among agents' multipliers is bounded, and show that this translates to a bounded constraint violation that decreases with graph connectivity and the number of consensus rounds. Unlike centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) approaches, whose complexity grows at least quadratically with agent count, our method scales linearly in both training and execution. Experiments on smart grid demand response demonstrate that consensus coordination is \emph{essential for feasibility}: without it, agents satisfy grid capacity constraints only by indefinitely postponing demand, a degenerate non-solution. With consensus, agents converge to a shared dual variable and satisfy both grid constraints and demand fulfillment, scaling to thousands of agents while CTDE baselines are limited to dozens.

</details>


### [257] [idSCD: Identifying Training Datasets through Semantic Correlation Descriptors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30462)
*Andrada Gobeaja,Ionut Hodoroaga,Elena Burceanu,Marius Leordeanu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于语义相关性描述符（SCDs）的白盒成员推理方法，通过模型学习到的语义相关结构来识别训练数据集中是否包含特定数据集，在多项任务中优于现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集级成员推理依赖行为或分布证据（如置信度、损失、生成样本等），尚未利用模型内部学习的语义相关结构来区分数据集来源。

Method: 提出语义指纹方法，使用语义相关性描述符（SCDs）捕获模型学到的语义相关结构；设计基于SCD的成员推理分数，仅需目标模型的SCD和目标数据集的独立SCD即可判定数据集是否属于训练混合。

Result: 在留一数据集诊断中SCD完美分离匹配与非匹配数据集对；在自然语言推理、情感分类、医学文本分类三组实验中，基于SCD的分类器平均性能最高、方差最低，优于RMIA、Attack-P、LiRA及SIF基线，最大ROC-AUC相对提升超过60%。

Conclusion: 数据集成员可以通过模型内部的语义相关结构被追踪，伪相关（偶然规律性）为数据集级成员推理提供了有效信号。

Abstract: Can a dataset be recognized from the spurious correlations it induces during training? We argue that datasets leave dataset-specific traces in a model's learned semantic correlation structure: incidental regularities that are predictive within a dataset, but not causal for the underlying task, can be internalized during training. We use this insight to study dataset-level membership inference, moving beyond existing methods that rely on behavioral or distributional evidence such as confidence scores, losses, margins, generated samples, or query responses. We introduce a white-box semantic fingerprinting approach based on semantic correlation descriptors (SCDs), which capture the semantic correlation structure learned by a model and make it comparable across dataset mixtures. In a controlled leave-one-dataset-out diagnostic, SCDs recover dataset-specific changes and perfectly separate matching from non-matching dataset pairs. We then propose a practical SCD-based membership score that tests whether a target dataset is part of a model's training mixture using only the model's SCD and the target dataset's standalone SCD, without requiring leave-one-dataset-out models. Across three diverse experimental settings, with dataset groups for natural language inference, emotion classification, and medical text classification, we test both the advantages and limitations of SCD-based membership inference with different degrees of semantic separation and keyword support between dataset splits. On average, the classifier based on this score achieves the highest performance and the lowest std, outperforming black-box baselines RMIA, Attack-P, and LiRA, as well as the white-box SIF baseline. These results show that dataset membership can be traced through internal semantic correlations, with the largest relative gain exceeding 60% in ROC-AUC when dataset groups expose distinct semantic particularities.

</details>


### [258] [Can Subgraph Explanations Be Weaponized to Steal Graph Neural Networks?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30470)
*Ojas Nimase,Jiate Li,Yue Zhao,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次提出针对图分类任务的模型提取攻击方法XSTEAL，在仅能获取离散类别标签和二值解释掩码的严格黑盒约束下，利用模型解释输出引导蒙特卡洛边敏感性估计，以Hoeffding浓度保证估计精度，并通过解释子图缩小边界搜索空间，实验证明该方法优于现有基线，揭示了可解释性接口的安全漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然GMLaaS平台为满足法规透明度要求而部署可解释性接口，但这种透明性为模型提取攻击创造了可利用的漏洞。本文旨在揭示这种安全风险并设计首个针对图分类任务的攻击方法。

Method: (1) 利用模型解释输出引导蒙特卡洛边敏感性估计，向决策边界靠近，并采用Hoeffding浓度保证估计精度；(2) 利用解释子图有效缩小边界搜索空间。

Result: 在多个领域的基准图数据集上进行了大量实验，证明该方法优于可比较的基线方法。

Conclusion: 可解释性接口创造了可利用的攻击面，该发现可为可解释AI强制要求的防御机制和政策框架提供参考。

Abstract: Graph Machine Learning as a Service (GMLaaS) platforms increasingly implement explainability interfaces to meet regulatory transparency requirements. However, this transparency creates exploitable vulnerabilities for model extraction attacks. We present the first model extraction attack specifically designed for graph classification under strict black-box constraints where the attacker observes only discrete class labels and binary explanation masks (no probability scores, gradients, or confidence values). Our method (1) uses model explanation outputs to guide Monte Carlo edge sensitivity estimation toward decision boundaries, with Hoeffding concentration guarantees on estimation accuracy and (2) exploits explanation subgraphs to efficiently narrow the boundary search space. Extensive experiments on benchmark graph datasets across multiple domains demonstrate our method's superiority over comparable baselines. These findings demonstrate that such explainability interfaces create exploitable attack surfaces, informing both defensive mechanisms and policy frameworks for explainable AI mandates. The implementation code is provided in https://github.com/LabRAI/XSTEAL/.

</details>


### [259] [Universal Multiclass Transductive Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30479)
*Steve Hanneke,Hongao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了通用传导性在线分类问题，其中标签空间可能无界。实例序列在预测前已知，概念类可学习当存在算法使错误数以亚线性增长。研究表明可学习类仅存在两种最优速率：有界或对数增长。引入LCLL树结构与无差别性质来刻画可学习性，并将结果推广到不可知场景和已知随机过程场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在实例序列已知（传导性设置）且标签空间可能无界的在线分类场景中，概念类的可学习性及其最优学习速率，填补该设定下理论理解的空白。

Method: 提出了一种名为"Level-Constrained-Littlestone-Littlestone (LCLL) tree"的新组合结构，结合无差别性质（indifference property）来刻画可学习性；通过理论分析推导出可学习类的最优错误率仅有两种可能（有界或对数增长），并将结果扩展至不可知场景及已知随机过程场景。

Result: 发现可学习概念类的最优错误率仅有两种：有界（bounded）或对数增长（logarithmically increasing）；LCLL树结构与无差别性质共同构成了可学习性的充要条件。

Conclusion: 完整刻画了传导性在线分类中的可学习性，建立了该设定下的学习理论框架，并展示了结果对不可知场景和已知随机过程场景的适用性。

Abstract: We consider the problem of universal transductive online classification with a possibly unbounded label space. This setting considers online learning, with the sequence of instances (without labels) known to the learner in advance. We say a concept class $\mathcal{H}$ is learnable if there is a learning algorithm $\mathcal{A}$, such that for every realizable sequence, the number of mistakes made by $\mathcal{A}$ grows at most sublinearly with the number of predictions. We characterize the learnability of this setting and show that there are only two possible optimal rates for the learnable classes: either bounded or increasing logarithmically. We introduce a new combinatorial structure, called ``Level-Constrained-Littlestone-Littlestone (LCLL) tree'', which, along with the indifference property, characterizes the learnability. We also extend the learnability result to the agnostic case and the case where only the stochastic process that generates the instance sequence is known.

</details>


### [260] [Discovering a Zeta Map Algorithm on Dyck Paths via Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30482)
*Xiaoyu Huang,Blake Jackson,Kyu-Hwan Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过机械可解释性分析一个微型Transformer学习Dyck路径上的zeta映射的过程，揭示了其基于层级（level）的遍历机制，并将此机制转化为一个精确的、可验证的峰中心遍历算法——scaffolding map，证明了该算法等价于zeta映射（模标签反转约定），展示了AI辅助数学发现的一个受控案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习越来越多地被用于数学发现，但数学中期望的输出往往不是预测本身，而是可以独立验证的显式构造。本文旨在通过一个受控案例，探索机械可解释性如何将模型行为转化为精确的、人类可验证的组合算法。

Method: 在Dyck路径的zeta映射（q,t- Catalan数组合学中的经典双射）这一设定下，训练了一个故意很小的单层单头编码器-解码器Transformer。使用机械可解释性工具（包括解码器交叉注意力分析、线性探测和因果干预）分析其学习到的计算过程。

Result: 分析揭示了基于层级的机制：编码器表示使路径层级线性可访问，解码器以结构化方式选择和遍历输入位置。将这些信号转化为组合学得到了scaffolding map——一种显式的以峰为中心的Dyck路径遍历算法。证明了该算法与zeta映射一致（模标签反转约定）。

Conclusion: 这提供了一个AI辅助数学发现的受控案例，在该案例中，机械可解释性将模型行为转化为精确的、人类可验证的组合算法。

Abstract: Machine learning is increasingly used in mathematical discovery, but in mathematics the desired output is often not a prediction itself, but an explicit construction that can be checked independently. We study this setting through the zeta map on Dyck paths, a classical bijection in the combinatorics of the q,t-Catalan numbers. We train a deliberately small one-layer, one-head encoder-decoder transformer on this map and analyze its learned computation using mechanistic interpretability tools, including decoder cross-attention analysis, linear probing, and causal intervention. The analysis reveals a level-based mechanism: encoder representations make path levels linearly accessible, while the decoder selects and traverses input positions in a structured way. Translating these signals into combinatorics leads to the scaffolding map, an explicit peak-centered traversal algorithm for Dyck paths. We prove that this algorithm agrees with the zeta map, modulo a reversal convention in the labeling. This gives a controlled example of AI-assisted mathematical discovery in which mechanistic interpretability turns model behavior into a precise, human-verifiable combinatorial algorithm.

</details>


### [261] [Graph-Conditioned Mixture of Graph Neural Network Experts for Traffic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30486)
*Amirhossein Ghaffari,Saeid Sheikhi,Ekaterina Gilman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GC-MoE提出了一种基于图条件的混合专家框架，为每个传感器节点分配个性化的交通预测专家组合，仅训练约17K参数的轻量路由模块，在四个标准基准上提升了预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时空预测模型对所有节点使用单一骨干架构，忽略了不同路段在功能类型、结构及交通行为上的异质性，因此需要节点级别的专家专业化来更好地捕捉多样化动态。

Method: 提出GC-MoE框架，包含：(1) 多个冻结的预训练时空GNN专家；(2) 输入感知的、基于图上下文的路由器，根据图拓扑和近期交通输入为每个节点分配个性化的专家组合；(3) 可选的边界图条件输出精炼层；(4) 节点自适应ST-LoRA适配器仅作为消融诊断。仅训练轻量路由模块。

Result: 在PEMS04、PEMS07、METR-LA和PEMS-BAY四个标准基准上，GC-MoE相较于零参数集成基线提升了MAE，在RMSE和MAPE上也具有竞争力。仅训练约17K参数，而冻结的专家权重为1.5M。

Conclusion: 基于图条件的混合专家策略能够以极小的训练开销有效提升时空预测性能，验证了节点级专家专业化在交通预测中的有效性。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal forecasting on sensor graphs is commonly tackled with a single backbone architecture applied uniformly across all nodes, although graph regions can exhibit different dynamics. Road segments differ in functional class, structure, and traffic behavior, suggesting that node-wise expert specialization can be useful. We propose GC-MoE, a graph-conditioned mixture of experts framework that assigns each node a personalized combination of frozen forecasting experts based on graph topology and the recent traffic input window. GC-MoE combines frozen pretrained spatio-temporal GNN experts with an input-aware, spatially contextualized router while training only a lightweight routing module. We also study a bounded graph-conditioned output refinement layer as an optional extension and include node-adaptive ST-LoRA adapters only as an ablation diagnostic. Across four standard benchmarks (PEMS04, PEMS07, METR-LA, and PEMS-BAY), GC-MoE improves MAE over a zero-parameter ensemble baseline, with competitive RMSE and MAPE, while training only ~17K parameters on top of 1.5M frozen expert weights.
