### [300] [DARTS: Distribution-Aware Active Rollout Trajectory Shaping for Accelerating LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30859)
*Yujie Wang,Siwei Chen,Longzan Luo,Xinyi Liu,Xupeng Miao,Fangcheng Fu,Bin Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出主动分布塑形范式，通过细粒度识别提示内长尾分布中的无效冗长，结合分布感知轨迹采样与自适应冗余分配机制，在保持模型性能前提下实现最高1.77倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习系统在推理时存在长尾响应长度分布导致的 rollout 效率瓶颈，已有工作仅通过提示级尾部调度缓解影响，未从根本上解决分布本身带来的低效问题。

Method: 1) 细粒度识别提示内长尾分布，发现其由无效冗长组成；2) 主动分布塑形范式，将 rollout 分布向简洁性与确定性方向塑形；3) 分布感知轨迹采样机制，从冗余探索空间中筛选轨迹；4) 自适应冗余分配方案，最大化塑形效果与系统效率。

Result: 在多个基准上相比最先进系统实现最高1.77倍加速，且不牺牲模型性能。

Conclusion: 从分布根源解决长尾效率问题，验证了主动分布塑形作为一种新范式的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become pivotal for improving model capabilities yet suffers from rollout efficiency bottlenecks due to the long-tail response length distribution. While existing works mitigate the impact of long tails via prompt-level tail scheduling, we focus on the root source of inefficiency: the distribution itself. Specifically, we characterize the long-tail distribution at a finer granularity, identifying intra-prompt long tails, and revealing that they frequently consist of ineffective verbosity. To address this, we propose a novel paradigm of active distribution shaping to shape the rollout distribution towards conciseness and certainty, thereby fundamentally resolving tail-induced overheads. We achieve this through a distribution-aware trajectory sampling mechanism, which selects trajectories from a redundant exploration space for each prompt, and an adaptive redundancy allocation scheme to maximize both shaping effectiveness and system efficiency. Experiments demonstrate significant acceleration over state-of-the-art systems by up to 1.77x without compromising model performance.

</details>


### [301] [GlucoFM: A Dual-Stream Foundation Model for Continuous Glucose Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30865)
*Zechen Li,Keerthana Natarajan,Weizhi Zhang,Menglian Zhou,Simon A. Lee,Yuwei Zhang,Maxwell A. Xu,Zeinab Esmaeilpour,Flora D. Salim,Mark Malhotra,Lindsey Sunden,Shwetak Patel,Yuzhe Yang,Ahmed A. Metwally*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GlucoFM 是一种轻量级 CGM 基础模型，通过将血糖记录对齐到24小时网格、分解为慢速生理状态和瞬时事件流，在477名受试者的109,066小时数据上预训练，在7项临床预测任务中平均PR-AUC提升4.1分，尤其在糖尿病风险和β细胞功能障碍任务上表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用时间序列和CGM基础模型将血糖数据编码为纠缠的单流序列，未能显式建模血糖动态的独特时间结构，限制了表征的迁移能力。

Method: 将不规则CGM记录对齐到24小时时间网格并保留观测掩码，将血糖动态分解为慢速生理状态流和瞬时事件流；采用掩码上下文潜变量预测和时序动态预测两个互补目标进行预训练。

Result: 在4个队列、7项临床任务上，线性探测平均PR-AUC超出最佳CGM专用基础模型4.1分；在所有糖尿病风险和β细胞功能障碍任务以及4项胰岛素抵抗任务中的3项上取得最优PR-AUC；跨数据集迁移和少样本适应性能最佳。

Conclusion: 生理感知的解耦分解作为有效的归纳偏置，可提升CGM表征学习的迁移能力，聚合多天数据可带来一致的性能增益。

Abstract: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) provides a dense view of daily metabolic physiology, yet existing generic time-series and CGM-specific foundation models often encode glucose traces as entangled single-stream sequences, leaving the distinct temporal structure of glycemic dynamics only implicitly modeled. We present GlucoFM, a lightweight CGM foundation model that aligns irregular recordings to a 24-hour chronological grid, preserves observation masks, and decomposes glucose dynamics into slow physiological state and transient event streams, capturing low-frequency glycemic baselines and short-term deviations that may reflect acute physiological responses or sensor artifacts. GlucoFM is pretrained on 109,066 hours of unlabeled CGM recordings from 477 subjects with two complementary objectives: masked contextual latent prediction over fused daily representations and temporal dynamics prediction over state and event streams. Across four diverse cohorts and seven clinical prediction tasks, GlucoFM achieves the strongest subject-disjoint linear-probing performance among evaluated baselines, improving average PR-AUC by 4.1 points over the best CGM-specific foundation model. Its gains are most pronounced on core metabolic outcomes, leading PR-AUC on all diabetes-risk and $β$-cell dysfunction tasks and on 3 of 4 insulin-resistance tasks. GlucoFM also achieves the best overall cross-dataset transfer performance and strong few-shot adaptation among evaluated methods, and consistent gains when aggregating multiple days for subject-level prediction, highlighting physiology-aware decomposition as an effective inductive bias for transferable CGM representation learning.

</details>


### [302] [Federated Variational Preference Alignment with Gumbel-Softmax Prior for Personalized User Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30873)
*Jabin Koo,Hoyoung Kim,Minwoo Jang,Jungseul Ok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedVPA-GP提出了一种联邦变分偏好对齐框架，通过Gumbel-Softmax先验和正交损失，在保护隐私的前提下解耦大模型对齐中冲突的用户偏好，有效解决了后验坍塌问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦学习框架在对齐大语言模型时使用单一奖励模型，会平均化用户冲突偏好（如有用性与无害性），而变分偏好学习在去中心化场景中面临后验坍塌问题。

Method: 提出联邦混合先验（Federated Mixture Prior）使客户端利用聚合的群体分布作为动态先验稳定变分推理；引入正交损失（Orthogonal Loss）显式分离潜在空间中的偏好原型。

Result: 在HH-RLHF数据集上显著优于单一模型基线，成功解耦冲突用户意图并实现动态偏好切换。

Conclusion: FedVPA-GP通过联邦变分偏好对齐有效解决了个性化偏好建模中的后验坍塌与隐私保护双重要求，为去中心化场景下的大模型对齐提供了新范式。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) offers a privacy-preserving pathway for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs); however, existing frameworks typically enforce a monolithic reward model, inevitably averaging out inherently conflicting user preferences (e.g., helpfulness vs. harmlessness). While Variational Preference Learning (VPL) offers a pathway to personalization, adapting it to decentralized settings presents a fundamental challenge: posterior collapse driven by severe local data scarcity and heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose Federated Variational Preference Alignment with Gumbel-Softmax Prior (FedVPA-GP), a framework designed to disentangle diverse preferences without compromising privacy. To stabilize variational inference, we introduce a Federated Mixture Prior that enables clients to leverage the aggregate population distribution as a dynamic prior. Furthermore, we incorporate an Orthogonal Loss that explicitly enforces the separation of preference prototypes in the latent space. Experiments on the HH-RLHF dataset demonstrate that FedVPA-GP significantly outperforms monolithic baselines, successfully disentangling conflicting user intents and enabling dynamic preference switching.

</details>


### [303] [Bandwidth Allocation with Device Partitioning for Federated Learning over Industrial IoT networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30892)
*Kangmin Kim,Jaeyoung Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向工业物联网联邦学习系统的带宽分配策略，通过将参与设备划分为有序子集并依次授予全部带宽，显著降低了总训练时间和上行能耗，并在真实数据集上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在联邦学习系统中，通信时间是制约整体训练效率的主要瓶颈。传统的带宽分配方法侧重于满足个体服务质量需求，而忽略了联邦学习系统集体收敛至最优模型的目标，因此需要一种全新的带宽分配方法。

Method: 提出了一种基于分区的带宽分配策略，利用设备计算能力的异构性，将参与设备划分为有序子集，依次为每个子集授予全部带宽进行传输，而非同时分配带宽给所有设备。

Result: 理论证明该分区策略在训练时间上严格优于任何无分区的带宽分配方案；同时降低了每设备传输时长和上行能耗；在GC10-Det和CIFAR-10数据集上的实验表明，该策略持续降低训练时间和能耗，接近轮次时间的理论下界。

Conclusion: 本文提出的分区带宽分配策略能有效解决联邦学习中的通信瓶颈问题，尤其适用于电池受限的工业物联网设备，实现了训练效率与能耗的双重优化。

Abstract: We consider a federated learning (FL) system in which Industrial Internet-of-Things (IIoT) devices collaboratively train a global model over wireless channels without sharing local data. In such systems, communication time is a primary bottleneck that constrains overall training efficiency. Unlike conventional networks that prioritize individual quality-of-service requirements, FL systems collectively aim to converge to an optimal global model as efficiently as possible, which calls for a fundamentally different approach to bandwidth allocation. In this paper, we propose a novel bandwidth allocation policy that exploits the heterogeneity of device computing capabilities to minimize total training time. Rather than distributing bandwidth among all selected devices simultaneously, the proposed policy partitions the participating devices into ordered subsets and sequentially grants each subset exclusive access to the full bandwidth. We formally prove that this partitioning-based policy achieves a strictly lower training time than any bandwidth allocation scheme without partitioning, irrespective of the underlying scheduling algorithm. Furthermore, by reducing per-device transmission duration, the proposed policy also minimizes uplink energy consumption, which is particularly beneficial for battery-constrained IIoT devices. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets - including GC10-Det, an industrial surface defect benchmark, and CIFAR-10, a standard image classification benchmark - demonstrate that the proposed policy consistently reduces training time and energy consumption compared to existing bandwidth allocation schemes, approaching the theoretical lower bound on round time.

</details>


### [304] [Zero Collapse: A Failure Mode of Policy Gradient Methods in Discontinuous Reward Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30896)
*Nishant Kumar,Enrique Areyan Viqueira,Amy Greenwald*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了重复拍卖竞价中强化学习面临的"零坍塌"失效模式，分析了不连续奖励景观导致策略陷入零奖励区域无法恢复的机制，并提出了缓解策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复拍卖竞价结合了连续控制与数字广告的战略复杂性，而策略梯度和值函数方法在面临不连续、"悬崖式"的奖励景观时表现不佳，存在根本性的失效模式需要被理解和解决。

Method: (1) 从机制上解释了不连续奖励如何导致梯度信号消失和零坍塌；(2) 分析了策略随机性与步长之间的交互作用；(3) 在REINFORCE和actor-critic变体上进行了实证演示，并提出了初始化和架构选择方面的缓解策略。

Result: 发现actor-critic方法尤其容易受到零坍塌影响，因为偏差化的值估计会加速策略向不稳定区域移动；随机探索和基于梯度的更新会导致策略越过最优高奖励区域进入平坦的零奖励区域，一旦陷入几乎无法恢复。

Conclusion: 本文提出了正式的拍卖环境RL框架，凸显了其独特的结构性质，并提供了实用的缓解策略以提高稳定性。

Abstract: Bidding in repeated auctions is a central challenge for reinforcement learning (RL), combining continuous control with the strategic complexities of digital advertising. While policy gradient and value-based methods seem well-suited for these settings, they often struggle with the discontinuous, "cliff-like" nature of auction reward landscapes. In a first-price auction, for example, a bidder receives zero reward until they cross a specific threshold, after which the reward decreases as the bid increases. This creates a landscape of flat, zero-reward regions separated by sharp boundaries.
  We identify a fundamental failure mode in this setting termed "zero collapse." We show that stochastic exploration and gradient-based updates can cause policies to overshoot optimal high-reward regions and enter flat, zero-reward regimes. Once there, the lack of an informative gradient signal makes recovery extremely sample-inefficient, effectively trapping the agent. We find that actor-critic methods are particularly susceptible, as biased value estimates can accelerate this movement toward unstable regions.
  Our contributions include: (1) a mechanistic explanation of how discontinuous rewards lead to vanishing signals and zero collapse; (2) an analysis of the interaction between policy stochasticity and step size; and (3) an empirical demonstration of this phenomenon across REINFORCE and actor-critic variants. We propose practical mitigation strategies involving initialization and architectural choices to improve stability. Finally, we introduce a formal RL framework for auction environments highlighting their unique structural properties.

</details>


### [305] [Density-Guided Robust Counterfactual Explanations on Tabular Data under Model Multiplicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30901)
*Jun Tan,Qing Guo,Zicheng Xu,Jinglin Li,Qi Fang,Ning Gui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DensityFlow是一个基于生成式框架的反事实解释方法，通过神经ODE和密度评分引导的连续时间动力学，在高置信度数据流形上生成鲁棒的反事实解释，同时利用局部代理蒸馏机制实现黑盒场景下的高效优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的反事实解释（CEs）在低密度区域可靠性差，因为分类器在这些区域方差高。现有方法依赖昂贵的集成交集来定义稳定性，缺乏高效且鲁棒的生成方式。

Method: 1) 将反事实生成建模为神经ODE参数化的连续时间动力学；2) 通过噪声对比估计（NCE）学习可微分密度评分，利用(K+1)路判别器估计密度比，主动避开低密度区域；3) 针对黑盒场景，提出局部代理蒸馏机制，在CE生成轨迹上对齐轻量级代理模型与目标模型，实现高效梯度优化。

Result: 在模型多重性下实现了优越的有效性，同时相比基于集成的基线方法显著降低了查询成本。

Conclusion: DensityFlow通过密度感知的连续生成框架，在保证反事实解释有效性的同时大幅提升查询效率，为黑盒场景下的鲁棒可解释性提供了新范式。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations (CEs) are essential for actionable recourse, yet their reliability is often compromised in low-density regions, where classifiers exhibit high variance. Unlike existing methods that rely on expensive ensemble intersections to define stability, we propose \textit{DensityFlow}, a generative framework that constructs robust CEs by adhering to the high-confidence data manifold. Specifically, we model the counterfactual generation as continuous-time dynamics parameterized by Neural ODE, guided by a differentiable density score to actively avoid uncertain, low-density areas. This density score is learned via Noise Contrastive Estimation, effectively leveraging a $(K{+}1)$-way discriminator to estimate density ratios. For black-box settings, we introduce a local proxy distillation mechanism that aligns a lightweight surrogate with the target model strictly within the trajectory of CE generation, enabling efficient gradient-based optimization with minimal queries. Experiments demonstrate that \textit{DensityFlow} achieves superior validity under model multiplicity while significantly reducing query costs compared to ensemble-based baselines. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/G-AILab/DensityFlow.

</details>


### [306] [Inverse Reinforcement Learning without an Optimal Demonstrator: A Feasible Reward Set Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30903)
*Kihyun Kim,Shripad Deshmukh,Nikos Vlassis,Jiawei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于可行奖励集框架的逆强化学习方法，用于处理来自多个异构次优演示者的数据，并提供了理论保证与实用算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统IRL假设演示来自单一最优演示者，但实际应用中数据常来自多个次优程度不同的演示者，需要一种能处理异构次优性的奖励学习方法。

Method: 通过可行奖励集框架，将每个演示者声明的次优性水平编码为线性约束，并取各可行集的交集。理论分析了联合可行集的单调收缩性质与严格收紧条件，建立了真实最优演示者可行奖励集的两种恢复保证（基于最优占据度接近性和覆盖充分性）。实践中提出处理奖励歧义性的策略，并给出适用于高维环境的带函数近似的离线算法。

Result: 在表格型网格世界和大语言模型微调场景中，实验结果与理论预测一致，验证了所提框架优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效整合多个异构次优演示者的信息，在理论上保证了奖励集的可识别性，并在实践中取得了良好效果。

Abstract: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) typically assumes demonstrations from a single optimal demonstrator, but in many applications data come from multiple imperfect demonstrators with heterogeneous suboptimality levels. We study reward learning in this setting through a feasible-reward-set framework: for each demonstrator, we encode its declared suboptimality level as a linear constraint and intersect the resulting feasible sets across demonstrators. Our theoretical analysis shows that the joint feasible set shrinks monotonically as data are added, and we give an exact characterization of when a new demonstrator strictly tightens it. We further establish two recovery guarantees for the feasible reward set of the ground-truth optimal demonstrator: one bound depends on closeness to the optimal occupancy, while the other requires only sufficient coverage and no near-optimal demonstrator. On the practical side, we introduce strategies to address the inherent reward ambiguity in the obtained reward set and provide an offline algorithm with function approximation for high-dimensional environments. Experiments in tabular grid-world and large language model (LLM) fine-tuning settings are consistent with the theoretical predictions and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework over baselines.

</details>


### [307] [PINNs Failure Modes are Overfitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30910)
*Nigel T. Andersen,Takashi Matsubara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs)的失败模式源于过拟合——损失在配点上被最小化但在其他位置不成立。通过引入正则化可消除失败模式，并扩展双反向传播到全部残差，在标准失败模式方程上以最多23倍少的配点和普通架构实现了最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINNs在处理某些简单方程时会收敛到错误解，尽管残差损失很低。这种失败模式已引起广泛关注，现有解决方案涉及架构和优化方法，但根本原因尚不明确。本文旨在揭示失败模式的本质并提供更有效的解决方案。

Method: 1) 直接可视化残差，证明失败模式是由过拟合导致——损失仅在配点上被最小化，而其他位置并非如此。2) 应用正则化（如L2正则化）可消除失败模式。3) 将双反向传播（double backpropagation）扩展到全部残差集上，用于训练PINNs。

Result: 在四个标准失败模式方程上，使用普通架构（vanilla architecture）和最多23倍少的配点，达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: PINNs的失败模式本质上是过拟合问题，正则化可有效缓解。扩展的双反向传播方法能以更少的配点和简单架构取得优异性能，为PINNs的鲁棒训练提供了新思路。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a common class of machine learning-based partial differential equation (PDE) solvers which train a network to represent a solution by minimizing a residual loss that encodes the PDE. Despite their successes, they are known to fail on certain simple equations, converging to an incorrect solution despite low loss. These failure modes have garnered significant attention in the literature over the past several years, motivating both architectural and optimization based solutions. By directly visualizing the residual, we show that failure modes are the result of overfitting: the loss is minimized on the collocation points, but not elsewhere. Applying regularization causes the failure modes to vanish. Finally, we extend double backpropagation over the full set of residuals, and use it to achieve state-of-the-art performance on four standard failure mode equations with up to $23\times$ fewer collocation points and a vanilla architecture.

</details>


### [308] [Automating Formal Verification with Reinforcement Learning and Recursive Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30914)
*Max Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本论文研究了如何通过基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）和验证器引导的推理时搜索，提升大语言模型生成验证程序与证明的能力。在Dafny上使用GRPO进行多轮RLVR训练，将验证通过率从9.7%提升至31.1%；在Lean上开发了验证器引导的推理支架，将初始验证通过率从46.2%提升至69.2%，并解决了42个先前未解决任务中的7个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在自动形式验证方面仍面临挑战：证明助手和验证感知语言的数据稀缺，且正确性依赖于满足精确的机器可检查规范而非生成看似合理的代码。因此需要研究如何利用验证器环境来改进LLM生成已验证程序和证明的能力。

Method: 1) 在Dafny中采用GRPO及其变体进行RLVR训练，将生成候选项组装为完整程序，并用编译器和验证器结果评分；发现规范破解问题后，过滤欠规范和易受攻击的任务，进行多轮RLVR训练。2) 在Lean中开发验证器引导的推理支架，将证明生成视为基于分解子目标、验证器反馈、诊断和修复的结构化搜索，包含整个任务分解和证明修订器。

Result: Dafny：初始实验将验证奖励从2.2%提升至58.1%，但发现规范破解问题；过滤后多轮RLVR将验证通过率从9.7%提升至31.1%。Lean：完整支架加证明修订器在VeriCoding上将通过率从46.2%提升至69.2%；在VERINA上解决了7个先前未解决任务；Dalek-Bench上初步结果仍较弱。

Conclusion: 基于验证器环境的RLVR和推理时搜索能够显著提升LLM生成已验证程序和证明的能力，但仍面临规范破解、复杂任务表现弱等挑战，需要更强的进度评估和任务特定的工具使用策略。

Abstract: Automated formal verification remains challenging for large language models because data for proof assistants and verification-aware languages is scarce, and correctness depends on satisfying precise machine-checkable specifications rather than producing plausible code. This thesis studies how verifier environments can improve LLM generation of verified programs and proofs through reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) and verifier-guided inference-time search. First, we train open-source models in Dafny with RLVR using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related variants, assembling generated candidates into complete programs and scoring them with compiler and verifier outcomes. Initial experiments on an APPS-derived Dafny dataset increased verified reward from 2.2% to 58.1%, but revealed specification hacking, where models exploit weak formal specifications instead of implementing the intended solutions. After filtering underspecified and vulnerable tasks, multi-turn RLVR on the refined benchmark improves the verified pass rate from 9.7% to 31.1%. Second, we develop a verifier-guided inference scaffold in Lean that treats proof generation as structured search over decomposed subgoals, verifier feedback, diagnostics, and repair. With a fixed base model, the full scaffold with proof reviser improves pass rate on an initial VeriCoding pilot set from 46.2% under direct repair to 69.2%. On the larger VERINA dataset, whole-task decomposition plus proof reviser solves 7 of 42 previously unsolved tasks. We also introduce Dalek-Bench, a repository-scale Lean benchmark derived from the Rust $\texttt{curve25519-dalek}$ verification project; preliminary results remain weak, indicating that stronger progress evaluation and task-specific tool-use policies are still needed.

</details>


### [309] [Welfare, Improvability, and Variance: A Principal-Agent Approach to Optimal Benchmark Item Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30916)
*Andreas Haupt,Justin Hartenstein,Anka Reuel,Mykel Kochenderfer,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个将基准测试建模为多任务委托-代理博弈的理论框架，揭示了基准福利损失由三个项目级原始因素决定：与福利优先级的对齐、边际可改进性和性能方差。通过OLMES项目的实证审计，识别出帕累托劣势项目。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI基准测试存在污染、饱和和构念指定不足等已知局限，但聚合方法（即对项目分数进行统一平均）受到的关注严重不足，隐含假设每个测试项目价值相等，缺乏理论基础。

Method: 将基准测试建模为多任务委托-代理博弈，推导出福利损失由三个项目级原始因素决定：对齐（与规范福利优先级的一致性）、边际可改进性（性能提升空间）和性能方差。将该理论转化为审计框架，沿三个维度对项目排序。使用WORKBank获取福利权重，EvoLM 4B模型套件评估可改进性，PolyPythias 410M模型面板估计方差，对OLMES项目进行实证分析。

Result: 该框架能够识别出OLMES基准测试中在"亲工作者"福利操作化条件下存在帕累托劣势的项目，证明了不同项目对基准福利的贡献不均等，统一平均聚合方式存在缺陷。

Conclusion: 基准测试的聚合方式应基于项目级原始特征进行差异化加权，而非简单平均。该审计框架为构建更高效的基准测试提供了理论支撑和实用工具。

Abstract: AI benchmarks have well-documented limitations, with prior work examining contamination, saturation, and construct underspecification. Aggregation has received far less attention: benchmarks are typically summarized by uniformly averaging item-level scores, implicitly treating every test item as equally valuable. We model benchmarking as a multitask principal-agent game and show that the welfare loss from a benchmark is determined jointly by three item-level primitives: alignment with normative welfare priorities, marginal improvability, and performance variance. We translate the theory into an audit framework that ranks items along each of these three axes, and apply it to OLMES items using WORKBank for welfare, the EvoLM 4B suite for improvability, and the PolyPythias 410M panel for variance. The framework surfaces items that are Pareto-inferior within OLMES subject to a pro-worker welfare operationalization. All code is available at https://github.com/stair-lab/principal-agent-benchmarks.

</details>


### [310] [De-attribute to Forget for LLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30919)
*Xinyang Lu,Jiabao Pan,Rachael Hwee Ling Sim,See-Kiong Ng,Anthony Kum Hoe Tung,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于数据归因奖励的LLM遗忘框架DareU，通过强化学习降低模型生成响应与遗忘数据的归因分数，实现平衡遗忘质量与模型效用的有效遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法多依赖优化预测损失（如最大化遗忘集损失），存在过度遗忘和模型效用下降等关键问题，亟需新的优化范式。

Method: 将LLM遗忘的优化目标重新定义为归因归零，提出DareU框架：基于数据归因奖励进行强化学习，通过降低生成响应与遗忘数据所有者的归因分数（即去归因）来更新模型，并使用LLM分类器作为归因的高效近似。

Result: DareU在遗忘质量与模型效用之间取得良好平衡，优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 基于数据归因奖励的强化学习范式能有效解决LLM遗忘中的过度遗忘和模型效用问题，为LLM遗忘提供了新思路。

Abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has raised concerns on the use of inappropriate data for training, which has led to a growing interest in LLM unlearning. Many existing LLM unlearning approaches rely on optimizing prediction loss(es), such as maximizing the loss on the forget set, but often face critical issues like over-forgetting and poor model utility. To address them, this paper novelly frames the optimization objective for LLM unlearning as one of zeroing out data attribution instead. In particular, we propose the first LLM unlearning framework based on data attribution rewards called DareU that performs reinforcement learning to update the LLM by reducing the attribution score of its generated responses (i.e., de-attributing) to the forget data owners. Empirical evaluation using an LLM classifier as an efficient approximation of attribution shows that DareU outperforms existing baselines by achieving effective unlearning while balancing forget quality and model utility well.

</details>


### [311] [Spectral Anatomy of Quantum Gaussian Process Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30952)
*Jian Xu,Chao Li,Guang Lin,Yuning Qiu,Delu Zeng,John Paisley,Qibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现量子高斯过程（QGP）中看似无关的两个问题——HHL-based QGP回归的指数加速被否定与量子核的后验病态——均受同一量（归一化谱熵 S(K)/log n）支配。通过理论证明与跨多种核族（包括量子与经典核）的实验验证，该诊断量在去量子化、ECE和方差收缩面板上呈现一致的曲线行为，并在IBM Heron硬件上实现高精度迁移（中位绝对误差3.2%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一解释QGP领域中两个看似独立的关键问题：HHL-based QGP回归的指数加速被否定（Lowe等人2025）与量子核后验病态导致贝叶斯优化失效，揭示其共同根源。

Method: 1) 理论证明：Cauchy-Schwarz尾界刻画Nyström近似误差；有限样本方差收缩恒等式关联Bach自由度 d_σ(K)；目标依赖的最优熵通过目标在内核本征基中的本征维数表征。2) 实验验证：在硬件高效（HE）、matchgate、IQP量子核以及RBF/Matérn/RFF/深度核经典核族上验证归一化谱熵的诊断一致性；在IBM Heron量子硬件上跨24种配置（n_q=4）及n_q=6扩展实验验证迁移性，未使用任何误差缓解技术。

Result: 1) 所有核族在去量子化、ECE和方差收缩面板上均塌缩至相同的S/log n曲线。2) NLL甜点：平滑目标对应高熵，带限量子数据目标对应低熵。3) 硬件迁移：IBM Heron上中位绝对误差3.2%，均值5.2%；第二个Heron后端均值误差2.7%；n_q=6扩展均值误差1.7%。单个HE配置出现30%异常值，重跑后降至0.5%（归因于校准漂移）。

Conclusion: 归一化谱熵是QGP性能的统一诊断量，可用于指导量子核选择、预测任务可行性（如去量子化程度）以及量化硬件噪声影响，对量子机器学习中QGP的可靠应用具有重要意义。

Abstract: Two recent results have reshaped quantum Gaussian processes (QGPs). On the one hand, \citet{lowe2025assessing} rule out the exponential speedups claimed by HHL-based QGP regression in the typical, well-conditioned regime; on the other, an independent line of work shows that highly expressive quantum kernels suffer posterior pathologies that break Bayesian optimization. We show that these seemingly unrelated phenomena are governed by the same quantity: the normalized spectral entropy $S(K)/\log n$ of the kernel Gram matrix. We prove a Cauchy--Schwarz tail bound on Nyström approximation error, a finite-sample variance-contraction identity in terms of Bach's degrees of freedom $d_σ(K)$, and a characterization of the \emph{target-dependent} optimal entropy via the intrinsic dimension of the target in the kernel eigenbasis. Empirically, the diagnostic is kernel-agnostic: hardware-efficient, matchgate, IQP \emph{and} RBF/Matérn/RFF/deep-kernel families all collapse onto identical $S/\log n$ curves on dequantization, ECE, and variance-contraction panels. The NLL sweet spot lives at high entropy for smooth targets and at low entropy for band-limited quantum-data targets. The diagnostic transfers from simulator to IBM Heron hardware with median absolute error $3.2\%$ and mean $5.2\%$ in $S/\log n$ across $24$ configurations at $n_q = 4$, with matchgate and IQP within $5\%$ mean and a single HE configuration returning a $30\%$ outlier that drops to $0.5\%$ on rerun (attributed to calibration drift); the same diagnostic transfers to a second Heron backend (mean error $2.7\%$) and to a $n_q = 6$ scale-up on the original backend (mean error $1.7\%$). No error mitigation is applied throughout.

</details>


### [312] [Revisiting Zeroth-Order Hessian Approximation: A Single-Step Policy Optimization Lens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30960)
*Junbin Qiu,Zhaowei Hong,Renzhe Xu,Yao Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ZoVH框架，通过单步策略优化的视角统一零阶Hessian估计，并构建了一套包含全Hessian矩阵、正则化逆及偏差校正逆Hessian-梯度积分的方差缩减估计器，理论证明了无偏性、方差最优性及收敛保证，实验验证了其优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高维场景下，零阶Hessian及其逆的估计存在方差大、估计器不完备的问题，现有方法缺乏统一的低方差估计框架。

Method: 将零阶Hessian估计重新解释为单步策略优化的Hessian，建立统一的理论等价性；提出ZoVH估计器套件，包含(1)理论推导的最优基线以最小化方差，(2)查询复用策略以提升样本效率。

Result: 理论证明了Hessian估计的无偏性、基线的方差最优性、整套估计器的误差界及曲率感知ZO算法的收敛保证；实验验证了ZoVH在估计精度和收敛性能上的优越性。

Conclusion: ZoVH提供了一套理论完备、方差最优的零阶Hessian估计框架，有效提升了高维无梯度方法的实用性和收敛性能。

Abstract: Accurate Zeroth-Order (ZO) Hessian estimation is a cornerstone of derivative-free methods, essential for tasks such as bilevel optimization, Bayesian inference, and uncertainty quantification. However, obtaining a complete suite of low-variance estimators for the Hessian and its inverse in high-dimensional settings remains a significant challenge. To address this, we propose a unified framework that reinterprets ZO Hessian approximation through the lens of single-step Policy Optimization (PO). This perspective establishes a theoretical equivalence between general ZO Hessian estimators and the Hessian of a smoothed PO objective, unifying distinct classical randomized estimators as specific instances of baseline selection. Building on this foundation, we introduce ZoVH, a comprehensive suite of variance-reduced estimators for the full Hessian matrix, its regularized inverse, and the bias-corrected inverse Hessian-gradient product. ZoVH leverages two key techniques: (1) a unique optimal baseline derived to provably minimize variance, and (2) a query reuse strategy that incorporates historical function queries to enhance sample efficiency without inflating costs. Our rigorous theoretical analysis confirms the unbiasedness of the Hessian estimator, validates the variance optimality of our baseline, provides error bounds for the entire ZoVH suite, and establishes convergence guarantees for the resulting curvature-aware ZO algorithm. Extensive empirical results validate our theoretical findings, demonstrating that ZoVH achieves superior estimation accuracy and convergence performance in real-world applications. Code is available at https://github.com/Qjbtiger/ZoVH

</details>


### [313] [Parallel Tempering Initial Sampling in Inference-Time Reward Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30991)
*Myeongjun Oh,Gwangho Kim,Sungyoon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PATHS方法，通过并行回火耦合多采样链，改进扩散/流模型推理时的奖励对齐，解决SMC方法在高复杂奖励景观中陷入局部模式的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SMC方法从标准先验初始化粒子，难以采样到高奖励区域；即使有奖励感知的初始化方法，在复杂多峰奖励景观中仍易陷入局部模式。

Method: 提出PATHS（Parallel Tempering for High-complexity reward Sampling），维护一条奖励回火链的梯子，周期性地执行Metropolis交换，使粒子能在平坦化的奖励景观中高效探索，缓解模式捕获问题。

Result: 在布局到图像生成和数量感知生成任务上，PATHS在复杂提示词上持续提升对齐质量。

Conclusion: 并行回火机制能有效增强有限预算下对稀有高奖励区域的探索，显著提升推理时奖励对齐的性能。

Abstract: Inference-time reward alignment steers pretrained diffusion and flow-based generative models to satisfy user-specified rewards without retraining. Recently, Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has emerged as a powerful framework for this task by iteratively filtering and propagating multiple particles. However, we show that standard SMC-based methods often suffer from poor performance because they initialize particles from a standard prior, whereas high-reward regions in complex reward landscapes are extremely rare. Further, we show that even recent reward-aware initial sampling approaches remain vulnerable to getting trapped in local modes, as complex reward landscapes are often multi-modal. To overcome these limitations, we propose PATHS (PArallel Tempering for High-complexity reward Sampling), a novel initialization method that couples multiple sampling chains through parallel tempering. PATHS maintains a ladder of reward-tempered chains and periodically performs Metropolis swaps, enabling efficient exploration across flattened reward landscapes, thereby mitigating the mode-trapping issues. Our analysis reveals that this mechanism substantially enhances the finite-budget exploration of rare, high-reward regions that are typically challenging to sample. Experiments on layout-to-image and quantity-aware generation show that PATHS achieves consistent gains in alignment quality, particularly on complex prompts.

</details>


### [314] [Learning Multi-Agent Coordination via Sheaf-ADMM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31005)
*Jeffrey Seely,Bartłomiej Cupiał,Llion Jones*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可微优化框架，将输入分解为重叠局部视图，每个代理求解由神经编码器参数化的凸子问题，并通过ADMM和细胞层（cellular sheaf）指定的约束进行协调。反向传播通过展开的优化联合训练整个多代理系统。在迷宫路径规划、图像分类和数独任务上验证了有效性，相比标准CNN和MPNN基线表现出更好的鲁棒性和求解率，且ADMM结构提供了可直接分析和干预的协调动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多代理协调方法依赖隐式消息传递，缺乏可解释性和可干预性，且难以处理异构全局共识。作者希望通过结构化优化框架显式建模协调约束，实现可微分训练、可分析的协调动态和异构共识。

Method: 将输入分解为重叠局部视图，每个代理通过神经编码器参数化一个凸子问题，代理间通过ADMM协调，约束由细胞层（cellular sheaf）指定，定义相邻解必须一致的方面。通过展开优化步骤实现端到端反向传播训练。

Result: 迷宫路径规划、MNIST图像分类和数独求解上均优于基线。MNIST上对分布偏移鲁棒性优于标准CNN；数独上求解率显著高于参数匹配的MPNN；ADMM结构可分离原变量、共识变量和对偶变量，便于分析和干预。

Conclusion: 基于ADMM和细胞层的可微优化框架能有效实现多代理协调，兼具任务性能、鲁棒性和可解释性，优于传统消息传递架构。

Abstract: We present a differentiable optimization framework for multi-agent coordination. An input is decomposed into overlapping local views, each processed by an agent that solves a convex subproblem parameterized by a neural encoder. Agents coordinate through the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) with inter-agent constraints specified by a cellular sheaf. The sheaf specifies which aspects of neighboring solutions must agree, allowing for heterogeneous notions of global consensus. Backpropagating through the unrolled optimization jointly trains all components of the multi-agent system. We evaluate on maze pathfinding, image classification, and Sudoku, where agents with individually insufficient local views learn to coordinate to produce correct global outputs. On MNIST, the local-view decomposition yields improved robustness to distribution shifts relative to a standard CNN. On Sudoku, the optimization-derived structure yields markedly higher solve rates than parameter-matched MPNN baselines. Finally, the ADMM structure exposes distinct primal, consensus, and dual state variables, opening the coordination dynamics to direct analysis and intervention -- a property unavailable in standard message-passing architectures.

</details>


### [315] [DEM: A Distilled Explanation Model for Interpretable Anomaly Detection in Physiological Sensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31007)
*Jyotirmoy Singh,Anushka Roy,Shreea Bose,Chittaranjan Hota*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Distilled Explanation Model (DEM)，一种三阶段玻璃箱框架，通过将梯度提升专家模型的知识蒸馏到基于残差的解释性决策树中，实现生理传感器数据异常检测的高精度与可解释性。在多个数据集上达到0.9964 AUC，推理速度比SHAP快1235倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线体域网(WBAN)中生理传感器数据的异常检测可能由传感器故障、网络中断或数据缺失引起，导致误报。现有方法要么是黑盒模型（高精度但不可解释），要么依赖SHAP/LIME等事后解释方法（近似解释而非真实预测过程）。亟需一种兼具高预测准确性和临床可解释性的方法。

Method: 提出三阶段玻璃箱框架DEM：(1) 线性基线模型拟合；(2) XGBoost梯度提升专家模型学习非线性残差；(3) 将专家模型的非线性知识蒸馏到可控制深度的决策树中，该决策树直接对残差进行操作。引入蒸馏保真度指标量化解释树对专家模型非线性贡献的捕捉程度。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV、WESAD、eICU和自建SmartNet WBAN四个数据集上，临床上下文异常检测AUC达0.9964，可穿戴压力检测AUC达0.9047。推理速度0.17ms/1000样本，比SHAP快1235倍。消融实验证实XGBoost蒸馏优于朴素残差拟合，深度敏感性分析展示了用户可控的精度-可解释性权衡。

Conclusion: DEM通过将解释与预测过程合一（而非事后近似），在保持高精度的同时提供透明、可读的if-then规则，且具备可量化的解释可信度指标，适用于实时生理监测场景。其可控深度机制提供了现有内在可解释模型所独有的精度-可解释性权衡。

Abstract: Anomaly detection in physiological sensor data from Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) can be caused by sensor faults, network disruptions, or missing data, leading to false alarms. Hence, it demands both high predictive accuracy and clinically interpretable explanations. Existing approaches rely either on black-box models that achieve strong performance but offer no transparency, or on post-prediction explanation methods such as SHAP and LIME. In this paper, we propose the Distilled Explanation Model (DEM), a three-stage glass-box framework that distills the non-linear knowledge of a gradient boosting expert into an interpretable decision tree operating on residuals relative to a linear baseline, so that the explanation is not an approximation but the prediction itself. DEM introduces a novel distillation fidelity metric that quantifies how faithfully the explanation tree captures the expert model's non-linear contribution, providing a principled measure of explanation trustworthiness absent from prior interpretable models. Evaluated across four physiological datasets, including MIMIC-IV, WESAD, eICU, and an in-house SmartNet WBAN corpus, DEM achieves an AUC of 0.9964 on clinical contextual anomaly detection and 0.9047 on wearable stress detection while producing human-readable if-then rules at a controllable depth. Inference requires 0.17ms per 1000 samples, rendering DEM 1235x faster than SHAP-based post-hoc explanation and suitable for real-time physiological monitoring. Ablation studies confirm that the XGBoost distillation step provides measurable gains over naive residual fitting, and depth-sensitivity analysis demonstrates an explicit, user-controlled accuracy-interpretability trade-off unique to DEM among existing intrinsically interpretable models.

</details>


### [316] [Physics-Informed Coarsening for Multigrid Graph Neural Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31013)
*Amir Bazzi,David Cardinaux,Ramy Nemer,Jose Alaves,Arjun Kalkur Matpadi Raghavendra,Elie Hachem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于多网格图神经网络的固体力学代理模型，采用物理信息指导的粗化策略（残差驱动的节点评分），在非线性弹性、塑性和瞬态问题中相较于传统均匀采样方法显著提升了精度和 rollout 稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的偏微分方程代理模型在流体和结构化几何问题上表现出色，但针对固体力学中非线性弹性、塑性和瞬态行为的鲁棒代理模型仍缺乏探索，标准架构难以处理这些挑战。

Method: 提出多网格图神经网络（MG-GNN），采用编码器-处理器-解码器架构，结合物理信息粗化策略：用残差度量局部物理活动强度，优先保留高应变/应力集中区域，通过层次化消息传递保持长程交互。

Result: 在线性、非线性和瞬态多个数据集上，相比标准采样基线，该方法在精度和 rollout 稳定性上均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: 物理信息指导的粗化策略对于固体力学中可扩展代理建模至关重要。

Abstract: Learning-based surrogates for partial differential equations have recently matched the accuracy of classical solvers while achieving orders-of-magnitude speedups, predominantly in fluid settings and structured geometries. In contrast, robust surrogates for deformable solids remain underexplored, despite the presence of nonlinear elasticity, plasticity, and transient behavior that challenge standard architectures. We introduce a multigrid graph neural network for solid mechanics that couples an encoder-processor-decoder backbone with a physics-informed coarsening strategy. Instead of downsampling via geometric heuristics, our method scores nodes using a residual-based measure of local physical activity and preferentially retains regions of high strain or stress concentration, allocating multiscale capacity where it is most needed. This preserves long-range interactions through hierarchical message passing while improving stability over long rollouts. We evaluate on multiple datasets covering linear, nonlinear, and transient regimes, and observe consistent gains in accuracy and rollout stability compared to standard sampling baselines. Our results highlight the importance of physics-informed coarsening for scalable surrogate modeling in solid mechanics.

</details>


### [317] [Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31022)
*Jeffrey Seely,Julian Gould*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出增广拉格朗日预测编码（PC-ALM），通过引入每层局部拉格朗日乘子累积约束误差，在保持预测编码推理预算的同时，使权重更新方向与反向传播对齐，在深层窄网络中匹配BP性能，并实现快速"弹道式"信用传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测编码（PC）虽提供局部学习的替代方案，但在深层窄网络中性能显著劣于反向传播（BP），其信用传播效率低且缓慢。作者旨在弥合PC与BP之间的性能差距，同时保留PC的局部学习特性。

Method: 将增广拉格朗日方法引入预测编码框架，为每层引入局部拉格朗日乘子以累积约束误差；在每层激活中引入循环动力学，以对偶上升（dual ascent）驱动而非传统PC的标量能量热流；通过局部更新实现全局反向传播梯度的等价计算。

Result: 在线性PC网络中，PC-ALM收敛到精确分布BP梯度的均衡点；在深度达128层的非线性网络中，PC-ALM在所有宽度-深度组合下均匹配BP性能，尤其在深层窄网络中显著优于传统PC。

Conclusion: 增广拉格朗日框架为预测编码提供了泛化形式，展示了通过纯局部动力学计算和传播BP类信用信号的可能性，对理解分布式系统如何实现信用分配具有启示意义。

Abstract: Predictive coding (PC) is a local-learning alternative to backpropagation (BP), training deep networks via local energy-minimization dynamics rather than a global backward pass. We introduce Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding (PC-ALM), which maintains PC's inference budget but aligns each weight update toward BP by accumulating per-layer constraint errors into a layer-local Lagrange multiplier. In linear PC networks, PC-ALM converges to an equilibrium with exact BP gradients distributed across the network via only layer-local updates. We analyze PC-ALM in nonlinear PC networks up to depth 128 and show that it matches BP performance across all width-depth regimes, notably in deep narrow networks where PC underperforms. PC-ALM introduces recurrent dynamics in each layer's activations. Compared to PC's heat flow on a scalar energy, PC-ALM dynamics are driven by dual ascent on the augmented Lagrangian. We observe "ballistic" credit propagation across very deep networks, with credit signals evenly distributed across layers, compared to PC's slow, diffusive credit propagation. Beyond the algorithm itself, the augmented Lagrangian framework offers a generalization of PC, and may yield insights into how distributed systems could compute and propagate BP-like credit signals through purely local dynamics.

</details>


### [318] [Multi-Scale Separable Fourier Neural Networks for Solving High-Frequency PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31027)
*Qihong Yang,Qiaolin He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种多尺度可分离傅里叶神经网络（MS-SFNN），通过可分离表示、固定随机权重、余弦激活函数和高效批处理QR分解，实现高精度、高效地求解线性与非线性高频偏微分方程，显著优于PINN和SV-SNN等现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络方法（如PINN）在求解高频PDE时面临精度低、计算效率差和内存瓶颈等问题，亟需一种既能保持高精度又能高效处理高维高频问题的新型神经网络架构。

Method: MS-SFNN采用可分离表示架构，使用d个独立子网络分别处理每个坐标，通过元素乘构造基函数，再用最小二乘求解系数。所有网络权重和偏置从均匀分布中随机初始化一次后固定，引入可调缩放因子调节基函数频率，使用余弦激活嵌入傅里叶特征。为缓解内存瓶颈，采用解析导数替代自动微分，并开发了内存高效的批处理QR分解算法。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的线性与非线性高频PDE数值实验中，MS-SFNN取得了前所未有的精度，显著优于PINN和SV-SNN等最先进方法。

Conclusion: MS-SFNN通过可分离傅里叶神经网络架构，结合固定随机权重与批处理QR分解，在高频PDE求解中实现了精度与效率的突破，为神经求解器的发展提供了新的方向。

Abstract: We propose a novel neural network architecture, termed Multi-Scale Separable Fourier Neural Networks (MS-SFNN), for the accurate and efficient solution of linear and nonlinear high-frequency partial differential equations (PDEs). MS-SFNN exploits a separable representation: given a $d$-dimensional input, it employs $d$ independent subnetworks -- each acting on a single coordinate -- and constructs basis functions via element-wise multiplication of their outputs. The PDE solution is approximated as a linear combination of these basis functions, with coefficients determined by least squares. Critically, all network weights and biases are randomly initialized once, from a uniform distribution with unit variance, and remain fixed thereafter. To enhance expressivity, a tunable scaling factor is introduced in each subnetwork to modulate the frequency content of the resulting basis functions. Fourier features are explicitly embedded through cosine activations, endowing the method with strong spectral approximation capabilities. To mitigate the memory bottleneck associated with dense collocation in high-frequency or three-dimensional problems, we replace automatic differentiation with analytically derived basis function derivatives and develop a memory-efficient batched QR decomposition algorithm for solving large-scale least-squares systems. Numerical experiments demonstrate that MS-SFNN achieves unprecedented accuracy across a range of challenging PDEs, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods such as Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN) and Separated-Variable Spectral Neural Networks (SV-SNN).

</details>


### [319] [Annealed Softmax Greedy in Many-Armed Bayesian Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31034)
*William Overman,Mohsen Bayati*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了无需显式不确定性追踪的强化学习（如RLVR和GRPO）为何仍然有效。通过分析退火softmax贪心策略在多臂贝叶斯伯努利强盗问题中的表现，证明在满足β-正则性（β=1）条件下，该策略可实现接近最优的贝叶斯遗憾界$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$，其有效性源于大量近优臂的存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释为什么RLVR和GRPO等基于可验证奖励的强化学习方法虽然不包含显式的不确定性追踪机制，却仍然能够有效工作。

Method: 将问题建模为多臂贝叶斯伯努利强盗问题，分析退火softmax（Boltzmann）策略的贝叶斯遗憾。在满足β-正则性（β=1）的线性上尾条件下进行理论分析，并与经验均值贪心策略进行对比。

Result: 在β=1的线性上尾条件下，退火softmax贪心策略实现了$\tilde{O}(m + T/m)$的贝叶斯遗憾，当臂数$m = Θ(\sqrt{T})$时达到$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$的接近最优遗憾率。但在臂数较少时，该策略会遭受线性遗憾。

Conclusion: 大量近优臂的存在是退火softmax策略有效性的关键。这为RLVR提供了结构类比：基础策略以不可忽略的概率生成正确回答，扮演了β-正则性的角色。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and group-based policy optimization methods such as GRPO update a stochastic policy by sampling multiple completions per prompt and increasing the policy's probability on those with higher reward, regularized by a KL penalty toward a reference policy. These updates do not include explicit mechanisms that track epistemic uncertainty. This paper studies a stylized explanation for why such uncertainty-agnostic updates can nevertheless be effective. We analyze an annealed softmax (Boltzmann) policy that selects actions according to a softmax of empirical mean rewards in a many-armed Bayesian Bernoulli bandit. Under a linear upper-tail condition on the prior (the $β=1$ case of $β$-regularity), which implies an abundance of near-optimal arms, we prove that annealed softmax greedy achieves Bayes regret $\tilde{O}(m + T/m)$, and in particular $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ when the number of arms scales as $m = Θ(\sqrt{T})$. This is the near-optimal Bayes regret rate in this regime, attained also by empirical-mean greedy. Under $β$-regularity, many arms maintain empirical means close to the optimum throughout learning, so when softmax samples an arm other than the empirically best, that arm tends to be another near-optimal one rather than a clearly inferior one. By contrast, with a small number of arms, the same kind of softmax policy can suffer linear regret. The result also provides a structural analogy to RLVR, where a base policy with a non-negligible probability of producing a correct completion plays the role of $β$-regularity.

</details>


### [320] [UniRTL: Unifying Code and Graph for Robust RTL Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31040)
*Yi Liu,Hongji Zhang,Lei Chen,Mingxuan Yuan,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UniRTL是一个针对RTL设计的多模态预训练框架，通过联合利用代码和控制数据流图(CDFG)两种互补模态，采用互掩码建模和分层训练策略学习统一的RTL表示，在性能预测和代码检索任务上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RTL设计表示方法通常依赖单一数据模态（仅RTL代码或仅图表示），限制了所学表示的表达能力和泛化能力。本文认为整合代码和CDFG这两种互补模态对于全面理解RTL设计至关重要。

Method: 提出UniRTL多模态预训练框架：(1) 通过互掩码建模实现代码与CDFG的细粒度对齐；(2) 采用分层训练策略，包含预训练的图感知分词器，以及先对齐功能摘要文本与代码、再逐步整合图结构的分阶段对齐方法。

Result: 在性能预测和代码检索两个下游任务、多种设置下的实验结果表明，UniRTL持续优于先前方法，被验证为更鲁棒且强大的硬件设计自动化基础框架。

Conclusion: UniRTL通过多模态融合有效提升了RTL表示的鲁棒性和泛化能力，为加速硬件设计自动化提供了更强大的基础表示方法。

Abstract: Developing effective representations for register transfer level (RTL) designs is crucial for accelerating the hardware design workflow. Existing approaches, however, typically rely on a single data modality, either the RTL code or its associated graph-based representation, limiting the expressiveness and generalization ability of the learned representations. For RTL, the control data flow graph (CDFG) offers a comprehensive structural representation that preserves complete information, while the code modality explicitly encodes semantic and functional information. We argue that integrating these complementary modalities is essential for a thorough understanding of RTL designs. To this end, we propose UniRTL, a multimodal pretraining framework that learns unified RTL representations by jointly leveraging code and CDFG. UniRTL achieves fine-grained alignment between code and graph through mutual masked modeling and employs a hierarchical training strategy that incorporates a pretrained graph-aware tokenizer and staged alignment of text (i.e., functional summary) and code prior to graph integration. We evaluate UniRTL on two downstream tasks, performance prediction and code retrieval, under multiple settings. Experimental results show that UniRTL consistently outperforms prior methods, establishing it as a more robust and powerful foundation for advancing hardware design automation.

</details>


### [321] [The Challenges of Using Reinforcement Learning for Controlling Industrial Energy Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31044)
*Tobias Lademann,Théo Vincent,Jan Peters,Matthias Weigold*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了强化学习在真实工业能源系统中的部署挑战，以热力供暖网络为例，从MDP形式化描述的结构出发，系统分析了部分可观测性、动作空间设计、奖励设计及仿真到现实迁移等挑战，并基于实际部署发现强化学习虽能实现运行稳定性，但与仿真存在显著性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习研究大多局限于仿真环境，缺乏对真实工业能源系统部署挑战的系统性分析，亟需理解从仿真到实际部署的差距及其根源。

Method: 将工业热能网络控制任务建模为马尔可夫决策过程，沿形式化描述的结构（部分可观测性、动作空间设计、奖励设计、仿真到现实迁移）系统分析部署挑战，并在真实系统中进行实际部署验证。

Result: 强化学习在真实工业能源系统中能实现运行稳定性，但与仿真结果相比存在显著的性能差距，表明仿真到现实的迁移问题在实际部署中尤为突出。

Conclusion: 实际部署强化学习面临仿真环境无法完全复现的诸多挑战，未来工作需重点关注缩小仿真与现实之间的性能差距，提升算法的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has shown promising results for optimizing the control of industrial energy systems, yet most existing studies remain limited to the application in simulation environments. We investigate the challenges of deploying reinforcement learning in a real-world industrial energy system, considering a thermal heating network as a use case. We formulate the task as a Markov Decision Process and systematically analyze the associated challenges along the structure of the formal description, including partial observability, action space design, reward design, and the simulation-to-reality gap. The challenges are grounded in an existing real-world deployment, where reinforcement learning achieves operational stability but shows a significant performance gap compared to simulation.

</details>


### [322] [Learning to Solve and Optimize by Evolving Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31049)
*Veronika Semmelrock,Benedetta Strizzolo,Francesco Zuccato,Gerhard Friedrich,Patrick Rodler,Konstantin Schekotihin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CHECKMATE工具，通过代码进化实现算法自动生成，仅需形式化规范（what）而无需专家设计求解过程（how），在工业配置与调度问题上超越现有最优求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模组合与优化问题需要专家精心设计求解器与启发式策略，即不仅要说明"解决什么"，还要指定"如何解决"。本文旨在消除对"如何解决"的依赖，仅通过形式化规范与自然语言描述自动生成高效算法。

Method: 提出CHECKMATE框架，结合形式化规范（保证解的正确性并支持系统性能评估）与自然语言描述（引导进化过程），通过代码进化自动生成求解算法。

Result: 在配置与调度两个工业领域的多个问题上，CHECKMATE进化生成的算法一致性地超越了现有最优求解器。

Conclusion: 形式化方法在引导代码进化方面具有巨大潜力，能够自动解决复杂现实问题，代表了从"如何求解"到"仅需定义问题"的范式转变。

Abstract: Combinatorial and optimization problems are fundamental to many industrial AI applications. Solving large-scale real-world instances of such problems typically requires careful problem formalization, specialized solvers, and expert-designed heuristics. Thus, experts need to specify not only what solutions are, but also how they are derived. By introducing the tool CHECKMATE, we show that algorithm generation via code evolution represents a paradigm shift by eliminating the need to formulate the how. CHECKMATE solely relies on the what. Specifically, a formal specification ensures solutions' correctness and enables systematic performance evaluation of the generated programs, while a natural language description guides the evolutionary process. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated on selected problems from two industrial domains: configuration and scheduling. In all cases, the evolved algorithms consistently outperform state-of-the-art solvers. This underscores the potential of formal methods in guiding code evolution for automatically solving complex real-world problems.

</details>


### [323] [Best-Arm Identification-Based Trust Region Selection for Bayesian Optimization on Multimodal Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31050)
*Nobuo Namura,Sho Takemori*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种轨迹感知的贝叶斯优化框架，将最佳臂识别与信任区域BO相结合，通过外推多个局部优化器的轨迹并逐步淘汰次优候选者，加速多模态优化问题的全局收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯过程贝叶斯优化在复杂多模态或高维问题上性能下降，信任区域BO虽有所缓解但仍需更有效的区域选择策略。

Method: 将信任区域选择建模为多臂赌博机问题，集成最佳臂识别（BAI）机制，外推多个局部初始化优化器的轨迹以预测其最终性能，并逐步淘汰次优候选者。

Result: 在温和假设下理论上证明了所提方法比传统BO更快收敛到全局最优，并在合成和真实基准实验中验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 轨迹感知的BAI引导BO框架能有效提升多模态优化问题的求解效率与全局收敛性能。

Abstract: Gaussian process-based Bayesian optimization (BO) is a popular approach for expensive black-box optimization, but its performance often degrades on complex multimodal or high-dimensional problems. Trust region-based BO mitigates this issue by focusing on local regions, and recent studies suggest that selecting an effective region can be formulated as a multi-armed bandit problem. We propose a trajectory-aware framework that integrates best-arm identification (BAI) with trust region-based BO to efficiently solve multimodal optimization problems. Our method extrapolates the optimization trajectories of multiple locally initialized optimizers to predict their final performance and progressively eliminates suboptimal candidates via BAI. We theoretically show that the proposed BAI-guided BO converges faster to the global optimum than conventional BO under mild assumptions, and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.

</details>


### [324] [STEP: Learning STructured Embeddings for Progressive Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31061)
*Lucas Thil,Jesse Read,Rim Kaddah,Guillaume Doquet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种自监督对比方法，学习渐进时间序列的可解释低维潜空间表示，其中极坐标(θ, r)分别追踪状态进展和运行模式，无需代理标签，在工业退化、机器人任务和神经活动等多个领域达到或超越黑盒方法性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列表示学习方法通常缺乏可解释性，难以在捕捉渐进过程（如退化、任务完成）的同时，将状态进展与运行模式解耦，且依赖代理标签。

Method: 采用自监督对比学习目标，学习以两个固定正交原型向量为锚点的低维流形潜空间；每个观测点映射到该流形上，轨迹对应流形上的路径；潜向量的极坐标(θ, r)构成“潜指南针”，θ追踪状态进展，r标识活跃模式。

Result: 在工业退化、机器人任务和神经活动等多个领域验证了三个关键能力：终态预测、多步预测和可解释的相位分离。方法在所有任务上匹配或超越黑盒方法，且潜指南针坐标上的简单线性回归器即可与深度架构竞争。

Conclusion: 潜空间的几何结构本身即提供了可解释性，状态进展被编码为几何可访问的形式，为透明化时间序列建模提供了有效框架。

Abstract: We present a novel method for learning interpretable representations of progressive time series, that is, data capturing irreversible state transitions such as degradation or task completion. Our approach uses a self-supervised contrastive objective to learn a low-dimensional latent space whose geometry is itself the interpretation: each observation becomes a point on a manifold anchored between two fixed orthogonal prototype vectors, and a trajectory becomes a path across that manifold. From this structure we read a latent compass, the polar coordinates (θ, r) of the latent vector, in which θ tracks the progression of the underlying state (e.g., from healthy to failed) and r identifies the active mode (e.g., the operating condition), without any proxy labels. We evaluate the approach against the state of the art on diverse domains, including industrial degradation, robotic tasks, and neural activity, validating three key capabilities: (1) end-state prediction, (2) multi-step forecasting, and (3) interpretable phase separation. Our method matches or improves over black-box counterparts on all of these while providing transparency about the underlying mechanisms. A simple linear regressor on top of the latent compass coordinates is competitive with deep architectures, direct quantitative evidence that the underlying state is encoded in a geometrically accessible form.

</details>


### [325] [Learning to Bid in FCR Markets: A Best-of-Both-Worlds Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31070)
*Marius Potfer,Cheng Wan,Pierre Gruet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了欧洲频率包含储备（FCR）市场的竞价问题，将多国FCR出清问题重新表述为重复多单元统一价格拍卖，并适配了一种“两全其美”的组合半老虎机算法，实现了在随机环境下的对数伪遗憾和对抗环境下的O(√T)遗憾，历史数据回测验证了其实际竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FCR市场中竞争报价隐藏，竞标者仅能观察到部分反馈（如出清价格和中标量），这使得灵活资源提供者的竞价策略设计面临挑战。现有方法缺乏理论保证和实际适用性，因此需要一种既有理论支撑又能在实践中有效的学习型竞价方法。

Method: 将多国FCR出清问题重新表述为针对内生对手报价向量的重复多单元统一价格拍卖，将其转化为在线学习问题，并适配一种“两全其美”（Best-of-Both-Worlds）组合半老虎机算法，该算法仅需标准市场反馈即可实现。

Result: 在随机环境下取得对数伪遗憾，在对抗环境下取得O(√T)遗憾；合成实验验证了预期的缩放规律；在欧洲FCR历史数据回测中展现出竞争力，在稳定产品上表现优异，而EXP3类基线在强非平稳性下更安全。

Conclusion: 基于学习的FCR市场竞价方法在理论上是成立的，在实践中也是有用的，前提是学习规则与产品层面的市场稳定性相匹配。

Abstract: Bidding in the European Frequency Containment Reserve (FCR) market is challenging for flexibility providers because competing offers are hidden and bidders observe only partial feedback form the market, such as, clearing price and awarded quantity. For a participant active in a single country, we show that the multi-country FCR clearing problem can be recast as a repeated multi-unit uniform-price auction against an endogenous vector of opposing bids. This reformulation yields an online learning problem and allows us to adapt a Best-of-Both-Worlds combinatorial semi-bandit algorithm implementable from this standard market feedback. The resulting bidder achieves logarithmic pseudo-regret in stochastic environments and $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret in adversarial ones. Synthetic experiments confirm the expected scaling, and backtests on historical European FCR data show competitive performance in practice: the method performs especially well on stable products, while EXP3-type baselines can be safer under stronger non-stationarity. Overall, the results show that learning-based bidding in FCR markets is theoretically grounded and practically useful when the learning rule matches product-level market stability.

</details>


### [326] [Riemannian Diffusion Models on General Manifolds via Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31106)
*Gyeonghoon Ko,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种利用物理信息神经网络(PINN)近似流形热核的方法，从而将黎曼扩散模型推广到任意显式定义的流形，无需热核的闭式解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黎曼扩散模型需要流形热核的解析形式，但除少数高度对称的流形外，热核极少有闭式解，限制了模型的应用范围。

Method: 给定显式流形规范，选择坐标系，推导对应的热方程（Fokker-Planck方程）和短时渐近近似，然后训练PINN学习对数热核，同时支持前向加噪（热核采样）和条件分数评估（去噪分数匹配）。

Result: 在S²、SO(3)、SPD(n)和置换商点云等多种流形上验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法将黎曼扩散模型推广到任意显式定义的流形，打破了热核闭式解的限制，拓展了生成建模在流形数据上的适用范围。

Abstract: Riemannian diffusion models generalize score-based generative modeling to manifold-supported data via stochastic diffusion equations on the manifold. However, training requires sampling from and differentiating the manifold heat kernel, which is rarely available in closed form beyond a few highly symmetric manifolds. We propose a general approach that approximates the heat kernel by directly solving the manifold heat equation with a physics-informed neural network (PINN). Given an explicit manifold specification, we choose a coordinate system, derive the corresponding heat (Fokker--Planck) equation and a short-time asymptotic approximation, and then train a PINN to learn the log heat kernel. The resulting surrogate enables both forward noising (heat-kernel sampling) and conditional-score evaluation for denoising score matching. We demonstrate the method on diverse manifolds including $S^2$, $SO(3)$, $\mathrm{SPD}(n)$, and permutation-quotiented point clouds.

</details>


### [327] [Subspace-Decomposed JEPAs: Disentangling Progression and Content in Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31111)
*Lucas Thil,Jesse Read,Rim Kaddah,Guillaume Doquet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SD-JEPA将JEPA潜表征分解为正交的两个子空间：低维的进度子空间（由余弦边界三元组损失塑造）和高维的内容子空间（由SIGReg正则化），证明两种抗坍塌力作用于不相交的坐标，从而加性组合而非竞争。该方法在大多数控制基准上优于LeWM基线，且产生的1D角度进度坐标可作为场景感知的指南针，在回溯时回归、受扰动时重新定位到语义适当的新阶段，量化测试显示其优于标准潜预测误差的惊奇定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA学习紧凑的潜世界模型，但没有任何单一潜坐标被指定编码任务进度，因此需要显式地将进度信息分离出来。

Method: 将JEPA潜表征分解为正交的进度子空间（低维，余弦边界三元组损失）和内容子空间（高维，SIGReg正则化），证明两种抗坍塌力作用在不相交坐标上因此加性组合。

Result: SD-JEPA在大多数控制基准上优于LeWM基线，且优于非LeWM的JEPA基线；1D角度进度坐标可作场景感知指南针，其|Δθ_t|在定位语义事件上优于标准潜预测误差，AUROC提升最多+0.18（97.5%胜率）；8维进度子空间（占潜的4.2%）解释72-95%的任务进度方差。

Conclusion: 通过分解潜空间为进度和内容子空间，SD-JEPA不仅提升了控制性能，还获得了可解释的进度信号，能区分"惊奇时刻"与"惊奇的意义"，这是预测误差标量无法做到的。

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn compact latent world models by predicting future embeddings, but no single coordinate of the latent is designated to encode task progression. We carve the JEPA latent into two orthogonal subspaces with disjoint roles: a low-dimensional progression subspace shaped by a cosine-margin triplet loss, and a high-dimensional content subspace regularised by the existing SIGReg objective of LeWM. We prove that the two anti-collapse forces act on disjoint coordinates, so they compose additively rather than competing on the same dimensions. Our method, SD-JEPA improves over the LeWM baseline on the majority of its control benchmarks at matched compute, and outperforms the strongest non-LeWM JEPA baseline on Push-T; a subspace-ablation falsifier confirms the split is the load-bearing ingredient. Beyond planning, the resulting 1-D angular progression coordinate functions as a scene-aware compass on the latent. It advances with task progress, regresses when the agent backtracks, and under controlled perturbations both spikes and relocalises to a semantically appropriate new task-phase sector, separating the moment of surprise from its meaning in a way that prediction-error scalars cannot. Three quantitative tests back this up: $|Δθ_t|$ outperforms the standard latent-prediction-error surprise at localising semantic events on 40 held-out cube episodes by up to +0.18 pooled AUROC (97.5% per-episode win rate at $\pm 1$-step tolerance); a within-episode linear probe across all four environments (40 episodes per env) shows the 8-dimensional progression subspace (4.2% of the latent) explains 72-95% of task-progress variance..

</details>


### [328] [Scalable Bayesian Inference for Nonlinear Conservation Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31127)
*Tim Weiland,Philipp Hennig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于高斯过程先验的数值保守方法，用于非线性守恒律的不确定性感知模拟，结合稀疏近似技术处理大规模正问题和反问题，在保持经典求解器精度的同时提供结构化不确定性量化，并在反问题中实现秒级后验推断，优于需要数分钟且精度更低的神经基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性守恒律在科学和工程中至关重要，但实际应用中常受稀疏或噪声测量等不确定性因素影响，导致推断问题不适定。经典数值方法和现代深度学习方法都难以恰当处理这一问题，亟需一种既能保持数值精度又能量化不确定性的方法。

Method: 将经典数值方法框架转化为高斯过程先验下的贝叶斯推断，从而获得物理感知的不确定性处理能力；采用稀疏近似技术以实现大规模正问题和反问题的可扩展性。

Result: 前向模拟在继承经典求解器精度的同时提供了结构化不确定性量化；反问题中可在数秒内恢复非参数源场的后验分布，而神经基线方法需要数分钟且只能提供精度较差的点估计。

Conclusion: 该方法有效结合了经典数值方法的保守性与贝叶斯推断的不确定性量化能力，在大规模问题上具备可扩展性，并在反问题求解速度和精度上显著优于神经网络基线方法。

Abstract: Nonlinear conservation laws are at the heart of many of the most important dynamical systems in science and engineering. In practical applications, such systems are often subject to various sources of uncertainty, e.g. due to sparse or noisy measurements. Inferring physical quantities and fields of interest then becomes an ill-posed problem which both classical numerical methods and modern deep learning-based methods struggle to treat appropriately. Recent work has framed classical numerical methods as Bayesian inference under Gaussian process priors, resulting in a physics-aware treatment of uncertainties. Following this line of work, we develop a novel numerically conservative method for uncertainty-aware simulations of nonlinear conservation laws. We use recent sparse approximation techniques to scale up to large-scale forward and inverse problems. For forward simulation, we inherit the accuracy of classical solvers while providing structured uncertainty quantification. On inverse problems, we recover posteriors over nonparametric source fields in seconds -- outperforming neural baselines that take minutes to produce a less accurate point estimate.

</details>


### [329] [Generalizing Multi-Scale Time-Series Modeling with a Single Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31129)
*Cheonwoo Lee,Dooho Lee,Doyun Choi,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SiGMA（单一广义多尺度架构），通过可学习离散高斯核实现距离感知缩放，统一了现有缩放方法，在长期和短期时间序列预测中超越现有最佳方法，训练速度提升最高5.3倍，内存消耗降低最高3.8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多尺度建模方法依赖固定且离散的缩放，缺乏原则性的理论基础，限制了时间序列预测的性能。

Method: 将现有缩放方法统一为缩放算子族，提出SiGMA架构，引入基于尺度空间理论的可学习离散高斯（LDG）核，实现距离感知缩放。

Result: 在长期（16个设置中13个最优）和短期预测基准上全面超越SOTA多尺度基线；训练速度提升最高5.3倍，内存消耗降低最高3.8倍。

Conclusion: SiGMA通过可学习的距离感知缩放有效克服了固定离散缩放的局限性，显著提升了预测精度与计算效率。

Abstract: Multi-scale modeling has emerged as an effective design principle for time-series forecasting by capturing temporal dynamics at multiple resolutions. As no principled foundation has been established in the literature, we unify existing scaling methods into a scaling operator family, revealing a fundamental limitation of existing approaches: reliance on fixed and discrete scaling. To address this limitation, we propose SiGMA (Single Generalized Multi-scale Architecture), which enables distance-aware scaling via the learnable discrete Gaussian (LDG) kernel grounded in scale-space theory. We evaluate SiGMA comprehensively on long- and short-term forecasting benchmarks against state-of-the-art multi-scale baselines. SiGMA outperforms all competitors on both tasks, especially achieving the best performance in 13 out of 16 long-term evaluation settings. Beyond accuracy, SiGMA significantly improves training speed by up to 5.3 times and reduces memory consumption by up to 3.8 times over the strongest competitors. Code is available at https://github.com/cheonwoolee/SiGMA.

</details>


### [330] [Learning Hyperspherical Time-Frequency Representations for Time-Series Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31155)
*Willian T. Lunardi,Samridha Shrestha,Martin Andreoni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于超球面嵌入的时序数据分布外检测方法，利用von Mises-Fisher似然目标函数学习类条件表示，融合时域和频域特征，在UCR和UEA数据集上优于对比学习和后处理方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序数据的OOD检测相较于视觉和语言领域研究不足，缺乏对监督时序表示如何用于可靠分布偏移检测的 principled 理解。

Method: 将时序OOD检测建模为超球面嵌入的表示学习，使用vMF似然目标在单位球面上诱导类条件结构；通过域特定编码器融合时域和频域视图，整合到联合嵌入空间；使用k-NN和马氏距离进行OOD检测。

Result: 在完整的UCR和UEA时序数据集上，该方法在k-NN和马氏距离评分下均一致优于强对比学习和后处理基线方法。

Conclusion: 基于超球面嵌入的vMF似然目标函数能有效学习时序数据的判别性表示，融合时频域信息有助于提升OOD检测性能。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection for time-series data remains comparatively underexplored compared to vision and language, with a limited principled understanding of how supervised time-series representations can be leveraged for reliable detection under distributional shifts. This work formulates time-series OOD detection as representation learning with hyperspherical embeddings, where class-conditional structure is induced by a von Mises-Fisher (vMF) likelihood-based objective on the unit sphere. The learned representation combines time- and frequency-domain views of the input signal via domain-specific encoders, integrating them into a joint embedding space for OOD detection. Detection uses distance-based scores over the learned embeddings, including k-nearest neighbors (k-NN) and Mahalanobis scores. We evaluate the approach at scale on the complete UCR and UEA time-series archives under a cross-dataset protocol. Empirical results show consistent improvements under both k-NN and Mahalanobis scoring over strong contrastive learning and post-hoc baselines in the same setting. Code is available at https://github.com/tiiuae/hypertf-time-series-ood.

</details>


### [331] [TabCausal: Pretraining Across Causal Environments for Tabular Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31156)
*Zi-Rong Li,Si-Yang Liu,Tian-Zuo Wang,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TabCausal，一种基于数据驱动的因果发现基础模型（CDFM），通过构建多样化的因果预训练任务（涵盖不同图先验、结构机制、噪声模型、维度、样本量和干预机制），实现了从观测和混合干预数据中可迁移的因果结构学习，在合成和语义基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现基础模型（CDFMs）性能有限，往往无法持续匹敌经典方法，关键瓶颈在于因果预训练任务的构建方式不够合理。

Method: 提出TabCausal，采用广泛的因果预训练策略，覆盖多样化的图先验、结构机制、噪声模型、维度、样本量和干预机制；通过动态任务构建策略组合这些因果环境为多样的发现任务；并引入协议引导和LLM审核的语义因果环境基准用于分布外分析。

Result: 在大规模合成基准上，TabCausal的宏观平均性能优于多种因果发现基线方法；在语义因果环境中也展现出稳健的结构恢复能力，尤其在干预证据下表现突出。

Conclusion: 广泛的因果预训练是实现可迁移的摊销因果发现的关键因素，TabCausal验证了通过数据驱动方式构建多样化预训练任务能够有效提升因果发现基础模型的泛化能力。

Abstract: Causal discovery aims to recover directed causal relations from observational and interventional data, providing a basis for mechanistic understanding and reliable decision-making. Causal discovery foundation models (CDFMs) seek to amortize this problem by mapping a dataset directly to a causal graph in a single forward pass, avoiding per-dataset testing, search, or optimization. However, existing CDFMs remain limited, often failing to consistently match strong classical methods, and we find that a key bottleneck is how causal pretraining tasks are constructed. Based on this observation, we propose TabCausal, a data-driven CDFM trained with broad causal pretraining over diverse graph priors, structural mechanisms, noise models, dimensions, sample sizes, and intervention regimes. A dynamic task construction strategy composes these causal environments into varied discovery tasks, enabling more transferable structural learning from observational and mixed-interventional data. On large-scale synthetic benchmarks, TabCausal achieves better macro-averaged performance than a diverse set of causal discovery baselines. To further bridge abstract synthetic generators and realistic causal reasoning scenarios, we introduce a protocol-guided and LLM-audited semantic causal environment benchmark, where domain-grounded SCMs generate interpretable observational and interventional datasets for out-of-distribution analysis. Across both synthetic and semantic environments, TabCausal demonstrates robust structure recovery, especially under interventional evidence, highlighting broad causal pretraining as a key ingredient for transferable amortized causal discovery.

</details>


### [332] [Trust-Region Behavior Blending for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31159)
*Daniil Plyusov,Alexey Gorbatovski,Alexey Malakhov,Nikita Balagansky,Boris Shaposhnikov,Daria Korotyshova,Daniil Gavrilov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出信任域行为混合（TRB）方法，通过在学生策略周围设置KL信任域，用最接近教师的先验行为策略替换早期rollout策略，解决在线策略蒸馏中早期rollout质量差的问题，并在KL预算退火至零后恢复纯学生rollout训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏中，学生早期的rollout质量差，导致教师监督建立在弱或低质量前缀上，影响蒸馏效果。

Method: 提出Trust-Region behavior Blending (TRB)，在信任域内用最接近教师的行为策略替换早期rollout策略，保持逐前缀反向KL蒸馏损失不变，并逐步将KL预算退火至零以恢复纯学生rollout。

Result: 在两个数学推理蒸馏任务中，TRB在所有对比方法中取得了最优的平均性能。

Conclusion: TRB作为一种warmup方法，有效缓解了在线策略蒸馏中早期rollout质量差的问题，提升了蒸馏效果。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on prefixes sampled from its own policy while matching a stronger teacher. This addresses the prefix mismatch of offline distillation, but early student rollouts can still be poor, placing teacher supervision on weak or low-quality prefixes. We propose Trust-Region behavior Blending (TRB), a warmup method that replaces the early rollout policy with the closest-to-teacher behavior policy inside a student-centered KL trust region, while keeping the per-prefix reverse-KL OPD loss unchanged. The KL budget is annealed to zero, so training returns to pure student rollouts after warmup. Across two math-reasoning distillation settings, TRB attains the strongest average among the compared methods.

</details>


### [333] [Convergence of Two-Timescale Markovian Stochastic Approximations with Applications in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31172)
*Vagul Mahadevan,Claire Chen,Shuze Daniel Liu,Shangtong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了双时间尺度随机逼近方法在马尔可夫噪声下的稳定性与收敛性，无需投影算子或紧致噪声空间，并通过控制快时间尺度参数的新技术，首次证明了离策略线性函数逼近下带资格迹的TDC算法的几乎必然收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的双时间尺度SA方法仅在i.i.d.噪声下证明了稳定性与收敛性，而强化学习中实际面临的是马尔可夫噪声（非独立同分布）。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，建立更贴近实际RL场景的理论保证。

Method: 核心技术创新在于：用慢时间尺度参数的运行最大值（running max）来控制快时间尺度参数，而非像以往工作那样使用当前慢时间尺度参数。这种方法无需使用投影算子，也无需假设噪声位于紧致空间。

Result: 建立了双时间尺度SA在马尔可夫噪声下的稳定性（有界性）和收敛性。作为关键应用，首次证明了离策略线性函数逼近下带资格迹的TDC算法的几乎必然收敛。

Conclusion: 本文的理论结果将双时间尺度SA的收敛性分析从i.i.d.噪声推广到更现实的马尔可夫噪声设定，为TDC、actor-critic等RL算法提供了更坚实的理论基础。

Abstract: This work studies the convergence of two-timescale stochastic approximations (SA), a class of iterative algorithms that update two sets of parameters in fast and slow timescales respectively. Notable examples of two-timescale SA in reinforcement learning (RL) include temporal difference learning with gradient correction (TDC) and actor-critic methods. Previously, the stability (i.e., boundedness) and convergence of two-timescale SA were only established under i.i.d. noise. This work instead establishes the stability and convergence of two-timescale SA under Markovian noise, a setup that is more realistic in RL. Notably, we do not need to use any projection operator and the noise does not need to live in a compact space. Our key technical novelty is to control the fast timescale parameter with the running max of the slow timescale parameter, instead of with the current slow timescale parameter, as most prior works do. As a key application, we establish the first almost sure convergence of TDC with eligibility traces under off-policy learning with linear function approximation.

</details>


### [334] [Retriever Portfolios: A Principled Approach to Adaptive RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31176)
*Miltiadis Stouras,Vincent Cohen-Addad,Silvio Lattanzi,Ola Svensson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自动选择小型多样化检索器组合（Portfolio）的方法，通过对查询分布进行期望最佳k优化，在多个QA基准测试中优于单检索器和简单多检索器基线，并在保持准确率的同时显著降低延迟和Token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统通常使用单一检索器和一组超参数，但实际查询高度异构（从简单事实型到复杂多跳推理），单一配置无法覆盖所有查询类型，导致性能受限。

Method: 提出基于期望最佳k目标（expected best-of-k objective）的检索器组合（Portfolio）自动选择方法，从大型候选池中选择小型多样化子集，并设计了具有近最优保证的高效构建算法，同时结合路由管道（router pipeline）进行查询分配。

Result: 在多个QA基准上，学习到的Portfolio和路由管道在检索指标和回答质量上均优于单检索器和朴素多检索器基线；与推理时超参数调优方法相比，固定Portfolio支持并行检索和LLM调用，在相当或更好准确率下显著降低延迟和Token成本。

Conclusion: 通过自动选择多样化的检索器组合，可以更有效地覆盖异构查询分布，在提升RAG系统性能的同时兼顾效率和成本，是一种实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically rely on a single retriever and a single set of hyperparameters, despite facing highly heterogeneous queries that range from simple factoid questions to complex multi-hop reasoning. We propose a method that automatically selects a small, diverse subset of retrievers (a portfolio) from a large pool of candidates, to cover different regions of the target query distribution. We formalize this setting via an expected best-of-$k$ objective over the query distribution and show that it admits an efficient portfolio construction algorithm with near-optimal guarantees. Across multiple QA benchmarks, our learned portfolios and router pipeline consistently outperform single-retriever and naive multi-retriever baselines on both retrieval metrics and answer quality. In addition, compared to inference-time hyperparameter tuning approaches, fixed portfolios enable parallel retrieval and LLM calls, achieving comparable (and sometimes better) accuracy with substantially lower latency and token cost.

</details>


### [335] [How well does Classification Accuracy capture Concept Drift Detection Quality? An overview of Concept Drift Detection evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31186)
*Joanna Komorniczak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了合成非平稳数据流中漂移检测质量指标与分类性能之间的关系，分析了七种数据流生成工具下的八种漂移检测质量指标，旨在识别最具信息量的指标集并深入理解评估方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学界尚未建立统一的概念漂移检测评估框架，现有研究常依赖分类质量指标，但分类质量受多因素影响，不能可靠反映漂移检测质量。

Method: 研究了八种漂移检测质量指标与分类器性能之间的关系，涉及七种合成数据流生成工具，并将漂移动态作为影响因素纳入分析。

Result: 识别出最具信息量的漂移检测质量指标集，提供了对评估方法的深入理解。

Conclusion: 本研究为建立统一的概念漂移检测评估框架提供了基础，揭示了漂移检测质量指标与分类性能之间的复杂关系。

Abstract: Data streams are nowadays among the most frequently analyzed data structures, with the concept drift posing a major challenge encountered by processing systems. Despite the proposition of numerous solutions to counteract the accuracy degeneration due to concept drift, the scientific community has not yet established a unified framework for evaluating the concept drift detection task. Existing research often relies on classification quality metrics, but these can be affected by multiple factors and may not reliably reflect drift detection quality. In this work, we present an in-depth overview of the relationship between metrics for quantifying drift detection quality and classification performance in synthetic nonstationary data streams. The proposed research studies eight drift detection quality metrics in relation to the classifier's performance across seven synthetic data stream generation tools, additionally considering drift dynamics as a factor. The studies aim to identify the most informative set of drift detection quality metrics and provide a deep understanding of the method's evaluation.

</details>


### [336] [FlagGAM: Rule-Based Generalized Additive Modeling for Explainable Tabular Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31189)
*Zijie Zhao,Roy E. Welsch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlagGAM提出了一个基于规则定义基函数的框架，将特征层面的规则构建与预测分离，通过稀疏、可读的单变量基函数（包括阈值标志、类别标志、尾偏差基和类别阶梯函数）和默认的加性预测头，在表格数据上实现了接近EBM的透明加性模型性能，同时在缺失和噪声扰动下比常见基线更鲁棒，灵活预测头可进一步逼近强树模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险的表格预测任务需要模型同时具备准确性、透明性和对不完美输入的鲁棒性，现有方法在这三者之间难以取得良好平衡。

Method: 提出FlagGAM框架，包含Flag Core Module（将数值和类别变量转化为稀疏可读的单变量基函数，如阈值标志、类别标志、尾偏差基和类别阶梯函数）和默认加性预测头（类似受限GAM），保留稀疏规则基矩阵而非压缩为计数摘要，支持混合类型分类/回归、特征特定权重和灵活预测头。

Result: 在表格基准上，默认FlagGAM在透明加性模式下接近EBM；在混合类型回归上显著优于岭回归；在缺失和噪声扰动下AUROC degradation小于常见基线；灵活预测头进一步提高准确率，接近强树模型基线。

Conclusion: FlagGAM为需要竞争性准确率、可解释规则和对不完美输入鲁棒性的表格预测任务提供了实用的折中方案。

Abstract: Tabular prediction in high-stakes domains requires models that are accurate, transparent, and robust to imperfect inputs. We propose FlagGAM, a rule-defined basis framework that separates feature-level rule construction from prediction. A Flag Core Module converts numerical and categorical variables into sparse, human-readable univariate bases, including threshold flags, category-level flags, tail-deviation bases, and categorical step functions; a default additive head then combines these bases as a restricted GAM-style predictor. Rather than reducing triggered rules to compact count summaries, FlagGAM retains a sparse rule-basis matrix that supports mixed-type classification and regression, feature-specific weighting, and optional flexible prediction heads. Across tabular benchmarks, default FlagGAM remains close to EBM in transparent additive mode, improves substantially over ridge regression on mixed-type regression, and shows smaller AUROC degradation than common baselines under missing and noisy perturbations. Flexible heads further improve accuracy and approach strong tree-based baselines, with the caveat that the resulting model should be interpreted as a rule-basis representation followed by a nonlinear predictor rather than as a fully additive GAM. Overall, FlagGAM provides a practical middle ground for tabular settings that require competitive accuracy, communicable rules, and robustness to imperfect inputs.

</details>


### [337] [Student Capacity Moderates Knowledge Distillation Effectiveness: A Systematic Study Across ResNet Teacher-Student Pairs on CIFAR-10](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31191)
*Umut Onur Yasar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了教师-学生容量关系在ResNet图像分类任务（CIFAR-10）中对知识蒸馏（KD）效果的影响，发现学生容量是蒸馏收益的关键调节因素；实现正确性（如梯度裁剪bug）会显著影响特征蒸馏表现；输入分辨率感知架构是有效蒸馏的前提条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究教师-学生网络的容量关系如何调节知识蒸馏的有效性，澄清先前研究中由于实现缺陷导致的结论偏差。

Method: 在CIFAR-10上使用三组ResNet师生对（R50→R18, R34→R18, R50→R34），在可控可复现条件下（3个随机种子，报告均值±标准差）比较Logit-KD和Feature-KD两种蒸馏方法。

Result: （1）学生容量是关键调节因素：R34学生收益显著高于R18学生，即使师生准确率差距相当时亦然；（2）梯度裁剪bug会抑制Feature-KD性能，修复后Feature-KD在三组中有两组匹配或优于Logit-KD；（3）修正输入分辨率感知架构使教师准确率提升超过5pp，远超任何KD收益。

Conclusion: 知识蒸馏的效果受学生容量、实现正确性和架构设计的共同影响，后续研究需注意这些因素以避免误导性结论。

Abstract: We investigate how teacher-student capacity relationships modulate knowledge distillation (KD) effectiveness in ResNet-based image classification on CIFAR-10. Across three teacher-student pairs -- R50->R18, R34->R18, and R50->R34 -- we compare Logit-KD and Feature-KD under controlled, reproducible conditions (3 seeds, mean+/-std reported throughout). We report three main findings. First, student capacity is a key moderating factor in distillation gain: R34 students benefit substantially more from KD than R18 students even when teacher-student accuracy gaps are comparable, with the strongest gain of +0.30pp observed for R50->R34 Feature-KD versus +0.18pp for R34->R18 Feature-KD and +0.00pp for R34->R18 Logit-KD. Second, implementation correctness critically affects Feature-KD: a gradient clipping bug that excluded projection layers suppressed Feature-KD performance and produced misleading comparisons with Logit-KD. After correction, Feature-KD matches or outperforms Logit-KD in two of three pairs, reaching 95.55% on R50->R34 against a baseline of 95.25%. Third, input-resolution-aware architecture is a prerequisite for effective distillation: correcting the ResNet stem for 32x32 inputs raises teacher accuracy by over 5pp -- an order of magnitude larger than any KD gain. All code and results are available at github.com/umutonuryasar/kd-capacity-gap.

</details>


### [338] [Geometry-based Schrödinger Bridges for Trustworthy Multimodal Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31193)
*Jiayu Xiong,Jing Wang,Qi Zhang,Wanlong Wang,Jun Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于几何的多模态融合方法(GMF)，通过测量隐空间中输运修正量评估数据可靠性，打破传统依赖模型预测置信度的循环依赖，显著提升对传感器噪声和语义冲突的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可信融合方法依赖模型自身预测置信度判断数据质量，形成循环依赖：当模型自信但错误时无法检测问题。亟需独立于预测的可靠性评估机制。

Method: 利用扩散薛定谔桥输运和Rectified Flow，以初始速度的平方作为学习到的修正分数；低平方速度表示有效数据，高平方速度表示噪声、不完整或冲突数据需要更大输运修正，从而提供独立于预测的几何可靠性信号。

Result: 在严重传感器噪声和语义冲突场景下，GMF显著优于基于置信度的基线方法，有效标记不可靠输入。

Conclusion: 基于几何的可靠性信号可作为独立裁判，突破传统置信度方法的局限，提升多模态系统的鲁棒性和可信度。

Abstract: Real-world multimodal systems must be robust against low-quality data, such as sensor noise, incomplete multimodal data and conflicting inputs. However, existing trustworthy fusion methods rely on the model's own prediction confidence to judge data quality. This creates a circular dependency: when a model is confident but wrong, these methods fail to detect the error. To break this loop, we propose Geometry-based Multimodal Fusion (GMF). Instead of relying on predictions, we evaluate reliability by measuring how much transport correction the input needs in latent space.
