The framework operates on learned representations, requires no knowledge of which specific confounder is present, and returns indeterminate when the evidence is insufficient. We validate DECAT on synthetic data across four multimodal model classes (over 2,500 trained representations) and on real data from 8,979 TCGA patients, evaluating both multimodal embeddings and five pretrained pathology foundation models. Entangled models (e.g., CLIP) achieve near-perfect shared biology detection but falsely claim shared biology in the majority of cases where it is absent on real foundation model embeddings. This false claim rate increases with confound strength so that larger cohorts and stronger representations produce more confident but still incorrect diagnoses. Applied to both multimodal TCGA embeddings and five pathology foundation models without paired RNA, DECAT detects confounding invisible to AUROC without requiring the confounder labels, as confirmed by post-hoc stratification.

</details>


### [379] [Skill Reuse as Compression in Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31509)
*Zhikun Xu,Yu Feng,Jacob Dineen,Taiwei Shi,Jieyu Zhao,Ben Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReuseRL方法，基于最小描述长度原理，通过提取可复用的技能字典并增加分割代价来惩罚个性化行为，在多个环境中提升了强化学习智能体的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体通过强化学习训练时往往学到脆弱的、特定任务的捷径，泛化能力差。作者假设当成功轨迹在结构上可压缩、可分解为少量可复用的抽象模式时，智能体泛化能力更好。

Method: 提出ReuseRL框架，基于最小描述长度（MDL）原理。从成功轨迹中提取共享技能字典，并在RL目标函数中加入分割代价，显式惩罚那些编码效率低的个性化行为。同时证明了该压缩惩罚的PAC-Bayes泛化界。

Result: 在ALFWorld、TextWorld-Cooking和Countdown-Stepwise三个环境中，ReuseRL在分布内和分布外的成功率均优于vanilla GRPO和强round-length基线方法。

Conclusion: 压缩原则可以有效提升语言模型智能体的泛化能力，ReuseRL通过MDL驱动的结构正则化是一种有效的途径。

Abstract: Large language model agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) often learn brittle, task-specific shortcuts. We hypothesize that agents generalize better when their successful trajectories are structurally compressible, decomposed into a small set of reusable abstract patterns. To formalize this, we introduce ReuseRL, which grounds agentic RL in the Minimum Description Length (MDL) principle. ReuseRL extracts a shared skill dictionary from successful trajectories and augments the RL objective with a segmentation cost, explicitly penalizing idiosyncratic behaviors that encode poorly. We prove a PAC-Bayes generalization bound for this compression penalty. Across ALFWorld, TextWorld-Cooking, and Countdown-Stepwise, ReuseRL improves in- and out-of-distribution success over vanilla GRPO and strong round-length baselines.

</details>


### [380] [On the Relationship Between Activation Outliers and Feature Death in Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31518)
*Elana Simon,Etowah Adams,James Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）在分解神经网络激活时会出现特征死亡（feature death）问题，原因在于激活中的维度级离群值使得与均值反对齐的特征初始预激活为负。论文提出离群严重性指标γ=‖μ‖/‖σ‖，能有效预测初始死亡比率，并证明均值中心化（减去激活均值）可彻底消除离群引发的特征死亡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）在分解神经网络激活时，部分学习到的特征永远不会激活（特征死亡），这浪费了字典容量并可能重新引入叠加（superposition）。不同模型间的死亡比率差异巨大（GPT-2接近零，AlphaFold3超过70%），需要解释这一现象的根本原因并提出解决方案。

Method: 论文发现维度级激活离群值（维度的平均幅度远大于逐词元变化的幅度）是导致特征死亡的根本原因。离群值通过每个特征与激活均值的对齐方式，在初始化时改变预激活值。与均值反对齐的特征获得永久负预激活，从而永不触发。形式化离群严重性为γ=‖μ‖/‖σ‖，并在454个模型-层组合（涵盖语言、视觉、蛋白质、基因组模型）上验证其预测能力（Spearman ρ=0.89 for dead-by-TopK, 0.82 for dead-by-ReLU）。此外发现，已死亡特征可在训练中复活，但复活要求SAE偏置学习到激活均值，在高γ下这一过程极其缓慢。均值中心化（减去激活均值）可规避该问题，彻底消除所有测试模型中的离群诱导死亡。

Result: γ=‖μ‖/‖σ‖能有效预测初始特征死亡比率，在454个模型-层组合上Spearman ρ达0.89（TopK）和0.82（ReLU）。均值中心化消除了所有测试模型中的离群诱导特征死亡，验证了所提出机制的正确性。

Conclusion: 特征死亡的根本原因是激活中的维度级离群值；离群严重性指标γ可预测死亡比率；均值中心化是消除离群诱导特征死亡的有效预处理步骤，为何时以及为何需要该预处理提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose neural network activations into interpretable features, but many learned features never activate, a problem called feature death that wastes dictionary capacity and can reintroduce superposition. Death rates vary dramatically between models: near-zero on GPT-2, over 70% on AlphaFold3 with identical configurations. We find that dimension-level activation outliers (dimensions whose mean magnitude is large relative to per-token variation) cause this by shifting pre-activations at initialization based on each feature's alignment with the activation mean. Features anti-aligned with the mean receive permanently negative pre-activations and never fire. We formalize outlier severity as $γ= \|μ\|/\|σ\|$; it predicts initial death rates (Spearman $ρ= 0.89$ for dead-by-TopK, $0.82$ for dead-by-ReLU) across 454 model-layer combinations spanning language, vision, protein, and genomic models. Dead features can revive during training, but recovery requires the SAE bias to learn the activation mean, a process that is prohibitively slow at high $γ$. Mean-centering (subtracting the activation mean) sidesteps this and eliminates outlier-induced death across all tested models, confirming the mechanism and providing a principled basis for when and why this preprocessing step is necessary.

</details>


### [381] [Chem-PerturBridge: a harmonized compendium of small molecule perturbation transcriptomic effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31522)
*Artur Szałata,Olga Novitskaia,Maiia Shulman,Matthew Mella,Altynbek Zhubanchaliyev,Fabian J. Theis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Chem-PerturBridge是一个包含3.7万+化合物、136种细胞背景、125万转录组样本的跨数据集资源，通过标准化处理实现跨数据集签名一致性评估和化合物表示学习预训练，发现不同数据集中同一化合物的logFC排名一致性较弱但方向一致性较好，且基于该资源的预训练嵌入在多个基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前小分子建模的转录组资源分散于不同技术平台、元数据规范、对照设置、剂量范围和预处理流程之间，缺乏统一的跨数据集资源来支持大规模扰动模型训练和化合物表示学习。

Method: 构建Chem-PerturBridge资源，涵盖37k+化合物、136种细胞背景、8种检测类型的125万转录组样本，使用标准化标识符和元数据对齐，生成副本感知的条件级效应值。在该资源上评估跨数据集的匹配条件一致性（spearman相关性、方向一致性）和数据集内副本一致性，并基于此进行化合物表示学习预训练。

Result: 跨数据集匹配条件在细粒度logFC排名和幅度上一致性较弱（常低于同背景不同化合物的基线），但方向一致性显著更稳定且超过基线。基于Chem-PerturBridge预训练的嵌入在化合物留出（OP3）分割和11个数据集的广泛评估中，优于仅L1000嵌入、Morgan指纹和无描述符基线。

Conclusion: Chem-PerturBridge既支持跨数据集签名一致性的诊断评估，也支持异质扰动转录组数据的模型导向重用，为大规模化合物-转录组建模提供了标准化基准资源。

Abstract: Large perturbation models require training data encompassing chemical, cellular, and assay diversity. Current transcriptomic resources for small-molecule modeling, however, are fragmented across technologies, metadata conventions, controls, doses, and preprocessing pipelines. We introduce Chem-PerturBridge, a harmonized multi-dataset resource comprising over 37k compounds, 136 cellular contexts, and 1.25M transcriptomic samples across eight assay types, with standardized identifiers, metadata, and replicate-aware condition-level effects. We use the resource to evaluate matched-condition agreement across datasets and replicate agreement within datasets. Matched same-compound conditions generally show weak agreement in fine-grained logFC rankings and magnitudes across most dataset pairs, often falling below same-context different-compound baselines. In contrast, logFC direction agreement is substantially more stable and usually exceeds these baselines. We further evaluate Chem-PerturBridge as a pretraining resource for compound representation learning. Under a compound-held-out OP3 evaluation split, embeddings pretrained on Chem-PerturBridge improve over L1000-only embeddings, Morgan fingerprints, and the descriptor-free OP3 baseline across metrics. An extensive molecule-holdout evaluation across 11 datasets further shows that models trained on Chem-PerturBridge outperform or match those that are not. Chem-PerturBridge therefore supports both diagnostic evaluation of cross-dataset signature agreement and model-oriented reuse of heterogeneous perturbation transcriptomic data.

</details>


### [382] [Value Functions as Supermartingale Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31524)
*Alessandro Abate,Daniel Contro,Mirco Giacobbe,Agustín Martínez-Suñé,Diptarko Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在随机系统的形式化认证与强化学习之间建立了理论桥梁，证明在适当奖励下，几乎必然满足ω-正则属性的策略的值函数可以编码为Streett超鞅证书，为通过RL进行证书合成提供了原则性路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认证方法基于超鞅证书可为ω-正则属性提供充分证明规则，但RL方法通常缺乏形式化保证。本文旨在弥合这两方面研究，使RL学到的策略能同时获得形式化认证。

Method: 建立理论联系：证明在适当奖励函数下，几乎必然满足ω-正则属性的策略的值函数编码了一个Streett超鞅证书。实验验证在有限马尔可夫决策过程上进行。

Result: 该理论联系对有限、可数无限和连续状态空间均成立，并在有限MDP上通过实验验证。

Conclusion: 该结果为通过强化学习进行证书合成提供了原则性途径，使RL方法能够生成带有形式化保证的策略。

Abstract: Certification methods for stochastic systems provide sufficient proof rules, based on real-valued supermartingale certificates, to determine the almost-sure satisfaction of $ω$-regular properties (and therefore of linear temporal logic) over general state spaces, encompassing both countably infinite and continuous state spaces. Conversely, reinforcement learning (RL) methods for $ω$-regular tasks have received considerable attention, but they typically lack formal guarantees that the learned policy satisfies the specification, except possibly for finite state and action spaces. We bridge these two lines of research by establishing a novel theoretical connection: under an appropriate reward, the value function associated to a policy that almost surely satisfies an $ω$-regular property encodes a Streett supermartingale certificate for that specification. Our results, validated experimentally on finite Markov decision processes, hold for finite, countably infinite, and continuous state spaces, suggesting a principled route to certificate synthesis via RL.

</details>


### [383] [The Dynamic-Probabilistic Consistency Gap in Chaotic Surrogate Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31547)
*Andre Herz,Matthijs Pals,Daniel Durstewitz,Georgia Koppe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了动力系统重建中的动态-概率一致性差距：追求有限时域概率目标会损害动力学特性或使预测不确定性与局部切线动力学脱耦。为此提出KAFFEE框架，基于可微扩展卡尔曼滤波，在随机超混沌Lorenz-96及13个混沌系统上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动力系统重建中，现有方法使用有限时域概率目标（如开环高斯展开目标）会导致动力学退化或不确定性与系统真实动力学特性脱耦，缺乏动态-概率一致性的系统分析及解决方案。

Method: 提出KAFFEE（Kalman-Aware Framework For Ergodic Emulation）框架，基于可微扩展卡尔曼滤波，在训练时利用局部预测残差（新息）计算似然，同时通过学习的局部雅可比矩阵传播协方差，实现动态与概率的一致性学习。

Result: 在随机超混沌Lorenz-96系统上，KAFFEE减少了核心坍缩、噪声掩蔽和盲不确定性三种失效模式，改善了动力学不变量重建，同时保持有竞争力的预测分数。在13个混沌系统上的基础模型概率适配实验中，KAFFEE实现了上下文贝叶斯滤波，同时大幅保留了零样本动力学特性。

Conclusion: 动力系统重建中需重视动态-概率一致性，KAFFEE通过局部新息驱动和雅可比协方差传播有效弥合了这一差距，为不确定感知的动力学模型学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Dynamical systems reconstruction (DSR) aims to learn surrogate models that capture the dynamics underlying time-series data. Reliably deploying these surrogates requires uncertainty estimates consistent with the learned dynamics. We expose a dynamic-probabilistic consistency (DPC) gap: the pursuit of finite-horizon probabilistic objectives can degrade dynamics or decouple predictive uncertainty from the local tangent dynamics it ought to reflect. We isolate three mechanisms behind this gap: core collapse, noise masking, and blind uncertainty. Specifically, we show that open-loop Gaussian rollout objectives can penalize Jacobian-generated covariance growth in chaotic systems, encouraging optimization shortcuts that weaken physical expansion or decouple uncertainty from it. To mitigate this gap, we propose KAFFEE (Kalman-Aware Framework For Ergodic Emulation), a differentiable extended Kalman filter-based training framework that evaluates likelihood on local predictive residuals (innovations) while transporting covariance through learned local Jacobians. On stochastic hyperchaotic Lorenz-96, KAFFEE reduces the identified failure modes, improves reconstruction of dynamical invariants relative to open-loop objectives, and maintains competitive predictive scores. We further show that the DPC gap appears when probabilistically adapting a DSR foundation model across 13 chaotic systems, where KAFFEE enables in-context Bayesian filtering while largely preserving zero-shot dynamics.

</details>


### [384] [Positional versus Symbolic Attention Heads: Learning Dynamics, RoPE Geometry, and Length Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31558)
*Felipe Urrutia,Juan José Alegría,Cinthia Sanchez Macias,Jorge Salas,Cristian B. Calderon,Cristobal Rojas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过在多跳推理任务中训练GPT-J模型，发现注意力头会分化为"位置型"和"符号型"两类纯注意力头。尽管两类任务结构等价，但数值任务需要两种类型头部协同，而字母任务仅需符号型头部。符号型机制在长序列外推上更稳健，位置型机制则面临更严重的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解Transformer在结构化任务中的学习机制及其在未见场景下的行为模式，对于安全部署至关重要。现有研究缺乏对注意力头在结构化推理任务中功能分化的定量理解。

Method: 在两种结构等价的多跳推理任务（数值位置推理和字母符号推理）上训练GPT-J模型，利用注意力头分类指标量化头部为"位置型"或"符号型"，并通过理论构造展示RoPE单层注意力如何实现这些功能，提出"差异度"度量来形式化位置与符号机制在长序列上的鲁棒性差异。

Result: 成功学习伴随着纯注意力头的涌现；数值任务同时需要位置型和符号型头部，而字母任务仅需符号型头部；符号型机制在长序列外推上更可靠，位置型机制面临更尖锐的限制；理论预测在受控和真实模型中均得到实证验证。

Conclusion: 注意力头会分化为位置型和符号型两类功能特化的头部；符号型机制相比位置型机制具有更好的长序列外推能力；这种定量分离可用于预测模型在未见场景下的行为。

Abstract: Transformer-based language models are widespread in today's society. As such, understanding the mechanisms by which they solve structured tasks and predicting how they may behave in novel scenarios is of great importance for safe deployment. We study the learning dynamics of attention heads in a controlled setting by training a decoder-only Transformer (GPT-J) on two structurally equivalent multi-hop reasoning tasks: a number task requiring positional reasoning and a letter task requiring symbolic reasoning. Using a recently introduced metric that classifies attention-head behavior as positional or symbolic for a given prompt, we show that successful learning is associated with the emergence of pure heads, i.e., heads that express themselves as either positional or symbolic. Despite the tasks' structural equivalence, they impose different mechanistic demands: the number task requires both positional and symbolic heads, whereas the letter task requires only symbolic heads. We then identify the computational roles of these heads, characterize the basic functions they implement, and give theoretical constructions showing how single-layer RoPE-based attention can realize these functions through geometrically interpretable query, key, and value operations. This analysis yields a quantitative separation between positional and symbolic mechanisms in their robustness to longer sequences, formalized through a novel notion of discrepancy. We empirically validate the resulting predictions in both controlled and real-world models, showing that symbolic mechanisms extrapolate more reliably to longer sequences while positional mechanisms face sharper limitations.

</details>


### [385] [Functional Attention: From Pairwise Affinities to Functional Correspondences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31559)
*Jiefang Xiao,Maolin Gao,Simon Weber,Guandao Yang,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Functional Attention，一种将注意力机制重新解释为自适应基之间函数对应的算子学习方法，通过结构化线性算子替代softmax亲和度，实现紧凑、可泛化、分辨率不变的全局依赖表示，在PDE求解、3D分割和回归等任务中达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的算子学习方法将连续场视为离散token，采用逐token注意力机制，忽略了全局函数结构，缺乏对函数空间的整体建模能力。

Method: 受几何函数映射启发，将注意力重新解释为自适应基之间的函数对应关系，用结构化线性算子替代softmax亲和度，构建紧凑且分辨率不变的全局依赖表示。

Result: 在多个算子学习任务（PDE求解、3D分割、回归）中达到最先进性能，且对不同离散化方式具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 所提出的Functional Attention方法在算子学习中有效捕获全局依赖，具备良好的泛化性和分辨率不变性。

Abstract: Learning mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces, or operator learning, is essential for many machine learning applications. Although transformer-based operators are popular, they often rely on token-wise attention. These methods treat continuous fields as discrete tokens and usually ignore the global functional structure. We introduce \emph{Functional Attention}, which reinterprets attention as a functional correspondence between adaptive bases. Inspired by geometric functional maps, our method replaces softmax affinities with structured linear operators. This yields a compact, generalizable, resolution-invariant representation that explicitly captures global dependencies. Experiments demonstrate that \emph{Functional Attention} can match state-of-the-art performance in many operator learning tasks, including solving PDEs, 3D segmentation, and regression, while remaining robust to varying discretizations. Project page is available at https://github.com/xjffff/FUNCATTN.

</details>


### [386] [Effective Biological Representation Learning by Masking Gene Expression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31562)
*Kian Kenyon-Dean,Alina Selega,Ihab Bendidi,Jordan M. Sorokin,Luca Bertinetto,David Errington,Hayley Donnella,Oren Kraus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TxFM模型，通过精心设计的掩码自编码方法和高质量训练数据DiverseRNA-1.4M，证明归纳式自监督学习在转录组学表征中优于线性基线及大规模预训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有转录组基础模型的表现往往不如线性基线，这引发了一个核心问题：深度表征学习相比直接使用原始转录本计数是否具有明显优势。本文旨在探索并验证归纳式自监督学习在转录组学表征中的可行性。

Method: 开发了TxFM模型，采用针对多样化RNA-seq计数数据定制的掩码自编码方法；通过消融研究确定关键架构配置；构建了DiverseRNA-1.4M公共训练语料库。

Result: TxFM在归纳表征学习评估中表现优异；在精心整理的数据集上训练的TxFM产生的基因表征优于在比其大100倍以上的图谱规模语料库上训练的基础模型。

Conclusion: 归纳式自监督学习是转录组学表征的有效建模方法，但前提是必须对模型架构和训练数据进行精心设计。

Abstract: RNA sequencing produces rich and diverse datasets of gene expression, offering compelling insights into cellular state and function that have many applications in drug discovery. Modeling such data is challenging due to inherent technical noise and experimental batch effects, as evidenced by many existing transcriptomic foundation models (FMs) underperforming relative to linear baselines. Such results raise the question of whether deep representation learning provides a distinct advantage over the direct use of raw transcript counts. Our work explores this by developing a new self-supervised model, TxFM, with a focus on inductive representation learning evaluations. TxFM employs a masked autoencoding approach tailored to diverse RNA-seq count data, and our ablation study empirically identifies crucial architecture configurations required for strong transfer performance. Additionally, we curate a public training corpus, DiverseRNA-1.4M, and find that TxFM trained on this curated dataset yields high-fidelity gene representations that outperform FMs trained on atlas-scale corpora over 100x larger. Overall, our results indicate that inductive self-supervised learning is a viable modeling approach for transcriptomics representation, provided a careful synthesis of model architecture and training data curation.

</details>


### [387] [Giving Sensors a Voice: Multimodal JEPA for Semantic Time-Series Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31580)
*Utsav Dutta,Gerardo Pastrana,Sina Khoshfetrat Pakazad,Henrik Ohlsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CHARM是一个基于Transformer的通道感知表示模型，结合通道级文本描述和JEPA训练目标，用于异构多元时间序列的通用表示学习，在异常检测、分类和预测任务中仅使用线性探测即可取得强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Transformer的架构在语言和视觉领域推动了序列建模发展，但面向异构多元时间序列的通用表示学习仍未被充分探索。

Method: 提出CHARM模型，将通道级文本描述集成到对通道顺序等变的Transformer编码器中；采用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）进行训练，引入新颖的损失函数以促进信息丰富且时间稳定的嵌入；通过潜在空间预测增强对传感器噪声的鲁棒性，描述感知门控机制通过学习通道间关系提供可解释性。

Result: 在异常检测、分类以及短/长期预测任务中，学习到的嵌入仅使用线性探测即可取得强性能。

Conclusion: 性能主要得益于JEPA目标和条件架构，文本描述作为通道标识符支持跨数据集泛化。

Abstract: Transformer-based architectures have advanced sequence modeling in language and vision, yet general-purpose representation learning for heterogeneous multivariate time series remains underexplored. We introduce CHARM (Channel-Aware Representation Model), which incorporates channel-level textual descriptions into a Transformer encoder equivariant to channel order. CHARM is trained with a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and a novel loss promoting informative, temporally stable embeddings; latent-space prediction encourages robustness to sensor noise while description-aware gating provides interpretability through learned inter-channel relationships. Across anomaly detection, classification, and short- and long-term forecasting, the learned embeddings achieve strong performance using only a linear probe. Performance is driven primarily by the JEPA objective and conditioning architecture, with text descriptions serving as channel identifiers for cross-dataset generalization.

</details>


### [388] [A Tight Theory of Error Feedback Algorithms in Distributed Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31594)
*Daniel Berg Thomsen,Adrien Taylor,Aymeric Dieuleveut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对分布式优化中的梯度压缩误差反馈机制，对两种主流算法EF和EF21进行了紧致收敛性分析，通过最优步长选择和Lyapunov函数构造，得到了与单智能体最优保证一致的收敛结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式学习中通信开销是主要瓶颈，梯度压缩虽可降低通信成本但会损害收敛性。误差反馈作为简单有效的补救方法，其众多变体的相对性能尚不明确，缺乏统一的理论理解。

Method: 针对经典EF和EF21两种误差反馈算法，通过识别最优步长选择并构造针对每种方法量身定制的最优Lyapunov函数进行紧致收敛性分析。

Result: 获得了与智能体数量无关的紧致收敛保证，且恢复（recover）了单智能体场景下已知的最佳保证。

Conclusion: 为EF和EF21两种误差反馈算法提供了最优的收敛分析，阐明了其理论性能边界。

Abstract: Communication costs are a major bottleneck in distributed learning and first-order optimization. A common approach to alleviate this issue is to compress the gradient information exchanged between agents. However, such compression typically degrades the convergence guarantees of gradient-based methods. Error feedback mechanisms provide a simple and computationally cheap remedy for this issue, but numerous variants have been proposed, and their relative performance remains poorly understood. This paper provides tight convergence analyses for two of the main error-feedback algorithms from the literature, the classic Error Feedback method (EF) and Error Feedback 21 (EF21), by identifying optimal step-size choices and constructing optimal Lyapunov functions tailored to each method. The results hold independently of the number of agents and recover the known best guarantees possible in the single-agent regime.

</details>


### [389] [Advances and Challenges in Meta-Learning: A Technical Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.04722)
*Anna Vettoruzzo,Mohamed-Rafik Bouguelia,Joaquin Vanschoren,Thorsteinn Rögnvaldsson,KC Santosh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对元学习进行了全面技术综述，涵盖了其与多任务学习、迁移学习、域适应与泛化、自监督学习、个性化联邦学习、持续学习等领域的联系，探讨了复杂多模态任务分布学习、无监督元学习、数据分布漂移适应、持续元学习等高级主题，并指出了未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 元学习使学习系统能够从多个任务中获取知识，从而更快地适应和泛化到新任务，这在数据稀缺或获取成本高的现实场景中具有重要意义。本文旨在通过系统综述梳理元学习的最新进展及其与其他学习范式的关联，推动该领域发展。

Method: 本文采用文献综述的方法，对元学习的最新研究进展进行系统整理和综合分析。概述了最先进的元学习方法，探讨了元学习与多任务学习、迁移学习、域适应与泛化、自监督学习、个性化联邦学习、持续学习等领域的联系与协同效应，并深入分析了高级元学习主题。

Result: 本文展示了元学习与多个相关学习范式之间的协同关系，指出一个领域的进展可以惠及整个领域并避免重复工作。系统梳理了复杂多模态任务分布学习、无监督元学习、数据分布漂移适应、持续元学习等高级主题的研究现状，并识别出开放的挑战和问题。

Conclusion: 通过对最新研究进展的综合分析，本文增进了对元学习及其对各类机器学习应用潜在影响的理解，有助于推动元学习的发展及其在现实问题中的实际应用。

Abstract: Meta-learning empowers learning systems with the ability to acquire knowledge from multiple tasks, enabling faster adaptation and generalization to new tasks. This review provides a comprehensive technical overview of meta-learning, emphasizing its importance in real-world applications where data may be scarce or expensive to obtain. The paper covers the state-of-the-art meta-learning approaches and explores the relationship between meta-learning and multi-task learning, transfer learning, domain adaptation and generalization, self-supervised learning, personalized federated learning, and continual learning. By highlighting the synergies between these topics and the field of meta-learning, the paper demonstrates how advancements in one area can benefit the field as a whole, while avoiding unnecessary duplication of efforts. Additionally, the paper delves into advanced meta-learning topics such as learning from complex multi-modal task distributions, unsupervised meta-learning, learning to efficiently adapt to data distribution shifts, and continual meta-learning. Lastly, the paper highlights open problems and challenges for future research in the field. By synthesizing the latest research developments, this paper provides a thorough understanding of meta-learning and its potential impact on various machine learning applications. We believe that this technical overview will contribute to the advancement of meta-learning and its practical implications in addressing real-world problems.

</details>


### [390] [Graph Machine Learning in the Era of Large Language Models (LLMs)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.14928)
*Shijie Wang,Jiani Huang,Zhikai Chen,Yu Song,Wenzhuo Tang,Haitao Mao,Wenqi Fan,Hui Liu,Xiaorui Liu,Dawei Yin,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了图机器学习在图神经网络时代的最新进展，重点探讨了LLMs与图技术的双向增强关系：一方面LLMs可提升图特征质量、减少对标注数据的依赖并解决图异质性和分布外泛化问题；另一方面图（尤其是知识图谱）可增强LLMs的预训练和推理能力，缓解幻觉和缺乏可解释性等局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLMs在语言任务中展现出前所未有的能力，研究者开始探索将其应用于图领域以提升图机器学习的泛化性、迁移性和少样本学习能力；同时图数据（特别是知识图谱）蕴含丰富的可靠事实知识，可用于增强LLMs的推理能力并缓解其幻觉和缺乏可解释性等问题。鉴于该方向的快速进展，亟需一篇系统性综述来总结LLM时代图机器学习的最新进展。

Method: 本文采用系统性综述方法，首先回顾图机器学习的最新发展，然后从两个方向展开分析：(1) LLMs如何增强图特征质量、减少对标注数据的依赖、解决图异质性和分布外泛化问题；(2) 图如何增强LLMs的预训练和推理能力。最后探讨了各类应用及未来潜在研究方向。

Result: 本文提供了一份系统性综述，梳理了LLM与图机器学习双向增强的最新进展，涵盖LLMs提升图特征质量、缓解标注数据依赖、应对图异质性和OOD泛化挑战，以及图增强LLM预训练和推理能力等方面的研究成果。

Conclusion: 该综述指出LLMs与图机器学习的融合是一个充满前景的研究方向，两者相互增强：LLMs可推动图ML在泛化性和少样本学习方面的进步，而图数据（特别是知识图谱）可增强LLMs的推理能力并缓解其固有局限。未来该领域仍有大量值得探索的方向。

Abstract: Graphs play an important role in representing complex relationships in various domains like social networks, knowledge graphs, and molecular discovery. With the advent of deep learning, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a cornerstone in Graph Machine Learning (Graph ML), facilitating the representation and processing of graphs. Recently, LLMs have demonstrated unprecedented capabilities in language tasks and are widely adopted in a variety of applications such as computer vision and recommender systems. This remarkable success has also attracted interest in applying LLMs to the graph domain. Increasing efforts have been made to explore the potential of LLMs in advancing Graph ML's generalization, transferability, and few-shot learning ability. Meanwhile, graphs, especially knowledge graphs, are rich in reliable factual knowledge, which can be utilized to enhance the reasoning capabilities of LLMs and potentially alleviate their limitations such as hallucinations and the lack of explainability. Given the rapid progress of this research direction, a systematic review summarizing the latest advancements for Graph ML in the era of LLMs is necessary to provide an in-depth understanding to researchers and practitioners. Therefore, in this survey, we first review the recent developments in Graph ML. We then explore how LLMs can be utilized to enhance the quality of graph features, alleviate the reliance on labeled data, and address challenges such as graph Heterophily and out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. Afterward, we delve into how graphs can enhance LLMs, highlighting their abilities to enhance LLM pre-training and inference. Furthermore, we investigate various applications and discuss the potential future directions in this promising field.

</details>


### [391] [Forecasting with Hyper-Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.07836)
*Alexander März,Kashif Rasul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Hyper-Trees框架，通过梯度提升树学习时间序列模型（如ARIMA、指数平滑）的参数，并融合决策树与神经网络解决高维参数估计问题，在多个预测任务上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统树模型直接预测时间序列，缺乏时间序列归纳偏置；经典时序模型（如ARIMA）虽具偏置但难以处理复杂特征。本文旨在将树模型在表格数据上的优势与经典时序模型的归纳偏置相结合。

Method: 1）Hyper-Trees框架：梯度提升树以特征为输入，学习目标时间序列模型（ARIMA/指数平滑）的参数，再由目标模型生成最终预测；2）为解决高维参数估计的扩展性问题，提出混合方法：决策树生成特征表示，浅层神经网络基于该表示学习时序模型参数。

Result: 在多个预测任务上验证了Hyper-Trees的有效性，拓展了树模型在时间序列分析中的应用边界。

Conclusion: Hyper-Trees成功将树模型的表格数据处理能力与经典时序模型的归纳偏置融合，混合架构有效解决了高维参数估计的扩展性瓶颈，为树模型在时间序列领域的应用提供了新范式。

Abstract: We introduce Hyper-Trees as a novel framework for modeling time series data using gradient boosted trees. Unlike conventional tree-based approaches that forecast time series directly, Hyper-Trees learn the parameters of a target time series model, such as ARIMA or Exponential Smoothing, as functions of features. These parameters are then used by the target model to generate the final forecasts. Our framework combines the effectiveness of decision trees on tabular data with classical forecasting models, thereby inducing a time series inductive bias into tree-based models. To resolve the scaling limitations of boosted trees when estimating a high-dimensional set of target model parameters, we combine decision trees and neural networks within a unified framework. In this hybrid approach, the trees generate informative representations from the input features, which a shallow network then uses as input to learn the parameters of a time series model. With our research, we explore the effectiveness of Hyper-Trees across a range of forecasting tasks and extend tree-based modeling beyond its conventional use in time series analysis.

</details>


### [392] [HYGENE: A Diffusion-based Hypergraph Generation Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.16457)
*Dorian Gailhard,Enzo Tartaglione,Lirida Naviner,Jhony H. Giraldo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的超图生成方法HYGENE，通过在二分图上进行渐进式局部扩展，从单个节点对开始迭代构建目标超图，这是首次将深度学习应用于超图生成任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超图能建模复杂高阶关系，但缺乏有效的生成模型，现有的生成方法难以生成真实且多样化的超图。

Method: HYGENE基于超图的二分图表示，从单个连通节点对开始，通过去噪扩散过程逐步局部添加节点和超边，先构建全局结构再细化局部细节。

Result: 实验证明HYGENE能够有效模仿超图的多种属性，生成质量优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 这是首次尝试使用深度学习模型进行超图生成，为未来研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: Hypergraphs are powerful mathematical structures that can model complex, high-order relationships in various domains, including social networks, bioinformatics, and recommender systems. However, generating realistic and diverse hypergraphs remains challenging due to their inherent complexity and lack of effective generative models. In this paper, we introduce a diffusion-based Hypergraph Generation (HYGENE) method that addresses these challenges through a progressive local expansion approach. HYGENE works on the bipartite representation of hypergraphs, starting with a single pair of connected nodes and iteratively expanding it to form the target hypergraph. At each step, nodes and hyperedges are added in a localized manner using a denoising diffusion process, which allows for the construction of the global structure before refining local details. Our experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of HYGENE, proving its ability to closely mimic a variety of properties in hypergraphs. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first attempt to employ deep learning models for hypergraph generation, and our work aims to lay the groundwork for future research in this area.

</details>


### [393] [Learning Coupled Subspaces for Multi-Condition Spike Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.19153)
*Yididiya Y. Nadew,Xuhui Fan,Christopher J. Quinn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CS-GPFA，一种贝叶斯模型，用于联合学习多实验条件下的神经活动潜变量表示，并开发了主动学习算法进行条件自适应选择，在合成和真实神经数据上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准GPFA独立推断每个实验条件下的潜在轨迹，未考虑活动如何随条件空间变化，限制了准确性和潜在表征的可解释性。

Method: 提出耦合子空间GPFA（CS-GPFA），一种贝叶斯模型，联合学习跨条件空间的潜变量表示；并在此基础上开发用于自适应选择实验条件的主动学习算法。

Result: 在合成和真实神经数据集上，CS-GPFA相比现有方法取得更优性能；主动学习结果证明能高效指导实际实验设计。

Conclusion: CS-GPFA有效解决了标准GPFA在多条件神经数据分析中的局限性，且主动学习扩展为实验设计提供了实用工具。

Abstract: In neuroscience, numerous studies conduct sensory or behavioral experiments under multiple conditions to acquire neural responses in the form of high-dimensional spike train datasets. Analyzing high-dimensional spike data is a challenging statistical problem. To this end, Gaussian process factor analysis (GPFA), a popular class of latent variable models, has been proposed for data collected under a single experimental condition. GPFA extracts smooth, low-dimensional latent trajectories that summarize highdimensional spike datasets. However, standard GPFA infers these trajectories independently for each experimental condition, not accounting for how the underlying activity varies across the condition space. This poses limitations on both accuracy and the interpretability of the latent representation. To address these limitations, we propose Coupled Subspaces GPFA (CS-GPFA), a Bayesian model that jointly learns latent representations, characterizing how the neural activity varies over the condition space. Building on this, we further develop an active-learning algorithm for adaptively selecting conditions. Experiments on both synthetic and real neural datasets demonstrate that CS-GPFA achieves superior performance compared to existing approaches. Moreover, our active learning results show that CS-GPFA can efficiently guide experiment design in practical settings.

</details>


### [394] [Adaptive NAD: Online and Self-adaptive Unsupervised Network Anomaly Detector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.22967)
*Yachao Yuan,Yu Huang,Jin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Adaptive NAD，一种在线自适应无监督网络异常检测框架，采用双层异常检测策略生成高置信度伪标签，并通过新颖的阈值计算技术实现在线更新，在多个数据集上实现了最低误报率和3倍以上的在线推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物联网的广泛使用增加了网络威胁风险，而现有研究多采用离线无监督学习方法，无法适应实际应用中的动态流量模式变化。

Method: 设计了一个双层异常检测策略来生成可靠的高置信度伪标签；提出在线训练方案，通过新颖的阈值计算技术更新Adaptive NAD模型。

Result: 在CIC-Darknet2020、NSL-KDD和Edge-IIoTset数据集上，误报率分别低至1.33%、0.71%和0.08%，在线推理延迟比现有最优方案快3倍以上。

Conclusion: Adaptive NAD作为一种在线自适应的无监督网络异常检测框架，在准确性和效率上均优于现有方法，适用于物联网安全领域的实际部署。

Abstract: The widespread usage of the Internet of Things (IoT) has raised the risks of cyber threats; thus, developing Anomaly Detection Systems (ADSs) that can adapt to evolving traffic pattern is critical. Previous studies primarily focused on offline unsupervised learning methods to safeguard ADSs, which is not applicable in practical real-world applications. In this paper, we design Adaptive NAD, an online and self-Adaptive unsupervised Network Anomaly Detection framework for security domains. A two-layer anomaly detection strategy is proposed to generate reliable high-confidence pseudo-labels. Then, an online training scheme is introduced to update Adaptive NAD by a novel threshold calculation technique. Experimental results demonstrate that Adaptive NAD achieves the lowest false alarm rate (1.33%, 0.71%, and 0.08%) and has a more than 3 times faster online inference latency compared with state-of-the-art solutions on the CIC-Darknet2020, NSL-KDD, and Edge-IIoTset datasets, respectively. The code is released at https://github.com/MyLearnCodeSpace/Adaptive-NAD.

</details>


### [395] [Minibatch Optimal Transport and Perplexity Bound Estimation in Discrete Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.00759)
*Etrit Haxholli,Yeti Z. Gurbuz,Ogul Can,Eli Waxman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离散流匹配框架提出动态最优传输最小化目标和困惑度上界估计方法，可将状态转换次数减少32倍，并引入Multimask Flows提升生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散流匹配虽在分类数据建模中表现优异，但无法像连续流匹配那样应用直线化策略减少状态转换；同时路径非确定性导致无法进行精确概率估计，亟需替代方法优化效率和评估。

Method: 提出类动态最优传输的最小化目标及其Kantorovich形式，通过小批量策略优化基于状态间不相似性的传输成本；提出两个困惑度上界用于训练和评估；设计Multimask Flows方法。

Result: 状态转换次数减少32倍（1024→32）且不损失多样性；Multimask Flows结合小批量最优传输在生成困惑度上优于掩码流，同时保持多样性。

Conclusion: 提出的最优传输方法和上界估计有效提升了离散流匹配的效率和可评估性，Multimask Flows进一步改进了生成性能。

Abstract: Discrete flow matching, a recent framework for modeling categorical data, has shown competitive performance with autoregressive models. However, unlike continuous flow matching, the rectification strategy cannot be applied due to the stochasticity of discrete paths, necessitating alternative methods to minimize state transitions. We propose a dynamic-optimal-transport-like minimization objective and derive its Kantorovich formulation for discrete flows with convex interpolants, where transport cost depends solely on inter-state dissimilarity and can be optimized via minibatch strategies. We show that such methods can reduce the number of transitions up to 32 times (1024 to 32) to reach the same generative perplexity without compromising diversity. Additionally, path nondeterminism in discrete flows precludes an instantaneous change-of-variables analogue, preventing precise probability estimation available to continuous flows. We therefore propose two upper bounds on perplexity, enabling principled training, evaluation and model comparison. Finally, we introduce Multimask Flows which outperform masked flows in generative perplexity without compromising diversity, particularly when utilizing minibatch Optimal Transport.

</details>


### [396] [Learning Randomized Reductions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.18134)
*Ferhat Erata,Orr Paradise,Thanos Typaldos,Timos Antonopoulos,ThanhVu Nguyen,Shafi Goldwasser,Ruzica Piskac*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Bitween，一种自动学习随机自归约（RSR）的框架。Vanilla Bitween集成多种后端，对80个函数中的43个（54%）发现了RSR；Agentic Bitween通过LLM智能体提出新的查询函数，成功率达到80%（64/80），包括首次为sigmoid找到RSR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RSR在程序自校正、实例隐藏协议及复杂性理论中具有重要意义，但40多年来一直依赖人工推导，缺乏自动化方法，限制了实际应用。

Method: 首先形式化了RSR学习问题并分析样本复杂度；然后提出Vanilla Bitween，集成线性回归、遗传编程、符号回归和混合整数规划四种后端；进一步提出Agentic Bitween，利用LLM智能体以神经符号方式生成超越固定查询函数集的新颖查询函数。

Result: Vanilla Bitween在RSR-Bench的80个函数中发现43个（54%）的RSR，其中线性回归后端表现最佳；Agentic Bitween扩展到64个（80%），包括首个sigmoid的RSR，在发现和验证准确率上均优于纯神经基线。

Conclusion: Bitween实现了RSR的自动化发现，大幅扩展了已知RSR函数库；Agentic Bitween的神经符号方法比纯神经方法更有效。

Abstract: Randomized self-reductions (RSRs) express $f(x)$ using $f$ evaluated at random correlated points, enabling self-correcting programs, instance-hiding protocols, and applications in complexity theory and cryptography. Yet discovering RSRs has required manual expert derivation for over 40 years, limiting their practical use. We present Bitween for automated RSR learning. First, we formalize RSR learning with sample complexity analysis under correlated sampling. Second, we develop Vanilla Bitween, which integrates multiple backends (linear regression, genetic programming, symbolic regression, and mixed-integer programming). The linear regression backend outperforms the others, discovering RSRs for 43 of 80 functions (54%) in RSR-Bench, our benchmark suite, including the first known reduction for sigmoid. Third, we introduce Agentic Bitween, a neuro-symbolic approach where LLM agents propose novel query functions beyond the fixed set ($x+r$, $x-r$, $x \cdot r$, $x$, $r$) in prior work. Agentic Bitween discovers RSRs for 64 of 80 functions (80%), outperforming pure neural baselines in both RSR discovery and verification accuracy.

</details>


### [397] [Learning General Causal Structures with Hidden Dynamic Process for Climate Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12500)
*Minghao Fu,Biwei Huang,Zijian Li,Yujia Zheng,Ignavier Ng,Guangyi Chen,Yingyao Hu,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CaDRe框架，联合识别观测变量间的因果关系和潜在驱动因素的动态过程，并证明了在非参数时间序列数据中两者的可识别性。实验验证了理论结果，并在真实气候数据上实现了可解释的因果图恢复和准确预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统因果表征学习（CRL）仅关注潜在因子，忽略了观测变量之间的直接因果关系，限制了其在气候分析等领域的适用性。本文旨在统一框架下同时发现观测变量间的因果结构和潜在驱动力的动态过程。

Method: 提出了CaDRe（Causal Discovery and Representation learning）框架，这是一个带有结构约束的时间序列生成模型，整合了CRL和因果发现。通过上下文信息在非参数设定下恢复潜在变量和因果关系，并建立了可识别性条件。

Result: 合成数据验证了理论可识别性结果。在真实气候数据集上，CaDRe达到了有竞争力的预测精度，并恢复了与领域知识一致的因果图，提供可解释的气候系统洞察。

Conclusion: 该工作统一了观测变量间因果关系发现与潜在因果表征学习，为气候动态分析提供了可解释的工具，并在理论和实践层面证实了其有效性。

Abstract: Understanding climate dynamics requires going beyond correlations in observational data to uncover the underlying causal process. Latent drivers such as atmospheric processes play a central role in temporal dynamics, while direct causal influences also exist among geographically proximate observed variables. Traditional Causal Representation Learning (CRL) typically focuses on latent factors but overlooks such observable-to-observable causal relations, which limits its applicability to climate analysis. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework that jointly uncovers (i) causal relations among observed variables and (ii) latent driving forces together with their interactions. We establish conditions under which both the hidden dynamic process and the causal structure among observed variables are simultaneously identifiable from time-series data, and our guarantees continue to hold in the nonparametric setting through contextual information that recovers latent variables and causal relations. Building on these insights, we propose CaDRe (Causal Discovery and Representation learning), a time-series generative model with structural constraints that integrates CRL and causal discovery. Experiments on synthetic datasets validate our theoretical results. On real-world climate datasets, CaDRe delivers competitive forecasting accuracy and recovers visualized causal graphs aligned with domain expertise, thereby offering interpretable insights into climate systems. Code is available at https://github.com/MinghaoFu/CaDRe.

</details>


### [398] [Auto-Discovery-Bench: Diagnosing Structured State Tracking in Oracle-Guided Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15224)
*Tingting Chen,Beibei Lin,Srinivas Anumasa,Vedant Shah,Zifeng Yuan,Qiran Zou,Anirudh Goyal,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Auto-Discovery-Bench，一个确定性、预言机引导的诊断基准，用于评估智能体在多轮交互中发现隐藏结构的能力。该基准包含有向图发现、无向关系发现和符号方程发现三个抽象任务。实验表明，模型性能随变量数、轨迹长度和干扰项增加而下降；即使去除干预选择和假设生成，许多失败依然存在，表明维护和整合长程结构化信息的能力是关键瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式发现要求智能体在多轮反馈中维护和更新结构化信念。在嘈杂、开放的科学环境中评估智能体之前，有必要在受控条件下孤立测试这一前提能力。

Method: 提出了Auto-Discovery-Bench，一个确定性预言机引导的诊断基准，通过重复的假设-干预-反馈循环让智能体恢复隐藏结构。基准包含三个受控发现抽象：有向图发现、无向关系发现和符号方程发现。

Result: 模型性能随变量数、轨迹长度和干扰项增加而下降。轨迹跟踪诊断显示，即使移除干预选择和假设生成，许多失败仍然存在。

Conclusion: 维护和整合长程结构化信息的限制是预言机引导发现的重要瓶颈。Auto-Discovery-Bench并非替代真实发现环境，而是提供了一个可复现、低混杂的诊断测试平台，用于隔离交互式科学智能体的前提能力。

Abstract: Interactive discovery requires agents to maintain and update structured beliefs over many rounds of feedback. Before evaluating agents in noisy, open-ended scientific environments, it is useful to isolate this prerequisite capability under controlled conditions. We introduce Auto-Discovery-Bench, a deterministic oracle-guided diagnostic benchmark in which agents recover hidden structures through repeated hypothesis--intervention--feedback cycles. The benchmark instantiates three controlled discovery abstractions: directed graph discovery, undirected relational discovery, and symbolic equation discovery. Across models, performance degrades as the number of variables, trajectory length, and distractors increase. A separate trajectory-tracking diagnostic shows that many failures persist even when intervention selection and hypothesis generation are removed, suggesting that limitations in maintaining and integrating long-range structured information are an important bottleneck for oracle-guided discovery. Auto-Discovery-Bench is not intended to replace realistic discovery environments; rather, it provides a reproducible, low-confound diagnostic testbed for isolating a prerequisite capability for interactive scientific agents.

</details>


### [399] [How does Bayesian Sampling help Membership Inference Attacks?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.07482)
*Zhenlong Liu,Wenyu Jiang,Feng Zhou,Hongxin Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BMIA方法，通过贝叶斯采样和拉普拉斯近似对单个参考模型进行后验估计，实现高效且有效的成员推断攻击，在多个数据集上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有成员推断攻击（MIA）通常需要训练多个参考模型来近似条件分数分布，计算开销大，限制了实际应用。本文旨在提出一种更高效的方法，减少计算成本的同时保持甚至提升攻击性能。

Method: 提出贝叶斯成员推断攻击（BMIA），对单个参考模型应用拉普拉斯近似得到模型参数的后验分布，从而直接估计条件分数分布；理论证明贝叶斯采样可减少模型内方差，提升攻击能力；进一步提出多参考变体以利用更多参考模型。

Result: 在图像、文本和表格数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在有效性和效率上均达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: BMIA通过贝叶斯采样有效降低了计算开销，同时提升了攻击性能，为成员推断攻击提供了一种高效且实用的新范式。

Abstract: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) aim to estimate whether a specific data point was used in the training of a given model. Existing state-of-the-art attacks typically rely on training multiple reference models to approximate the conditional score distribution for individual data points, which leads to significant computational overhead and limits their practical applicability. In this work, we propose a novel approach -- Bayesian Membership Inference Attack (BMIA), which performs conditional attack through Bayesian sampling. Specifically, we apply Laplace approximation to a single reference model to obtain a posterior over model parameters, enabling direct estimation of the conditional score distribution. Theoretically, we demonstrate that Bayesian sampling reduces intra-model variance, thereby improving attack power. This insight naturally motivates the multi-reference variant that further enhances performance when additional reference models are available. Extensive experiments across image, text, and tabular datasets indicate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both effectiveness and efficiency.

</details>


### [400] [NeUQI: Near-Optimal Uniform Quantization Parameter Initialization for Low-Bit LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17595)
*Li Lin,Xinyu Hu,Xiaojun Wan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NeUQI方法，通过优化均匀量化的尺度初始化参数，在低比特量化场景下提升LLM性能，结合轻量蒸馏甚至超越资源密集型方法PV-tuning。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM低比特均匀量化研究主要关注量化方法本身，而量化参数的初始化仍沿用传统的Min-Max公式，该公式存在局限性，参数初始化这一环节被忽视。

Method: 提出NeUQI方法，将尺度和零点联合优化简化为仅优化尺度（通过给定尺度推导出零点），从而高效确定近最优的均匀量化初始化参数。

Result: 在LLaMA和Qwen系列模型上，NeUQI在多种设置和任务中一致优于现有方法；结合轻量蒸馏策略后，性能甚至超越资源密集型方法PV-tuning。

Conclusion: NeUQI通过改进量化参数初始化，有效提升了低比特均匀量化下LLM的性能，且具有高效性和通用性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve impressive performance across domains but face significant challenges when deployed on consumer-grade GPUs or personal devices such as laptops, due to high memory consumption and inference costs. Post-training quantization (PTQ) of LLMs offers a promising solution that reduces their memory footprint and decoding latency. In practice, PTQ with uniform quantization representation is favored due to its efficiency and ease of deployment, as uniform quantization is widely supported by mainstream hardware and software libraries. Recent studies on low-bit uniform quantization have led to noticeable improvements in post-quantization model performance; however, they mainly focus on quantization methodologies, while the initialization of quantization parameters remains underexplored and still relies on the conventional Min-Max formula. In this work, we identify the limitations of the Min-Max formula, move beyond its constraints, and propose NeUQI, a method that efficiently determines near-optimal initialization for uniform quantization. Our NeUQI simplifies the joint optimization of the scale and zero-point by deriving the zero-point for a given scale, thereby reducing the problem to a scale-only optimization. Benefiting from the improved quantization parameters, our NeUQI consistently outperforms existing methods in the experiments with the LLaMA and Qwen families on various settings and tasks. Furthermore, when combined with a lightweight distillation strategy, NeUQI even achieves superior performance to PV-tuning, a considerably more resource-intensive method.

</details>


### [401] [Ubiquity of Emergent Hebbian Dynamics in Regularized Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18069)
*David Koplow,Tomaso Poggio,Liu Ziyin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现L2权重衰减在接近平稳状态时，会使许多更新规则的学习信号分量在方向上趋近于Hebbian方向，且随机噪声可诱导anti-Hebbian对齐，这表明观察到的Hebbian/anti-Hebbian突触可塑性结构不一定源于真正的Hebbian计算，而可能是一种涌现现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决一个可辨识性问题：观察到突触更新中的Hebbian/anti-Hebbian结构是否唯一地意味着底层存在Hebbian计算？

Method: 理论分析表明，在接近平稳状态下，L2权重衰减会使多种更新规则（包括SGD、非学习规则甚至随机更新规则）的学习信号分量在方向上与Hebbian方向对齐；进一步证明学习信号中的随机噪声可诱导anti-Hebbian对齐，在回归场景中与权重衰减形成简单权衡和相边界。

Result: L2权重衰减强度越大，对齐越单调增强；Hebbian式特征并非SGD特有，在学习停止前也可出现在非学习或随机更新规则中；随机噪声可诱导anti-Hebbian对齐，与权重衰减形成相边界。

Conclusion: 这些机制与真正的Hebbian可塑性共存，但会混淆突触测量的解释，需要设计实验区分机械式Hebbian计算与涌现的Hebbian特征。

Abstract: Hebbian and anti-Hebbian plasticity are widely observed in the brain and are classically modeled as mechanistic, local homosynaptic rules stabilized by homeostatic constraints. This raises an identifiability question: does observing Hebbian/anti-Hebbian structure in synaptic updates uniquely imply an underlying Hebbian computation? We identify an alternative, emergent route. We show that near stationarity, L2 weight decay generically drives the \emph{learning-signal} component of many update rules to align with a Hebbian direction, with alignment increasing monotonically with decay strength. This Hebbian-like signature is not specific to SGD and can arise even for non-learning or random update rules long before learning has ceased. We further show that stochastic noise in the learning signal can induce anti-Hebbian alignment, yielding a simple tradeoff with weight decay and a phase boundary in regression settings. These mechanisms do not replace standard Hebbian theory; they can coexist with genuine Hebbian plasticity and complicate the interpretation of synaptic measurements, motivating experiments that distinguish mechanistic Hebbian computation from emergent Hebbian signatures.

</details>


### [402] [Aggregation Buffer: Revisiting DropEdge with a New Parameter Block](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20840)
*Dooho Lee,Myeong Kong,Sagad Hamid,Cheonwoo Lee,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了DropEdge数据增强技术，发现其在监督学习中的性能提升有限，并从理论角度分析了其局限性源于GNN架构的固有限制。为此，提出了聚合缓冲区（Aggregation Buffer），一种专门设计的参数模块，用于提升GNN的鲁棒性，可兼容任何GNN模型，在多个数据集上表现一致，并能有效解决度偏差和结构差异等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DropEdge作为一种随机移除边的数据增强技术，虽然可以减少过拟合，但在监督学习任务中的性能提升十分有限。作者希望理解这一局限性的根本原因，并提出改进方案。

Method: 首先通过理论分析揭示DropEdge性能受限的根本原因在于许多GNN架构的固有限制；然后提出聚合缓冲区（Aggregation Buffer），一个专门设计的参数块，用于提升GNN的鲁棒性。

Result: 该方法与任何GNN模型兼容，在多个数据集上取得一致的性能提升；同时能有效解决度偏差和结构差异等经典问题。

Conclusion: 聚合缓冲区作为一种统一解决方案，能够有效克服DropEdge在监督学习中的局限性，并提升GNN的鲁棒性与公平性。

Abstract: We revisit DropEdge, a data augmentation technique for GNNs which randomly removes edges to expose diverse graph structures during training. While being a promising approach to effectively reduce overfitting on specific connections in the graph, we observe that its potential performance gain in supervised learning tasks is significantly limited. To understand why, we provide a theoretical analysis showing that the limited performance of DropEdge comes from the fundamental limitation that exists in many GNN architectures. Based on this analysis, we propose Aggregation Buffer, a parameter block specifically designed to improve the robustness of GNNs by addressing the limitation of DropEdge. Our method is compatible with any GNN model, and shows consistent performance improvements on multiple datasets. Moreover, our method effectively addresses well-known problems such as degree bias or structural disparity as a unifying solution. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/dooho00/agg-buffer.

</details>


### [403] [Who Gets Credit or Blame? Attributing Accountability in Modern AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.00175)
*Shichang Zhang,Hongzhe Du,Jiaqi W. Ma,Himabindu Lakkaraju*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出责任归因框架，用于追溯AI模型在多阶段开发（预训练、微调、对齐等）中各阶段对最终行为的贡献，并设计了无需重新训练的高效估计方法，成功应用于图像分类和文本毒性检测中的虚假相关性识别与消除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统通常经历预训练、微调、对齐等多阶段开发，每个阶段对模型行为的影响不同。当模型在部署中表现成功或失败时，亟需回答哪个阶段应承担责任以及责任程度，但目前缺乏系统的归因方法。

Method: 提出一个通用框架，通过回答反事实问题（如果某阶段的更新没有发生，模型行为会如何变化）来量化阶段效应。设计了无需重新训练模型的高效估计器，同时考虑了数据分布和模型优化动力学（包括学习率调度、动量、权重衰减等关键因素）。

Result: 成功量化了各阶段对模型行为的责任程度；基于归因结果，能够在图像分类和文本毒性检测任务中识别并移除多阶段开发过程中学习到的虚假相关性。

Conclusion: 本文方法为模型分析提供了实用工具，是迈向更负责任的AI开发的重要一步。

Abstract: Modern AI systems are typically developed through multiple stages-pretraining, fine-tuning rounds, and subsequent adaptation or alignment, where each stage builds on the previous ones and updates the model in distinct ways. This raises a critical question of accountability: when a deployed model succeeds or fails, which stage is responsible, and to what extent? We pose the accountability attribution problem for tracing model behavior back to specific stages of the model development process. To address this challenge, we propose a general framework that answers counterfactual questions about stage effects: how would the model's behavior have changed if the updates from a particular stage had not occurred? Within this framework, we introduce estimators that efficiently quantify stage effects without retraining the model, accounting for both the data and key aspects of model optimization dynamics, including learning rate schedules, momentum, and weight decay. We demonstrate that our approach successfully quantifies the accountability of each stage to the model's behavior. Based on the attribution results, our method can identify and remove spurious correlations learned during image classification and text toxicity detection tasks that were developed across multiple stages. Our approach provides a practical tool for model analysis and represents a significant step toward more accountable AI development.

</details>


### [404] [Unlearning's Blind Spots: Over-Unlearning and Prototypical Relearning Attack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01318)
*SeungBum Ha,Saerom Park,Sung Whan Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对机器遗忘（MU）中两个盲点——过度遗忘（损害保留数据）和事后重新学习攻击（复活遗忘知识），提出Spotter方法：结合掩码知识蒸馏惩罚（抑制过度遗忘）和类内分散损失（防止原型重新学习攻击），在多个数据集上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘技术忽略了两个关键盲点：（1）过度遗忘导致遗忘集附近保留数据性能退化；（2）事后重新学习攻击能够复活被遗忘的知识。本文旨在同时解决这两个问题。

Method: 提出Spotter方法：（1）定义过度遗忘度量OU@epsilon；（2）揭示原型重新学习攻击（利用少量样本恢复遗忘类原型）；（3）Spotter损失函数包含两个部分：对遗忘类邻近区域的掩码知识蒸馏惩罚（抑制过度遗忘），以及类内分散损失（分散遗忘类嵌入，抵御原型重新学习攻击）。

Result: 在CIFAR、TinyImageNet、CASIA-WebFace数据集上，Spotter在类级遗忘任务中达到SOTA结果，有效降低了OU@epsilon并抵御了原型重新学习攻击。

Conclusion: Spotter作为一种即插即用的目标函数，能够同时缓解机器遗忘中的过度遗忘和重新学习攻击两大盲点，为实际问题提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Machine unlearning (MU) aims to expunge a designated forget set from a trained model without costly retraining, yet the existing techniques overlook two critical blind spots: "over-unlearning" that deteriorates retained data near the forget set, and post-hoc "relearning" attacks that aim to resurrect the forgotten knowledge. Focusing on class-level unlearning, we first derive an over-unlearning metric, OU@epsilon, which quantifies collateral damage in regions proximal to the forget set, where over-unlearning mainly occurs. Next, we expose an unforeseen relearning threat on MU, i.e., the Prototypical Relearning Attack, which exploits the per-class prototype of the forget class with just a few samples, and easily restores the pre-unlearning performance. To counter both blind spots in class-level unlearning, we introduce Spotter, a plug-and-play objective that combines (i) a masked knowledge-distillation penalty on the nearby region of forget classes to suppress OU@epsilon, and (ii) an intra-class dispersion loss that scatters forget-class embeddings, neutralizing Prototypical Relearning Attacks. Spotter achieves state-of-the-art results across CIFAR, TinyImageNet, and CASIA-WebFace datasets, offering a practical remedy to unlearning's blind spots.

</details>


### [405] [Feature-Aware (Hyper)graph Generation via Next-Scale Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01467)
*Dorian Gailhard,Enzo Tartaglione,Lirida Naviner,Jhony H. Giraldo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FAHNES框架，通过多尺度层级生成和特征感知机制，实现大规模带特征图与超图的联合拓扑-特征生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图生成模型在小型结构化数据上表现良好，但难以扩展到大规模复杂结构；层级方法虽提升了可扩展性，却忽略了实际应用中关键的节点和边特征，尤其对于建模高阶关系的超图而言。

Method: 提出FAHNES分层框架，通过节点粗化和局部扩展构建多尺度表示，引入新型层级尺度编码以控制粒度并确保跨尺度一致性，实现拓扑和特征的联合生成。

Result: 在合成图、3D网格和图点云数据集上达到竞争性或最先进的性能，并且是唯一能扩展到带特征的大规模图和超图的方法。

Conclusion: FAHNES有效解决了大规模特征图的生成难题，同时适用于超图，代码已开源。

Abstract: Graph generative models perform well on small structured data but struggle to scale to large, complex structures. Hierarchical approaches improve scalability but often ignore node and edge features, which are critical in real-world applications, particularly for hypergraphs that model higher-order relationships. In this paper, we propose FAHNES (feature-aware (hyper)graph generation via next-scale prediction), a hierarchical framework that jointly generates topology and features for graphs and hypergraphs. FAHNES builds multi-scale representations through node coarsening and localized expansion, guided by a novel hierarchical scale encoding that controls granularity and ensures cross-scale consistency. Experiments on synthetic, 3D mesh, and graph point cloud datasets demonstrate competitive or state-of-the-art performance while uniquely scaling to featured large-scale graphs and hypergraphs. Our code is open source

</details>


### [406] [SHIELD: Secure Hypernetworks for Incremental Expansion Learning Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08255)
*Patryk Krukowski,Łukasz Gorczyca,Piotr Helm,Kamil Książek,Przemysław Spurek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SHIELD 是一个融合区间界传播（IBP）与超网络架构的框架，通过任务嵌入生成模型参数，无需重放缓冲区或完整模型副本，并引入 Interval MixUp 训练策略，在多个基准上实现了对抗环境下可证明鲁棒的持续学习，在平均准确率、可扩展性和认证鲁棒性方面均达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法在对抗条件下难以同时兼顾鲁棒性、可扩展性和认证性，往往顾此失彼。

Method: 将区间界传播（IBP）与超网络架构结合，通过共享超网络基于紧凑任务嵌入生成任务特定参数；提出 Interval MixUp 训练策略，混合以 MixUp 点为中心的 ℓ∞ 球表示的虚拟样本，利用区间算术保证认证鲁棒性并缓解包裹效应。

Result: 在多种基准上，面对 PGD 和 AutoAttack 等强白盒对抗攻击，SHIELD 在平均准确率、可扩展性和认证鲁棒性方面均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: SHIELD 为对抗环境下实用且理论可证的持续学习迈出了重要一步。

Abstract: Continual learning under adversarial conditions remains an open problem, as existing methods often compromise either robustness, scalability, or both. We propose a novel framework that integrates Interval Bound Propagation (IBP) with a hypernetwork-based architecture to enable certifiably robust continual learning across sequential tasks. Our method, SHIELD, generates task-specific model parameters via a shared hypernetwork conditioned solely on compact task embeddings, eliminating the need for replay buffers or full model copies and enabling efficient over time. To further enhance robustness, we introduce Interval MixUp, a novel training strategy that blends virtual examples represented as $\ell_{\infty}$ balls centered around MixUp points. Leveraging interval arithmetic, this technique guarantees certified robustness while mitigating the wrapping effect, resulting in smoother decision boundaries. We evaluate SHIELD under strong white-box adversarial attacks, including PGD and AutoAttack, across multiple benchmarks. It consistently outperforms existing robust continual learning methods, achieving state-of-the-art average accuracy while maintaining both scalability and certification. These results represent a significant step toward practical and theoretically grounded continual learning in adversarial settings.

</details>


### [407] [Unfolding Generative Flows with Koopman Operators: Trajectory-Preserving Linearization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.22304)
*Erkan Turan,Aristotelis Siozopoulos,Louis Martinez,Julien Gaubil,Emery Pierson,Maks Ovsjanikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用Koopman理论对连续归一化流进行全局线性化，通过将预训练的条件流匹配模型提升到高维Koopman空间，用单一线性算子表示其演化，实现了保持轨迹的线性化，支持一步并行采样，并揭示了生成过程的可解释结构（语义编辑方向、逆映射、类别条件谱特征）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续归一化流（CNFs）受限于迭代采样的高成本和中间状态缺乏可解释性。尽管已有通过拉直轨迹或蒸馏端点来加速采样的方法，但它们将原始生成过程视为黑箱，丢弃了教师模型的中间动态信息。作者旨在保留完整生成轨迹信息的同时实现线性化，从而兼顾采样效率与可解释性。

Method: 基于Koopman理论，将预训练的条件流匹配（CFM）模型提升到高维Koopman空间，用单一线性算子近似其完整演化。方法的关键在于：与仅边界蒸馏不同，该方法强制保证与教师向量场沿整个生成路径的无穷小一致性。作者推导了一个无需模拟的训练目标来实现全局对齐。

Result: 实现了（1）一步并行采样；（2）发现语义一致的编辑方向；（3）通过教师对齐的线性算子进行逆映射；（4）类别条件谱特征。实验上取得了具有竞争力的样本质量，并实现了对生成流完整轨迹的谱分析与控制。

Conclusion: 通过Koopman线性化为CNFs提供了一种兼顾采样效率与可解释性的新范式，在保持教师动态忠实性的同时，开辟了语义编辑、逆映射和谱分析等先前方法无法实现的应用。

Abstract: Continuous Normalizing Flows (CNFs) enable elegant generative modeling but remain bottlenecked by their iterative nature requiring costly sampling and lacking interpretability of the intermediate states. Recent approaches accelerate sampling by straightening trajectories or distilling endpoints, yet they treat the original generative process as a black box, discarding the teacher's intermediate dynamics. We propose a fundamentally different perspective: globally linearizing flow dynamics via Koopman theory to achieve trajectory-preserving linearization. By lifting a pre-trained Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) model into a higher-dimensional Koopman space, we represent its evolution with a single linear operator. Crucially, unlike boundary-only distillation, our method enforces infinitesimal consistency with the teacher's vector field along the full generative path. We derive a practical, simulation-free training objective that ensures this global alignment and yields two key benefits. First, sampling becomes one-step and parallelizable. Second, because the linearization is faithful to the dynamics, the Koopman operator provides unique insights on the generation. We demonstrate that this structure enables novel applications unavailable in prior approaches, including discovery of semantically coherent editing directions, inversion with a teacher-aligned linear operator and class-conditional spectral signatures. Empirically, our approach achieves competitive sample quality, while enabling spectral analysis and control of the entire trajectories of generative flows.

</details>


### [408] [Cost-aware Stopping for Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.12453)
*Qian Xie,Linda Cai,Alexander Terenin,Peter I. Frazier,Ziv Scully*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于贝叶斯优化的成本感知停止规则，该规则与成本感知采集函数（PBGI和LogEIPC）结合时，能提供期望成本调整简单遗憾的理论保证，并在超参数优化和神经架构搜索等任务中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯优化停止规则要么是启发式的，要么虽具理论基础但仅优化简单遗憾而未考虑评估成本，导致高成本下可能产生不必要的评估。需要一个能适应变化评估成本且无需启发式调参的原则性停止规则。

Method: 提出了一种成本感知的停止规则，理论上与Pandora's Box Gittins Index (PBGI) 和 log expected improvement per cost (LogEIPC) 两种采集函数建立联系。证明了当与任一采集函数配对时，该策略满足期望成本调整简单遗憾的理论界。

Result: 在合成任务和实证基准（包括超参数优化和神经架构大小搜索）中，将提出的停止规则与PBGI或LogEIPC配对，在成本调整简单遗憾指标上通常匹配或优于其他采集函数-停止规则组合。

Conclusion: 该停止规则为成本感知的贝叶斯优化提供了理论保证和实用性能，有效平衡了解质量与累积评估成本之间的权衡。

Abstract: In automated machine learning, scientific discovery, and other applications of Bayesian optimization, deciding when to stop evaluating expensive black-box functions in a cost-aware manner is an important but underexplored practical consideration. A natural performance metric for this purpose is the cost-adjusted simple regret, which explicitly captures the trade-off between solution quality and cumulative evaluation cost. Existing stopping rules for Bayesian optimization are either heuristic, or are theoretically grounded but designed to optimize simple regret without accounting for evaluation costs; as a result, they provide no guarantees against unnecessary evaluations when costs are high. We propose a principled cost-aware stopping rule for Bayesian optimization that adapts to varying evaluation costs without heuristic tuning. Our rule is grounded in a theoretical connection to state-of-the-art cost-aware acquisition functions, namely the Pandora's Box Gittins Index (PBGI) and log expected improvement per cost (LogEIPC). When paired with either acquisition function, we prove that the resulting policy satisfies a theoretical guarantee bounding the expected cost-adjusted simple regret. Across synthetic tasks and empirical benchmarks including hyperparameter optimization and neural architecture size search, pairing our stopping rule with PBGI or LogEIPC usually matches or outperforms other acquisition-function--stopping-rule pairs in terms of cost-adjusted simple regret.

</details>


### [409] [Population-Free Pareto Tracking for Sample-Efficient Multi-Policy MORL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02217)
*Zeyu Zhao,Yueling Che,Kaichen Liu,Jian Li,Junmei Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MPFT是一种无需自我进化种群的多策略帕累托前沿追踪框架，通过初始化单目标极端策略并稀疏稠密区域，显著提升样本效率，在机器人控制任务中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线多策略MORL方法依赖大型种群进化，导致样本复杂度高、智能体-环境交互过多，需要更高效的帕累托前沿逼近方法。

Method: 提出MPFT框架，利用帕累托追踪机制，初始化单目标极端策略后追踪帕累托前沿，并对稀疏区域进行致密化处理以逼近完整前沿；可无缝集成离线MORL算法。

Result: 在6个机器人控制任务（最多3目标）和3个高维任务（超过3目标）上，MPFT在超体积和期望效用指标上优于SOTA基线，并显著减少智能体-环境交互次数。

Conclusion: MPFT是一个通用框架，能够无缝集成在线和离线MORL算法，在样本效率和性能上均取得显著提升。

Abstract: Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) is a fundamental framework for real-world decision-making problems involving multiple conflicting criteria. Existing multi-policy (MP) methods typically rely on online evolutionary frameworks that maintain large policy populations, leading to high sample complexity and excessive agent-environment interactions. To mitigate these limitations, we present Multi-policy Pareto Front Tracking (MPFT), a framework without a self-evolving population. It leverages an efficient Pareto-tracking mechanism initialized with single-objective extreme policies to trace the Pareto front, and further densifies sparse regions to achieve an accurate approximation of the full Pareto front. MPFT can be seamlessly integrated with advanced offline MORL algorithms, thereby substantially improving sample efficiency. We evaluate MPFT on six robotic control tasks with up to three objectives and three high-dimensional tasks with more than three objectives. Experimental results show that MPFT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of hypervolume and expected utility. It also significantly reduces agent-environment interactions. These results further demonstrate that MPFT serves as a general-purpose framework that can seamlessly integrate both online and offline MORL algorithms.

</details>


### [410] [Residual Reservoir Memory Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.09925)
*Matteo Pinna,Andrea Ceni,Claudio Gallicchio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Residual Reservoir Memory Networks (ResRMNs)的新型未训练循环神经网络，它结合线性记忆储层和基于残差正交连接的非线性储层，通过时间维度上的残差连接增强长期输入传播，并在时间序列和像素级1D分类任务上超越传统RC模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有储层计算模型在处理长期时间依赖时存在局限性，传统RNN训练成本高且易出现梯度问题。作者旨在设计一种无需训练的RC架构，通过结合线性记忆储层与残差正交连接的非线性储层，增强长期信息传播能力。

Method: ResRMN包含两个核心组件：1）线性记忆储层用于保持长期依赖；2）基于残差正交连接的非线性储层，沿时间维度引入残差连接以促进信息长程传播。通过线性稳定性分析研究储层状态动力学，并探索多种时间残差连接配置。

Result: 在时间序列和像素级1D分类任务上的实验结果表明，ResRMN相对于传统RC模型具有显著优势，性能更优。

Conclusion: ResRMN作为一种新型无需训练的RC架构，通过线性记忆与残差正交非线性储层的结合，有效提升了长期时间依赖建模能力，在多个基准任务上优于传统方法。

Abstract: We introduce a novel class of untrained Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) within the Reservoir Computing (RC) paradigm, called Residual Reservoir Memory Networks (ResRMNs). ResRMN combines a linear memory reservoir with a non-linear reservoir, where the latter is based on residual orthogonal connections along the temporal dimension for enhanced long-term propagation of the input. The resulting reservoir state dynamics are studied through the lens of linear stability analysis, and we investigate diverse configurations for the temporal residual connections. The proposed approach is empirically assessed on time-series and pixel-level 1-D classification tasks. Our experimental results highlight the advantages of the proposed approach over other conventional RC models.

</details>


### [411] [Native Hierarchical and Compositional Representations with Subspace Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.16687)
*Gabriel Moreira,Zita Marinho,Manuel Marques,João Paulo Costeira,Chenyan Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将概念表示为线性子空间而非传统向量的新范式，通过子空间的维度、包含关系和线性代数操作自然捕捉概念的泛化性、层次性和组合性，并设计了可微分的软投影矩阵参数化方法进行训练，在层次推理和自然语言推理任务上取得了最优性能，且能原生处理否定查询等逻辑组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统向量嵌入将数据点表示为向量，虽然便于计算相似度，但难以有效捕捉层级结构和组合性，因此需要一种新范式来更自然地表达概念之间的层次关系和组合逻辑。

Method: 提出将概念表示为线性子空间，利用高维子空间表示更广泛的概念、子空间包含关系表示层级、线性代数运算表示组合；引入可微分的软投影矩阵参数化方法，使子空间的有效维度可被学习。

Result: 在层次推理和自然语言推理基准上取得最优性能；在否定查询等逻辑组合任务上，子空间嵌入能原生捕获逻辑组合而无需显式监督，且保持与高效欧几里得向量搜索的兼容性。

Conclusion: 子空间嵌入范式在捕捉层级结构、组合逻辑和推理能力上优于传统向量嵌入，同时兼具几何可解释性和实际可用性。

Abstract: Traditional embeddings represent datapoints as vectors, which makes similarity easy to compute but limits how well they capture hierarchies and compositionality. We propose a fundamentally different approach: representing concepts as linear subspaces. By spanning multiple dimensions, subspaces can model broader concepts with higher-dimensional regions and nest more specific concepts within them. This geometry naturally captures generality through dimension, hierarchy through inclusion, and enables an emergent structure for composition via linear algebraic operations. To make this paradigm trainable, we introduce a differentiable subspace parameterization via soft projection matrices, allowing the effective dimension of each subspace to be learned. Our method not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on hierarchical and natural language inference benchmarks but also provides a geometrically-grounded model of entailment. Further, we demonstrate that while standard vector embeddings degrade to near-random performance on negated queries, subspace embeddings natively capture logical composition without explicit supervision, while preserving compatibility with efficient Euclidean vector search.

</details>


### [412] [Beyond Tokens: Enhancing RTL Quality Estimation via Structural Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.18730)
*Yi Liu,Hongji Zhang,Yiwen Wang,Dimitris Tsaras,Lei Chen,Mingxuan Yuan,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StructRTL提出了一种基于控制数据流图(CDFG)的结构感知图自监督学习框架，用于RTL设计质量评估，通过知识蒸馏策略引入后映射网表信息，在面积和延迟等指标预测上取得了最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的RTL质量评估方法忽略了RTL代码的结构语义，而CDFG视图能更显式地暴露设计结构特征，因此需要一种结构感知的学习方法来提升评估精度。

Method: 1) 从RTL代码构建CDFG作为结构表示；2) 采用图自监督学习框架学习结构感知的表示；3) 引入知识蒸馏策略，将后映射网表的低层信息迁移到CDFG-based预测器中。

Result: 在多种质量评估任务上显著优于现有方法，取得了新的最佳结果。

Conclusion: 结构学习与跨阶段监督相结合的方法能有效提升RTL设计质量评估性能。

Abstract: Estimating the quality of register transfer level (RTL) designs is crucial in the electronic design automation (EDA) workflow, as it enables instant feedback on key performance metrics like area and delay without the need for time-consuming logic synthesis. While recent approaches have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to derive embeddings from RTL code and achieved promising results, they overlook the structural semantics essential for accurate quality estimation. In contrast, the control data flow graph (CDFG) view exposes the design's structural characteristics more explicitly, offering richer cues for representation learning. In this work, we introduce StructRTL, a novel structure-aware graph self-supervised learning framework for improved RTL design quality estimation. By learning structure-informed representations from CDFGs, StructRTL significantly outperforms prior art on various quality estimation tasks. To further boost performance, we incorporate a knowledge distillation strategy that transfers low-level insights from post-mapping netlists into the CDFG-based predictor. Experimental results demonstrate that StructRTL establishes new state-of-the-art results, highlighting the effectiveness of combining structural learning with cross-stage supervision.

</details>


### [413] [Delayed Momentum Aggregation: Communication-efficient Byzantine-robust Federated Learning with Partial Participation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.02970)
*Kaoru Otsuka,Yuki Takezawa,Makoto Yamada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出延迟动量聚合（DeMoA）方法，通过缓存未采样客户端的动量与新鲜动量聚合，使拜占庭客户端在服务器视角下始终为少数，从而在部分参与场景下实现鲁棒联邦学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有拜占庭鲁棒方法通常假设全客户端参与，但在部分参与场景下，若采样集中拜占庭客户端占多数，现有方法会立即失效。

Method: 提出延迟动量聚合原则：服务器将未采样客户端的缓存动量与采样客户端的新鲜动量聚合，确保拜占庭客户端在服务器视角中始终为少数。基于此原则实现优化器DeMoA。

Result: 理论分析了DeMoA的收敛率，证明其在部分参与下具有拜占庭鲁棒性。实验表明，在20%拜占庭比例、仅10%部分参与率下，DeMoA在现有方法失效时仍能达到最佳准确率。

Conclusion: 延迟动量聚合能有效解决部分参与场景下的拜占庭鲁棒联邦学习问题，为大规模通信高效联邦学习提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Partial participation is essential for communication-efficient federated learning at scale, yet existing Byzantine-robust methods typically assume full client participation. In the partial participation setting, a majority of the sampled clients may be Byzantine, once Byzantine clients dominate, existing methods break down immediately. We introduce delayed momentum aggregation, a principle where the central server aggregates cached momentum from non-sampled clients along with fresh momentum from sampled clients. This principle ensures Byzantine clients remain a minority from the server's perspective even when they dominate the sampled set. We instantiate this principle in our optimizer DeMoA. We analyze the convergence rate of DeMoA, showing that DeMoA is Byzantine-robust under partial participation. Experiments show that, with 20% Byzantine ratio and only 10% partial participation rate, DeMoA achieves the best accuracy even when existing methods fail empirically.

</details>


### [414] [LiMuon: Light and Fast Muon Optimizer for Large Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14562)
*Feihu Huang,Yuning Luo,Songcan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LiMuon优化器，通过动量方差缩减和随机SVD技术，在保持更低内存的同时实现了O(ε⁻³)的样本复杂度，相比Muon及其变体具有更低的内存和样本复杂度，并在Mamba-130M、Qwen2.5-0.5B和ViT模型上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Muon优化器及其变体在训练大模型时存在样本复杂度高或内存开销大的问题，亟需一种同时降低内存和样本复杂度的优化方法。

Method: 基于动量方差缩减技术和随机奇异值分解(SVD)，设计LiMuon优化器；对于使用Newton-Schulz步骤的情况也进行了理论分析。

Result: LiMuon在非凸随机优化广义光滑条件下达到O(ε⁻³)的样本复杂度，低于现有Muon变体；在Mamba-130M、Qwen2.5-0.5B和ViT模型上的实验验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: LiMuon同时实现了更低的内存开销和更低的样本复杂度，缩小了理论与实践之间的差距，为大规模模型训练提供了更高效的优化方案。

Abstract: Large models recently are widely applied in machine learning, so efficient training of large models has received widespread attention. More recently, the useful Muon optimizer is specifically designed for matrix-structured parameters of large models. Although some works have begun to study the Muon optimizer, the existing Muon and its variants still suffer from high sample complexity or high memory for large models. To fill this gap, we propose a light and fast Muon (LiMuon) optimizer for training large models, which builds on the momentum-based variance reduced technique and randomized Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). In particular, our LiMuon simultaneously has a lower memory and lower sample complexity than the Muon and its variants. Moreover, we prove that our LiMuon with lower memory has a lower sample complexity of $O(ε^{-3})$ for finding an $ε$-stationary solution of non-convex stochastic optimization under the generalized smooth condition. To further narrow practice and theory gap, we also prove that our LiMuon with Newton-Schulz steps has a lower sample complexity than the Muon with Newton-Schulz steps. Numerical experimental results on training Mamba-130M, Qwen2.5-0.5B and ViT models demonstrate effectiveness of our LiMuon.

</details>


### [415] [Towards Foundation Models for Zero-Shot Time Series Anomaly Detection: Leveraging Synthetic Data and Relative Context Discrepancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21190)
*Tian Lan,Hao Duong Le,Jinbo Li,Wenjun He,Meng Wang,Chenghao Liu,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TimeRCD是一种基于相对上下文差异（RCD）预训练范式的时间序列异常检测基础模型，通过对比查询模式与其周围上下文来检测异常，在零样本设置下优于现有通用和专用基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测基础模型在零样本泛化方面存在困难，基于重构误差打分的方法会遗漏被良好重构的细微异常，并对未见领域中的复杂正常模式产生误报。

Method: 提出RCD预训练范式，让模型通过比较查询模式与其周围上下文来检测异常；使用标准Transformer架构实现；构建大规模带上下文依赖异常标签的合成语料库提供监督预训练信号。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，TimeRCD在大多数零样本TSAD设置中优于现有通用和异常检测专用基础模型，并与数据集特定的全样本基线方法具有竞争力。

Conclusion: RCD是构建鲁棒且可泛化的TSAD模型的有效方向。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is a critical task, but developing models that generalize to unseen data in a zero-shot manner remains challenging. Existing foundation models for TSAD often rely on reconstruction-error scoring at inference time, which can miss subtle anomalies that are well reconstructed and can falsely flag complex but normal patterns in unseen domains. We introduce TimeRCD, a foundation model for TSAD built on Relative Context Discrepancy (RCD), a pre-training paradigm that trains the model to detect anomalies by comparing a query pattern with its surrounding context. This relational formulation, implemented with a standard Transformer architecture, enables the model to infer normality from the input context rather than relying on fixed global normal patterns. We further construct a large-scale synthetic corpus with context-dependent anomaly labels to provide supervised pre-training signals for RCD. Experiments across diverse benchmarks show that TimeRCD outperforms existing general-purpose and anomaly-specific foundation models in most zero-shot TSAD settings, while remaining competitive with dataset-specific full-shot baselines. These results provide empirical evidence that RCD is an effective direction for building robust and generalizable TSAD models.

</details>


### [416] [Spectral Collapse Drives Loss of Plasticity in Deep Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22335)
*Arjun Prakash,Naicheng He,Kaicheng Guo,Saket Tiwari,Ruo Yu Tao,Tyrone Serapio,Amy Greenwald,George Konidaris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了深度神经网络在持续学习中失去可塑性的原因，发现这是由于新任务初始化时的Hessian谱坍塌导致。通过线性化ReLU网络分析，推导了ε-秩条件，证明了损失加权Gram矩阵与广义Gauss-Newton近似的谱等价性。基于Kronecker分解近似的Hessian，提出了两种正则化增强方法：保持高有效特征秩和施加L2惩罚。实验验证了组合使用这两种正则化器能有效保持可塑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究深度神经网络在持续学习中失去可塑性的根本原因，即为什么网络在不重新初始化参数的情况下难以学习新任务。

Method: 1. 通过分析线性化ReLU网络，推导出成功训练的ε-秩条件；2. 证明损失加权Gram矩阵与广义Gauss-Newton近似的谱等价性，建立NTK动力学与Hessian曲率的联系；3. 基于Kronecker分解近似的Hessian，提出两种正则化增强：保持高有效特征秩和施加L2惩罚。

Result: 实验结果表明，在持续监督学习和强化学习任务中，组合使用保持高有效特征秩和L2惩罚两种正则化器能有效保持网络的可塑性。

Conclusion: Hessian谱坍塌是深度神经网络在持续学习中失去可塑性的关键前兆，通过针对性的正则化方法可以有效缓解这一问题。

Abstract: We investigate why deep neural networks suffer from loss of plasticity in continual learning, and thus fail to learn new tasks without reinitializing parameters. We show that this failure is preceded by Hessian spectral collapse at new-task initialization, where meaningful curvature directions vanish and gradient descent becomes ineffective. Analyzing a linearized ReLU network, we derive explicit $ε$-rank conditions for successful training and prove that the loss-weighted Gram matrix is spectrally equivalent to the Generalized Gauss-Newton approximation, thereby relating NTK dynamics to Hessian curvature. Targeting spectral collapse directly, we then discuss the Kronecker factored approximation of the Hessian, which motivates two regularization enhancements: maintaining high effective feature rank and applying L2 penalties. Experiments on continual supervised and reinforcement learning tasks confirm that combining these two regularizers effectively preserves plasticity.

</details>


### [417] [Federated Learning with Enhanced Privacy via Model Splitting and Random Client Participation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.25906)
*Yiwei Li,Shuai Wang,Zhuojun Tian,Xiuhua Wang,Shijian Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MS-PAFL框架，通过模型拆分（私有子模型保留本地+公开子模型共享聚合）并仅向公开子模型注入校准高斯噪声，结合客户端随机参与和本地数据子采样的统计隐私放大，在强隐私保护下实现更优的隐私-效用权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习采用差分隐私时，为满足隐私保证所需的添加噪声会严重降低模型精度，亟需一种既能提供强隐私保护又能保持高模型准确性的方法。

Method: 将客户端模型拆分为私有子模型（本地保留）和公开子模型（共享聚合），仅对公开子模型注入校准高斯噪声；通过随机客户端参与和本地数据子采样实现联合隐私放大，并提供单轮和总隐私损失的严格理论界。

Result: 理论分析证明MS-PAFL能显著减少满足目标隐私保护级别所需的噪声量；实验验证表明该方法始终能实现更优的隐私-效用权衡，在强隐私保证下训练出高精度模型。

Conclusion: MS-PAFL通过结构化的模型拆分与隐私放大策略，有效缓解了差分隐私噪声对模型精度的负面影响，实现了隐私保护与模型效用的双赢。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) often adopts differential privacy (DP) to protect client data, but the added noise required for privacy guarantees can substantially degrade model accuracy. To resolve this challenge, we propose model-splitting privacy-amplified federated learning (MS-PAFL), a novel framework that combines structural model splitting with statistical privacy amplification. In this framework, each client's model is partitioned into a private submodel, retained locally, and a public submodel, shared for global aggregation. The calibrated Gaussian noise is injected only into the public submodel, thereby confining its adverse impact while preserving the utility of the local model. We further present a rigorous theoretical analysis that characterizes the joint privacy amplification achieved through random client participation and local data subsampling under this architecture. The analysis provides tight bounds on both single-round and total privacy loss, demonstrating that MS-PAFL significantly reduces the noise necessary to satisfy a target privacy protection level. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical findings, showing that MS-PAFL consistently attains a superior privacy-utility trade-off and enables the training of highly accurate models under strong privacy guarantees.

</details>


### [418] [Learning a Zeroth-Order Optimizer for Fine-Tuning LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00419)
*Kairun Zhang,Haoyu Li,Yanjun Zhao,Yifan Sun,Huan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ZO-Finetuner，一种基于学习的零阶优化器，通过可学习的扰动策略和一次性模型训练，在节省内存的同时实现高效的大语言模型微调，在82.1%的任务-模型组合中优于现有零阶方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零阶优化器依赖手工设计的静态采样策略，无法适应特定模型结构，缺乏自适应性。

Method: 提出ZO-Finetuner，一种基于学习的零阶优化器，通过紧凑且内存高效的设计自动学习高效的扰动策略，支持一次性每模型训练并在下游任务间复用。

Result: 在4个LLM和7个数据集上，ZO-Finetuner在82.1%的任务-模型组合中优于先前的零阶基线方法。
