Nevertheless, most existing one-shot approaches remain either impractical or constrained, for example, they often depend on the availability of a public dataset, assume homogeneous client models, or require uploading additional data or model information. To overcome these issues, we introduce the Gaussian-Head OFL (GH-OFL) family, a suite of one-shot federated methods that assume class-conditional Gaussianity of pretrained embeddings. Clients transmit only sufficient statistics (per-class counts and first/second-order moments) and the server builds heads via three components: (i) Closed-form Gaussian heads (NB/LDA/QDA) computed directly from the received statistics; (ii) FisherMix, a linear head with cosine margin trained on synthetic samples drawn in an estimated Fisher subspace; and (iii) Proto-Hyper, a lightweight low-rank residual head that refines Gaussian logits via knowledge distillation on those synthetic samples. In our experiments, GH-OFL methods deliver state-of-the-art robustness and accuracy under strong non-IID skew while remaining strictly data-free.

</details>


### [458] [Diving into Kronecker Adapters: Component Design Matters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01267)
*Jiayu Bai,Danchen Yu,Zhenyu Liao,TianQi Hou,Feng Zhou,Robert C. Qiu,Zenan Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出Kronecker适配器中组件结构（维度与数量）是影响模型容量的关键因素，通过细粒度分析揭示了组件配置与全微调对齐的关系，据此提出组件设计的Kronecker适配器（CDKA），并提供了参数预算感知的配置指南和训练稳定策略，实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Kronecker适配器工作将组件结构视为固定或启发式设计选择，忽略了组件维度与数量对模型容量的影响，缺乏对组件结构的系统性探索。

Method: 对Kronecker组件的维度与数量进行细粒度分析，揭示组件配置与全微调对齐的关系；基于此提出Component Designed Kronecker Adapters (CDKA)，并提供参数预算感知的配置指南以及针对性的训练稳定策略。

Result: 在不同架构和模态上的实验证明了CDKA的有效性。

Conclusion: 组件结构是Kronecker适配器容量的关键因素，合理设计组件配置可以提升适配器与全微调的对齐效果，CDKA为这一方向提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Kronecker adapters have emerged as a promising approach for fine-tuning large-scale models, enabling high-rank updates through tunable component structures. However, existing work largely treats the component structure as a fixed or heuristic design choice, leaving the dimensions and number of Kronecker components underexplored. In this paper, we identify component structure as a key factor governing the capacity of Kronecker adapters. We perform a fine-grained analysis of both the dimensions and number of Kronecker components. In particular, we show that the alignment between Kronecker adapters and full fine-tuning depends on component configurations. Guided by these insights, we propose Component Designed Kronecker Adapters (CDKA). We further provide parameter-budget-aware configuration guidelines and a tailored training stabilization strategy for practical deployment. Experiments across various architectures and modalities demonstrate the effectiveness of CDKA. Code is available at https://github.com/rainstonee/CDKA.

</details>


### [459] [An Odd Estimator for Shapley Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01399)
*Fabian Fumagalli,Landon Butler,Justin Singh Kang,Kannan Ramchandran,R. Teal Witter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了Shapley值仅依赖于集合函数的奇部，并据此提出OddSHAP估计器，通过在奇子空间上进行多项式回归来提升估计精度，在较大采样预算下达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Shapley值的精确计算通常是棘手的，需要高效的近似方法。虽然配对采样启发式方法在实践中效果显著，但其理论机制尚不清晰。本文旨在从理论上解释配对采样的有效性，并基于此设计更优的估计器。

Method: 1) 证明Shapley值仅依赖于集合函数的奇部，配对采样通过正交化回归目标滤除无关的偶部；2) 提出OddSHAP，一种在奇子空间上进行多项式回归的一致估计器；3) 利用傅里叶基隔离奇子空间，通过代理模型识别高影响交互作用，避免高阶近似的组合爆炸。

Result: 通过大量基准测试，OddSHAP在较大采样预算下达到了最先进的估计精度。

Conclusion: 配对采样的有效性源于其正交化了回归目标以滤除集合函数的偶部；基于奇子空间的OddSHAP估计器在较大采样预算下显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: The Shapley value is a ubiquitous framework for attribution in machine learning, encompassing feature importance, data valuation, and causal inference. However, its exact computation is generally intractable, necessitating efficient approximation methods. While the most effective and popular estimators leverage the paired sampling heuristic to reduce estimation error, the theoretical mechanism driving this improvement has remained opaque. In this work, we provide an elegant and fundamental justification for paired sampling: we prove that the Shapley value depends exclusively on the odd component of the set function, and that paired sampling orthogonalizes the regression objective to filter out the irrelevant even component. Leveraging this insight, we propose OddSHAP, a novel consistent estimator that performs polynomial regression solely on the odd subspace. By utilizing the Fourier basis to isolate this subspace and employing a proxy model to identify high-impact interactions, OddSHAP overcomes the combinatorial explosion of higher-order approximations. Through an extensive benchmark, we find that OddSHAP achieves state-of-the-art estimation accuracy at larger sampling budgets.

</details>


### [460] [Plain Transformers are Surprisingly Powerful Link Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01553)
*Quang Truong,Yu Song,Donald Loveland,Mingxuan Ju,Tong Zhao,Neil Shah,Jiliang Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PENCIL是一个纯编码器结构的Plain Transformer，通过注意力机制采样局部子图进行链接预测，无需手工设计的结构启发式或节点嵌入，在保持可扩展性的同时优于或媲美现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有链接预测方法依赖显式结构启发式或高内存消耗的节点嵌入，难以泛化或扩展到大规模图。图Transformer虽有潜力但复杂结构编码开销大。作者希望用简单设计替代这些复杂工程方法。

Method: 提出PENCIL，一个纯编码器Plain Transformer，通过注意力机制对采样的局部子图进行交互，替代手工设计的结构先验，保留了标准Transformer的可扩展性和硬件效率。

Result: PENCIL比启发式GNN表现更好，比基于ID嵌入的替代方案参数效率更高，在多种基准测试中具有竞争力，甚至在没有节点特征的情况下也能取得良好效果。

Conclusion: 挑战了当前对复杂工程技术的依赖，表明简单的设计选择足以实现相同甚至更强的链接预测能力。

Abstract: Link prediction is a core challenge in graph machine learning, demanding models that capture rich and complex topological dependencies. While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are the standard solution, state-of-the-art pipelines often rely on explicit structural heuristics or memory-intensive node embeddings -- approaches that struggle to generalize or scale to massive graphs. Emerging Graph Transformers (GTs) offer a potential alternative but often incur significant overhead due to complex structural encodings, hindering their applications to large-scale link prediction. We challenge these sophisticated paradigms with PENCIL, an encoder-only plain Transformer that replaces hand-crafted priors with attention over sampled local subgraphs, retaining the scalability and hardware efficiency of standard Transformers. Through experimental and theoretical analysis, we show that PENCIL extracts richer structural signals than GNNs, implicitly generalizing a broad class of heuristics and subgraph-based expressivity. Empirically, PENCIL outperforms heuristic-informed GNNs and is far more parameter-efficient than ID-embedding--based alternatives, while remaining competitive across diverse benchmarks -- even without node features. Our results challenge the prevailing reliance on complex engineering techniques, demonstrating that simple design choices are potentially sufficient to achieve the same capabilities. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/quang-truong/pencil.

</details>


### [461] [Towards Long-Horizon Interpretability: Efficient and Faithful Multi-Token Attribution for Reasoning LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01914)
*Wenbo Pan,Zhichao Liu,Xianlong Wang,Haining Yu,Xiaohua Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlashTrace提出了一种高效的多Token归因方法，通过跨度聚合和递归归因机制，在长上下文和推理链场景下实现130倍以上的加速，同时保持归因忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Token归因方法在长上下文和推理链场景下面临两大问题：效率瓶颈（O(M*N)复杂度）和忠实度下降（中间推理Token吸收归因质量，无法传播回原始输入），亟需一种高效且忠实的方法。

Method: 提出FlashTrace方法：(1) 采用跨度聚合（span-wise aggregation）实现单次前向传播中完成对多Token目标的归因；(2) 设计递归归因机制，将重要度通过中间推理链回溯到源输入。

Result: 在长上下文检索（RULER）和多步推理（MATH, MorehopQA）任务上，FlashTrace相比现有基线实现了130倍以上的加速，同时保持优越的忠实度。单次递归跳步即可改善忠实度。

Conclusion: FlashTrace有效解决了长上下文和推理链场景下的归因效率与忠实度问题，验证了递归归因在追踪推理链中重要度传播的有效性。

Abstract: Token attribution methods provide intuitive explanations for language model outputs by identifying causally important input tokens. However, as modern LLMs increasingly rely on extended reasoning chains, existing schemes face two critical challenges: (1) efficiency bottleneck, where attributing a target span of M tokens within a context of length N requires O(M*N) operations, making long-context attribution prohibitively slow; and (2) faithfulness drop, where intermediate reasoning tokens absorb attribution mass, preventing importance from propagating back to the original input. To address these, we introduce FlashTrace, an efficient multi-token attribution method that employs span-wise aggregation to compute attribution over multi-token targets in a single pass, while maintaining faithfulness. Moreover, we design a recursive attribution mechanism that traces importance through intermediate reasoning chains back to source inputs. Extensive experiments on long-context retrieval (RULER) and multi-step reasoning (MATH, MorehopQA) tasks demonstrate that FlashTrace achieves over 130x speedup over existing baselines while maintaining superior faithfulness. We further analyze the dynamics of recursive attribution, showing that even a single recursive hop improves faithfulness by tracing importance through the reasoning chain.

</details>


### [462] [FlexRank: Nested Low-Rank Knowledge Decomposition for Adaptive Model Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02680)
*Riccardo Zaccone,Stefanos Laskaridis,Marco Ciccone,Samuel Horváth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlexRank是一种通过低秩权重分解和基于重要性的嵌套压缩方法，能从预训练大模型中提取不同规模子模型，实现"一次训练，随处部署"，在计算预算与性能之间提供灵活权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型（如LLM、ViT）规模持续增长，从头训练成本极高，且作为固定计算成本的"整体"使用，无法根据可用预算灵活部署。

Method: 利用低秩权重分解与基于重要性的嵌套整合，从预训练模型中提取按重要性排序的嵌套子模型，根据计算预算选择性激活。

Result: 实现了"一次训练，随处部署"范式，在不同计算预算下可优雅地权衡成本与性能，无需为每个预算重新训练。

Conclusion: FlexRank推动了大型模型的实际部署，解决了从头训练成本高昂和部署灵活性不足的问题。

Abstract: The growing scale of deep neural networks, encompassing large language models (LLMs) and vision transformers (ViTs), has made training from scratch prohibitively expensive and deployment increasingly costly. These models are often used as computational monoliths with fixed cost, hindering adaptive deployment across different cost budgets.We argue that nested components, ordered by importance, can be extracted from pretrained models and selectively activated within the available computational budget. To this end, our proposed FlexRank method leverages low-rank weight decomposition with nested, importance-based consolidation to extract submodels of increasing capabilities. Our approach enables a ``train-once, deploy-everywhere'' paradigm offering a graceful trade-off between cost and performance without training from scratch for each budget - advancing practical deployment of large models.

</details>


### [463] [Causal Evaluation of Membership Inference Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02819)
*Mathieu Even,Clément Berenfeld,Linus Bleistein,Tudor Cebere,Julie Josse,Aurélien Bellet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将成员推断攻击（MIA）评估形式化为因果推断问题，将"记忆"定义为包含某个数据点对训练集的因果效应，揭示了现有单次运行和零次运行协议中的干扰和混杂偏差，并提出了具有非渐近一致性保证的实用估计器，在无需重训练和存在分布偏移的情况下可靠测量MIA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准MIA评估需要重复重训练，计算成本高昂；单次运行和零次运行方法虽被广泛使用但其统计有效性尚不明确。作者旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 将MIA评估形式化为因果推断问题，定义记忆为数据点包含在训练集中的因果效应；推导标准MIA指标的因果对应物；提出多运行、单次运行和零次运行场景下的实用估计器，并给出非渐近一致性保证。

Result: 在预训练和微调LLM等多个场景中验证了方法的有效性，证明无需重训练且能在分布偏移下可靠测量MIA性能。

Conclusion: 该框架为现代AI系统的隐私评估提供了原则性基础，弥合了现有评估方法的理论缺陷。

Abstract: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) aim to distinguish training points (members) from unseen data (non-members), and are widely used to quantify memorization and assess privacy risks. Standard MIA evaluation requires repeated retraining, which is computationally costly for large models. One-run (single training with randomized data inclusion) and zero-run (post hoc evaluation) methods are often used instead, but their statistical validity remains unclear. We address this gap by framing MIA evaluation as a causal inference problem, defining \emph{memorization as the causal effect of including a data point in the training set}. This novel formulation reveals and formalizes key sources of bias in existing protocols: one-run methods suffer from interference between jointly included points, while zero-run evaluations are additionally confounded by distribution shift between member and non-member evaluation data. We derive causal analogues of standard MIA metrics and propose practical estimators for multi-run, one-run, and zero-run regimes with non-asymptotic consistency guarantees. We validate our approach in several settings, including pretrained and fine-tuned LLMs, showing that it enables reliable measurement of MIA performance without retraining and under distribution shift. Overall, our framework provides a principled foundation for privacy evaluation in modern AI systems.

</details>


### [464] [Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02886)
*Francesco De Santis,Gabriele Ciravegna,Giovanni De Felice,Arianna Casanova,Francesco Giannini,Michelangelo Diligenti,Johannes Schneider,Danilo Giordano,Mateo Espinosa Zarlenga,Pietro Barbiero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出混合概念瓶颈专家（M-CBE）框架，通过引入多个专家表达和灵活的函数形式，在概念瓶颈模型中平衡准确性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）的任务预测器仅限于单一且函数形式预设的表达式，限制了预测精度和适应不同用户需求的能力。

Method: 提出M-CBE框架，沿两个维度泛化CBM：专家数量（任务预测器使用的表达式个数）和每个表达式的函数形式。具体实例化两种模型：线性M-CBE（学习有限个线性表达式）和符号M-CBE（利用符号回归从数据中自动发现专家函数，支持用户指定的算子词汇表）。

Result: 实证评估表明，改变表达式数量和函数形式为导航准确性与可解释性之间的权衡提供了稳健的框架。

Conclusion: M-CBE框架通过引入多个专家表达和灵活的函数形式，有效扩展了概念瓶颈模型的设计空间，在保持可解释性的同时提升了预测性能。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) promote interpretability by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, existing CBMs typically constrain their task predictor to a single expression whose functional form is set a priori, limiting both predictive accuracy and adaptability to diverse user needs. We propose Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts (M-CBE), a framework that generalizes existing CBMs along two dimensions: the number of expressions, referred to as experts, employed by the task predictor to map concepts to the task, and the functional form each expression takes, thus exposing an underexplored region of this design space. We investigate this region by instantiating two novel models: Linear M-CBE, which learns a finite set of linear expressions, and Symbolic M-CBE, which leverages symbolic regression to discover expert functions from data subject to user-specified operator vocabularies. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that varying the number of expressions and their functional form provides a robust framework for navigating the accuracy-interpretability trade-off.

</details>


### [465] [Sequential Group Composition: A Window into the Mechanics of Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03655)
*Giovanni Luca Marchetti,Daniel Kunin,Adele Myers,Francisco Acosta,Nina Miolane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过序列群组合任务研究神经网络学习结构化运算（如算术、几何、算法计算）的机制，分析了群结构、编码统计和序列长度对学习的影响，并证明了两层网络与深层架构（RNN、多层网络）在扩展性上的根本差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解神经网络如何从序列数据中习得结构化运算（如算术、几何和算法计算）的内在机制。

Method: 引入序列群组合任务，网络接收有限群元素序列并预测累积乘积；从理论层面分析群结构、编码统计和序列长度的作用；对比两层网络（从零初始化学习，按不可约表示逐次学习）与深层架构（RNN顺序组合，多层网络并行组合）的表现。

Result: 两层网络从零初始化时按编码的傅里叶统计决定顺序、逐一学习群的不可约表示；完美学习所需隐藏宽度随序列长度k指数增长；而RNN可在k步内顺序组合，多层网络可在log k层内并行组合相邻元素。

Conclusion: 序列群组合任务为理解深度学习机制提供了一个可解析的窗口，揭示了深度架构通过利用结合性显著改善扩展性的原理。

Abstract: How do neural networks trained over sequences acquire the ability to perform structured operations, such as arithmetic, geometric, and algorithmic computation? To gain insight into this question, we introduce the sequential group composition task. In this task, networks receive a sequence of elements from a finite group encoded in a real vector space and must predict their cumulative product. This task can be order-sensitive and cannot be solved by a linear model. Our analysis isolates the roles of the group structure, encoding statistics, and sequence length in shaping learning. We prove that two-layer networks from vanishing initialization learn this task one irreducible representation of the group at a time in an order determined by the Fourier statistics of the encoding. To perfectly learn the task, these networks require a hidden width exponential in the sequence length $k$. In contrast, we construct deeper architectures that exploit associativity to dramatically improve this scaling: recurrent neural networks can compose elements sequentially in $k$ steps, while multilayer networks can compose adjacent pairs in parallel in $\log k$ layers. Overall, the sequential group composition task offers a tractable window into the mechanics of deep learning.

</details>


### [466] [The Illusion of Generalization in Tabular Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04031)
*Aditya Gorla,Ratish Puduppully*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对Tabula-8B作为代表性表格语言模型的系统重新评估发现，其声称的强泛化能力源于评估伪影而非真正的表格推理：二元和分类任务相比多数类基线几乎无提升，高性能数据集存在严重污染（包括完全的训练-测试重叠和任务级泄漏），且仅通过指令微调（无表格数据暴露）即可恢复92.2%的标准分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格语言模型（TLMs）被宣称在表格预测任务上实现了强泛化能力，但这些声称的有效性缺乏系统性验证，需要对其实际表现进行严格重新评估。

Method: 以Tabula-8B作为代表性TLM，利用UniPredict基准中的165个数据集进行系统重新评估，分析其在二元分类、分类分类和四分位分类任务上的表现，检测数据集污染程度，并通过指令微调（无表格数据）进行对比实验。

Result: 1）二元和分类分类的中位提升接近零，总体性能完全由四分位分类任务驱动；2）高性能数据集存在普遍污染，包括完整的训练-测试重叠和标准去重无法检测的任务级泄漏；3）无表格数据暴露的指令微调恢复了92.2%的标准分类性能，四分位分类中格式熟悉度填补了71.3%的差距，剩余部分来自污染数据集。

Conclusion: TLM声称的泛化能力很可能反映的是评估伪影而非真正的表格推理能力，并提出了加强TLM评估的建议。

Abstract: Tabular Language Models (TLMs) have been claimed to achieve strong generalization for tabular prediction. We conduct a systematic re-evaluation of Tabula-8B as a representative TLM, utilizing 165 datasets from the UniPredict benchmark. Our investigation reveals three findings. First, binary and categorical classification achieve near-zero median lift over majority-class baselines and strong aggregate performance is driven entirely by quartile classification tasks. Second, top-performing datasets exhibit pervasive contamination, including complete train-test overlap and task-level leakage that evades standard deduplication. Third, instruction-tuning without tabular exposure recovers 92.2% of standard classification performance and on quartile classification, format familiarity closes 71.3% of the gap with the residual attributable to contaminated datasets. These findings suggest claimed generalization likely reflects evaluation artifacts rather than learned tabular reasoning. We conclude with recommendations for strengthening TLM evaluation.

</details>


### [467] [Supervised Learning as Lossy Compression: Characterizing Generalization and Sample Complexity via Finite Blocklength Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04107)
*Kosuke Sugiyama,Masato Uchida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于信息论中有限块长分析的学习泛化框架，将训练数据采样视为编码、模型构建视为解码，推导了样本复杂度与泛化误差的下界，并将过拟合程度与归纳偏置-任务不匹配度分离为不同项，统一了信息论与稳定性理论视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有泛化理论框架未能在统一视角下清晰区分过拟合程度与归纳偏置-任务不匹配度这两类不同的泛化误差来源，作者期望通过信息论中的损失压缩和有限块长分析来建立更精细的泛化理论。

Method: 将学习问题建模为损失压缩过程：训练数据采样对应编码过程，模型构建对应解码过程；运用有限块长分析（finite blocklength analysis）推导固定随机学习算法及其最优采样策略下样本复杂度和泛化误差的下界。

Result: 推导出泛化误差下界，其中过拟合程度和归纳偏置-任务不匹配度被分离为两个不同的项；进一步将过拟合项分解，证明其与现有信息论界和稳定性理论中的度量指标存在理论联系。

Conclusion: 该框架成功统一了信息论泛化界与稳定性理论两种视角，提供了一种更清晰的泛化误差归因方式，具有超越现有框架的优势。

Abstract: This paper presents a novel information-theoretic perspective on generalization in machine learning by framing the learning problem within the context of lossy compression and applying finite blocklength analysis. In our approach, the sampling of training data formally corresponds to an encoding process, and the model construction to a decoding process. By leveraging finite blocklength analysis, we derive lower bounds on sample complexity and generalization error for a fixed randomized learning algorithm and its associated optimal sampling strategy. Our bounds explicitly characterize the degree of overfitting of the learning algorithm and the mismatch between its inductive bias and the task as distinct terms. This separation provides a significant advantage over existing frameworks. Additionally, we decompose the overfitting term to show its theoretical connection to existing metrics found in information-theoretic bounds and stability theory, unifying these perspectives under our proposed framework.

</details>


### [468] [Rationality Measurement and Theory for Reinforcement Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04737)
*Kejiang Qian,Amos Storkey,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套针对强化学习智能体的理性度量（rationality measures）及其相关理论，定义了完全理性动作、期望理性风险、理性风险缺口等概念，并将其分解为外生（环境迁移）和内生（算法泛化能力）两部分，分别用1-Wasserstein距离和经验Rademacher复杂度上界约束。实验验证了正则化器和领域随机化的益处以及环境迁移的危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习智能体的理性（rationality）是一个日益关键但鲜有探索的性质，现有研究缺乏对其系统性的度量和理论分析。

Method: 定义了完全理性动作（在部署中最陡方向最大化隐藏真实价值函数的动作），提出了期望理性风险（策略动作与理性动作之间期望价值差异在轨迹上的累积）、理性风险缺口（训练与部署理性风险之差），并将其分解为外生部分（环境迁移引起，由训练与部署间转移核和初始状态分布的1-Wasserstein距离上界约束）和内生部分（算法在动态环境中的泛化能力，由价值函数类的经验Rademacher复杂度上界约束）。

Result: 理论推导了理性风险缺口的上界，并提出假设：正则化器（层归一化、L2正则化、权重归一化）和领域随机化有益，环境迁移有害。实验验证了这些假设。

Conclusion: 本文为强化学习智能体的理性提供了系统的理论框架和度量方法，揭示了正则化与领域随机化的积极作用，以及环境迁移的负面影响，实验与理论一致。

Abstract: This paper proposes a suite of rationality measures and associated theory for reinforcement learning agents, a property increasingly critical yet rarely explored. We define an action in deployment to be perfectly rational if it maximises the hidden true value function in the steepest direction. The expected value discrepancy of a policy's actions against their rational counterparts, culminating over the trajectory in deployment, is defined to be expected rational risk; an empirical average version in training is also defined. Their difference, termed as rational risk gap, is decomposed into (1) an extrinsic component caused by environment shifts between training and deployment, and (2) an intrinsic one due to the algorithm's generalisability in a dynamic environment. They are upper bounded by, respectively, (1) the $1$-Wasserstein distance between transition kernels and initial state distributions in training and deployment, and (2) the empirical Rademacher complexity of the value function class. Our theory suggests hypotheses on the benefits from regularisers (including layer normalisation, $\ell_2$ regularisation, and weight normalisation) and domain randomisation, as well as the harm from environment shifts. Experiments are in full agreement with these hypotheses. The code is available at https://github.com/EVIEHub/Rationality.

</details>


### [469] [End-to-End Compression for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05649)
*Guri Zabërgja,Rafiq Kamel,Arlind Kadra,Christian M. M. Frey,Josif Grabocka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TACO，一种端到端表格压缩模型，通过将训练数据集压缩到潜在空间，在TabArena基准测试上实现高达94倍推理加速和97%内存节省，同时保持性能无明显下降，且随着数据集规模增大表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于注意力机制的表格基础模型在处理大规模数据集时存在二次复杂度问题，导致训练和推理时间开销大、内存消耗高，限制了其处理大规模数据的能力。

Method: 提出TACO（端到端表格压缩模型），通过将训练数据集压缩到潜在空间中的压缩表示，在单次前向传播中完成上下文学习，无需参数更新。

Result: 在TabArena基准测试上，TACO相比最先进的表格Transformer架构，推理速度提升高达94倍，内存消耗降低高达97%，性能无明显下降，且随数据集规模增大表现更好。

Conclusion: TACO通过压缩训练数据到潜在空间，有效解决了表格Transformer的二次复杂度问题，在保持性能的同时实现了显著的加速和内存节省，且在大规模数据集上展现出更好的扩展性和性能优势。

Abstract: The long-standing dominance of gradient-boosted decision trees for tabular data has recently been challenged by in-context learning tabular foundation models. In-context learning methods fit and predict in one forward pass without parameter updates by leveraging the training data as context for predicting on query test points. While recent tabular foundation models achieve state-of-the-art performance, their transformer architecture based on the attention mechanism has quadratic complexity regarding dataset size, which in turn increases the overhead on training and inference time, and limits the capacity of the models to handle large-scale datasets. In this work, we propose TACO, an end-to-end tabular compression model that compresses the training dataset in a latent space. We test our method on the TabArena benchmark, where our proposed method is up to 94x faster in inference time, while consuming up to 97\% less memory compared to the state-of-the-art tabular transformer architecture, all while retaining performance without significant degradation. Lastly, our method not only scales better with increased dataset sizes, but it also achieves better performance compared to other baselines.

</details>


### [470] [Parameter-free Dynamic Regret: Time-varying Movement Costs, Delayed Feedback, and Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06902)
*Hao Qiu,Andrew Jacobsen,Emmanuel Esposito,Mengxiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带有时变移动代价的无约束在线凸优化（OCO）中的动态遗憾问题，提出了一种新颖的算法，首次在该设置下实现了比较器自适应的动态遗憾界 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(M^2+MP_T)(T+\sum_t λ_t)})$，其中 $P_T$ 是比较器序列的路径长度，$M$ 是比较器最大范数。该结果在 $λ_t=0$ 时恢复OCO中最优的静态和动态遗憾自适应率。通过将延迟反馈和时变记忆两种应用转化为时变移动代价问题，展示了结果的普适性，其中延迟反馈的归约方法具有独立意义。关键在于遗憾界中移动代价的一阶依赖性使得两种设置下都能获得最优的比较器自适应动态遗憾保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有带移动代价的OCO研究通常假设移动代价系数恒定，而现实应用中移动代价往往随时间变化。本文旨在将移动代价系数推广为任意时变，并建立与之匹配的比较器自适应动态遗憾界。

Method: 提出一种新颖算法，通过巧妙处理时变移动代价与动态比较器路径长度之间的关系，实现比较器自适应的遗憾界。同时建立了从延迟反馈和时变记忆问题到时变移动代价OCO的归约方法。

Result: 获得了 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(M^2+MP_T)(T+\sum_t λ_t)})$ 的遗憾界，在 $λ_t=0$ 时恢复OCO最优自适应率。延迟反馈和时变记忆两种应用均能通过归约得到最优比较器自适应保证。

Conclusion: 时变移动代价下的比较器自适应动态遗憾问题是可解的，且移动代价的一阶依赖性是实现最优自适应保证的关键因素。

Abstract: In this paper, we study dynamic regret in unconstrained online convex optimization (OCO) with movement costs. Specifically, we generalize the standard setting by allowing the movement cost coefficients $λ_t$ to vary arbitrarily over time. Our main contribution is a novel algorithm that establishes the first comparator-adaptive dynamic regret bound for this setting, guaranteeing $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{(M^2+MP_T)(T+\sum_t λ_t)})$ regret, where $P_T$ is the path length of the comparator sequence over $T$ rounds and $M$ is the maximal comparator norm. Our result recovers the optimal adaptive rates for both static and dynamic regret in OCO as the special case where $λ_t=0$ for all rounds. To demonstrate the versatility of our results, we consider two applications: OCO with delayed feedback and OCO with time-varying memory. We show that both problems can be translated into time-varying movement costs, establishing a novel reduction specifically for the delayed feedback setting that is of independent interest. A crucial observation is that the first-order dependence on movement costs in our regret bound plays a key role in enabling optimal comparator-adaptive dynamic regret guarantees in both settings.

</details>


### [471] [Fair Decisions from Calibrated Scores: Achieving Optimal Classification While Satisfying Sufficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07285)
*Etam Benger,Katrina Ligett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对充分性（sufficiency）公平约束下的二分类问题，提出了基于群体校准分数的最优二元（随机化）分类精确解。通过几何刻画可行域，推导出仅需群体校准分数和群体归属的简单后处理算法，并进一步给出了在充分性约束下最小化分离性（separation）偏差的分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作已解决独立性（statistical parity）和分离性（equalized odds）下的阈值化最优分类问题，但充分性（sufficiency）约束下即使使用完美群体校准的分数（包括真实类概率），阈值化后仍会违反预测均等性（predictive parity）。亟需针对充分性约束下的最优分类方法。

Method: 1) 提出有限群体校准分数集下的最优二元随机化分类精确解；2) 对可行阳性预测值（PPV）与错误遗漏率（FOR）对进行几何刻画；3) 基于几何刻画推导仅需群体校准分数和群体归属的简单后处理算法；4) 识别在充分性约束下最小化分离性偏差的分类器，并证明该分类器也可由同一算法获得。

Result: 给出了充分性约束下最优分类器的精确解，以及相应的几何刻画和后处理算法；证明了所提算法也能获得在满足充分性的同时最小化分离性偏差的分类器，且该分类器性能常接近最优。

Conclusion: 充分性约束下的最优分类存在精确解，可通过简单后处理算法实现；该框架还能有效处理充分性与分离性之间的权衡问题。

Abstract: Binary classification based on predicted probabilities (scores) is a fundamental task in supervised machine learning. While thresholding scores is Bayes-optimal in the unconstrained setting, using a single threshold generally violates statistical group fairness constraints. Under independence (statistical parity) and separation (equalized odds), such thresholding suffices when the scores already satisfy the corresponding criterion. However, this does not extend to sufficiency: even perfectly group-calibrated scores -- including true class probabilities -- violate predictive parity after thresholding. In this work, we present an exact solution for optimal binary (randomized) classification under sufficiency, assuming finite sets of group-calibrated scores. We provide a geometric characterization of the feasible pairs of positive predictive value (PPV) and false omission rate (FOR) achievable by such classifiers, and use it to derive a simple post-processing algorithm that attains the optimal classifier using only group-calibrated scores and group membership. Finally, since sufficiency and separation are generally incompatible, we identify the classifier that minimizes deviation from separation subject to sufficiency, and show that it can also be obtained by our algorithm, often achieving performance comparable to the optimum.

</details>


### [472] [ParisKV: Fast and Drift-Robust KV-Cache Retrieval for Long-Context LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07721)
*Yanlin Qi,Xinhang Chen,Huiqiang Jiang,Qitong Wang,Botao Peng,Themis Palpanas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ParisKV是一个基于碰撞候选选择和量化内积重排估计的漂移鲁棒、GPU原生的KV缓存检索框架，支持百万token上下文，通过UVA实现CPU卸载KV缓存，在长输入和长生成基准上匹配或超越全注意力质量，相比SOTA基线实现最高44倍解码延迟降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KV缓存检索方法在长上下文LLM推理中面临分布漂移和高延迟问题，尤其在大规模场景下性能退化严重。

Method: 基于碰撞的候选选择（collision-based candidate selection）进行初步筛选，随后使用量化内积重排估计器（quantized inner-product reranking estimator）进行精排；通过UVA支持CPU卸载的KV缓存，实现按需top-k获取。

Result: 在长上下文中匹配或超越全注意力质量；在batch size为1时匹配或超越全注意力速度；吞吐量最高提升2.8倍；支持全注意力内存不足的百万token上下文；相比MagicPIG和PQCache分别降低17倍和44倍解码延迟。

Conclusion: ParisKV在长上下文解码效率上达到SOTA，有效解决了分布漂移和大规模场景下的延迟瓶颈问题。

Abstract: KV-cache retrieval is essential for long-context LLM inference, yet existing methods struggle with distribution drift and high latency at scale. We introduce ParisKV, a drift-robust, GPU-native KV-cache retrieval framework based on collision-based candidate selection, followed by a quantized inner-product reranking estimator. For million-token contexts, ParisKV supports CPU-offloaded KV caches via Unified Virtual Addressing (UVA), enabling on-demand top-$k$ fetching with minimal overhead. ParisKV matches or outperforms full attention quality on long-input and long-generation benchmarks. It achieves state-of-the-art long-context decoding efficiency: it matches or exceeds full attention speed even at batch size 1 for long contexts, delivers up to 2.8$\times$ higher throughput within full attention's runnable range, and scales to million-token contexts where full attention runs out of memory. At million-token scale, ParisKV reduces decode latency by 17$\times$ and 44$\times$ compared to MagicPIG and PQCache, respectively, two state-of-the-art KV-cache Top-$k$ retrieval baselines, code is available at https://github.com/amy-77/ParisKV/tree/main.

</details>


### [473] [A Kinetic Energy Perspective of Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07928)
*Ziyun Li,Huancheng Hu,Soon Hoe Lim,Xuyu Li,Fei Gao,Enmao Diao,Zezhen Ding,Michalis Vazirgiannis,Henrik Bostrom*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出动力学路径能量（KPE）作为流生成模型中每个样本的类作用量诊断指标，发现高KPE与语义保真度正相关但非单调——极端高能量会导致记忆化，并据此提出无训练的动力学轨迹整形（KTS）推理策略，通过提升早期运动与后期软着陆提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从经典力学视角出发，希望为流生成模型中的每个采样轨迹提供一种物理意义明确的、可解释的诊断指标，以衡量轨迹的动力学代价并揭示其与生成质量的内在关系。

Method: 引入Kinetic Path Energy (KPE)，定义为ODE轨迹上累积的动能；基于经验流匹配的闭式公式，分析极端能量导致记忆化的理论保证；提出Kinetic Trajectory Shaping (KTS)，一种两阶段无训练推理策略：早期增强运动，后期强制软着陆。

Result: 实验表明KPE与语义保真度正相关，高KPE轨迹落在稀疏表示区域；非单调现象：极端高能量导致生成退化为记忆化训练样本。

Conclusion: 存在金发姑娘原则（Goldilocks principle），KTS策略能有效减少记忆化、提升生成质量，且无需额外训练。

Abstract: Flow-based generative models can be viewed through a physics lens: sampling transports a particle from noise to data by integrating a learned velocity field, and each sample corresponds to a trajectory with its own dynamical effort. Motivated by classical mechanics, we introduce Kinetic Path Energy (KPE), an action-like, per-sample diagnostic that measures the accumulated kinetic effort along an ordinary differential equation (ODE) trajectory. Empirically, KPE exhibits two robust correspondences: {i} higher KPE predicts stronger semantic fidelity; {ii} high-KPE trajectories land in sparse representation regions. We further provide theoretical guarantees linking trajectory energy to data sparsity. Paradoxically, this correlation is non-monotonic. At sufficiently high energy, generation can degenerate into memorization. Leveraging the closed-form formula of empirical flow matching, we show that extreme energies drive trajectories toward near-copies of training examples. This yields a Goldilocks principle and motivates Kinetic Trajectory Shaping (KTS), a training-free two-phase inference strategy that boosts early motion and enforces a late-time soft landing, reducing memorization and improving generation quality across benchmark tasks.

</details>


### [474] [Inverting Data Transformations via Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08267)
*Jinwoo Kim,Sékou-Oumar Kaba,Jiyun Park,Seunghoon Hong,Siamak Ravanbakhsh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在一般李群上进行变换逆变换的方法（TIED），通过将变换后验建模为玻尔兹曼分布，并利用李群上的扩散过程进行采样，以恢复原始数据分布。实验证明该方法在测试时等变性方面优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习与科学建模中，观测数据常被未知群变换扭曲，现有方法在一般李群上高效恢复原始数据分布仍具挑战性。

Method: 将变换后验建模为由数据空间能量函数定义的玻尔兹曼分布，引入李群上的扩散过程（仅需在对应李代数中计算），基于新的平凡化目标-分数恒等式进行高效基于分数的后验采样。

Result: 在图像单应变换和PDE对称性实验中，TIED能将变换后的输入恢复至训练分布，在测试时等变性上表现优于强规范化和采样基线。

Conclusion: TIED通过李群上的扩散过程有效解决了未知变换的逆变换问题，为测试时等变性提供了鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: We study the problem of transformation inversion on general Lie groups: a datum is transformed by an unknown group element, and the goal is to recover an inverse transformation that maps it back to the original data distribution. Such unknown transformations arise widely in machine learning and scientific modeling, where they can significantly distort observations. We take a probabilistic view and model the posterior over transformations as a Boltzmann distribution defined by an energy function on the data space. To sample from this posterior, we introduce a diffusion process on Lie groups that keeps all updates on-manifold and only requires computations in the associated Lie algebra. Our method, Transformation-Inverting Energy Diffusion (TIED), relies on a new trivialized target-score identity that enables efficient score-based sampling of the transformation posterior. As a key application, we focus on test-time equivariance, where the objective is to improve the robustness of pretrained neural networks to input transformations. Experiments on image homographies and PDE symmetries demonstrate that TIED can restore transformed inputs to the training distribution at test time, showing improved performance over strong canonicalization and sampling baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/jw9730/tied.

</details>


### [475] [Breaking the Simplification Bottleneck in Amortized Neural Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08885)
*Paul Saegert,Ullrich Köthe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SimpliPy，一个基于规则的表达式简化引擎，比SymPy快100倍。基于此构建的Flash-ANSR框架在高效符号回归任务上超越了现有摊销方法（NeSymReS, E2E），并在准确率上与最优方法PySR持平，同时恢复出更简洁的表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摊销符号回归（Amortized SR）相比遗传规划方法效率更高，但难以扩展到真实科学复杂场景。关键障碍在于缺乏将等价表达式快速归约为简洁范式的手段：现有方法使用SymPy等通用计算机代数系统进行简化，但计算代价过高，严重限制了训练和推理速度。

Method: 提出SimpliPy，一个高效的基于规则的表达式简化引擎，实现比SymPy快100倍的简化速度。基于SimpliPy构建Flash-ANSR框架，利用快速简化能力实现：1）扩展训练集规模；2）更高效利用每个表达式的token预算；3）系统性训练集去污染（去除与测试集等价的表达式）。

Result: Flash-ANSR在FastSRB基准上显著优于摊销基线（NeSymReS, E2E），并与最优直接优化方法PySR表现相当；同时随着推理预算增加，能恢复更简洁而非更复杂的表达式。

Conclusion: 有效的表达式简化是摊销符号回归的关键瓶颈，SimpliPy通过规则引擎大幅提升简化效率，从而显著增强了摊销SR的可扩展性和准确性，弥合了与遗传编程方法的性能差距。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover interpretable analytical expressions that accurately describe observed data. Amortized SR promises to be much more efficient than the predominant genetic programming SR methods, but currently struggles to scale to realistic scientific complexity. We find that a key obstacle is the lack of a fast reduction of equivalent expressions to a concise normalized form. Amortized SR has addressed this with general-purpose Computer Algebra Systems (CAS) like SymPy, but the high computational cost severely limits training and inference speed. We propose SimpliPy, a rule-based simplification engine achieving a 100-fold speed-up over SymPy at comparable quality. This enables substantial improvements in amortized SR, including scalability to much larger training sets, more efficient use of the per-expression token budget, and systematic training set decontamination with respect to equivalent test expressions. We demonstrate these advantages in our Flash-ANSR framework, which achieves much better accuracy than amortized baselines (NeSymReS, E2E) on the FastSRB benchmark. Moreover, it performs on par with state-of-the-art direct optimization (PySR) while recovering more concise rather than more complex expressions with increasing inference budget.

</details>


### [476] [A Behavioural and Representational Evaluation of Goal-Directedness in Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08964)
*Raghu Arghal,Fade Chen,Niall Dalton,Evgenii Kortukov,Calum McNamara,Angelos Nalmpantis,Moksh Nirvaan,Gabriele Sarti,Mario Giulianelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合行为评估与内部表征可解释性分析的框架来评估智能体的目标导向性，并以LLM在2D网格世界中的导航为案例，发现其非线性编码粗略空间地图且行为与内部表征一致，表明仅靠行为评估不足以刻画智能体如何表征和追求目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解智能体的目标有助于解释和预测其行为，但目前缺乏可靠的归因方法学来评估智能系统的目标导向性。

Method: 提出一个整合行为评估与基于可解释性的内部表征分析的框架。行为层面评估智能体在不同网格大小、障碍密度、目标结构下的最优策略；内部表征层面使用探针方法解码环境表示和多步行动计划。

Result: LLM智能体非线性编码粗略空间地图，保留近似任务相关线索（自身位置和目标位置）；行为与内部表征基本一致；推理过程会重组内部表征，从空间线索转向即时行动选择。

Conclusion: 仅靠行为评估不足以刻画智能体如何表征和追求目标，需要结合内省性检验（可解释性分析）来全面评估智能体的目标导向性。

Abstract: Understanding an agent's goals helps explain and predict its behaviour, yet there is no established methodology for reliably attributing goals to agentic systems. We propose a framework for evaluating goal-directedness that integrates behavioural evaluation with interpretability-based analyses of models' internal representations. As a case study, we examine an LLM agent navigating a 2D grid world towards a goal state. Behaviourally, we evaluate the agent against optimal policies across varying grid sizes, obstacle densities, and goal structures, finding that performance scales with task difficulty while remaining robust to difficulty-preserving transformations and multi-goal structures. We then use probing methods to decode internal representations of the environment and multi-step action plans. We find that the LLM agent non-linearly encodes a coarse spatial map, preserving approximate task-relevant cues about its position and the goal location; that its actions are broadly consistent with these internal representations; and that reasoning reorganises them, shifting from spatial cues towards immediate action selection. Our findings support the view that introspective examination is required beyond behavioural evaluations to characterise how agents represent and pursue their objectives.

</details>


### [477] [Biases in the Blind Spot: Detecting What LLMs Fail to Mention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10117)
*Iván Arcuschin,David Chanin,Adrià Garriga-Alonso,Oana-Maria Camburu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种全自动黑盒流水线，用于检测大语言模型在特定任务中的未言明偏见（unverbalized biases）。该流水线通过LLM自动评分器生成候选偏见概念，在逐步增大的样本上生成正负变体进行统计检验，并验证那些导致显著性能差异但未在思维链中被引用为理由的概念。在七个LLM和三个决策任务上，该方法自动发现了先前未知的偏见（如西班牙语流利度、英语熟练度、写作正式度），同时验证了已知偏见（性别、种族、宗教、民族）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型提供的思维链推理痕迹虽然表面合理，但可能隐藏内部偏见（即未言明偏见）。仅通过模型陈述的推理来监控其行为不可靠，而现有的偏见评估通常需要预定义类别和手工制作的数据集，缺乏自动化、可扩展的方法。

Method: 提出全自动黑盒流水线：(1) 使用LLM自动评分器从任务数据集中生成候选偏见概念；(2) 对每个概念生成正负变体并在逐步增大的输入样本上进行测试；(3) 应用多重检验和早停的统计技术；(4) 若某概念导致统计显著的性能差异且未在模型的CoT中被引用为理由，则标记为未言明偏见。

Result: 在七个LLM上针对三个决策任务（招聘、贷款审批、大学录取）进行实验，自动发现了先前未知的偏见（如西班牙语流利度、英语熟练度、写作正式度），同时验证了先前人工识别的偏见（性别、种族、宗教、民族）。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种实用、可扩展的自动化路径，用于更高效、更广泛地发现特定任务的未言明偏见，有助于更全面地评估和监控LLM的公平性。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often provide chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning traces that appear plausible, but may hide internal biases. We call these unverbalized biases. Monitoring models via their stated reasoning is therefore unreliable, and existing bias evaluations typically require predefined categories and hand-crafted datasets. In this work, we introduce a fully automated, black-box pipeline for detecting task-specific unverbalized biases. Given a task dataset, the pipeline uses LLM autoraters to generate candidate bias concepts. It then tests each concept on progressively larger input samples by generating positive and negative variations, and applies statistical techniques for multiple testing and early stopping. A concept is flagged as an unverbalized bias if it yields statistically significant performance differences while not being cited as justification in the model's CoTs. We evaluate our pipeline across seven LLMs on three decision tasks (hiring, loan approval, and university admissions). Our technique automatically discovers previously unknown biases in these models (e.g., Spanish fluency, English proficiency, writing formality). In the same run, the pipeline also validates biases that were manually identified by prior work (gender, race, religion, ethnicity). More broadly, our proposed approach provides a practical, scalable path to automatic, more efficient, and broader task-specific unverbalized bias discovery.

</details>


### [478] [What Does Preference Learning Recover from Pairwise Comparison Data?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10286)
*Rattana Pukdee,Maria-Florina Balcan,Pradeep Ravikumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从三元组比较数据出发，形式化了条件偏好分布（CPRD），分析了Bradley-Terry模型在偏好学习中的适用条件，并指出了边际和连通性对样本效率的影响，为理解偏好学习实际恢复的内容提供了数据中心的理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实数据可能违反Bradley-Terry模型的假设，但现有研究不清楚在这种违反假设的情况下BT学习实际恢复了什么。作者希望从数据角度形式化偏好信息，阐明BT模型的适用条件及影响因素。

Method: 从三元组比较数据$(x, y^+, y^-)$出发，形式化定义了条件偏好分布（CPRD）；给出BT模型适用于建模CPRD的精确条件；识别影响样本效率的关键因素（边际和连通性）。

Result: 明确了BT模型何时适用于建模CPRD；发现边际（margin）和连通性（connectivity）是影响偏好学习样本效率的核心因素。

Conclusion: 本文为偏好学习提供了数据驱动的基础理论，揭示了在实际数据偏离BT假设时偏好学习实际恢复的内容，并为数据收集和模型选择提供了指导。

Abstract: Pairwise preference learning is central to machine learning, with recent applications in aligning language models with human preferences. A typical dataset consists of triplets $(x, y^+, y^-)$, where response $y^+$ is preferred over response $y^-$ for context $x$. The Bradley--Terry (BT) model is the predominant approach, modeling preference probabilities as a function of latent score differences. Standard practice assumes data follows this model and learns the latent scores accordingly. However, real data may violate this assumption, and it remains unclear what BT learning recovers in such cases. Starting from triplet comparison data, we formalize the preference information it encodes through the conditional preference distribution (CPRD). We give precise conditions for when BT is appropriate for modeling the CPRD, and identify factors governing sample efficiency -- namely, margin and connectivity. Together, these results offer a data-centric foundation for understanding what preference learning actually recovers.

</details>


### [479] [Token-Efficient Change Detection in LLM APIs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11083)
*Timothée Chauvin,Clément Lalanne,Erwan Le Merrer,Jean-Michel Loubes,François Taïani,Gilles Tredan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为B3IT的黑盒远程变化检测方法，仅通过观察输出token即可检测LLM的变化，通过"边界输入"（Border Inputs）实现与灰盒方法相当的性能，同时成本降低30倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM远程变化检测方法要么部署成本过高，要么需要白盒访问模型权重或灰盒访问log概率，缺乏一种既低成本又严格黑盒的检测方案。

Method: 提出"边界输入"（Border Inputs）概念——即存在多个输出top token的特定输入。从统计角度分析，最优变化检测依赖于模型Jacobian和输出分布的Fisher信息量。基于此理论，设计黑盒边界输入追踪（B3IT）方案。

Result: 在低温度设置下，边界输入易于为非推理型端点找到；B3IT在性能上与最佳灰盒方法相当，且成本降低30倍。

Conclusion: B3IT方案在严格的纯黑盒设定下实现了低成本、高性能的LLM远程变化检测，为大规模部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Remote change detection in LLMs is a difficult problem. Existing methods are either too expensive for deployment at scale, or require initial white-box access to model weights or grey-box access to log probabilities. We aim to achieve both low cost and strict black-box operation, observing only output tokens. Our approach hinges on specific inputs we call Border Inputs, for which there exists more than one output top token. From a statistical perspective, optimal change detection depends on the model's Jacobian and the Fisher information of the output distribution. Analyzing these quantities in low-temperature regimes shows that border inputs enable powerful change detection tests. Building on this insight, we propose the Black-Box Border Input Tracking (B3IT) scheme. Extensive in-vivo and in-vitro experiments show that border inputs are easily found for non-reasoning tested endpoints, and achieve performance on par with the best available grey-box approaches. B3IT reduces costs by $30\times$ compared to existing methods, while operating in a strict black-box setting.

</details>


### [480] [Weight Decay Improves Language Model Plasticity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11137)
*Tessa Han,Sebastian Bordt,Hanlin Zhang,Sham Kakade*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究预训练过程中的权重衰减对模型可塑性的影响，发现更大的权重衰减虽然可能导致预训练损失更高，但能增强模型在下游任务微调后的性能表现，揭示了预训练损失并非评估超参数的唯一标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注基模型在预训练阶段的验证损失，忽视了模型的下游适应能力（即可塑性），因此需要系统研究预训练超参数（尤其是权重衰减）对模型可塑性的影响。

Method: 通过系统实验研究权重衰减在预训练中的作用，分析其对下游微调性能的影响，并从机制层面探究权重衰减对线性可分性、注意力矩阵正则化及训练数据过拟合的影响。

Result: 更大的权重衰减能增强预训练模型的可塑性，在下游微调后获得更好的性能，甚至出现预训练表现较差的基模型在微调后表现更好的反直觉现象。

Conclusion: 预训练模型的可塑性至关重要，交叉熵损失不应用作超参数优化的唯一指标，单个优化超参数（如权重衰减）在塑造模型行为中具有多面作用。

Abstract: Large language models are typically trained in two broad phases: pretraining to produce a base model, followed by further training to improve downstream performance. However, hyperparameter optimization and scaling laws are studied primarily from the perspective of the base model's validation loss, overlooking a crucial model property: downstream adaptability. In this work, we study pretraining from the perspective of model plasticity, that is, the ability of the base model to successfully adapt to downstream tasks upon additional training. We focus on the role of weight decay, a key regularization parameter during pretraining, and show through systematic experiments that larger weight decay increases the plasticity of the pretrained model, resulting in greater performance gains downstream after fine-tuning. This effect can lead to counterintuitive trade-offs where base models that perform worse after pretraining can perform better after further training. Further investigation of weight decay's mechanistic effects on model behavior reveals that it encourages linearly separable representations, regularizes attention matrices, and reduces overfitting on the training data. Together, these findings highlight the importance of pretrained model plasticity, the limits of using cross-entropy loss as the sole metric for hyperparameter optimization, and the multifaceted role that a single optimization hyperparameter plays in shaping model behavior.

</details>


### [481] [Adaptive Physics Transformer with Fused Global-Local Attention for Subsurface Energy Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11208)
*Xin Ju,Nok Hei,Fung,Yuyan Zhang,Carl Jacquemyn,Matthew Jackson,Randolph Settgast,Sally M. Benson,Gege Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应物理变换器（APT），一种几何、网格和物理无关的神经算子，通过融合图编码器和全局注意力机制，解决地下流体模拟中高计算成本问题。APT在规则和不规则网格上均优于现有架构，具备超分辨率能力，可直接从自适应网格细化模拟中学习，并展现出良好的扩展性和跨数据集学习能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地下系统（如油气、地热、CO₂封存）的全物理数值模拟由于地质非均质性、高分辨率需求以及多物理过程耦合（时间尺度差异大）而计算成本极高，亟需高效的代理模型加速模拟。

Method: 提出自适应物理变换器（APT），核心融合两种机制：1）基于图的编码器提取高分辨率局部非均质特征；2）全局注意力机制捕获长程物理影响。该架构几何、网格和物理无关，可直接从自适应网格细化（AMR）模拟中学习。

Result: APT在规则和不规则网格的地下任务中均优于现有最先进架构；具备鲁棒的超分辨率能力；是首个直接从高分辨率自适应网格细化模拟中学习的架构；展现出良好的扩展行为和跨数据集学习能力。

Conclusion: APT可作为大规模地下基础模型开发的鲁棒且可扩展的骨干架构，为地下系统的高效模拟和基础模型构建提供了新的范式。

Abstract: The Earth's subsurface is a cornerstone of modern society, providing essential energy resources like hydrocarbons, geothermal, and minerals while serving as the primary reservoir for $CO_2$ sequestration. However, full physics numerical simulations of these systems are notoriously computationally expensive due to geological heterogeneity, high resolution requirements, and the tight coupling of physical processes with distinct propagation time scales. Here we propose the $\textbf{Adaptive Physics Transformer}$ (APT), a geometry-, mesh-, and physics-agnostic neural operator that explicitly addresses these challenges. APT fuses a graph-based encoder to extract high-resolution local heterogeneous features with a global attention mechanism to resolve long-range physical impacts. Our results demonstrate that APT outperforms state-of-the-art architectures in subsurface tasks across both regular and irregular grids with robust super-resolution capabilities. Notably, APT is the first architecture that learns directly from HR-adaptive mesh refinement simulations. We also demonstrate APT's favorable scaling behavior and cross-dataset learning capability, positioning it as a robust and scalable backbone for large-scale subsurface foundation model development.

</details>


### [482] [Protein Language Model Embeddings Improve Generalization of Implicit Transfer Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11216)
*Panagiotis Antoniadis,Beatrice Pavesi,Simon Olsson,Ole Winther*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PLaTITO方法，通过整合蛋白质语言模型(pLM)嵌入等辅助信息，改进了可迁移隐式传递算子(TITO)在分子动力学中的数据效率和泛化能力，在蛋白质平衡采样任务上实现了最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分子动力学(MD)计算成本高昂，生成式分子动力学(GenMD)虽能高效采样但跨分子系统的可迁移性有限。本文旨在通过引入辅助信息源来提高可迁移隐式传递算子的数据效率和泛化能力。

Method: 提出PLaTITO方法：1) 采用粗粒化TITO模型提高数据效率；2) 整合蛋白质语言模型(pLM)嵌入改善分布外泛化；3) 研究结构嵌入、温度、大语言模型衍生嵌入等额外条件信号对性能的影响。

Result: PLaTITO在分布外蛋白质系统的平衡采样基准(包括快速折叠蛋白)上达到最先进性能；粗粒化TITO模型相比Boltzmann Emulator具有显著更高的数据效率。

Conclusion: 辅助信息源的引入能有效提升分子动力学生成模型的可迁移性和数据效率，pLM嵌入对分布外泛化尤为关键，为构建通用分子动力学替代模型提供了新思路。

Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) is a central computational tool in physics, chemistry, and biology, enabling quantitative prediction of experimental observables as expectations over high-dimensional molecular distributions such as Boltzmann distributions and transition densities. However, conventional MD is fundamentally limited by the high computational cost required to generate independent samples. Generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) has recently emerged as an alternative, learning surrogates of molecular distributions either from data or through interaction with energy models. While these methods enable efficient sampling, their transferability across molecular systems is often limited. In this work, we show that incorporating auxiliary sources of information can improve the data efficiency and generalization of transferable implicit transfer operators (TITO) for molecular dynamics. We find that coarse-grained TITO models are substantially more data-efficient than Boltzmann Emulators, and that incorporating protein language model (pLM) embeddings further improves out-of-distribution generalization. Our approach, PLaTITO, achieves state-of-the-art performance on equilibrium sampling benchmarks for out-of-distribution protein systems, including fast-folding proteins. We further study the impact of additional conditioning signals such as structural embeddings, temperature, and large-language-model-derived embeddings on model performance.

</details>


### [483] [Structural Bias Beyond Homophily: A Study of Fairness in Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11802)
*Lilian Marey,Mathilde Perez,Tiphaine Viard,Charlotte Laclau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究图链接预测中的拓扑偏差与公平性关系，提出拓扑偏差度量分类法，通过可控结构属性的合成图生成方法，实证表明公平性结果与图拓扑强相关，现有公平性方法对同质性之外的拓扑偏差敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图链接预测在求职推荐、好友关系形成等社会影响应用中至关重要，但现有公平性方法多通过操纵图结构来缓解预测差异，而对社交图中固有的拓扑偏差理解不足，且常将其与同质性混为一谈，因此需要系统研究结构偏差与公平性之间的关系。

Method: 形式化了拓扑偏差度量的分类学体系，提出了一种图生成方法，能够生成具有可控结构属性的多样化合成图语料库，并基于该语料库进行实证分析。

Result: 实证结果表明公平性结果与图拓扑结构强相关，且现有公平性方法对同质性之外的多种结构偏差仍然敏感。

Conclusion: 这些发现凸显了在公平图学习中进行基于结构的评估的必要性，即需要在方法论中系统考虑拓扑偏差对公平性的影响。

Abstract: Graph link prediction (LP) plays a critical role in socially impactful applications such as job recommendation and friendship formation, making fairness a critical concern in this task. While many fairness-aware methods manipulate graph structures to mitigate prediction disparities, the topological biases inherent to social graphs remain poorly understood and are consistently conflated with homophily alone. In this work, we study the relationship between structural biases and fairness outcomes in LP. To this end, we formalize a taxonomy of topological bias measures and introduce a graph generation method producing a diverse corpus of synthetic graphs with controlled structural properties. Using this corpus, we show empirically that fairness outcomes are strongly correlated with graph topology, and that current fairness-aware methods remain sensitive to structural biases beyond homophily. These findings highlight the need for structurally grounded evaluations in fair graph learning.

</details>


### [484] [Memory-Efficient Structured Backpropagation for On-Device LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13069)
*Juneyoung Park,Yuri Hong,Seongwan Kim,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MeSP方法，通过利用LoRA的低秩结构手动推导反向传播，在移动设备上实现与精确梯度相同的效果但内存减少49%，解决了精确梯度高内存（MeBP）与低内存噪声梯度（MeZO）之间的矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动设备上大语言模型的个性化微调需要保护隐私，但设备内存严重受限（通常6-12GB共享内存），现有方法要么需要高内存存储精确梯度（MeBP），要么使用低内存但梯度估计有噪声（MeZO），两者之间存在无法兼顾的权衡。

Method: 利用LoRA低秩分解中投影h = xA的中间结果可在反向传播时以极低成本重计算（因秩r远小于输入维度d_in），从而无需存储中间激活，手动推导出利用低秩结构的反向传播过程。

Result: 在Qwen2.5系列模型（0.5B-3B）上，相比MeBP平均减少49%内存；Qwen2.5-0.5B峰值内存从361MB降至136MB；同时发现MeZO的梯度估计与真实梯度余弦相似度仅约0.001，解释了其收敛缓慢的原因。

Conclusion: MeSP在内存受限设备上实现了精确梯度的低内存微调，使得之前不可行的微调场景成为可能，同时揭示了MeZO梯度估计质量极差的问题。

Abstract: On-device fine-tuning enables privacy-preserving personalization of large language models, but mobile devices impose severe memory constraints, typically 6--12GB shared across all workloads. Existing approaches force a trade-off between exact gradients with high memory (MeBP) and low memory with noisy estimates (MeZO). We propose Memory-efficient Structured Backpropagation (MeSP), which bridges this gap by manually deriving backward passes that exploit LoRA's low-rank structure. Our key insight is that the intermediate projection $h = xA$ can be recomputed during backward at minimal cost since rank $r \ll d_{in}$, eliminating the need to store it. MeSP achieves 49\% average memory reduction compared to MeBP on Qwen2.5 models (0.5B--3B) while computing mathematically identical gradients. Our analysis also reveals that MeZO's gradient estimates show near-zero correlation with true gradients (cosine similarity $\approx$0.001), explaining its slow convergence. MeSP reduces peak memory from 361MB to 136MB for Qwen2.5-0.5B, enabling fine-tuning scenarios previously infeasible on memory-constrained devices.

</details>


### [485] [The Information Geometry of Softmax: Probing and Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15293)
*Kiho Park,Todd Nief,Yo Joong Choe,Victor Veitch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究AI系统如何将语义结构编码到表征空间的几何结构中，重点论证了信息几何作为定义softmax分布的表征空间的自然几何，并提出了"双重引导"方法，该方法利用线性探针稳健地引导表征以展现特定概念，理论上证明了其最优性，实验上验证了其增强可控性和稳定性的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统的表征空间几何结构应反映模型使用表征产生行为的方式，而目前对于定义softmax分布的表征空间的自然几何缺乏深入研究。

Method: 以信息几何作为softmax分布表征空间的自然几何，在此基础上开发"双重引导"方法，利用线性探针进行概念操控。

Result: 理论上证明了双重引导方法能最优地修改目标概念同时最小化对非目标概念的改变；实验上发现该方法增强了概念操控的可控性和稳定性。

Conclusion: 信息几何是理解语义编码和线性表征假说的有效框架，双重引导方法为概念操控提供了理论最优且实践有效的解决方案。

Abstract: This paper concerns the question of how AI systems encode semantic structure into the geometric structure of their representation spaces. The motivating observation is that the natural geometry of these representation spaces should reflect the way models use representations to produce behavior. We focus on the important special case of representations that define softmax distributions. In this case, we argue that the natural geometry is information geometry. Our focus is on the role of information geometry on semantic encoding and the linear representation hypothesis. As an illustrative application, we develop "dual steering", a method for robustly steering representations to exhibit a particular concept using linear probes. We prove that dual steering optimally modifies the target concept while minimizing changes to off-target concepts. Empirically, we find that dual steering enhances the controllability and stability of concept manipulation.

</details>


### [486] [Beyond ReLU: Bifurcation, Oversmoothing, and Topological Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15634)
*Erkan Turan,Gaspard Abel,Maysam Behmanesh,Emery Pierson,Maks Ovsjanikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从分岔理论角度重新审视GNN的过平滑问题，通过用特定函数族替代标准单调激活函数，利用Lyapunov-Schmidt约化理论证明这种替换能诱导分岔，破坏同质固定点的稳定性并产生新的稳定的非均匀模式，从而在理论上抵抗过平滑，并推导出闭式初始化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN在深层时会出现过平滑问题，即节点特征收敛到同质、非信息性的状态，现有方法缺乏对这一问题的理论理解。

Method: (1) 从分岔理论视角将过平滑重新定义为收敛到稳定的"同质固定点"；(2) 用特定函数族替代标准单调激活函数（如ReLU）；(3) 利用Lyapunov-Schmidt约化进行理论分析，证明该替换诱导分岔，破坏同质态稳定性并产生稳定的非均匀模式；(4) 推导闭式的、分岔感知的初始化方法。

Result: 理论证明了激活函数替换能诱导分岔，产生新的稳定非均匀模式；预测了模式幅度的精确非平凡标度律并实验验证；推导的初始化方法在真实基准实验中展现出实用价值。

Conclusion: 通过分岔理论为GNN过平滑问题提供了新视角和理论解决方案，证明了激活函数替换能从根本上破坏过平滑的稳定性，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) learn node representations through iterative network-based message-passing. While powerful, deep GNNs suffer from oversmoothing, where node features converge to a homogeneous, non-informative state. We re-frame this problem of representational collapse from a \emph{bifurcation theory} perspective, characterizing oversmoothing as convergence to a stable ``homogeneous fixed point.'' Our central contribution is the theoretical discovery that this undesired stability can be broken by replacing standard monotone activations (e.g., ReLU) with a class of functions. Using Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction, we analytically prove that this substitution induces a bifurcation that destabilizes the homogeneous state and creates a new pair of stable, non-homogeneous \emph{patterns} that provably resist oversmoothing. Our theory predicts a precise, nontrivial scaling law for the amplitude of these emergent patterns, which we quantitatively validate in experiments. Finally, we demonstrate the practical utility of our theory by deriving a closed-form, bifurcation-aware initialization and showing its utility in real benchmark experiments.

</details>


### [487] [HiPER: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Explicit Credit Assignment for Large Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16165)
*Jiangweizhi Peng,Yuanxin Liu,Ruida Zhou,Charles Fleming,Zhaoran Wang,Alfredo Garcia,Mingyi Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HiPER提出了一种分层计划-执行强化学习框架，通过将策略分解为高层规划器和低层执行器，并引入分层优势估计（HAE）技术，有效解决了多轮LLM智能体在稀疏奖励长程任务中的信用分配问题。在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上分别达到97.4%和83.3%的成功率，显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL方法将LLM智能体建模为扁平策略，在稀疏奖励的长程任务中，智能体需要执行大量动作后才能获得反馈，导致信用分配困难、优化不稳定。缺乏显式的时间抽象机制使得梯度传播效率低下。

Method: HiPER包含两个核心组件：(1) 分层策略分解：高层规划器提出子目标，低层执行器在多个动作步骤中执行子目标；(2) 分层优势估计（HAE）：在规划和执行两个层面分别进行信用分配，通过聚合每个子目标执行过程中的回报并协调两层更新，提供无偏梯度估计并理论上比扁平GAE降低方差。

Result: 基于Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，HiPER在ALFWorld上达到97.4%成功率（比最优方法高6.6%），在WebShop上达到83.3%成功率（高8.3%），在需要多依赖子任务的长程任务上增益尤为显著。

Conclusion: 显式的层次分解对于多轮LLM智能体的可扩展RL训练至关重要，能够有效处理稀疏奖励下的长程决策问题。

Abstract: Training LLMs as interactive agents for multi-turn decision-making remains challenging, particularly in long-horizon tasks with sparse and delayed rewards, where agents must execute extended sequences of actions before receiving meaningful feedback. Most existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches model LLM agents as flat policies operating at a single time scale, selecting one action at each turn. In sparse-reward settings, such flat policies must propagate credit across the entire trajectory without explicit temporal abstraction, which often leads to unstable optimization and inefficient credit assignment.
  We propose HiPER, a novel Hierarchical Plan-Execute RL framework that explicitly separates high-level planning from low-level execution. HiPER factorizes the policy into a high-level planner that proposes subgoals and a low-level executor that carries them out over multiple action steps. To align optimization with this structure, we introduce a key technique called hierarchical advantage estimation (HAE), which carefully assigns credit at both the planning and execution levels. By aggregating returns over the execution of each subgoal and coordinating updates across the two levels, HAE provides an unbiased gradient estimator and provably reduces variance compared to flat generalized advantage estimation.
  Empirically, HiPER achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging interactive benchmarks, reaching 97.4\% success on ALFWorld and 83.3\% on WebShop with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (+6.6\% and +8.3\% over the best prior method), with especially large gains on long-horizon tasks requiring multiple dependent subtasks. These results highlight the importance of explicit hierarchical decomposition for scalable RL training of multi-turn LLM agents.

</details>


### [488] [Position: Evaluation of ECG Representations Must Be Fixed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17531)
*Zachary Berger,Daniel Prakah-Asante,John Guttag,Collin M. Stultz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出当前12导联ECG表征学习的基准测试存在缺陷，需要改进。研究显示：(1) 现有基准被心律不齐和波形形态标签主导，忽略更广泛的临床信息；(2) 评估应扩展到结构性心脏病、患者预测等临床目标；(3) 应用多标签不平衡评估最佳实践后，文献中的结论会发生改变；(4) 随机初始化的编码器+线性评估在许多任务上能达到与SOTA预训练方法相当的性能，因此随机编码器可作为合理的基线模型。作者通过5种预训练方法在6个评估设置上的实证研究验证了这些观点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前12导联ECG表征学习领域在基准测试实践上存在缺陷，基准被心律不齐和波形形态标签主导，无法全面评估ECG表征的临床价值，且评估方法不规范导致结论不可靠。

Method: 本文采用立场论述结合实证评估的方法：(1) 提出评估标准应扩展至结构性心脏病和患者预测；(2) 提出多标签不平衡设置的评估最佳实践；(3) 采用5种代表性ECG预训练方法在6个评估设置（3个标准基准+结构性心脏病数据集+血流动力学推断+患者预测）上进行对比实验。

Result: (1) 应用评估最佳实践后，文献中关于最佳表征的结论发生改变；(2) 随机初始化编码器+线性评估在许多任务上匹配SOTA预训练方法的表现，证明随机编码器可作为合理基线。

Conclusion: 当前ECG表征学习基准测试需要改革：扩展评估指标以涵盖更广泛的临床目标，规范化评估实践，并将随机编码器作为基线模型以避免夸大预训练方法的效果。

Abstract: This position paper argues that current benchmarking practice in 12-lead ECG representation learning must be fixed to ensure progress is reliable and aligned with clinically meaningful objectives. The field has largely converged on three public multi-label benchmarks (PTB-XL, CPSC2018, CSN) dominated by arrhythmia and waveform-morphology labels, even though the ECG is known to encode substantially broader clinical information. We argue that downstream evaluation should expand to include an assessment of structural heart disease and patient-level forecasting, in addition to other evolving ECG-related endpoints, as relevant clinical targets. Next, we outline evaluation best practices for multi-label, imbalanced settings, and show that when they are applied, the literature's current conclusion about which representations perform best is altered. Furthermore, we demonstrate the surprising result that a randomly initialized encoder with linear evaluation matches state-of-the-art pre-training on many tasks. This motivates the use of a random encoder as a reasonable baseline model. We substantiate our observations with an empirical evaluation of five representative ECG pre-training approaches across six evaluation settings: the three standard benchmarks, a structural disease dataset, hemodynamic inference, and patient forecasting.

</details>


### [489] [On the "Induction Bias" in Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18333)
*M. Reza Ebrahimi,Michaël Defferrard,Sunny Panchal,Roland Memisevic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实验发现，Transformer在状态追踪任务中的数据效率远低于RNN，且不同序列长度间几乎没有权重共享，而RNN则能有效共享权重实现跨长度泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究指出Transformer在状态追踪（如长度外推）的分布外泛化中存在局限，但本文转向研究其在分布内设置下的影响，探究Transformer在训练与测试分布匹配时是否仍面临状态追踪挑战。

Method: 在多种监督范式下进行大规模实验，比较Transformer与RNN的数据效率，分析模型在不同状态空间大小和序列长度下所需训练数据量的增长情况，并通过权重共享分析评估跨长度学习迁移程度。

Result: Transformer所需训练数据随状态空间大小和序列长度增长远快于RNN；Transformer在不同序列长度间几乎没有权重共享（甚至存在负迁移），而RNN能有效共享权重，使数据从一个长度迁移到另一个长度。

Conclusion: 即使训练与评估分布匹配，状态追踪仍然是Transformer的根本性挑战；相比之下，RNN通过跨长度权重共享实现了有效的摊销学习。

Abstract: Despite the remarkable practical success of transformer-based language models, recent work has raised concerns about their ability to perform state tracking. In particular, a growing body of literature has shown this limitation primarily through failures in out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, such as length extrapolation. In this work, we shift attention to the in-distribution implications of these limitations. We conduct a large-scale experimental study of the data efficiency of transformers and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) across multiple supervision regimes. We find that the amount of training data required by transformers grows much more rapidly with state-space size and sequence length than for RNNs. Furthermore, we analyze the extent to which learned state-tracking mechanisms are shared across different sequence lengths. We show that transformers exhibit negligible or even detrimental weight sharing across lengths, indicating that they learn length-specific solutions in isolation. In contrast, recurrent models exhibit effective amortized learning by sharing weights across lengths, allowing data from one sequence length to improve performance on others. Together, these results demonstrate that state tracking remains a fundamental challenge for transformers, even when training and evaluation distributions match.

</details>


### [490] [L2G-Net: Local to Global Spectral Graph Neural Networks via Cauchy Factorizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18837)
*Samuel Fernández-Menduiña,Eduardo Pavez,Antonio Ortega*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出L2G-Net，通过对图傅里叶变换进行精确分解为子图操作并通过柯西矩阵组合，实现了一种兼具局部与全局特性的谱图神经网络，避免了全特征分解，以二次复杂度（按最大子图割集规模缩放）实现长程依赖建模，在大型图上以极少的可学习参数达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱方法基于图傅里叶变换（GFT）虽有理论优势，但因计算特征基代价高且表征缺乏顶点域局部性而很少用于GNN；现有方法依赖多项式拉普拉斯滤波器或消息传递等局部近似，限制了建模长程依赖的能力。

Method: 提出GFT的精确分解，将其分解为作用于子图的算子，再通过柯西矩阵序列组合；基于此分解构建L2G-Net，先处理子图谱表征，再通过结构化矩阵进行组合；避免完全特征分解，利用图拓扑结构以二次复杂度（按最大子图割集规模缩放）构造分解。

Result: 在强调长程依赖的大型图实验中，L2G-Net可扩展到标准GFT无法企及的规模，并以数量级更少的可学习参数与SOTA方法竞争。

Conclusion: L2G-Net通过局部到全局的谱分解策略，在保留谱方法理论优势的同时克服了其计算瓶颈和局部性缺失问题，为长程依赖建模提供了一种高效、参数精简的解决方案。

Abstract: Despite their theoretical advantages, spectral methods based on the graph Fourier transform (GFT) are seldom used in graph neural networks (GNNs) due to the cost of computing the eigenbasis and the lack of vertex-domain locality in the resulting representations. As a result, most GNNs rely on local approximations such as polynomial Laplacian filters or message passing, which limit their ability to model long-range dependencies. In this paper, we introduce an exact factorization of the GFT into operators acting on subgraphs, which are then combined via a sequence of Cauchy matrices. Building on this factorization, we propose a new class of spectral GNNs, termed L2G-Net (Local to Global Net). Unlike existing spectral methods, which are either fully global (when using the GFT) or local (when using polynomial filters), L2G-Net operates by processing the spectral representations of subgraphs and then combining them via structured matrices. Our algorithm avoids full eigendecompositions, exploiting graph topology to construct the factorization with quadratic complexity in the number of nodes, scaled by the maximum cut size between subgraphs. Experiments stressing long-range dependencies on large graphs show that L2G-Net scales to regimes out of reach for the standard GFT, and is competitive with state-of-the-art methods with orders of magnitude fewer learnable parameters.

</details>


### [491] [HiPPO Zoo: Explicit Memory Mechanisms for Interpretable State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.21340)
*Jack Goffinet,Casey Hanks,David E. Carlson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在HiPPO框架基础上提出了五种可解释的扩展（统称"HiPPO动物园"），使多项式历史表示具备自适应内存分配和联想记忆等现代SSM能力，同时保持正交多项式基下的直接可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代SSM（如Mamba）在处理长程依赖任务上表现优异，但其表征和优先处理历史的机制仍然是隐式的。本文旨在通过扩展HiPPO框架，使这些机制变得显式且可解释。

Method: 在HiPPO框架的正交多项式基上，引入五种可解释的扩展，使模型具备在线自适应记忆、联想记忆等能力，并通过高效的增量更新在流式场景中训练。

Result: 在一系列合成序列建模任务上，展示了这些扩展的行为和建模优势，证明现代SSM的典型能力可以通过显式、可解释的多项式记忆结构来实现。

Conclusion: 通过显式修改HiPPO框架，可以在保持可解释性的同时实现现代SSM的自适应内存和联想记忆能力，为构建可解释的序列建模方法提供了新思路。

Abstract: Representing the past in a compressed, efficient, and informative manner is a central problem for systems trained on sequential data. The HiPPO framework, originally proposed by Gu & Dao et al., provides a principled approach to sequential compression by projecting signals onto orthogonal polynomial (OP) bases via structured linear ordinary differential equations. Subsequent works have embedded these dynamics in state space models (SSMs), where HiPPO structure serves as an initialization. Nonlinear successors of these SSM methods such as Mamba are state-of-the-art for many tasks with long-range dependencies, but the mechanisms by which they represent and prioritize history remain largely implicit. In this work, we revisit the HiPPO framework with the goal of making these mechanisms explicit. We show how polynomial representations of history can be extended to support capabilities of modern SSMs such as adaptive memory allocation and associative memory, while retaining direct interpretability in the OP basis. We introduce a unified framework comprising five such extensions, which we collectively refer to as a "HiPPO zoo." Each extension exposes a specific modeling capability through an explicit, interpretable modification of the HiPPO framework. The resulting models adapt their memory online and train in streaming settings with efficient updates. We illustrate the behaviors and modeling advantages of these extensions through a range of synthetic sequence modeling tasks, demonstrating that capabilities typically associated with modern SSMs can be realized through explicit, interpretable polynomial memory structures.

</details>


### [492] [Mollified Value Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.23280)
*Hrishikesh Viswanath,Juanwu Lu,S. Talha Bukhari,Mihir Chauhan,Damon Conover,Ziran Wang,Aniket Bera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Mollified Value Learning (MVL)，通过空间测度上的期望聚合替代点态微分约束，实现无需显式微分算子的距离类价值学习，在导航与高维机器人操作任务中提升目标达成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习中，现有基于物理信息的方法通过HJB最优性原理施加点态Eikonal方程约束，但在高维复杂环境下显式微分结构不稳定。

Method: 将距离类约束重新解释为局部空间测度上的期望，通过聚合该测度上的约束而非点态评估，作为空间磨光子诱导距离类价值几何，避免昂贵的微分算子。

Result: 在导航和高维机器人操作任务中，MVL学习了结构化的价值表示，提升了目标达成性能。

Conclusion: MVL通过测度聚合策略有效替代了显式微分约束，为离线GCRL中的价值学习提供了更稳定且可扩展的方案。

Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) learns goal-reaching behaviors from static datasets, but accurate value estimation remains challenging under limited state-action coverage. Existing physics-informed approaches address this by imposing pointwise distance-like geometric constraints derived from Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) optimality principles, often through first-order partial differential equations such as the Eikonal equation. However, enforcing local consistency through explicit differential structure can become unstable in complex, high-dimensional environments. Our key insight is to instead reinterpret distance-like constraints as an expectation over a local spatial measure. By aggregating constraints over this measure rather than evaluating them pointwise, the objective acts as a spatial mollifier, inducing distance-like value geometry without requiring expensive differential operators. We refer to this as Mollified Value Learning (MVL). Experiments across navigation and high-dimensional robotic manipulation tasks show that MVL learns structured, value representations, improving goal-reaching performance, when used with implicit value representation learning methods. Open-source codes are available at https://github.com/HrishikeshVish/MVL.

</details>


### [493] [MASPOB: Bandit-Based Prompt Optimization for Multi-Agent Systems with Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02630)
*Zhi Hong,Qian Zhang,Jiahang Sun,Zhiwei Shang,Mingze Kong,Xiangyi Wang,Yao Shu,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MASPOB框架，利用基于bandit的优化方法、图神经网络和坐标上升法，在有限评估预算下高效优化多智能体系统的提示词，解决样本效率低、提示耦合和搜索空间爆炸三大挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体系统（MAS）中，由于部署场景不允许修改工作流，且系统性能对输入提示高度敏感，提示优化成为提升性能的自然途径。然而，实际场景中的提示优化面临样本效率低（评估成本高）、提示间拓扑耦合以及搜索空间组合爆炸三大挑战。

Method: 提出MASPOB框架：1) 基于UCB的bandit方法平衡探索与利用，在有限预算下最大化收益；2) 集成图神经网络（GNN）捕捉结构先验，学习拓扑感知的提示语义表示；3) 采用坐标上升法将优化分解为单变量子问题，将搜索复杂度从指数级降至线性级。

Result: 在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，MASPOB取得了最先进的性能，持续优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: MASPOB通过bandit框架、GNN和坐标上升的组合，有效解决了MAS提示优化的核心挑战，实现了样本高效且可扩展的优化方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved great success in many real-world applications, especially the one serving as the cognitive backbone of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) to orchestrate complex workflows in practice. Since many deployment scenarios preclude MAS workflow modifications and its performance is highly sensitive to the input prompts, prompt optimization emerges as a more natural approach to improve its performance. However, real-world prompt optimization for MAS is impeded by three key challenges: (1) the need of sample efficiency due to prohibitive evaluation costs, (2) topology-induced coupling among prompts, and (3) the combinatorial explosion of the search space. To address these challenges, we introduce MASPOB (Multi-Agent System Prompt Optimization via Bandits), a novel sample-efficient framework based on bandits. By leveraging Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) to quantify uncertainty, the bandit framework balances exploration and exploitation, maximizing gains within a strictly limited budget. To handle topology-induced coupling, MASPOB integrates Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to capture structural priors, learning topology-aware representations of prompt semantics. Furthermore, it employs coordinate ascent to decompose the optimization into univariate sub-problems, reducing search complexity from exponential to linear. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that MASPOB achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming existing baselines.

</details>


### [494] [Rank-Factorized Implicit Neural Bias: Scaling Super-Resolution Transformer with FlashAttention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06738)
*Dongheon Lee,Seokju Yun,Jaegyun Im,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出秩因子隐式神经偏置（RIB）替代相对位置偏置（RPB），使超分Transformer能够利用FlashAttention，从而大幅扩大窗口尺寸（至96×96）并提升训练/推理效率，在Urban100×2上达到35.63 dB PSNR，同时训练和推理时间分别减少2.1倍和2.9倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超分Transformer过度依赖RPB，导致无法使用FlashAttention等高效注意力核，造成计算开销过大，限制了训练patch尺寸和自注意力窗口的扩展，阻碍了超分Transformer的规模化发展。

Method: 提出RIB，利用低秩隐式神经表示近似位置偏置，并通过通道拼接方式与像素内容token融合，将注意力分数计算中的逐元素加法转为点积运算，从而兼容FlashAttention；同时引入卷积局部注意力和循环窗口策略以充分利用长距离交互能力。

Result: 在Urban100×2上达到35.63 dB PSNR，训练时间减少2.1倍，推理时间减少2.9倍，窗口尺寸可扩展至96×96。

Conclusion: RIB有效替代RPB，释放了超分Transformer的规模化潜力，实现了更优的性能与效率平衡。

Abstract: Recent Super-Resolution~(SR) methods mainly adopt Transformers for their strong long-range modeling capability and exceptional representational capacity. However, most SR Transformers rely heavily on relative positional bias~(RPB), which prevents them from leveraging hardware-efficient attention kernels such as FlashAttention. This limitation imposes a prohibitive computational burden during both training and inference, severely restricting attempts to scale SR Transformers by enlarging the training patch size or the self-attention window. Consequently, unlike other domains that actively exploit the inherent scalability of Transformers, SR Transformers remain heavily focused on effectively utilizing limited receptive fields. In this paper, we propose Rank-factorized Implicit Neural Bias~(RIB), an alternative to RPB that enables FlashAttention in SR Transformers. Specifically, RIB approximates positional bias using low-rank implicit neural representations and concatenates them with pixel content tokens in a channel-wise manner, turning the element-wise bias addition in attention score computation into a dot-product operation. Further, we introduce a convolutional local attention and a cyclic window strategy to fully leverage the advantages of long-range interactions enabled by RIB and FlashAttention. We enlarge the window size up to \textbf{96$\times$96} while jointly scaling the training patch size and the dataset size, maximizing the benefits of Transformers in the SR task. As a result, our network achieves \textbf{35.63\,dB PSNR} on Urban100$\times$2, while reducing training and inference time by \textbf{2.1$\times$} and \textbf{2.9$\times$}, respectively, compared to the RPB-based SR Transformer~(PFT).

</details>


### [495] [Group Entropies and Mirror Duality: A Class of Flexible Mirror Descent Updates for Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08651)
*Andrzej Cichocki,Piergiulio Tempesta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个融合群论、群熵与现代机器学习的理论框架，通过群论镜像映射（link functions）构建了一类无限、灵活的Mirror Descent优化算法族，并在大规模单纯形约束二次规划问题上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Mirror Descent算法（如基于Shannon、Tsallis、Kaniadakis熵的变体）受限于特定trace-form熵函数，缺乏统一的群论理论基础，难以灵活适应多样化的数据几何与统计分布。作者希望用群论统一并扩展这些熵函数，设计更通用的MD更新规则。

Method: 1) 利用群熵（group entropies）作为广义熵泛函，其受群组成律支配，涵盖并扩展了所有trace-form熵族。2) 引入群论镜像映射（多参数广义对数及其逆函数——群指数），实现可调的MD更新。3) 提出"镜像对偶性"（mirror duality），允许在特定学习率约束下互换群论link函数与其逆函数。4) 通过调整或学习群对数的超参数，使模型适配训练分布的统计特性。

Result: 在大规模单纯形约束二次规划问题上的实验验证了所提更新规则的有效性、鲁棒性和性能优势。

Conclusion: 该框架不仅提供了更大的灵活性和更优的收敛特性，还为机器学习/深度学习中正则化器和自然梯度算法的设计开辟了新视角。

Abstract: We introduce a comprehensive theoretical and algorithmic framework that bridges formal group theory and group entropies with modern machine learning, paving the way for an infinite, flexible family of Mirror Descent (MD) optimization algorithms. Our approach exploits the rich structure of group entropies, which are generalized entropic functionals governed by group composition laws, encompassing and significantly extending all trace-form entropies such as the Shannon, Tsallis, and Kaniadakis families. By leveraging group-theoretical mirror maps (or link functions) in MD, expressed via multi-parametric generalized logarithms and their inverses (group exponentials), we achieve highly flexible and adaptable MD updates that can be tailored to diverse data geometries and statistical distributions. To this end, we introduce the notion of \textit{mirror duality}, which allows us to seamlessly switch or interchange group-theoretical link functions with their inverses, subject to specific learning rate constraints. By tuning or learning the hyperparameters of the group logarithms enables us to adapt the model to the statistical properties of the training distribution, while simultaneously ensuring desirable convergence characteristics via fine-tuning. This generality not only provides greater flexibility and improved convergence properties, but also opens new perspectives for applications in machine learning and deep learning by expanding the design of regularizers and natural gradient algorithms. We extensively evaluate the validity, robustness, and performance of the proposed updates on large-scale, simplex-constrained quadratic programming problems.

</details>


### [496] [Beyond Test-Time Memory: State-Space Optimal Control for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09221)
*Peihao Wang,Shan Yang,Xijun Wang,Tesi Xiao,Xin Liu,Changlong Yu,Yu Lou,Pan Li,Zhangyang Wang,Ming Lin,René Vidal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出测试时控制（TTC）层，通过将推理形式化为最优控制问题，在推理时对潜在状态执行有限时域LQR规划，并将值函数作为嵌套目标嵌入神经架构，从而实现模型架构内的规划能力。作为适配器集成到预训练LLM中，TTC层在数学推理任务上取得了显著提升（MATH-500提升+27.8%，AMC和AIME上Pass@8提升2-3倍），并设计了基于辛形式的高效CUDA核实现以保证可扩展性。
