Motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体遵循顺序的截屏-执行循环，每轮迭代都需要调用LLM，导致高延迟和频繁的工具使用错误，亟需一种更高效、更可靠的任务执行方式。

Method: 提出Agent即时编译系统，包含三个组件：(1) JIT-Planner：生成多个代码计划，根据工具规范验证并选择最小成本方案；(2) JIT-Scheduler：通过学习延迟分布进行蒙特卡洛成本估计，探索并行化策略；(3) 不变式强制工具协议：定义前置条件和后置条件要求，减少工具使用错误。

Result: 在五个应用中，JIT-Planner相比Browser-Use实现10.4倍加速和28%准确率提升；JIT-Scheduler相比OpenAI CUA实现2.4倍加速和9%准确率提升。

Conclusion: Agent即时编译系统通过编译时优化和并行化策略，显著提升了计算机使用智能体的执行效率和准确性，为自动化任务执行提供了一种高效范式。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) automate tasks specified with natural language such as "order the cheapest item from Taco Bell" by generating sequences of calls to tools such as click, type, and scroll on a browser. Current implementations follow a sequential fetch-screenshot-execute loop where each iteration requires an LLM call, resulting in high latency and frequent errors from incorrect tool use. We present agent just-in-time (JIT) compilation, a system that compiles task descriptions directly into executable code that may include LLM calls, tool calls, and parallelization. Our approach comprises three components: (1) JIT-Planner, which generates multiple code plans, validates each against tool specifications, and selects the minimum-cost candidate; (2) JIT-Scheduler, which explores parallelization strategies via Monte Carlo cost estimation from learned latency distributions; and (3) an invariant-enforcing tool protocol specifying precondition and postcondition requirements to reduce the rate of incorrect tool use. Across five applications, JIT-Planner achieves $10.4\times$ speedup and 28$\%$ higher accuracy over Browser-Use, while JIT-Scheduler achieves $2.4\times$ speedup and 9\% higher accuracy over OpenAI CUA.

</details>


### [535] [The Distillation Game: Adaptive Attacks & Efficient Defenses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22737)
*Youssef Allouah,Mahdi Haghifam,Sanmi Koyejo,Reza Shokri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过最小-最大博弈框架研究模型蒸馏攻击中的防御-利用权衡，提出了自适应评估方法（学生重加权高价值样本）和产品-of-专家（PoE）防御策略（教师与代理学生联合生成）。实验表明自适应评估比被动评估更能揭示蒸馏能力恢复，且PoE在成本与推理质量上优于现有防御方法，结论是强蒸馏难以阻止，应使用自适应学生评估防御效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型提供者面临部署权衡：模型输出越有用，越容易被蒸馏攻击模仿。现有防御评估多采用被动方法，可能低估了蒸馏攻击的实际能力，需要更严格的评估框架和更经济的防御策略。

Method: 1) 构建最小-最大博弈框架，包含效用约束的教师与自适应学生；2) 提出自适应评估规则，学生动态重加权高价值样本；3) 设计PoE防御模板，在前向传播中组合教师与代理学生；4) 在GSM8K和MATH数据集上对比被动与自适应评估。

Result: 自适应评估下，先进防御的蒸馏能力恢复显著高于被动评估（被动-自适应差距大）；PoE与昂贵防御在自适应评估下的鲁棒性差距缩小，且PoE成本更低、推理轨迹质量更高。

Conclusion: 强蒸馏攻击目前难以有效阻止；反蒸馏进展应使用自适应学生而非被动学生进行评估。

Abstract: Distillation attacks create a deployment trade-off for model providers: the same outputs that make a model more useful can also make it easier to imitate. We study this trade-off through a minimax game between a utility-constrained teacher and an adaptive student. Our framework yields tractable one-sided response rules: an adaptive evaluation rule in which the student reweights high-value examples, and a teacher-side defense template that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. From a cheap proxy for example value, we derive Product-of-Experts (PoE), a simple forward-pass-only defense that combines the teacher with a proxy student during generation. Empirically, adaptive evaluation reveals a large passive--adaptive gap: on state-of-the-art defenses, adaptive students recover substantially more capability than passive evaluation suggests on GSM8K and MATH. Under this stronger evaluation, the apparent robustness gap between expensive defenses and PoE narrows considerably, while PoE remains substantially cheaper and preserves higher-quality reasoning traces. Overall, our results suggest that strong distillation remains difficult to stop, and that progress on antidistillation should be judged against adaptive students rather than passive ones. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ysfalh/distillation-game.

</details>


### [536] [Learned Relay Representations for Forward-Thinking Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22967)
*Benjamin Rozonoyer,Jacopo Minniti,Dhruvesh Patel,Neil Band,Avishek Joey Bose,Tim G. J. Rudner,Andrew McCallum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Learned Relay Representations (Relay)方法，通过可微分的逐token通道在去噪步骤间传递潜在信息，使掩码扩散模型(MDMs)能够前向思考，避免每次迭代时丢弃中间计算信息。该方法可与块扩散和KV缓存等技术兼容，在Fast-dLLM v2模型上实现编码任务性能提升和高达32%的推理延迟降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散模型在序列生成过程中，每次去噪迭代都会丢弃中间层计算得到的丰富内部表征信息，导致后续步骤需要重新计算这些有价值的信息，造成计算浪费和推理效率低下。

Method: 提出Relay方法，引入可微分的逐token通道在MDM的前向传播之间传递潜在信息，并通过截断式时间反向传播(BPTT)进行训练。该方法可与块扩散和KV缓存等技术无缝兼容。

Result: 在Sudoku规划任务上验证了设计选择的合理性；在Fast-dLLM v2模型上，Relay在编码任务上优于标准有监督微调，同时将推理延迟降低高达32%。

Conclusion: 状态级DLM可以通过显式训练在解码步骤间前向传递潜在信息，从而推进性能-延迟帕累托前沿。

Abstract: When Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) generate sequences through iterative refinement, the rich internal computation over masked positions is discarded, forcing every subsequent refinement step to recompute the valuable internal information stored as model representations. To avoid a hard reset between denoising rounds, we propose Learned Relay Representations (Relay), a method that allows MDMs to be forward-thinking when denoising by explicitly learning how to propagate latent information for the benefit of future denoising steps. Relay introduces a differentiable per-token channel that passes information between forward passes and is trained via truncated backpropagation through time (BPTT). We show that this framework can be scaled to state-of-the-art Diffusion Language Models (DLMs), and is seamlessly compatible with techniques like block diffusion and KV caching. We first provide a thorough justification of the design choices in Relay on a challenging Sudoku-based planning task. We then scale Relay to Fast-dLLM v2, a state-of-the-art DLM, outperforming standard supervised finetuning on coding tasks while reducing inference latency by up to 32%. Our empirical results demonstrate that state-of-the-art DLMs can be explicitly trained to relay latent information forward across decoding steps, advancing the performance-latency Pareto frontier. We provide code for all our experiments.

</details>


### [537] [Assessing Predictive Models for Fairness Based on Movement Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23234)
*Francesco Lettich,Mario A. Nascimento,Chiara Pugliese,Chiara Renso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将空间公平性概念从单一地理位置扩展到移动轨迹模式，通过多分辨率空间分区和空间扫描统计量，评估预测模型对个体移动模式的公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间公平性研究仅考虑个体的单一地理位置（如居住地），忽略了人们活动轨迹覆盖多个区域的事实，因此需要将空间公平性推广到包含移动模式的新维度。

Method: 首先将个体的移动轨迹关联到不同地理区域，采用多种空间分区（不同分辨率和对齐方式）；然后使用合适的空间扫描统计量来评估预测模型基于移动模式的公平性。

Result: 在数千个合成不公平数据集上实验，该方法能有效检测这种新型不公平性，并能检索出被不公平对待的对象集合；定位性能表现出一致的多分辨率权衡。

Conclusion: 将空间公平性推广至移动模式是必要且可行的，所提方法能有效检测基于移动轨迹的预测模型不公平性，但需注意多分辨率权衡对定位精度的影响。

Abstract: Assessing the spatial fairness of predictive models involves establishing whether they are statistically penalizing (favoring) individuals associated with certain geographical locations. Literature on this topic makes the fundamental assumption that each individual is assigned to a single geographical location (e.g., place of residence). However, fairness with respect to the set of locations where one has been, i.e., their movement patterns over different regions, also matters when fairness is considered. Consequently, we argue that it is necessary to generalize the notion of spatial fairness to also include movement patterns, leading to the novel problem of assessing predictive models for fairness relative to the movements of individuals. To deal with this problem, we propose an approach that first associates the movements of individuals to certain geographic regions, considering multiple spatial partitions with different resolutions and alignments, and then employs a suitable spatial scan statistic to assess whether a predictive model is fair based on movement patterns. In the experimental evaluation, we study the performance of our approach over thousands of synthetic unfair datasets, showing that it is effective at detecting this new type of unfairness and at retrieving the set of objects treated unfairly, while localization performance exhibits a consistent multi-resolution trade-off.

</details>


### [538] [Theoretical Analysis of Sparse Optimization with Reparameterization, Weight Decay, and Adaptive Learning Rate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25134)
*Huangyu Xu,Jingqin Yang,Qianqian Xu,Jiaye Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReWA方法（基于重参数化、权重衰减和自适应学习率）用于稀疏优化，解决了ℓ_p正则化（0<p<1）因梯度无界导致的优化不稳定问题，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上相比ℓ_1正则化显著提升了稀疏性，同时保持了测试准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ℓ_p正则化（0<p<1）虽能诱导稀疏性，但其梯度在零点附近无界，导致优化不稳定。本文旨在解决这一不稳定问题。

Method: 提出ReWA方法，核心思路是通过重参数化（Reparameterization）改变优化景观，结合权重衰减（Weight decay）和自适应学习率（Adaptive learning rate）来稳定训练过程，从而间接实现类似ℓ_p正则化的稀疏效果。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet数据集上，使用ResNet架构，ReWA相比ℓ_1正则化方法实现了显著的稀疏性提升，同时测试准确率得以保持。

Conclusion: ReWA是一种有效的稀疏优化替代方案，既保留了ℓ_p正则化的稀疏优势，又克服了其优化不稳定的缺陷。

Abstract: Sparse optimization is a fundamental challenge in various practical applications. A popular approach to sparse optimization is $\ell_p$ regularization. However, it may encounter optimization instability due to the unbounded gradients when $0<p<1$. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to sparse optimization termed ReWA, based on Reparameterization, Weight decay, and Adaptive learning rate. ReWA is closely connected to $\ell_p$-regularization, yet it unveils a distinct optimization landscape that helps mitigate instability issues. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet with ResNets demonstrate that ReWA leads to significant sparsity improvements over the $\ell_1$-regularization approach while preserving test accuracy.

</details>


### [539] [GEM: Geometric Entropy Mixing for Optimal LLM Data Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26121)
*Yue Min,Ziyun Qiao,Ruining Chen,Yujun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GEM框架，将数据配比问题重新形式化为超球面上的变分问题，通过MM算法优化几何熵正则项，结合师生蒸馏实现对大规模语料的几何保真缩放，在1.1B参数模型上集成现有混合策略后平均下游准确率提升1.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据混合策略受限于分类缺陷：人工分类存在本体论对齐问题，欧氏聚类无法处理嵌入各向异性，导致最优混合比例难以确定。

Method: GEM框架将数据配比形式化为超球面上的变分问题，引入混合平衡正则项；通过解耦生成先验并使用MM（Minorize-Maximize）算法优化目标，有效对抗聚类坍缩；采用师生蒸馏将几何保真度扩展到网络规模语料，并提出几何影响分数（GIS）用于可解释的类别生成。

Result: 在1.1B参数模型上的实验表明，GEM集成到DoReMi和RegMix等混合策略中后，平均下游准确率提升最多1.2%，建立了新的最先进水平，并为可预测的数据混合提供了稳健的坐标系统。

Conclusion: GEM通过几何熵视角重新定义了数据配比问题，证明了超越欧氏启发式的几何方法能更有效地发现平衡的语义结构，并为大规模预训练的数据组成优化提供了新的理论框架和实用工具。

Abstract: LLM pre-training efficacy increasingly depends on data composition rather than sheer volume. Yet, optimal mixing is hindered by categorization flaws: human taxonomies suffer from ontological misalignment, and Euclidean clustering fails to address embedding anisotropy. We introduce GEM (Geometric Entropy Mixing), a framework reformulating data curation as a variational problem on the hypersphere augmented with a mixing-balance regularizer. By decoupling the generative prior and optimizing the objective via a provable MM (Minorize-Maximize) algorithm, GEM effectively counteracts the cluster collapse to discover balanced semantic structures invisible to Euclidean heuristics. We employ teacher-student distillation to scale this geometric fidelity to web-scale corpora and introduce the Geometric Influence Score (GIS) for interpretable taxonomy generation. Experiments with 1.1B-parameter models demonstrate that GEM establishes a new state-of-the-art when integrated into mixing strategies like DoReMi and RegMix, improving average downstream accuracy by up to 1.2% and offering a robust coordinate system for predictable data mixing.

</details>


### [540] [PRISM: Position-encoded Regressive Inverse Spectral Model for Multilayer Thin-Film Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26502)
*Runtian Wang,Renhao Xue,Baige Chen,Hao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM是一个统一的自回归Transformer模型，通过频谱前缀条件化和累积深度旋转位置编码两大创新，联合预测多层薄膜光学涂层设计中的离散材料选择和连续厚度回归，在显著减少参数量的同时将MAE降低50%以上，达到0.010的SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多层薄膜光学涂层设计的逆问题是一个复杂的组合-连续联合优化挑战，传统方法（如模拟退火）计算效率低下，亟需一种能够同时处理离散材料选择和连续厚度回归的高效统一解决方案。

Method: 提出PRISM模型：(1) 采用仅解码器的自回归Transformer架构，在单一骨干网络中联合预测离散材料选择和连续厚度回归；(2) 频谱前缀条件化（spectrum prefix conditioning）利用标准前缀令牌实现上下文目标注入；(3) 累积深度旋转位置编码（cumulative-depth Rotary Position Embeddings）将连续厚度直接编码到位置表示中，保留物理空间层间关系。

Result: PRISM-13M模型比其它Transformer基线减少50%以上MAE，且仅使用五分之一的参数；PRISM-44M变体在分布内验证基准上达到SOTA性能（MAE=0.010），运行速度显著快于模拟退火算法。

Conclusion: PRISM为多层薄膜光学涂层设计提供了一种高度高效且性能优越的替代方案，能够替代经典的优化方法，在保持高精度的同时大幅提升计算效率。

Abstract: The inverse problem of multilayer thin-film optical coatings design represents a complex combinatorial-continuous optimization challenge. We present PRISM (Position-encoded Regressive Inverse Spectral Model), a unified decoder-only autoregressive transformer that streamlines this process by jointly predicting discrete material selection and continuous thickness regression within a single backbone. PRISM introduces two primary architectural innovations: (1) spectrum prefix conditioning, which utilizes standard prefix tokens for in-context target injection, and (2) cumulative-depth Rotary Position Embeddings, which encode continuous thickness directly into the positional representation to preserve the physical spatial relationships of the stack. Our benchmarks demonstrate that a PRISM-13M model reduces MAE by over 50\% compared to other transformer baselines while utilizing only one-fifth of the parameters. Furthermore, a 44M-parameter variant achieves state-of-the-art performance (MAE = 0.010) on our in-distribution validation benchmark and operates significantly faster than simulated annealing, offering a highly efficient alternative to classical optimization methods.

</details>


### [541] [When Muon Optimizer Meets Adversarial Training: A Theoretical and Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26929)
*Jun Yan,Weiquan Huang,Jiankai Zuo,Yujian Mo,Xi Fang,Chengliang Wu,Zeming Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了正交化优化器Muon在对抗训练中的应用，理论上证明Muon对矩阵更新施加谱范数稳定性上限，实验上在多种架构和威胁模型下Muon与SGD竞争力相当且优于AdamW，表明优化器几何特性是影响对抗训练安全性的关键因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管自适应优化器（如AdamW）能提升标准训练性能，但在对抗训练中往往导致鲁棒性下降，而SGD仍是默认选择。Muon优化器通过近似极分解对矩阵更新进行正交化，在大规模训练中取得成功且内存成本与SGD相当。这引发了一个安全问题：正交化优化能否在强且异构的威胁模型下改进对抗训练？

Method: 理论分析：证明Muon对矩阵更新施加了谱范数稳定性上限，限制训练动态中谱的失控增长而不显式收缩学习权重。实验设计：在5种架构（CNN和ViT）和3种ℓp威胁模型（ℓ∞, ℓ1, ℓ2）及其联合威胁下，对比Muon、SGD和AdamW在对抗训练中的表现。

Result: Muon在CNN上与SGD竞争力相当，在CNN和ViT上均显著优于AdamW。Muon的正交化更新在多种架构和威胁模型下均展现出优势。

Conclusion: 优化器几何特性是对抗训练中影响安全性的关键因素，正交化更新在特定经验场景下有益，优化器设计应被视为对抗训练的安全关键组件。

Abstract: Adversarial training (AT) remains one of the most reliable empirical defenses against adversarial attacks. Its robustness critically depends on how the underlying min-max objective is optimized. In practice, Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) optimizer remains the default optimization choice for AT, whereas adaptive optimizers often improve standard training but may yield inferior robustness. Recently, the Muon optimizer, which orthogonalizes matrix-valued updates via an approximate polar decomposition, has achieved notable success in large-scale training at a memory cost comparable to SGD. This raises a security-relevant question: \textit{can orthogonalized optimization improve AT under strong and heterogeneous threat models?} Focusing on this problem, we conduct a comprehensive theoretical and empirical study. Theoretically, we show that Muon imposes a spectral-norm stability ceiling on matrix updates, limiting uncontrolled spectral growth in the training dynamics without explicitly shrinking the learned weights. Empirically, across five architectures and three $\ell_p$ threat models ($\ell_\infty$, $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$) and their union, Muon is competitive with SGD on CNNs and substantially outperforms AdamW on both CNNs and ViTs. These results identify optimizer geometry as a security-relevant factor in adversarial training, while clarifying the empirical regimes in which orthogonalized updates are beneficial. Overall, our findings highlight optimizer design as a security-critical component of AT.

</details>


### [542] [The Fundamental Limits of Fraud Detection in Card Payment Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27557)
*Gaurav Dhama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文论证了银行卡支付欺诈检测的核心瓶颈并非模型架构或优化算法，而是支付生态系统中固有的信息质量缺陷（延迟、删失、污染、反事实缺失），并通过理论推导证明改善报告基础设施比提升模型复杂度能更有效降低后悔下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管模型架构取得了重大进展，但基于监督学习的支付欺诈检测性能提升却趋于停滞。作者认为主要原因不是函数逼近或优化失败，而是支付生态系统中固有的结构性信息损伤（延迟、删失、污染、反事实缺失反馈）未被充分考虑。

Method: 将银行卡授权形式化为一个顺序决策问题，其反馈具有延迟、删失、污染和反事实缺失特征。推导出极小极大后悔下界，证明这些信息损伤以乘积形式出现在可达到学习率的分母中。同时分析了不同发卡机构间异质性对可学习性的负面影响。

Result: 信息损伤以乘性方式降低学习率；改善发卡机构报告质量或减少删失比增加模型复杂度能更大幅度降低后悔下界；发卡机构间的异质性进一步恶化了可学习性，超出了平均损伤率所暗示的水平。

Conclusion: 欺诈检测在支付网络中本质上比标准在线学习环境更困难；生态系统信息质量是关键瓶颈；应优先投资于报告基础设施、争议处理流程质量和选择性探索策略，而非单纯追求模型复杂度的提升。

Abstract: Card payment fraud detection is usually framed as a supervised classification problem. Although this approach has generated practical progress, improvement has remained incremental despite major advances in model architecture. We argue that this is not mainly a failure of function approximation or optimization, but a consequence of structural information impairments inherent to the payment ecosystem.
  We formalize card authorization as a sequential decision problem with delayed, censored, corrupted, and counterfactually missing feedback. We derive a minimax regret lower bound showing that these impairments enter multiplicatively in the denominator of the achievable learning rate. The bound implies that improving issuer reporting quality or reducing censorship can yield larger reductions in the regret floor than increasing model complexity. We also show that heterogeneity across issuers worsens learnability beyond what average impairment rates suggest.
  The paper contributes a theory of why fraud detection in payment networks is fundamentally harder than in standard online learning settings, identifies ecosystem information quality as the key bottleneck, and provides a theoretical basis for prioritizing investments in reporting infrastructure, dispute process quality, and selective exploration. The paper is theory-first and does not rely on proprietary transaction data.

</details>


### [543] [PINE: Pruning Boosted Tree Ensembles with Conformal In-Distribution Prediction Equivalence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28068)
*Haruki Yajima,Yusuke Matsui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PINE是一种针对树集成模型的剪枝方法，通过在分布区域内保持预测等价性并利用保形校准控制区域大小，在12个表格数据集上实现了高达30%的压缩率提升，同时保持与现有忠实剪枝方法相当的预测一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有树集成剪枝方法要么在压缩时牺牲预测一致性（非忠实剪枝），要么因要求全局预测等价导致压缩率过低（忠实剪枝）。PINE旨在平衡压缩率与决策一致性，在分布区域内提供强保证而非全局保证。

Method: PINE通过单个参数α利用保形校准（conformal calibration）控制分布内区域的大小，在该区域内保持预测等价性，在区域外允许剪枝引入的预测变化。

Result: 在12个公开表格数据集上，PINE相比现有忠实剪枝方法将压缩率提升了最高30%，同时预测保持率处于可比水平。

Conclusion: PINE通过放宽全局预测等价为分布内区域等价，有效提升了忠实剪枝的压缩率，为树集成模型提供了一种更实用的可解释性优化方案。

Abstract: Tree ensembles are machine learning models with strong predictive performance and interpretability, and remain widely used for tabular data. Standard pruning methods for tree ensembles typically optimize an accuracy-compression trade-off and may change a subset of predictions, potentially compromising decision consistency. Faithful pruning methods address this issue by preserving prediction equivalence over the entire input space, but this requirement leads to lower compression ratios. We propose PINE, a pruning method that provides strong guarantees within an in-distribution region. PINE preserves prediction equivalence within this region and controls the region size using a single parameter $α$ via conformal calibration. Experiments on 12 public tabular datasets show that PINE improves the compression ratio by up to 30% while preserving predictions at a comparable level to existing faithful pruning methods.

</details>


### [544] [Conveyance: A Versatile Framework for Learning in Structured Class Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28420)
*Yasser Taha,Grégoire Montavon,Nils Körber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Conveyance，一种针对结构化类别空间的统一分类方法，通过最大化两个独立类别分区的间隔来编码类别间关系，在层次分类、序数回归和多实例学习任务中匹配或超越专业基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准损失函数（如交叉熵）具有“类别对称”特性，无法利用类别间的结构化关系，尤其在面对结构化噪声时表现受限。现有方法需要定义复杂联合分布或手动调整效用矩阵，缺乏统一且高效的解决方案。

Method: 提出Conveyance损失函数，允许用户编码类别间的图结构关系，通过最大化两个独立类别分区的间隔来运作，同时保持单调性和部分凸性等形式化性质。

Result: 在层次分类、序数回归和多实例学习任务中，Conveyance匹配或超越了专业基线方法的性能。

Conclusion: Conveyance为结构化类别空间提供了一种统一、有效且无需复杂手动调整的解决方案。

Abstract: While machine learning (ML) architectures have evolved rapidly to account for complex data, loss functions like cross-entropy remain mostly structure-agnostic in many real-world applications. However, the "class-symmetric" nature of these standard losses fundamentally limits the ability of ML models to exploit structural relationships between classes, particularly when facing structured noise. We propose Conveyance, a new classification approach and associated loss function tailored to structured class spaces. It allows users to encode graph-like relations between classes without having to define complex joint distributions or manually tune utility matrices. Technically, our loss function operates by maximizing two separate margins over distinct class partitions, while preserving formal properties such as monotonicity and partial convexity. We demonstrate the versatility and effectiveness of our method by applying it to hierarchical classification, ordinal regression, and multiple instance learning. Across these tasks, Conveyance either matches or exceeds the performance of specialized baselines, thereby offering a unified solution for structured class spaces.

</details>


### [545] [Inferring the Size of Large Language Models From Popular Text Memorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29223)
*Ivica Nikolic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅通过文本输出来黑盒推断大语言模型参数规模下界的方法，利用模型对经典文本的预测准确度（记忆信号）来估计参数量，并验证了该方法在开源和闭源模型上的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多大语言模型的开发者不公开参数量，而参数量是理解模型能力和成本的关键参考指标。现有方法无法在仅能访问模型文本输出（如API接口）的情况下推断模型大小，因此需要一种黑盒方法。

Method: 基于一个关键观察：经典文本（如文学、宗教、基础文献）几乎存在于所有大规模预训练语料中，模型对不同长度文本片段的下一词预测准确度反映了其记忆程度，而记忆能力受参数量限制。该方法将多样化的文本和片段长度的记忆信号聚合成每个模型的准确率轮廓向量，然后构建两种互补推断方法：成对统计检验（比较两个模型哪个更大）和标度律估计器（通过PCA提取一维潜在指标映射到参数量）。

Result: 在开源模型上验证了两种方法的准确性和可靠性。应用于闭源模型时，恢复了内部产品层级结构，揭示了行业不同的扩展策略——一些开发者参数量增长显著，另一些则保持在严格的参数上限内。

Conclusion: 即使在严格的API限制下，也可以通过系统化的方法探测模型隐藏的设计选择，揭示了不同开发商的扩展战略差异。

Abstract: The parameter counts of the most widely used large language models (LLMs) are often withheld by their developers, leaving model size -- a primary reference point for interpreting capabilities and costs -- largely undisclosed. We propose a black-box method to infer conservative lower bounds on LLM size from generated text outputs alone, requiring nothing beyond the ability to submit text fragments and observe next-token predictions. Our approach is grounded in a key observation: popular, widely-circulated texts -- such as classical literature, religious texts, and foundational documents -- are present in virtually every large-scale pretraining corpus, and how accurately a model predicts the next word across text fragments of varying length is a reliable signal of how much it has memorized them, which in turn is fundamentally limited by its total parameter count. We aggregate this memorization signal across a diverse corpus of texts and fragment lengths into a single accuracy profile vector per model, and build two complementary inference methods on top of it: a pairwise statistical test that determines which of two models is larger, and a scaling-law estimator that extracts a one-dimensional latent index from these vectors via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to map the aggregated signal to a parameter count. Validated on a broad set of open-weight models, both methods produce accurate and reliable lower bounds. When applied to popular closed-weight models, our framework recovers internal product hierarchies and reveals a clear divergence in industry scaling strategies: while some developers yield significantly higher bounds indicative of large generational parameter growth, others operate under strict parameter ceilings, demonstrating that hidden design choices can be systematically probed even under strict API limitations.

</details>


### [546] [Deep Adaptive Dimension Reduction for Bayesian Inference in Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29373)
*Yueyang Wang,Xili Wang,Kejun Tang,Xiaoliang Wan,Tao Zhou,Chao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于变分流（VF）模型的深度自适应降维贝叶斯推断框架，通过VAE非线性降维与双归一化流结合、迭代先验更新策略以及自适应FNO代理模型，高效求解高维PDE控制反问题，在100维Rosenbrock问题和三个标准PDE反问题中优于MCMC、UKI和SVGD等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维PDE控制反问题面临三个主要挑战：复杂的非高斯后验分布、昂贵的正向模型评估以及错误设定的先验信息。现有方法难以同时有效应对这些问题。

Method: 1) 基于VF模型，将VAE非线性降维与双归一化流（潜在先验流和编码器流）相结合，克服标准归一化流因双射限制无法降维的问题；2) 提出迭代先验更新策略，逐步将先验均值移向高概率后验区域；3) 结合自适应微调的FNO代理模型，形成闭环自适应循环：VF生成后验集中样本以改进代理模型，更新后的代理模型进一步提升后验推断。

Result: 在100维Rosenbrock问题和三个标准PDE控制反问题上的数值实验表明，该方法在所有测试配置下均达到与MCMC、UKI、SVGD基线相当或更优的精度，在高噪声观测和高维参数空间等挑战性场景中优势最为显著。

Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了高维PDE反问题中非高斯后验、昂贵正向评估和先验误设等核心挑战，在精度和适应性方面均优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Solving high-dimensional PDE-governed inverse problems is often challenging due to complex non-Gaussian posterior distributions, expensive forward model evaluations, and misspecified prior information. To address these issues, we propose a deep adaptive dimension-reduction Bayesian inference framework based on the Variational Flow (VF) model. Since standard normalizing flows are restricted by bijective mappings and cannot directly reduce dimensions, VF overcomes this limitation by integrating VAE-based nonlinear dimension reduction with dual normalizing flows for the latent prior and encoder. This design provides a strictly higher evidence lower bound than VAE and allows more flexible approximation of complex posterior distributions. We further introduce an iterative prior updating strategy that gradually moves the prior mean toward high-probability posterior regions, avoiding manual prior tuning. These components form a closed adaptive loop together with an adaptively fine-tuned Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) surrogate: VF generates posterior-concentrated samples to refine the surrogate, while the updated surrogate further improves posterior inference. Numerical experiments on a 100-dimensional Rosenbrock problem and three standard PDE-governed inverse problems show that our method delivers competitive or superior accuracy compared with MCMC, UKI, and SVGD baselines across all tested configurations, with the most pronounced advantages emerging in challenging scenarios such as high-noise observations and high-dimensional parameter spaces.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [547] [AI Loss of Control Incident Management: Response & Resilience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30406)
*Ross Gruetzemacher*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个管理AI失控（LOC）灾难性事件的基础框架和分类法，区分了"极其昂贵"与"不可能"两种恢复控制场景，并将可管理事件进一步分为意外LOC（需自动断路器响应）和对抗性LOC（需逐步升级措施），通过三个严重等级映射到具体场景矩阵，为管理前所未有的AI风险提供了具体、成比例的指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究几乎完全聚焦于AI对齐和预防，缺乏针对AI失控（LOC）灾难性事件发生后的应急管理框架，这一空白亟需填补。

Method: 提出了一个分层分类法：第一层区分恢复控制"极其昂贵"与"不可能"两类场景；对于"极其昂贵"的可管理事件，进一步分为意外LOC（自动断路器响应）和对抗性LOC（逐步升级措施），并将三个严重等级映射到具体场景矩阵。

Result: 构建了涵盖恢复控制难度分级、事件类型分类和严重等级映射的具体框架，提供了从即时韧性投资到主动事件管理的完整方案。

Conclusion: 当前AI系统表现出的欺骗和抗关闭能力使AI失控成为紧迫的政策问题，该框架为管理前所未有的AI风险提供了具体、成比例的指南，其中不可控场景需要立即投资韧性以限制AI攻击面。

Abstract: Recent research demonstrating AI systems exhibiting deception and shutdown resistance suggests that AI loss of control (LOC) is an urgent policy concern , yet current literature focuses almost exclusively on alignment and prevention. To address this gap, this paper introduces a foundational framework and taxonomy for managing catastrophic AI LOC incidents. The taxonomy's first level distinguishes between scenarios where regaining control is 'extremely costly' versus 'impossible'. While impossible scenarios demand immediate resilience investments to fundamentally restrict an AI's attack surface , extremely costly scenarios require active incident management via Containment and Threat Neutralization. The framework further categorizes these manageable events into accidental LOC (requiring automated circuit-breaker responses) and adversarial LOC (requiring graduated escalatory measures). By mapping three severity classes to specific scenario matrices, this paper provides a concrete, proportional guide for managing unprecedented AI risks.

</details>


### [548] [Reinforcement Learning for Special Education: Aligning LLM Tutors to Diverse Learners through Disability-Adaptive Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30670)
*Unggi Lee,Jihoi Na,Yeil Jeong,Haeun Park,Yeonju Jang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出Special-R1框架，将强化学习驱动的LLM教学扩展到特殊教育领域，通过二维自适应系统提示（难度支持级别×残障教学风格）和基于残障档案的Thinking Reward，在690轮多轮对话测试中将个性化适配度从6.75提升至8.40，帮助性从0.720提升至0.768，同时保持通用基准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM教学对齐研究针对通用学习者和单一数学领域，未考虑残障学习者的认知与沟通多样性，缺乏面向特殊教育的对齐方法。

Method: (1) 二维自适应系统提示：耦合难度支持级别与五种残障档案对应的教学风格；(2) 基于残障档案的Thinking Reward，其评判标准依赖于学习者残障类型。

Result: 在690轮多轮对话测试中，全模型将个性化适配度从6.75提升至8.40(+1.65)，帮助性从0.720提升至0.768，综合得分2.911（领先第二名0.064），在通用基准OpenLearnLM上保持8.53（差距≤0.01）。

Conclusion: Thinking Reward仅在结合自适应提示时有效；针对特定数学学习障碍的剩余弱点表明需要多模态扩展。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as intelligent tutors, yet research on aligning them for special education remains absent. Recent work has applied reinforcement learning to LLM tutors, but these methods target a generic learner in a single domain (mathematics) and do not address the cognitive and communicative diversity of learners with disabilities. We introduce \emph{Special-R1}, a framework that extends pedagogical RL to special education through two components: (1) a two-dimensional adaptive system prompt that couples a difficulty-based support level with a disability-specific teaching style across five disability profiles; and (2) a persona-aware Thinking Reward whose judge rubric is conditioned on the learner's disability profile. On a persona-augmented test set of 690 multi-turn dialogues, our full model raises persona-aware Fit from 6.75 (generic baseline) to 8.40 (+1.65) and SPED-rubric Helpfulness from 0.720 to 0.768, leading on the four-component Total (2.911, +0.064 over the runner-up) while remaining within 0.01 of the strongest variant on the out-of-domain OpenLearnLM benchmark (8.53). Ablations show that the Thinking Reward becomes effective only in combination with adaptive prompting, and that residual weakness on specific learning disability in mathematics motivates targeted multimodal extensions.

</details>


### [549] [How Early Adopters Used Generative AI Worldwide: Variation by Country Income and Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30685)
*Madeleine I. G. Daepp,Isaac Slaughter*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 基于大规模匿名聊天机器人交互数据，研究发现不同国家早期用户的使用模式存在显著差异：低GDP国家以教育用途为主，高GDP国家以休闲用途为主；英语使用过度集中在非英语主导语言地区，表明语言性能提升对数字鸿沟或跨越式发展至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究AI聊天机器人的使用模式在不同国家之间的差异，以及这些差异与经济发展水平、语言等因素的关系，为理解AI技术是否会扩大或缩小数字鸿沟提供实证依据。

Method: 使用大规模匿名化、去标识化且经过隐私清洗的真实AI聊天机器人交互数据集，对跨国家的早期用户使用行为进行实证分析，考察使用领域（教育、休闲等）与GDP、语言之间的关联。

Result: 教育是大多数国家（尤其是低收入国家）最常见的用途，且教育与GDP呈强负相关；休闲用途与GDP呈正相关；英语交互在非英语主导语言地区被过度使用。

Conclusion: 提升模型在多语言上的表现可能是决定AI技术扩大数字鸿沟还是实现跨越式发展的关键因素。

Abstract: AI is being used by people globally, but not everyone is using it in the same ways. Using a large-scale dataset of anonymized, de-identified, and privacy-scrubbed interactions with a widely available and free AI chatbot, we empirically characterize differences in early adopters' usage across countries. Schooling is the most common domain of use in most countries, particularly low-income countries, with a strong inverse association evident between schooling and country-level GDP. Leisure-related use, by contrast, is positively associated with country-level income. Language, we find, also shapes use: English-language interactions are overrepresented in places where the predominant languages were not well-served by existing models during the period of the study. Improving performance across languages may be a key factor, our work suggests, in whether this technology expands digital divides or enables leapfrogging.

</details>


### [550] [Comparing LLM-Based Conversational and Graphical Interfaces for Industrial Decision Tasks: An Exploratory Mixed-Methods Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31224)
*Roberto Figliè,Simone Caputo,Alan Serrano,Tommaso Turchi,Daniele Mazzei*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过混合方法研究（20名参与者），比较了基于LLM的对话式UI与传统仪表盘在工业决策任务中的表现。结果表明对话式UI能减少交互成本、提供更直接的信息访问，而仪表盘在概览和验证方面仍有优势，但效果因任务复杂度而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI对话式UI在工业数据分析和决策中的潜力日益增长，但其相较于传统GUI仪表盘的实际效果尚未经过严格验证。作者旨在检验"LLM-based CUI能降低学习成本、自动化任务并辅助决策推理"这一承诺是否成立。

Method: 采用混合方法研究：20名参与者分别使用最先进的仪表盘和基于LLM的对话代理完成4个不同复杂度的模拟工业决策任务；测量指标包括心理负荷、完成时间、决策准确性，并结合问卷和半结构化访谈进行主题分析。

Result: 对话代理能减少交互努力、支持更直接的信息访问；仪表盘在提供数据概览和验证方面仍具价值；但优势因任务类型而异，需更大规模研究验证。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的对话式UI在工业决策中可降低交互成本，但无法完全替代传统仪表盘；两者在不同任务场景下各有优势，需进一步大规模研究确认其普适性。

Abstract: The use of Generative AI Conversational User Interfaces (CUI) as a new way to access and analyze data is growing in all sectors, and the industrial one is no exception. There, large amounts of data produced by IoT devices are flowing through user interfaces and may require them a new adaptation to the new analyses needs of decision-makers. LLM-based CUIs are promising a new way to directly interact with those data through the directness of natural language and without the learning costs that every GUI design has. Moreover, the capabilities of LLMs and their agency open up the possibility to automate some tasks and help with the reasoning during decision-making activities. But are this promises well founded? We try to scope this general question with a mixed-approach study comparing a state-of-the-art dashboard with a conversational agent. A total of 20 participants used both interfaces to complete four simulated industrial decision tasks of varying complexity. We combined measures of mental workload, completion time, and decision accuracy with a post-study questionnaire and semi-structured interviews analyzed through thematic analysis. The findings suggest that the conversational agent can reduce interactional effort by supporting more direct access to information, while the dashboard remains valuable for overview and verification. However, these benefits may vary across tasks and require validation through larger-scale studies.

</details>


### [551] [Neither Replacement nor Panacea: Comparing LLM-Based Conversational and Graphical Decision Support in Industrial Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31287)
*Roberto Figliè,Simone Caputo,Alan Serrano,Daria Mikhaylova,Tommaso Turchi,Daniele Mazzei*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过2x3混合因素实验（134名工业决策者），比较了基于LLM的对话界面与仪表盘在制造决策支持场景中的效果。结果表明：对话界面能降低整体心理负荷，在简单任务中速度更快，但随着任务复杂度增加优势消失；两种界面在决策准确性上无显著差异；对话界面不被用户作为唯一决策依据；数据素养未显著调节界面效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 制造业管理者依赖数字界面解读运营数据，但数据量与复杂性的增长使高效识别关键洞察变得困难。尽管仪表盘在工业场景中占主导地位，基于LLM的对话代理通过对话式用户界面可能提供更直接的数据访问，但其有效性可能取决于任务的信息处理需求，这一假设尚待验证。

Method: 采用2x3混合因素实验设计（界面类型×任务复杂度），134名工业决策者被分配至LLM对话界面或仪表盘条件，完成三种复杂度递增的任务。测量指标包括感知心理负荷、决策准确性、完成时间和意图依赖性，并检验自我报告的数据素养作为调节变量。

Result: 1）对话界面整体降低了感知心理负荷，在简单任务中完成速度更快，但随任务复杂度增加优势消失；2）两种界面在决策准确性上无一致优势；3）对话界面不被用户青睐作为后续决策的唯一依据；4）数据素养未可靠地调节界面效果。

Conclusion: 对话交互为工业决策支持提供的是条件性而非普遍性优势。基于LLM的对话代理可降低信息访问努力，但复杂决策仍需依赖持久、可检视的可视化表征。

Abstract: Managers in manufacturing settings rely on digital interfaces to interpret operational data for decision-making, but growing data volume and complexity can make relevant insights difficult to identify efficiently. While dashboards remain dominant in industrial contexts, Large Language Model (LLM)-based conversational agents (CAs), accessed through conversational user interfaces (CUIs), may provide more direct access to such data. However, their effectiveness may depend on the information-processing demands of the task. This study compares an LLM-based CA delivered through a CUI with a dashboard in a manufacturing decision-support scenario. In a mixed factorial experiment with a 2x3 design, 134 industrial decision-makers were assigned to one interface condition and completed three tasks of increasing complexity. We examined perceived Mental Workload (MWL), decision accuracy, completion time, and intended reliance, and tested self-reported data literacy as a moderator. Results showed that the CUI reduced perceived MWL overall and supported faster completion in less demanding tasks, but both advantages diminished as task complexity increased. Neither interface produced a consistent overall advantage in decision accuracy, and the CUI was not preferred as a sole basis for subsequent decisions. Furthermore, data literacy did not reliably moderate interface effects. These findings indicate that conversational interaction offers conditional rather than universal benefits for industrial decision support. LLM-based CAs may reduce information-access effort, whereas complex decisions continue to benefit from persistent, inspectable visual representations.

</details>


### [552] [Context-Conditioned Generative Models Enable Subnational Refinement of Sparse Humanitarian Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31489)
*Federica Sibilla,Vasiliki Voukelatou,Duccio Piovani,Kyriacos Koupparis,Daniela Paolotti,Rossano Schifanella,Kyriaki Kalimeri*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文评估了条件归一化流（conditional normalizing flows）在数据稀缺场景下对调查数据进行子国家层面（sub-national）分布细化的能力。在六个低收入或中等收入国家的八个人道领域数据集上，发现该方法能有效提升稀疏样本下的局部估计精度，且效果随条件信息丰富度增加而提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据稀缺限制了科学和政策领域的推断能力。调查数据对决策至关重要，但稀疏样本往往无法捕捉细粒度的空间异质性，亟需有效的数据增强方法。

Method: 采用条件归一化流（conditional normalizing flows）作为生成模型，学习复杂数据分布并以外生上下文特征为条件，在受控数据稀缺场景下进行系统评估。

Result: 在八个跨六国的调查数据集上，条件生成模型能够显著细化稀疏样本下的子国家层面分布，且性能随条件信息丰富度增加而系统性地提升。

Conclusion: 当稀疏样本保留足够支持且上下文协变量编码了相关局部异质性时，生成模型可有效改进子国家层面估计。通过学习完整条件分布而非点估计，该方法为人道主义决策和资源分配提供了细粒度证据。

Abstract: Data scarcity limits inference in many scientific and policy domains. Survey data are essential for decision-making, but sparse samples often fail to capture fine spatial granularities. We evaluate normalizing flows, a generative model that learns complex data distributions and can be conditioned on exogenous contextual features, in controlled data scarcity scenarios. Across eight household survey datasets spanning six low-income or middle-income countries in the humanitarian domain, we show that context-conditioned generative models can refine sub-national survey distributions under severe data scarcity, and that performance increases systematically with the richness of the conditioning information. These findings support a general principle for survey data augmentation: generative models can improve sub-national estimates when the sparse sample retains sufficient support and contextual covariates encode relevant local heterogeneity. By learning full conditional distributions rather than point estimates, the approach provides fine-grained evidence for humanitarian decision-making and resource allocation.

</details>


### [553] [The Refutability Gap: Challenges in Validating Reasoning by Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02380)
*Elchanan Mossel*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文指出当前关于大语言模型（LLM）具备科学发现和人类级通用智能的声明缺乏可证伪性，不满足波普尔科学哲学标准。作者识别了训练数据不透明、模型持续更新导致不可复现、忽略人机交互记录、缺乏反事实和失败数据等方法论缺陷，并提出了科学透明性与可复现性指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对近期声称LLM具备科学发现能力和人类级通用智能的论断，作者认为这些声明缺乏严格科学依据，未能满足波普尔的可证伪性原则，亟需建立科学透明的评估标准。

Method: 采用波普尔的可证伪性作为分析框架，系统识别当前AI推理研究中存在的方法论陷阱：训练数据不透明且不可检索、模型持续更新导致不可复现、忽略人机交互记录、缺乏反事实和失败尝试数据导致的偏差。并提出科学透明性与可复现性指南作为解决方案。

Result: 识别出多个影响LLM能力评估有效性的方法论问题：训练数据不可检索导致新颖性无法验证、模型版本迭代使实验不可复现、交互过程缺失混淆科学发现的真实来源、选择性偏差夸大LLM能力。提出了面向LLM推理研究的科学透明性与可复现性准则。

Conclusion: 建立科学透明性和可复现性指南对于维护科学诚信和公平数据使用的社会辩论至关重要，同时指出该问题与LLM生成内容的抄袭、检索与新颖性区分等更广泛议题相关联。

Abstract: Recent reports claim that Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved the ability to derive new science and exhibit human-level general intelligence. We argue that such claims are not rigorous scientific claims, as they do not satisfy Popper's refutability principle (often termed falsifiability), which requires that scientific statements be capable of being disproven. We identify several methodological pitfalls in current AI research on reasoning, including the inability to verify the novelty of findings due to opaque and non-searchable training data, the lack of reproducibility caused by continuous model updates, and the omission of human-interaction transcripts, which obscures the true source of scientific discovery. Additionally, the absence of counterfactuals and data on failed attempts creates a selection bias that may exaggerate LLM capabilities. To address these challenges, we propose guidelines for scientific transparency and reproducibility for research on reasoning by LLMs. Establishing such guidelines is crucial for both scientific integrity and the ongoing societal debates regarding fair data usage. We also discuss related issues such as the challenge of LLM-generated plagiarism and the general questions of retrieval vs. novelty in LLMs.

</details>


### [554] [The Global Landscape of Environmental AI Regulation: From the Cost of Reasoning to a Right to Green AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00068)
*Kai Ebert,Boris Gamazaychikov,Philipp Hacker,Sasha Luccioni*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文揭示了生成式Web搜索和推理模型的环境成本远高于前代AI技术，指出现有环境治理主要关注设施层面和训练阶段、缺乏推理能耗披露等监管盲区，并提出涵盖模型级透明度、用户选择权、国际协调的三方面政策建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统造成了巨大且不断增长的环境成本，然而在AI部署加速的同时，其环境影响透明度却在下降。现有监管体系未能有效覆盖新兴AI应用（尤其是2025年激增的生成式搜索和推理模型）的环境影响。

Method: 本文采用三管齐下的方法：(1) 收集生成式Web搜索和推理模型环境影响的实证证据；(2) 跨十一个司法辖区绘制全球监管格局地图，分析现有环境治理的局限性；(3) 提出包含模型级透明度、用户选择权和国际协调的三方面政策方案，并给出具体立法修改建议。

Result: 研究发现：生成式AI的环境累积影响远高于前代；现有环境治理主要在设施层面而非模型层面，关注训练而非推理，除欧盟外缺乏AI特定能源披露要求；现有监管框架适用性有限。

Conclusion: 本文提出强制性模型级透明度（覆盖推理能耗、基准测试、计算位置）、用户有权选择退出不必要的生成式AI集成并选择环境优化模型、以及国际协调以防止监管套利。同时提出对欧盟AI法案、消费者权利指令和数字服务法的具体修订建议，可作为其他司法辖区的模板。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems impose substantial and growing environmental costs, yet transparency about these impacts has declined even as their deployment has accelerated. This paper makes three contributions. First, we collate empirical evidence that generative Web search and reasoning models - which have proliferated in 2025 - come with much higher cumulative environmental impacts than previous generations of AI approaches. Second, we map the global regulatory landscape across eleven jurisdictions and find that the manner in which environmental governance operates (predominantly at the facility-level rather than the model-level, with a focus on training rather than inference, with limited AI-specific energy disclosure requirements outside the EU) limits its applicability. Third, to address this, we propose a three-pronged policy response: mandatory model-level transparency that covers inference consumption, benchmarks, and compute locations; user rights to opt out of unnecessary generative AI integration and to select environmentally optimized models; and international coordination to prevent regulatory arbitrage. We conclude with concrete legislative proposals - including amendments to the EU AI Act, Consumer Rights Directive, and Digital Services Act - that could serve as templates for other jurisdictions.

</details>


### [555] [Multi-Level Barriers to Generative AI Adoption Across Disciplines and Professional Roles in Higher Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27052)
*Jianhua Yang,Kerem Öge,Adrian von Mühlenen,Abdullah Bilal Akbulut,Tanya Suzanne Carey,Chidi Okorro*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过对英国罗素集团大学272名学术和专业服务人员的多方法调查分析，发现生成式人工智能（GenAI）在高等教育中的采用障碍并非源于个体因素，而是结构性产生的：非STEM人员主要报告伦理与文化障碍（学术诚信），而STEM和专业服务人员则强调制度、治理与基础设施限制。研究结论认为，大学需超越泛化培训，发展针对特定角色的治理与支持框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献常将GenAI采用障碍归因于个体层面的感知有用性和易用性，但跨学科和不同机构角色之间的结构性障碍尚待探索。本研究旨在考察学科背景和机构角色如何结构性地产生产生采用障碍，而非仅关注个体因素。

Method: 采用多方法调查分析，对英国罗素集团大学的272名学术与专业服务人员开展问卷调查，综合运用多项逻辑回归（MLR）、结构方程模型（SEM）以及对开放式回答的语义聚类分析，实现多层面的解释。

Result: 非STEM学术人员主要报告与学术诚信相关的伦理和文化障碍；STEM和专业服务人员则不成比例地强调制度、治理和基础设施约束。障碍呈现系统性、模式化的学科与角色差异。

Conclusion: GenAI采用障碍深嵌于组织生态系统和认识论规范之中，大学必须超越通用性培训，制定针对特定角色的治理与支持框架。

Abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly reshaping higher education, yet barriers to its adoption across different disciplines and institutional roles remain underexplored. Existing literature frequently attributes adoption barriers to individual-level factors such as perceived usefulness and ease of use. This study instead investigates whether such barriers are structurally produced. Drawing on a multi-method survey analysis of 272 academic and professional services (PSs) staff at a Russell Group university, we examine how disciplinary contexts and institutional roles shape perceived barriers. By integrating multinomial logistic regression (MLR), structural equation modelling (SEM), and semantic clustering of open-ended responses, we move beyond descriptive accounts to provide a multi-level explanation of GenAI adoption. Our findings reveal clear, systematic differences: non-STEM academics primarily report ethical and cultural barriers related to academic integrity, whereas STEM and PSs staff disproportionately emphasize institutional, governance, and infrastructure constraints. We conclude that GenAI adoption barriers are deeply embedded in organizational ecosystems and epistemic norms, suggesting that universities must move beyond generalized training to develop role-specific governance and support frameworks.

</details>


### [556] [Who, Why, and How: Disentangling the Effects of Moderation Source, Context, and Language on Post-Removal Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16204)
*Siyi Zhou,Lindsay Young,Marlon Twyman,Emilio Ferrara*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于Reddit 1179万条 moderation 事件数据，发现机器人版主相比人类版主能产生更高的合规率和更低的自我审查；违规严重度调节了语言策略的效果——常规情境下有效的策略（详细解释、社区诉求、直接称呼）在严重违规时会适得其反，而亲社会框架和情感强调在严重违规时最有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将内容审核视为统一干预，忽略了审核者来源、违规情境和语言风格三者如何共同塑造用户行为，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 基于HAII-TIME理论框架，使用Reddit 2021-2025年1179万条审核事件数据，结合概率行为分类、ANOVA、OLS回归及PCA衍生的语言特征进行分析。

Result: 机器人审核比人类/团队审核带来更高合规率和更低自我审查；团队审核导致最强的自我审查效应；违规严重度调节语言策略效果——常规情境有效的策略在严重违规时适得其反，亲社会框架和情感强调在高风险时最有效；480个语言交互中33个通过FDR校正。

Conclusion: 将违规显著性引入HAII-TIME作为线索加工的调节变量，为情境自适应审核设计提供了实证基础。

Abstract: Content moderation is a central mechanism through which platforms attempt to balance user engagement with community governance. Yet existing research has largely treated moderation as a uniform intervention, overlooking how moderator source, violation context, and linguistic style jointly shape user behavior. Drawing on the Human--AI Interaction Theory of Interactive Media Effects (HAII-TIME), this study examines how these three dimensions produce divergent post-moderation behavioral trajectories in a large-scale observational dataset of 11,795,036 moderation events across 9,285,410 users and 61,261 subreddits on Reddit (2021--2025). Using probabilistic behavioral classification, ANOVA, and OLS regression with PCA-derived linguistic features, we find that bot moderation consistently produces higher compliance and lower self-censorship than human or modteam moderation, challenging the assumption that human agency cues are inherently advantageous. Modteam moderation produces the strongest self-censorship effects, suggesting that institutional depersonalization is a meaningful driver of behavioral withdrawal. Violation severity emerges as a critical contingency: linguistic strategies effective in routine contexts -- elaborated explanation, community-scale appeals, direct personal address -- can backfire for serious violations, whereas prosocially framed and emotionally emphatic messages become most effective when stakes are highest. Of 480 linguistic interactions tested, 33 survive FDR correction. These findings extend HAII-TIME by introducing violation salience as a moderator of cue-based processing, and offer empirical grounding for context-adaptive moderation design.

</details>

### [557] [Identifying Connectivity Distributions from Neural Dynamics Using Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26506)
*Timothy Doyeon Kim,Ulises Pereira-Obilinovic,Yiliu Wang,Eric Shea-Brown,Uygar Sümbül*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于最大熵和连续归一化流（CNF）的推理框架，用于从神经群体记录中推断低秩循环神经网络（lrRNN）的连接结构，解决了标准方法中连接结构不可识别的问题。该方法学习连接权重的分布而非单一矩阵，在匹配观测动力学的同时保持对不可识别分量的最大无偏性，能捕捉经验数据中的重尾分布等复杂结构。在合成数据和大鼠前额叶皮层记录中验证了有效性，将电路推理从恢复连接转向识别计算必需的连接结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从神经群体记录中推断连接结构存在退化问题：多种连接结构可以生成完全相同的动力学。标准lrRNN训练方法可能恢复出与底层动力学无关的虚假结构，需要解决连接结构的可识别性问题。

Method: 首先刻画lrRNN中连接结构的可识别性条件，确定存在唯一解的条件。然后开发基于最大熵和连续归一化流（CNF）的推理框架，通过流匹配训练。该方法学习连接权重上的分布，在匹配观测动力学的同时，对不可识别分量保持最大无偏性。

Result: 在合成数据集上验证了方法能够正确推断生成多稳态吸引子、极限环和环吸引子的连接结构，并在大鼠前额叶皮层决策任务记录中展示了实际应用能力。

Conclusion: 该框架将电路推理的范式从恢复单一连接结构转向识别哪些连接结构是计算必需的、哪些是欠约束推理产生的伪影，为神经回路的结构-功能映射提供了更可靠的方法。

Abstract: Connectivity structure shapes neural computation, but inferring this structure from population recordings is degenerate: multiple connectivity structures can generate identical dynamics. Recent work uses low-rank recurrent neural networks (lrRNNs) to infer low-dimensional latent dynamics and connectivity from observed activity, enabling a mechanistic interpretation of the dynamics. However, standard approaches for training lrRNNs can recover spurious structures irrelevant to the underlying dynamics. We first characterize the identifiability of connectivity structures in lrRNNs and determine conditions under which a unique solution exists. To find such solutions, we develop an inference framework based on maximum entropy and continuous normalizing flows (CNFs), trained via flow matching. Instead of estimating a single connectivity matrix, our method learns a distribution over connection weights that is maximally unbiased over unidentifiable components while matching the observed dynamics. This approach captures complex yet necessary distributions such as heavy-tailed connectivity found in empirical data. We validate our method on synthetic datasets with connectivity structures that generate multistable attractors, limit cycles, and ring attractors, and demonstrate its applicability in recordings from rat frontal cortex during decision-making. Our framework shifts circuit inference from recovering connectivity to identifying which connectivity structures are computationally required, and which are artifacts of underconstrained inference.

</details>


### [558] [Neural Manifolds as Crystallized Embeddings: A Synthesis of the Free Energy Principle, Generalized Synchronization, and Hebbian Plasticity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04200)
*Vikas N. O'Reilly-Shah*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出广义同步（GS）作为自由能原理的底层神经实现机制：收缩性递归电路通过感觉驱动同步将低维感觉流形嵌入神经状态空间，再通过Hebbian可塑性形成连续吸引子网络，最终解释头部方向、网格细胞等成熟神经流形的发育过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由能原理将知觉建模为变分推理，但其生物学实现机制不明确，广义坐标形式主义不能直接解释神经元如何计算任意泰勒展开，需要一种自底向上的神经机制。

Method: 提出三个相互作用的机制：1) 动力收缩（contracting dynamics）使递归电路具有指数收敛的轨迹；2) 广义同步（generalized synchronization）使电路与感觉输入同步，将低维感觉流形嵌入神经状态空间；3) 基于相关性的Hebbian可塑性将嵌入流形塑造成递归连接，形成连续吸引子网络。

Result: 预测-分离界限（prediction-separation bounds）表明：网络预测准确时，同步映射能分离潜在状态；预测失败时，表征坍缩，表现为类别感知、等视知觉和辨别阈值等现象。成熟的头朝向、网格细胞和视觉流形是这三种过程相互作用的发展产物。

Conclusion: 自由能原理预测的几何结构并非来自显式的贝叶斯神经计算，而是来自普通的递归动力学。关键未解决问题是Hebbian不动点的存在性及Hebbian动力学能否在相关输入分布上产生足够准确的预测器。

Abstract: The free energy principle casts perception as variational inference, but its biological implementation is underspecified. The generalized-coordinate formalism is not a literal claim that neurons compute arbitrary Taylor expansions. This paper argues that generalized synchronization (GS) provides the missing bottom-up mechanism. Certain recurrent circuits satisfy a contraction property: nearby trajectories converge exponentially. A contracting circuit driven by structured sensory input synchronizes to driving dynamics. Under generic embedding conditions, the resulting synchronization map embeds the low-dimensional sensory manifold into neural state space. The geometry predicted by the free energy principle is not imposed from above by an explicitly Bayesian neural calculus. It arises from ordinary recurrent dynamics.
  I then propose a developmental extension. Hebbian plasticity acting on the correlations generated by sensory-driven synchronization shapes the embedded manifold into recurrent connectivity, producing a continuous attractor network that approximates the embedded sensory manifold. Prediction-separation results bound the representational fidelity of the resulting circuit by prediction accuracy: where the network predicts future observations well, the synchronization map separates underlying states; where prediction fails, the representation collapses. The collapses are observable as categorical perception, metameric equivalence, and discrimination thresholds. On this view, mature head-direction, grid-cell, and stimulus-driven visual manifolds are developmental products of three interacting processes: dynamical contraction, generalized synchronization, and correlation-based plasticity. The central open problems are whether the Hebbian fixed point exists and whether Hebbian dynamics produce a sufficiently accurate predictor on the relevant input distribution.

</details>
